tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ /
'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so//

oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ khrom gzigs rngam klong gter byon drag sgrub rmad/ /dug ri me 'bar chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de'ang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni yi dam gyi sgrub skor te/ zab gter bdun cu las/ mtha' dmag zlog byed drag po'i chos bzhi'i nang tshan 'jam dpal drag po gshin rje dug ri me 'bar zhes gshed skor rgya mtsho'i snying bcud yin te/ gter gzhung dbang gi lo rgyus las/ 'di nyid shin tu bka' gnyan la byin rlabs che: rgyu mtshan ci zhe na kho bo gnubs ston pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sprul pa dngos yin zhing gshin rje'i bdag po mchog yin la: khyad par sangs rgyas ye shes kyi bstan pa srung zhing dmod pas 'phung 'tshengs nus pa'i gshin rje'i chos ka tshan gnyis sbas pa ste: thog mar bdag dum rgya zhang khrom gyi dus: gshin rje ya gab gsang khrid gong ma rgyud bzhi la: 'jigs byed khro chu dgra nag gdong drug me'i spu gri tshe bdag sman gdong la sogs rgyud bzhi dang cha lag bco brgyad kyis brgyan pa gdan drangs: da lta bdag rtsa gsum gling pa'i dus 'dir gshin rje'i ya gab gsang khrid 'og ma: rgyud bzhi la: dug ri nag po me 'obs khrag mtsho 'khor lo zangs mtsho 'khor lo gsal shing 'khor lo'am: ya ma snying gzer: had pa kha tham sogs rgyud bzhi dang cha lag bco brgyad kyis spras pa gdan drangs pa'i gshin rje'i bdag nyid kho bo yin pas brgyud pa nye khyad kyis byin rlabs shin tu che'o: zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'di ga'i rgyud lung man ngag gi skor phal cher dus 'gyur rlung dmar gyis khyer nas slar mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod du bsdus par mngon no/ /skabs 'dir rnyed son ji byung rnams kyi them byang 'god pa la/

zab pa gter gzhung gi skor dang yan lag chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor ro/ ༈ dang po gter gzhung la/ ka) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus las: dbang bskur bsdus pa rab 'bar rdo rje'i mtshon cha rlung gi 'khor lo/ kha) bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar las: brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rdo rje'i drwa ba/ ga) 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus las: sgrub pa'i phrin las pha rol rgol 'joms gnam lcags thog mda'/ nga) 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi sgrub pa ngan sngags zhag sgrub dug gi par bu nag po spu gri'i mtshon cha/ ca) 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar las: khro chu dug gdong gi mngon rtogs las sngags dang bcas pa/ cha) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: bskang ba rngam phreng 'bar ba gdug pa'i g.yul las rgyal byed/ ja) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: dpal khrag 'thung mgon po ma hā kā la legs ldan bya rog gdong gi gsol mchod srog gzan nag po byad ma rtsad brlag nya) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen gyi gsol mchod/ ta) gza' yi gtor 'bul gnam lcags ral gri/ tha) khyab 'jug dug mtsho khol ma las: bstod bskul me rlung thog char rab tu 'bar ba/ ༈ smad las srung bsad bzlog gsum gyi skor la/ da) 'jam dpal dug ri nag po'i srung bzlog gi dmigs rim/ na) bsad pa'i dmigs pa/ pa) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: bskul pa me rlung thog char/ pha) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: bzlog pa spu gri'i 'khor lo/ ba) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: srin mo za lam zor gyi sgo 'byed/ ma) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: dgongs gsol dgra bgegs dpung 'joms/ ༈ mnan pa la/

tsa) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: dgra brub dang mnan pa'i las rim dug mda' nag po/ tsha) dpal chen 'jigs byed rngam pa las: dgra bo klu la gtad pa nyi ma'i 'khor lo/ dza) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: las kyi gshin rje nag po'i thebs ldog rgyu gsum/ ༈ yan lag kha skong dang chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor la/ wa) 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi ngan sngags zhag sgrub chog bsgrigs bklag chog tu bkod pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba/ zha) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi bsnyen sgrub sogs nyer mkho'i phrin las snying po gsal byed/ za) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun khyer/ 'a) sman mchod shrī'i ming gis sbyar ba/ ya) bdud rtsi lag mchod mdzad byang mi gsal ba/ ra) cho ga'i zur 'debs/ la) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi skong ba bsdus pa/ sha) las mgon bya rog gdong gi bskang bstod/ sa) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: bsnyen sgrub kha skong rten 'brel rnam gsum la brten pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'khor 'das rang grol/ ha) 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar gyi bsnyen yig yang snying kun 'dus/ 'phang ba zor gyi las tshogs la/ a) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las/ smad las spu gri dmar po'i tha mar sbyar ba bklag chog tu bkod pa/ ki) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las/ bzlog pa spu gri'i 'khor lo bklag chog tu bkod pa pha rol rgol 'joms/ khi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi rtsang bzlog pho nya bsgyur chog gi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las/ bskul bzlog bsad pa smad las bcas/ ngi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi gser skyems shan pa dmag bskul/ gnyis pa bsreg pa me'i las tshogs la/

ci) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi drag po'i sbyin sreg las mtha' gdug pa kun 'joms/ gsum pa brub pa mnan pa'i las tshogs/ chi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi/ sri mnan pa'i cho ga gter gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar nag 'gros bklag chog tu bkod pa/ ji) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar khro bo kun 'dus kyi dgra brub las kyi rlung dmar/ nyi) sri mnan skabs 'gugs gzhug bsdus pa/ ti) 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ thi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi zin bris snang gsal khrag 'thung rngam byed/ di) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi mnan pa bya ba'i cho ga'i dmar khrid yig chung*/ ni) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las/ bzlog pa'i zin bris bla ma'i zhal shes bstan dgra sgrol ba'i mtshon cha pha rol g.yul zlog pi) 'don bsgrigs zin bris mdzad byang mi gsal ba/ phi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi 'don bsgrigs zin bris bla ma'i zhal shes ltar ma nan ta ma tis sbyar ba bcas chos tshan zhe bzhi bzhugs so/ /zhi la 'jam pa'i dpal gyur ye shes sems/ /drag tu khros pa 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed/ /dug ri me 'bar bdud sde'i tshang tshing dpung*/ /rmang med sreg mdzad mngon spyod phrin las rmad/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e wam̐ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa de bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/

// ka) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus las: dbang bskur bsdus pa rab 'bar rdo rje'i mtshon cha rlung gi 'khor lo bzhugs so: bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod: sa ma ya: e maḥ thabs mkhas thugs rje'i dbang phyug pad 'byung ngas: gangs can bstan 'gro'i ched du legs bkod 'di: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar dbang chog bstan: shes rab drwa ba'i gar bsgyur dbyangs can mas: brda ru gzugs shing gsang ba'i gter du sbos: bka' yi rgya 'di legs ldan mgon pos srungs: skal ldan las can thugs kyi sras la sprod: snod min bdud rigs lag tu ma shor rgya: sa ma ya: de nas dbang bskur bya ba'i rim pa ni: bum pa rgyan ldan sum gnyis bdud rtsis gtams: gtor ma bdud rtsi tsa ka li la sogs: gzhung tshig bzhin tu dgos pa'i las rim dang : dbang sgrub byed pa'i mchod rdzas rnams kyang bsham: las rim gzhung bsrang tshogs las grub pa'i rjes: dngos gzhi dbang la 'jug par byed pa ni: slob mar khrus bstsal mdun du gral la 'god: bgegs bskrad bgyis te sngon 'gro'i chab kyang btang : bsod nams tshogs rdzogs maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i mthar: dam tshig 'bog phyir rdo rje'i mna' chu ni: dung zhal gzar bu phyag tu thogs byas nas: hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig gsang ba'i chu: rdo rje'i khas blangs ldan rnams 'thung : dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob: ma bsrung dmyal ba'i rgyu yin phyir: las kyi gshin rjes brdeg par 'gyur: oṃ sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes dam chu byin: so sos khas blang bya: de nas las rim la 'jug pa ni: slob mas: kyaiḥ yang dag rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: dkyil 'khor gnyan la bdag 'jug phyir: dpa' bo chen pos rjes bzung stsol: bla mas: hoḥ 'di ni 'jam dpal gshin rje yi: yang gsang ye shes pho brang ste: dam med rnams kyis mi rig par: de ltar khas blangs dbang mchog sbyin:

slob mas: kyaiḥ nged cag las 'phro skal bar ldan: yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di la mos: dam tshig mchog bsrung gnang ba stsol: bla mas: hoḥ khyed rnams dam ldan snod 'chang na: yang gsang thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: smin grol don stsol bya phyir 'jug: de nas ma dag pa'i shes sgrib sbyang phyir bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: bsang chu 'thor zhing : oṃ hriṣ+ṭi waṣ+ṭi ta na na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis e nam mkha' mthing nag gi rang bzhin pho brang khro chu khol ma tshwa tshwa lam lam khol ba'i dbus su: ya ma bam las gshin rje ma rungs pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du bam ro smug nag gi snying khar gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa: de las 'od zer 'phros pas dgra bgegs dang gnod byed bgegs tshogs thams cad tshar bcad: 'od zer gyis mthu stobs gzi byin thams cad tshur bsdus hūm̐ dang rdo rje la stim: de yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar nag po rtsa zhal ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can: g.yas g.yon dang brtsegs ma'i zhal du shin tu khro ba'i spyi gtsug tu 'jam dpal nag po'i dbang rtags rdzogs pa: phyag so bzhi dang ldan zhing g.yas pa bcu drug gi mtshon cha ni: gri khug ral gri chu gri me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje 'khor lo mdung thung lcags kyu spu gri dbyug tho ḍā ma ru dgra satwa zhags pa tho ba gsal shing rgyal mtshan bsnams pa'o: g.yon pa bcu drug gi mtshon cha ni: thod khrag snying phreng rgyu ma gtun khung lcags sgrog rnga chung mgo phreng ru mtshon dug rlangs dril bu me long rkong zor khram shing shwa rdel rtsis rdo g.yang gzhi 'dzin pa'o: rtsa phyag gnyis kyis gnam lcags las kyi phur bu bsgril ba: sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan zhing rdo rje'i sgro gshog bar snang mkha' la gzengs pa:

lte bar chu srin rngam pa'i zhal gdangs shing sku smad gnam lcags ngar ldan gyi phur gsham 'dril ba bam chen gyi snying khar brjid pa: de'i pang du yum chen dur khrod kyi bdag mo dug ti ma dmar mo: zhal gsum phyag drug ma: rtsa phyag gnyis kyis gri thod 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud pa: lhag ma bzhis rdo rje dang phur bu 'khor lo dang ral gri 'dzin cing : zhabs bzhi sked la 'khril nas yab yum me ri drag tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa: spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'jam dpal nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis dor stabs su bzhugs pa: de'i spyi bor tshe bdag dmar ser mnyam bzhag can lham mer gsal ba'o: gtso bo'i shar du tshe bdag nag po: lhor khro chu dug gdong : nub tu dgra nag dregs pa: byang du ki kang spu gri: de thams cad kyang shin tu khros shing dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa sku smad gnam lcags dbal zur ldan pa'o: gzhan yang sprul 'khor gshin rje'i sgo skyong dang bcas par gsal ba'i dpral bar om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dang ya dmar nag las 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod rngam chen 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te slob ma la thim par sgoms shig: om̐ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya āḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: las kyi gshin rje nag po mthu bo che: sku mchog khro bos snang srid dbang bsgyur phyir: skad cig gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mthu rtsal bskyed la dbang chen deng 'dir bskur: om̐ sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes pas rdo rje rgya gram bya: slob mas: hoḥ bla ma gshin rje'i gshed po dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la: lus ngag yid kyis gsol ba 'debs: sgo gsum mi dge mthol lo bshags: rdzu 'phrul mnga' la rjes yi rangs: drag po mthu yi dbang bskur stsol:

ces pas gsol ba lan gsum btab nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas ngo sprod cing sku'i dbang bskur ba ni: bum pa thogs la: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal dpa' bo rdo rje nag po che: sku yi gzi brjid lus la bstim pa'i phyir: bum pa'i dbang bskur bskyed rim mthar phyin mchog: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ya mān+ta ka kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas gsung gi dbang bskur ba ni: ngo sprod dang bcas te bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal dpa' bo rdo rje nag po che: gsung gi gzi brjid ngag la bstim pa'i phyir: bhan+dha'i dbang bskur drag sngags nus rtsal mngon: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ya mān+ta ka wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas thugs kyi dbang bskur ba ni: ngo sprod cing gnam lcags kyi mchod rten thogs la: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal dpa' bo rdo rje nag po yi: thugs kyi gzi byin sems la bstim pa'i phyir: mchod rten dbang bskur gnas lugs don ston rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ya mān+ta ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

zhes me tog 'thor: de nas yon tan dbang bskur ngo sprod cing gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal dpa' bo rdo rje nag po che: yon tan gzi byin khyab par bstim pa'i phyir: gtor ma'i dbang bskur bka' sdod dam tshig che: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ya mān+ta ka gu ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor: de nas phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba ngo sprod cing rdo rje phur pa thogs la: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal dpa' bo rdo rje nag po che: phrin las gzi byin rtsal bcu'i don ston phyir: phyag mtshan dbang bskur las mtha' kun kyang 'grub: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ya mān+ta ka gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor: de nas tshe dpag med kyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: shes rab 'bar ba'i rtsal chen gzhon nu'i sku: 'chi med mgon po dmar ser li khri'i mdangs: sgrub la 'ja' lus rig 'dzin stsol ba'i phyir: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ.āḥyur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas 'jam dpal kyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: rmongs tshogs rab gzhom dpa' bo 'jam dpal dbyangs: sa lam rab rdzogs sgeg pa'i cha byad can: sku yi rigs bdag phrin las rdzogs pa'i phyir: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ wa gī shwa ri tshan+dha sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gshin rje'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: sku mchog gshin rje rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ pha rol gdug pa'i rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: khro rgyal dug ri me 'bar yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ ya mān+ta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas tshe bdag gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: gsung mchog gshin rje rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ pha rol gdug pa'i rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: khro rgyal tshe bdag nag po yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ ya mān+ta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas khro chu dug gdong gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: thugs mchog gshin rje rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ pha rol gdug pa'i rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: khro rgyal khro chu dug gdong yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ ya mān+ta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dgra nag gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: yon tan gshin rje rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ pha rol gdug pa'i rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: khro rgyal dgra nag dregs 'dul yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ ya mān+ta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas ki kang gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: phrin las gshin rje rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ pha rol gdug pa'i rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: khro rgyal ki kang spu gri yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ ya mān+ta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sgo ma rigs bzhi'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ dzaḥ gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' nyan pa: myur mgyogs las bzhi phrin las sgrub: dam tshig bstan ba'i bya ra mkhan: rigs bzhi sgo skyong dbang bskur ro: om̐ ya mān dā dra bā la tsa tur a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur dang khro bo kun 'dus dur khrod kyi chas la sogs pas dbang chen ltar bskur na: zur rgyan lhan thabs su gsal: de nas dbang bzhi ye shes lnga'i ngo sprod ni: thog mar bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa 'ja' lus rdo rje'i mkha': snang stong sku yi dkyil 'khor che: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal btab lha khrid don thob shog: om̐ kā ya swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'o des ngo sprod bskyed rim snang stong yid gzugs rang rig lha sku stong gsal sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rang rtsal gyi ngo sprod thob pa yin pas deng phyin chad 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor du byas so: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas gsung gi ngo sprod ni:

me tog gi phreng ba thogs la: hūm̐: sngags phreng 'byung 'jug skye med sgra: grags stong bde chen gsang ba'i lam: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phyag rgya drug gi don thob shog: om̐ wāk+ka swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'o des gsang dbang bde stong drug 'dren thob ste lam pho nya mtha' ru phyin pas 'bras bu dga' bzhi lhan skyes kyi ngo 'phrod: sgra grags stong gling bu'i 'phrul 'khor ltar shes te zung 'jug sngags kyi rnal 'byor la dbang bar byas so: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas thugs kyi ngo sprod ni: me long dang shel rdo thogs la: hūm̐: thugs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po nyid: gsal stong ka dag lhun gyis grub: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: don gsal shes rab mchog thob shog: om̐ tsit+ta swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa ham̐'u: 'o des gnas lugs skye med rang byung gi ngo sprod thob: grol ba ye shes lnga'i gdeng dang ldan te dran rig 'od gsal chen po'i 'bras bu thob pas deng phyin chad a ti bya bral chen po'i rnal 'byor la dbang bar byas so: zhes ngo sprod byas shing me tog 'thor maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas bka' yi glegs bam thogs la: hūm̐: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi: bka' yi 'dus sde ma lus kun: gcig tu bsdus pa 'di gtad pas: tshig dbang sna tshogs thob par shog: om̐ gu ya swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'o des gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i bka' yi sde lhug par brjod pa dang tshigs su bcad pa dum bur phyung ba ched du brjod pa so sor dbye ba: ngo bo tha dad mi phyed pa dbyangs su bsnyad pa lung du bstan pa bka' yis gdams pa: skyes rabs bsdu ba rmad du byung ba drang por ston pa: nges par sprad pa: zung du gnas pa la tan+t+ra kṛ ya chen por 'dus pa'i tshig dbang ngo sprod thob pa yin pas: deng phyin chad 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la sogs pa chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rnal 'byor la dbang bar byas so:

zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas phrin las kyi ngo sprod la: hūm̐: zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi yi: phrin las ston par byed pa'i snod: de ring slob bu khyod la gtad: mtha' sdud spyi rigs 'dzin par gyis: om̐ gu h+ya swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'o des las mtha' phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas smin cing grol ba dang : mngon spyod kyi mthu la sogs pa ched du smod pa dang ris su med pa'i gzhung bsrang mtha' sdud pa thams cad las tsam rung ba'i rnal 'byor du dbang bar byas so: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas slob ma rnams la dam tshig sbyin pa ni: hoḥ bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed po yi: zhe sdang ma spangs dam tshig gcig: rtag tu srog gcod mthu yang sgrub: dug lnga'i khrag la dgyes par gyis: nga rgyal ma spangs dam tshig tu: rtag tu nga rgyal khro gtum bskyed: phung po lnga yi khrag la dgyes: 'dod chags ma spangs dam tshig tu: khro mo yum la rtag tu rol: nyon mongs lnga yi khrag la dgyes: phrag dog ma spangs dam tshig tu: dmod pa'i ngan sngags rtag tu 'dren: 'du khams lnga yi khrag la dgyes: gti mug ma spangs dam tshig tu: dmod pa nag po'i cha lugs 'chang : ye shes lnga nyid rtag tu 'dren: las kun ma spangs 'grub pa'i phyir: dgra sha khrag gi mchod tshogs kyi: skong bshags dus gtor brtson par gyis: de'ang dag pa'i dam tshig rtag tu mi g.yel zhing rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du 'chang bar bya'o: de nas slob ma snod ldan yin na 'jam dpal gshin rje'i rnal 'byor du bka' bsgo smon lam 'dud pa ni: hoḥ chos sku kun tu bzang po: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro: longs sku tshe bdag dbang phyug: sprul sku 'jam dpal gzhon nu: mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: bdud 'joms khrag 'thung rdo rje:

o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa: rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje: chos bdag 'jam dpal mtshan can: rig 'dzin mkhas mchog rdo rje: sngags 'chang kun dga' snying po: mkhas grub don yod rgyal mtshan: kun mkhyen ngag dbang mtshan can: dpal ldan grags pa rnam rgyal: dge legs nyi ma rgyal mtshan: grub thob rdo rje rgyal mtshan: yongs grags nam mkha' dbang phyug: mtshungs med pad+ma mchog grub: rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la sogs skyes chen dam pa rnams dang : khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje khro rgyal dug ri me 'bar gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol: sku mnyam par gshin rje'i gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur cig: gsung mnyam par gshin rje'i bden stobs dang ldan par gyur cig: thugs mnyam par gshin rje'i mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur cig: yon tan mnyam par gshin rje'i nus stobs dang ldan par gyur cig: phrin las mnyam par gshin rje'i dmod pa dang ldan par gyur cig: las kun la thogs pa med pa gshin rje'i mngon spyod dang ldan par gyur cig: om̐ ya mān+ta ka sarba tsit+ta dzñā na hūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa a āḥ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa sogs brjod: maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing me tog 'thor: sa ma ya: khyad par dbang 'di shin tu bka' gnyan la byin rlabs che: rgyu mtshan ci zhe na kho bo gnubs ston pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sprul pa dngos yin zhing gshin rje'i bdag po mchog dang : khyad par sangs rgyas ye shes kyi bstan pa srung zhing dmod pas 'phung 'tshengs nus pa'i gshin rje'i chos ka tshan gnyis sbas pa ste: thog mar bdag dum rgya zhang khrom gyi dus: gshin rje ya gab gsang khrid gong ma rgyud bzhi la: 'jigs byed khro chu dgra nag gdong drug me'i spu gri tshe bdag sman gdong la sogs rgyud bzhi dang cha lag bco brgyad kyis brgyan pa gdan drangs:

da lta bdag rtsa gsum gling pa'i dus 'dir gshin rje'i ya gab gsang khrid 'og ma: rgyud bzhi la: dug ri nag po me 'obs khrag mtsho 'khor lo zangs mtsho 'khor lo gsal shing 'khor lo'am: ya ma snying gzer: had pa kha tham sogs pa rgyud bzhi dang cha lag bco brgyad kyis spras pa gdan 'dren pa'i gshin rje'i bdag nyid kho bo yin pas brgyud pa nye khyad kyis byin rlabs shin tu che'o: gong du bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i brgyud rim de rnams da lta bzhugs pa dang ma 'ongs pa dag tu 'byon pa rnams la lung ston pa yin: ji bzhin lung 'di'i mtshan 'dzin pa'i skyes bu de byung ba'i dus su gshin rje'i las kun bsgrub cing thogs med 'grub pa'i skal pa mchis: chos 'di 'don zhing spel ba'i dus de dang mtshungs pa'i gter min bdud rigs gsum 'byung : de rnams dang srin mo gsum mi nag bdud rigs bzhi yod pa de 'brel na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu 'tshe bas: de rnams khro rgyal dug ri me 'bar gyis tshar gcod par gyur cig: ces yig chung 'di lung rgya ma nyams pa'i kha byang nas phab pa'o: sa ma ya: e maḥ kho bo bdag 'dra gu ru rgya gar pas: yang zab gshin rje'i man ngag khyad can ni: dbang bskur rdo rje'i go cha rlung 'khor bzhag: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma ru: thugs sras dzñā na'i sprul par 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di legs ldan mgon pos srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos 'jam dpal gyi gnas khrom gzigs nas lcags glang lor gdan drangs shing chu stag lor shog ser nas bsgyur ba'o/ /bkra shis par gyur cig/ // kha) bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar las: brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rdo rje'i drwa ba bzhugs so: ma lus gang zhig srid mtshos 'ching ba rnam par grol mdzad dpa' bo 'jam dpal gzhon nur rnam par grol ba'i sku la 'dud:

sa ma ya: de'ang skyabs yul brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di la 'jug par 'dod pa'i skal ldan blo'i pad+mo rab tu bye ba'i rnal 'byor pa de nyid yi dam rim gnyis kyi bzhed don ltar dwang ba'i snang bas gya nom lhar zhen med pa'i ngang nas brtsam mo: na mo: snang srid bdag med pa ngo bo stong gsal ma 'gags mi 'gyur ba kun tu klong chen po'i rang bzhin 'byams klas pa'i ngang las: bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pas mtha' yas pa'i sems can phal mo che rnams: yun ring 'khor ba'i duḥkhas gdung ba dag la rab tu brtse ba'i shugs kyis snying rje phan sems rlabs bskyed pa dang : gzhan gyis bgyid pa la rjes su yi rangs shing dge ba'i bskul ma dam pas rjes su bzung zhing yongs su mi gtong bar bya ba'i phyir: dus deng nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dam bca' gsum gyi sdom pa las mi 'da' zhing : rtsa ba dang yan lag gi sgo nas dkyil 'khor zab mo bla med rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas 'bras bu gsang sngags ting nge 'dzin la rab tu gnas par bya'o: om̐ na mo mañdzu shrī badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐: hoḥ sems can thams cad bde ba'i tshogs la 'god: sdug bsngal srid pa'i rgya mtsho rab skem nas: mthar thug bde ba nam yang mi 'bral zhing : srid 'khrul zhi gol med par btang snyoms 'god: na mo: snang srid gdod nas dag pa chos kyi dbyings: snod bcud skye 'gag mtha' bral khyab brdal ngang : ci yang ma nges ci yang 'byung ba'i rgyu: rnam pa mtshan mas ma bskyed ma bsdus pa: rig cing rtsal snang stong pa'i khor yug dbus: skyon med snang ba rnam dag pad+mo'i mtshor: rang byung u dum wa ra'i sdong po'i rtser: pad 'dab brtsegs ma ze'u 'bru'i tshom bu'i dbus: rang bzhin gsal la 'dzin med nyi zla'i steng : thog ma'i mgon po rgyal ba 'od mi 'gyur: de la bskor ba'i brgyud rim gsal ba ni:

rdor 'chang rdo rje sems dpa' las kyi dbang : dga' rab rdo rje shrī singha dang : 'jam dpal gshin rje rdo rje gro bo lod: rdo rje be con bha su dha ra dang : bka' bab mthu chen sangs rgyas ye shes sogs: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam par gsal: mdun du dmigs par gdung bas gsol ba 'debs: e ma hoḥ sangs rgyas spyi mes rang bzhin dbyings la shar: gdod ma'i mgon po sku la gsol ba 'debs: rigs lnga'i gtso bo longs sku'i ston pa mchog: mi 'gyur rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs: rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad: sprul sku rdo rje sems la gsol ba 'debs: de nyid rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gsang mdzod bdag: las kyi dbang mo che la gsol ba 'debs: sde snod ma lus dgongs pa'i klong las shar: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs: mkhyen gnyis gnas lugs nyi ma mkha' la shar: mkhas pa shrī singhar gsol ba 'debs: shes rab rtse mos sku bzhi yongs la 'gengs: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la gsol ba 'debs: lha srin btul mdzad sde snod gcig tu bsdus: rdo rje gro bo lod la gsol ba 'debs: lha srin btul ba'i dkyil 'khor phyag rgya'i bdag: rdo rje be con ma la gsol ba 'debs: khyad chos rnam gsum gdams pa'i bka' chen bab: bal po bha su dha ra la gsol ba 'debs: gshin rje 'dul rgyud so drug bka' chen bab: gnubs chen bud+dha dzñā na la gsol ba 'debs: bka' dgongs sgyu gsum zab chos bka' chen bab: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling la gsol ba 'debs: sku yi 'dul rgyud rdo rje rnam par rol: 'jigs byed he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs: sku yi dkyil 'khor bla med don gyis rdzogs: dug ri'i dkyil 'khor tshogs la gsol ba 'debs: zla gsang thig le dkar nag dmar po sogs: 'dus pa spyi rgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs: thugs rje'i brtse bas dgongs shing byin gyis rlobs:

bum pa'i dbang bskur lha dang gnyis su med: gsang dbang ye shes bde stong zung du 'jug: sher dbang ka dag dbyings rig bya rtsol bral: tshig dbang rin chen 'khor ba yongs su grol: dbang lnga'i rjes gnang mtshams sbyor phyir mi ldog: rim skyes 'dam chu'i sbal ltar mi bying bar: gcig car gtsang po'i nya ldang ji lta bu: thod rgal nyams zad a ti'i 'bras bu 'di: rtsol med sa lam rdzogs pa'i go 'phang du: dge bas yongs su khyab pa'i don thob shog:

ces gsol 'debs brgyud rim gsum mam brgyad yod de: ston pa 'jam dpal nag pos gsungs pa: 'phags pa 'jam dpal la gsungs pa: spyi rgyud lag na rin po che rdo rjes bsdus pa: khyad par sku rgyud shel gyi ri ltar yin rung : pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas rdol ba bcas thams cad bsdus pas bal po'i phan chod tshud chod bsam yas: yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug sogs so so'i zhu ba bcas mang na'ang : 'di nyid dgongs brda zung du 'brel nas khyad par bha su dha ra'i rgya gzhung sogs kun 'dus pa'i chos yin pas brgyud 'debs yang der 'jug pa'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: thim rgya: rdo rje las rab rtsal gyis khrom gzigs nas gdan drangs shing bdud 'dul sngags gling du zhal bshus so// // ga) 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus las: sgrub pa'i phrin las pha rol rgol 'joms gnam lcags thog mda' bzhugs so: bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra 'jigs byed rol pa'i dgyes pa rtsal: drag sngags dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir mthar byed na: yang gsang dug ri nag po me 'bar bstan: shes rab drwa bar mtsho rgyal legs par zungs: brdar gzugs zab rgya bde chen klong du sbos: ma 'ongs 'di 'byin bud+dha dzñā na yi: rnam sprul bdud 'joms khrag 'thung rol pa rtsal: rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes: ji bzhin kho bo'i rnam sprul de dang sprod: bka' yi gnyer 'di legs ldan bya rog gdong : skal med bdud rigs lag tu ma shor rgya: de'ang 'jam dpal gshin rje sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: brag dmar chu 'gyu tsan+dan tshang tshing 'khrigs: shin tu gnyan pa srin po khros 'dra'i gdong : yang na rab tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod dang : gcan gzan sha za lha 'dre 'du ba'i gling :

drag po mngon spyod 'grub pa'i gnas de ru: zhi sgrub ltar na mthing nag yid mchis dal: sa dpyad dpags la dkyil 'khor legs par gdab: drag sngags mthu sgrub lta bur 'dod byed la: phung shul sa la dkyil 'khor stegs kyang bcag: dug khrag ngar ma ro sol chag chag gdab: bca' gzhi rgyas pa sgrub gzhung lta bur bya: zhi sgrub bdag bskyed lta bur bsgrub pa la: dkyil 'khor dbus su bum pa bdud rtsi dang : bhan+dha ril bu me long rdo rje sogs: dmar nag dar tshon bla 'khor bris pa bzhag: gtor ma dag ni 'bru nag ngar phye la: ri rab steng du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi dang : chos 'byung steng du dpal gtor bra gzugs bzhag: khram ris btod cing dkar dmar rgyan gyis spras: 'khor ni rang 'dra lha grangs lta bur bkod: dar nag gdugs dang gri snying la sogs pa: 'os pa'i rdzas dang gtor kyu tshang bar bya: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bsham: rol mo la sogs spyan gzigs tshang bar bkram: de nas dkyil 'khor 'jug pa'i rim pa ni: rang nyid dpa' bo rdo rje nag po ru: gsal btab nga rgyal ting 'dzin ma bral bya: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: bla ma bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: rang bzhin sku mchog rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor la: mthu rtsal gzi byin bskyed nas dbang bskur ba'i: kun 'dus rol pa'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ gdod nas 'khor 'das rang byung dkyil 'khor lha: sgra grags chos rnams bdag med stong pa'i ngang : ma rtogs sems can nges don la 'jug phyir: dran shes bag yod lta bas sems bskyed do: gsum pa bgegs gtor gtong ba ni: chu gtsang bran la byin rlabs bya: hūm̐ dzaḥ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje khro bo yi: rdzu 'phrul thugs las spros pa pho nya'i tshogs: grangs med myur mgyogs glog ltar rab 'phros nas: sgrub la mi dbang bgegs tshogs thams cad kun:

mchod sbyin gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir khug: om̐ ya ma rā dza he kro ta ka la hūm̐ hūm̐: gnod byed bgegs tshogs a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bzhi pa bsngo zhing bskrad pa ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ bdag ni 'jigs byed 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: bgegs tshogs 'joms byed dug ri me 'bar sku: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams bka' las ma 'da' bar: dug skyu'i gtor ma changs bu 'di khyer la: 'di ru ma gnas phyogs med gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro sdang sems 'tshe gyur na: rab 'jigs khro bo rnams kyis mtshon char 'bebs: 'joms byed khro mo rnams kyis me thun brdeg: sras mchog rnams kyis dug rlangs smyo 'bog 'gyed: ma rungs gdug pa'i bgegs tshogs 'joms shing skem: phye ma rdul phran ming med brlag par mchis: de bas 'byung po gzhan du phyir dengs shig: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka he ru ka kro ta kā la ha la badz+ra raṃ dz+wa la gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa mtshams gcod srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐ ya: bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po yi: ye shes thugs las sprul pa'i 'od zer tshogs: mtshams gcod khro bo'i phyag mtshan sprin ltar gtibs: nam yang bgegs tshogs mi gnas gur khang ni: dang po 'jam dpal shel bum thogs pa'i gur: gnyis pa khro bo dkar po nang gzigs gur: gsum pa ye shes 'bar mched 'od kyi gur: bzhi pa dbyangs gsal sngags dang me dpung gur: lnga pa gri gug rdo rje gtun shing gur: drug pa ral gri bsam chod rdo rje'i gur: bdun pa dug rlangs khro bo nag po'i gur: brgyad pa gnam lcags ur mo mchod rten gur: dgu pa e mthing nam mkha' stong pa'i gur: bskal pa'i rlung yang mi bgrod dgu rim de: bgegs dang 'byung po mtshams gcod srung 'khor gyur: om̐ mañdzu shrī badz+ra tsakra bh+rūm̐ rak+ṣa: om̐ kro ta sid ta tsakra rak+ṣa: om̐ dzñā na dz+wa la tsakra rak+ṣa: oṃ raṃ ā li kā li tsakra rak+ṣa:

om̐ bi shwa ā yu dha tsakra rak+ṣa: om̐ khaḍ+ga tshin+dha tsakra rak+ṣa: om̐ kro ta kā la tsakra rak+ṣa: om̐ bha ga le hā gar+bha tsakra rak+ṣa: om̐ e khaṃ swa bhā tsakra rak+ṣa: om̐ badz+ra mañdzu shrī hūm̐ kro ta e badz+ra la ma bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: dang po mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bhan+dha yangs pa gling bzhi'i khyon gyi nang : phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dang : dri chab zhal zas rol mo sgra yi dbyangs: phyag rgya 'khrul 'khor glu len gar ma dang : gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dbang po lnga: nang mchod sha lnga ye shes pañtsa dang : gsang mchod sbyor ba'i a haṃ byang sems tshogs: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag mthun pa'i rdzas: tshogs mchod bskang rdzas spyan gzigs du ma sogs: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'di: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs dgyes pa'i rdzas: rmad byung bla med dgyes mchod chen por spel: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ lā s+ye mā l+ye gi'arti nīrti rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta dzñā na a haṃ pū dza māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta āḥhūm̐: zhes pas lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs: gnyis pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings drag po e yi klong : lhun grub bde chen dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dpal chen khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: yang gsang 'jigs byed me 'bar lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir byin phob sgrub la dbang mchog bskur: che btsan mthu yi gzi byin bskyed pa'i phyir: dpa' bo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dza a be sha ya a āḥ gsum pa brda sgo dbye zhing brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe gnas lugs dran rig yi dam lha:

gdod nas 'bral med gshis lugs rgyu lags kyang : bar du tshogs drug rlung gis ris su phyes: da ni lhan skyes gnyug ma'i zhal mjal phyir: rmongs tshogs 'thib pa'i ma rig sgo bcad de: kun mkhyen lta ba'i dbang po mthong lam phye: ring por brtsegs pa'i bag chags rang grol bshags: bag yod kun gzhi dbyer med mchod bstod nas: brdal khyab dang po'i lta bas brda bstan no: om̐ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ na mo a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ dharma dzñā na hūm̐: bzhi pa dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa ni: hūm̐: yang dag don chen bla med gsang ba'i dal: khro rgyal chen po 'jam dpal gshin rje yi: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor dag: lhag pa'i lhar mos 'dun pas mi gtong bsgrub: om̐ badz+ra dzñā na tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: hūm̐: gdod nas rang bzhin mkha' ltar khyab pa yi: thig le chen po smra brjod blo las 'das: rtag chad bral la bya rtsol med pa'i ngang : rang bzhin ma 'gags klong gi zer chen po: rgyu nyid lhun grub rang byung 'dus ma byas: chos rnams sgyu ma'i snang tshul ston pa'i phyir: dpa' bo 'jam dpal gzhon nus de ltar smras: oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ dharma dhā tu dzñā na ma hā shū n+ya ta swa bhā wa āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa 'byung rim lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: bskal par brtsegs pa'i zhing rdul 'byung lnga'i khams: ye nas e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ suṃ keṃ bh+rūm̐ : nam mkha' rdo rje gzhal yas lte bar hūm̐: yongs gyur 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri nag: dbu dgu so bzhi'i phyag la sku smad dbal: rdo rje dur khrod bdag mo zhal gsum sbyor: bde chen bskul ba'i mkha' nas sras bzhi 'gyed: ma 'dres gtso 'khor dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: om̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ : maṇ+ḍal pad+ma tsan+d+ra sūr+ya ru tra ti ra baṃ: om̐ ya mān+ta ka a kro te ka ya ma rā dza hūm̐ bh+yoḥ

gsum pa dngos gzhi bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: e las nam mkha' smug nag dug rlangs 'khrigs: yam̐ las drag po'i rlung dmar 'u ru ru: ram̐ las bskal pa'i me dpung wa la la: kham̐ las rak+ta'i rba rlabs chi li li: sum̐ las dur khrod sa gzhi smug nag brjid: keṃ las bam ro sna tshogs gar stabs bsgyur: bh+rūm̐ las gnam lcags las grub gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi khro chu khol ma'i mdangs: rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa 'dab rnams: me yi ser ba tshwa tshwa si li li: ka gdung dral phyam ngan sngags 'brug ltar ldir: rta babs tog la drag po'i glog dmar 'khyugs: phyi rol gur khang thog rgod zi ra khol: rab 'jigs pho brang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus: pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs ti ra'i steng : gnam lcags rdo rje mthing nag rtse dgu pa: me zer rab g.yo lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan: de nyid yongs khro bo gshin rje'i gshed: 'jigs byed khro rgyal dug ri me 'bar sku: dud kha rab 'phros rtsa zhal ma he'i gdong : dbu dgu rngam pa'i zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: phyag g.yas bcu drug pha rol 'joms pa'i mtshon: gri gug ral gri chu gri me kha ṭ+wāṃ: rdo rje 'khor lo mdung dang lcags kyu gdengs: spu gri dbyug to ḍā ru dgra satwa zhags: tho ba dang ni zhing gi rgyal mtshan thogs: g.yon pa bcu drug dgra bgegs rdeg pa'i mtshon: thod khrag snying phreng rgyu ma gtun khung dang : lcags sgrog rnga chung mgo phreng ru mtshon rno: dug rlangs dril bu kong zor khram shing nag: sho rdel rtsis rdo g.yang gzhi 'dzin pa'o: rtsa phyag gnyis kyis ri rab phur pa bsgril: dur khrod chas ldan spu gri'i sgro gshog brgyangs: lte bar srid pa'i chu srin mche ba gtsigs: sku smad gnam lcags phur bu'i dbal dang ldan: dgra bgegs snying khar gzugs phyir dpa' bar bsgom: hūm̐: sbyor ba'i yum mchog rdo rje dur khrod bdag: dug ti dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma:

rtsa phyag gnyis kyis gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: lhag mas rdo rje 'khor lo phur bu gri: dur khrod chas ldan zhabs bzhi sked la 'khril: khro rgyal yab yum gsal ba'i thugs ka ru: hūm̐ ya bh+yo dang tha mar sngags kyis bskor: mi bzad rab 'bar me dpung dbus su gsal: om̐ ya mān+ta ka a kro te ka baṃ bh+yo badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: gtso bo'i spyi gtsug me dpung 'bar ba'i klong : 'jam dpal mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: ral gri po ti 'dzin cing dor stabs bzhugs: dur khrod chas ldan rab 'jigs rngam par bsgom: om̐ ma hā kā la mañdzu shrī hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: de yi spyi bor ye shes lnga ldan dbus: tshe bdag dmar ser mnyam bzhag tshe bum 'dzin: mtshan dpe rab rdzogs longs sku'i cha lugs can: gzi brjid 'od zer dpal du 'bar bar bsgom: om̐ mañdzu shrī ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥ hūm̐: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhi 'khor lo rim pa bzhin: shar phyogs dgra bgegs ru tra bsnol ba'i steng : gsung gi bdag nyid tshe bdag he ru kaḥ mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug rab tu rngam: g.yas gsum 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri dang : g.yon gsum lcags kyu gtun shing sdigs mdzub can: dur khrod chas ldan spu gri'i sgro gshog brgyangs: sku smad chu srin rngam zhing dbal zur ldan: yum mchog khrag mig gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐: lho phyogs dgra bgegs ru tra bsnol ba'i steng : thugs kyi bdag nyid khro chu dug gdong can: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug rab tu rngam: g.yas gsum dgra satwa dam nyams mgo lus phral: g.yon gsum byad ma gdug pa'i tsit+ta 'dzin: dur khrod chas ldan spu gri'i sgro gshog brgyangs: sku smad chu srin rngam zhal dbal zur ldan: yum mchog be ta gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐: nub phyogs dgra bgegs ru tra bsnol ba'i steng :

yon tan bdag nyid dgra nag dregs 'dul ni: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug rab tu rngam: g.yas gsum sbrul zhag chu srin rgyal mtshan gri: g.yon gsum khyab 'jug mda' gzhu me dpung 'dzin: dur khrod chas ldan spu gri'i sgro gshog brgyangs: sku smad chu srin rngam zhing dbal zur ldan: ya ma tsaṇ+ḍi gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐: byang phyogs dgra bgegs ru tra bsnol ba'i steng : phrin las ki kang me yi spu gri ni: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug rab tu rngam: g.yas gsum 'khor lo spu gri tho ba dang : g.yon gsum lcags kyu gtun shing sog le 'dzin: dur khrod chas brgyad spu gri'i sgro gshog brgyangs: sku smad chu srin rngam zhal dbal zur ldan: srid pa stobs ldan gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐: phyogs bzhir sgo skyong ma mo srog bdag bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang rang rtags phyag mtshan can: g.yang gzhi'i gos gyon dur khrod srin mo'i chas: gar bsgyur rngam stabs 'jigs pa'i cha lugs bsgom: hūm̐: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i bka' nyan pa: sprul pa yang sprul nyi khri bdun stong tshogs: sha za khrag 'thung las byed pho nya mo: dug ri me 'bar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: ma 'dres dbyings la 'ja' shar ji bzhin gsal: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas lnga'i sa bon gyis: 'og min zhing dang lho phyogs gshin rje'i gnas: rang rang pho brang klong nas spyan drangs gyur: om̐ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dza dzaḥ

dang po spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: rigs bdag 'jam dpal gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs rab 'jigs dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed dug ri gshegs su gsol: gshin yul lcags mkhar nag po nas: sras mchog rigs bzhi gshegs su gsol: 'chi bdag las kyi pho brang nas: sgo skyong yang 'khor gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: las gshin dug ri khro bo'i tshogs: bdag la dbang bskur byin brlab phyir: rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir bzhugs: om̐ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la yaḥ 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rab gus dwang bas phyag bgyid do: om̐ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ bzhi pa phyi'i mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga dang : dur khrod bdag mo dgra la rngam pa'i gar: pho nyas dgra bo bla 'bod 'debs pa'i gdangs: rtag tu dur khrod ma mo sbyor ba sogs: drag po phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs 'di: khro rgyal dug ri'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti pū dza a hūm̐: lnga pa nang mchod sna tshogs 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngo bo mchog: sha chen la sogs khu ba rdzas dang sbyar: sman mchog ngad ldan dug rigs sbyar ba'i phud: 'bru bcud myos pa'i dza gad chang la sogs: drag po nang gi mchod pa sna tshogs 'di: khro rgyal dug ri lha tshogs rnams la 'bul:

pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥkha kha khā hi: drug pa gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: lha mo dus mtshan nag mo'i mkha' lam nas: las kyi rlung gis bskyod pa'i bdud rtsi dang : rigs bzang a haṃ drug tu sbyor ba yis: bde stong dga' bzhi bsrubs pa'i bdud rtsi dang : gzhan yang ma chags chags pa chen po'i khrag: dga' chen ston pa'i gsang mchod sna tshogs 'di: khro rgyal dug ri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ a haṃ pañtsa rak+ta mu kha kun+da sa ma ya pū dza khā hi: bdun pa gtor tshogs spyan gzigs mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bhan+dha lcang lo ru: 'bru nag gri khrag rlan dang sbrags pa yi: ba liṃ gtor ma sha sna snying snas brgyan: dar nag gdugs dang bla 'khor srog rten bkod: ma rungs gdug pa'i don snying 'bras bus spras: tshogs mchod la sogs dgyes shing mthun pa'i rdzas: thod rnga rkang gling rol mo sna tshogs dang : dur khrod bkod pa'i spyan gzigs sprin ltar 'khrigs: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'di: khro rgyal dug ri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha kha khā hi: brgyad pa bstod cing bsngags pa ni: hūm̐ e ya bh+yoḥ skye med ngang las ma g.yos rigs kyi bdag: bdud bzhi 'byung po'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod phyir: sku mdog dmar ser li khri dbang gi mdog: zhi 'dzum mdzes ldan gzhon nu'i rnam par rol: mnyam bzhag 'chi med tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs sku bde stong cha lugs 'chang : sgrub la shes rab dbang bzhi stsol ba'i lha:

rigs bdag tshe yi mgon por phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: stobs ldan dbang phyug mu stegs rgol 'joms pa: sku mdog mthing nag drag po'i dpa' stobs can: dbu skra dmar nag gzengs pa me ltar 'bar: phyag g.yas ral gris nyon mongs dpung tshogs gzhom: g.yon pa po ti drag sngags bdud la 'debs: dur khrod chas ldan mu stegs dpung tshogs sngangs: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bgegs dpung sa la bsgyel: dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i gar dgu can: mu stegs 'joms mdzad 'jam dpal nag por bstod: hūm̐ e ya: gtum drag khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: srog la rngam byed 'chi bdag gshin rje ni: pha rol kun gyi gshed ma lho phyogs bdag: 'jigs byed kun gyi sde dpon khro bo'i rgyal: stobs ldan rdo rje dug ri mthu bo che: sku mdog dud kha me 'od chi li li: rtsa zhal khros pa ma he'i nga ro 'byin: rwa gnyis rtse nas thog ser dgra la 'bebs: rtsa zhal kham nag khros gnyis hūm̐ sgra sgrog: steng gsum dmar nag mthing gas bon byad 'joms: de'i steng dkar dmar ser bas ban byad 'joms: zhal dgu rab tu khros pas snang srid sngangs: dbu skra dmar nag bskyod pas lha srin 'dul: g.yas pa bcu drug mtshon cha 'khrugs pa yis: dgra bo'i pho rgyud rtsad gcod phye mar brlag: g.yon pa bcu drug mtshon cha 'khrugs pa yis: dgra bo'i mo rgyud rigs gcod mngal nas skem: rtsa phyag ri rab phur bu bsgril ba yis: pha rol rgol ba'i tshogs rnams phyung zhing rdeg: spu gri'i sgro gshog tshwa tshwa 'thor ba yis: ma rungs gdon bgegs 'byung po'i klad nas skem: dur khrod dpal chas rngam pa'i gar ldan gyis: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha dgra la 'bebs: lte bar chu srin rkan sgra brdebs pa yis: bsam pa tsam gyis ru tra'i snying khrag rol: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham ngar ma yis: dam nyams log 'dren bla srog gtub cing gcod:

zur gsum dbal la thog ser g.yo ba yis: ma rungs bgegs tshogs phye mar rab tu 'thag: sku la dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba yis: pha rol kun gyi rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: 'jigs byed chen po dug ri'i sku la bstod: hūm̐ bh+yo yaḥ las kyi yum chen ma mo dur khrod bdag: dug ti nag mo rdo rje rab 'bar ma: snang srid yongs kyi las sbyor srog gi bdag: sku mdog dmar nag srin mo'i cha lugs can: khams gsum za byed zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: dbus dmar g.yas dkar g.yon sngos srid gsum sngangs: g.yas su mtshon chas log lta phye mar bcom: g.yon gsum mtshon chas 'byung po'i klad khrag rol: dur khrod chas rdzogs dam nyams 'dre rgod sngangs: zhabs bzhi 'khril sbyor las kyi gshin rje bskul: ba spu'i gseb nas rang 'dra'i ma mo 'gyed: gshin rje'i lcam mo snang srid dbang mo che: dur khrod bdag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ ya: shar phyogs gshin rje'i grong khyer dur khrod dbus: las kyi khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: gsung gi dbang phyug tshe bdag 'bar ba'i sku: mthing nag dkar dmar rab khros rngam zhal bgrad: phyag drug mtshon gyi sgyogs chen dgra la 'bebs: spu gri'i sgro gshog log 'dren rtsad nas gcod: dur khrod chas ldan ru tra phye mar brlag: chu srin zhal bgrad ma rungs snying khrag 'thung : gnam lcags dbal gsham bstan pa'i ru tra sgrol: khrag mig yum sbyor snang srid dbang du sdud: las kyi gshin rje pha rol rgol 'joms pa: tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐ ya: lho phyogs gshin rje'i grong khyer dur khrod dbus: las kyi khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: thugs kyi dbang phyug khro chu dug gdaung sku: mthing nag dkar dmar rab khros rngam zhal bgrad: phyag drug mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'bebs: spu gri sgro gshog log 'dren rtsad nas gcod: dur khrod chas ldan ru tra phye mar brlag:

chu srin rngam zhal ma rungs snying khrag 'thung : gnam lcags dbal gsham bstan pa'i dgra bo sgrol: be ta yum sbyor ma sring dbang du sdud: las kyi gshin rje pha rol rgol 'joms pa: khro chu dug gdong yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐ ya: nub phyogs gshin rje'i grong khyer dur khrod dbus: las kyi khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: yon tan bdag nyid dgra 'dul nag po'i sku: mthing nag dkar dmar rab khro rngam zhal bgrad: phyag drug mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'bebs: spu gri'i sgro gshog log 'dren rtsad nas gcod: dur khrod chas ldan ru tra phye mar brlag: chu srin zhal bgrad ma rungs snying khrag 'thung : gnam lcags dbal ldan bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: tsaṇ+ḍi yum sbyor ma sring dbang du sdud: las kyi gshin rje pha rol rgol 'joms pa: dgra 'dul nag po yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐ ya: byang phyogs gshin rje'i grong khyer dur khrod dbus: las kyi khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: phrin las dbang phyug me yi spu gri can: mthing nag dkar dmar rab khros rngam zhal bgrad: phyag drug mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'bebs: spu gri'i sgro gshog log 'dren rtsad nas gcod: dur khrod chas ldan ru tra phye mar brlag: chu srin zhal bgrad ma rungs snying khrag 'thung : gnam lcags dbal gsham bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: srid pa gsum sbyor ma sring dbang du sdud: las kyi gshin rje pha rol rgol 'joms pa: me yi spu gri yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐ yaḥ pho brang chen po'i phyogs bzhi sgo skyong ma: las kyi gshin rje ma mo srog gi bdag: srin mo'i gzugs can dgra sha khrag la dgyes: dur khrod g.yang gzhi gos gyon shams se sham: phyag g.yas rang rang go chas log 'dren gzhom: g.yon pa bhan dmar dgra bgegs rak+ta 'thung : rngam pa'i gar sgyur bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod: sgo skyong rigs bzhi ma mor phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: gzhan yang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' sdod pa: pho nya las byed sprul pa bye ba 'bum: rlung ltar 'tshubs shing dgra yul phye mar brlag: mi sdug gzugs 'chang 'jigs pa'i gad mo sgrog: las kyi mtha' sdud shan pa bye ba 'bum: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'dus la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs: deng 'dir thugs dam gnyan po rgyud bskul na: rig 'dzin sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bstan la sdang ba'i log 'dren rtsad nas chod: thugs dam dus las ma 'da' sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka a kro te ka du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa spyi dril sngags 'di gang 'grub bzlas: so sor phral na: dang po gtso bo'i sngags ni: om̐ hriṣ+ṭi wi kri ta na na ya ma rā dza badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshe bdag la: om̐ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ khro chu la: om̐ du tri ya ma rā dza ya mān+ta ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra nag la: om̐ ya ma rā dza kā la rū pa ya mān+ta ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ me'i spu gri la: om̐ ki kang ya ma rak+ṣa a kro te ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ yum rnams spyi dril ni: om̐ ya mān+ta ka ni ma tri kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sgo ma bzhi'i sngags ni: om̐ ma tri ya ma rak+sha ni ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i sngags rnams lhag chad spang bar bzlas: drag sgrub lta bur bsnyen pa byed mos na: tshad ni 'bum phrag zhig tu 'don par bya: sa ma ya: de nas tshogs bya ba ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum byin gyis brlabs: dang po de bzhin nyid kyis byin brlab pa ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos rnams dmigs med de bzhin nyid: sme grib gtsang btsog ka nas dag: rang byung rgya yan lhun grub las:

ting 'dzin tshogs kyi 'khor lor shar: ye nas zag med bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ dharma dzñā na pra ti pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rtsa gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa yi: bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rngam chen me ltar 'bar ba yi: dur khrod e yi klong dkyil nas: 'jigs byed dpa' bo gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar nag po che: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: lho phyogs 'chi bdag nag po yi: gshin yul zangs gling dmar po las: gshed chen yongs rdzogs lha tshogs rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang nyams re dga': g.yang gzhi sna tshogs rgyan du mdzes: sha chen sna tshogs bcud mchog rgyas: ga ṇa tshogs 'khor bag re dro: gri rkang gling bu gdangs re snyan: dur khrod bkod pa lhun re chags: 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor dam tshig gtsang : tshogs khang gzhal yas byin re che: rak+ta zham chu mdangs dang ldan: keng rus sa gzhi rngam zhing brjid: yid du mchis pa'i gnas mchog 'dir: bcom ldan gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams: thogs med thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs: dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhugs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ gsum pa tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐ ya: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed chen po: 'jigs byed khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bskang ba bya ba ni: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi dbang po dang : byad ma'i sha khrag rus pa nang rol bcas: ga ṇa'i tshogs kyi mchod sogs mnyes pa'i rdzas: phyi nang gsang ba'i spyan gzigs du ma 'dis: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po yi:

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mi mthun gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar bcad cing : mthun rkyen bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: lnga pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ bdag blo gti mug 'thug pos rab rmongs nas: bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa'i dam bca' g.yel ba dang : tshul bzhin ma ldan bag med dbang gyur tshogs: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: ces pa yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : drug pa tha ma bsgral ba ni: hūm̐ ya: bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po yis: mdun du brub khung gnam lcags hom gyi nang : dgra bgegs ru tra mngon sum lta bur gsal: phaṭḥ na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: khyad par za byed las kyi gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: bla ma'i sku dgra sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra: rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe: dmag sna ston dang jag rkun chom po'i tshogs: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gar gnas kyang : 'chi bdag pho nya rnams kyis khug la shog: dgra gzugs tha ma'i liṅga 'di la stims: dus la bab po las mkhan mthu ma chung : om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dza ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya khug:

bdun pa phur bu gdab pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal 'jam dpal nag po'i sprul pa ni: 'chi bdag gshin rje dgra 'dul kī la ya: phyag gnyis 'joms byed las kyi phur bu 'dril: ru tra gdug pa'i snying la kī la ya: bcad gtub rdul du rlog cig mā ra ya: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ru tra trig nan gzer thum rbad myog: brgyad pa gtub cing mchod pa ni: hūm̐: 'joms byed mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yis: dgra bgegs gzugs phung phye mar rab bshigs te: bhan+dhar bskyil ba'i sha khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta i daṃ bha ling+ta kha hi: dgu pa tshogs la rol ba ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: mchog gi rtsa ba dngos grub kyi: yang dag don chen gnas rig pa: deng 'dir legs 'ong gnang bar stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'khor 'das bde stong ye shes ngang : mtshan 'dzin mi dmigs ye nas grol: gtsang dme bag chags gdod nas dag: chos dbyings dgongs klong a la la: zhes pa pad kor dang bcas nas rol: bcu pa lhag ma gtong ba ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ dur khrod 'bar ba'i pho brang mtha' skyong ba: ya ba ya ma dregs sde shan pa'i tshogs: sha za dmar nag zangs kyi mche ba can: mi sdug gzugs can dgra la bla 'gugs 'debs: rngam stabs ling ling g.yang gzhi dmar po gyon: mgo snying thogs nas rgyu ma 'dren zhing rgyug: ging chen dbyug pa thogs nas bshud sgra 'debs: skra dmar ral bsigs srin po'i las nyul bzhin: gshin rje'i bka' sdod dregs sde bye ba 'bum: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: om̐ ya wa ha ri ya ma ra ti sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: rnga brdung dung bus gtor ma la rak+tas bran zhing dpal 'bar 'dzugs la:

hūm̐ e ya: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: mi bzad khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku mdog mun ltar 'khrugs shing stong khams g.yo: rwa gnyis rtse las bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: ma he drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: dbu dgu rab khros sa gsum sngangs shing 'dar: sum cu so bzhi mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: chu srin zhal nas 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: gnam lcags dbal las ser ba hri li li: zur gsum rtse nas thog ser dgra la 'bebs: srid pa 'joms byed dug ti nag mo sbyor: yab yum sku la khro chu'i tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: ba spu'i khrod nas bya khyung ya la la: rang 'dra'i khro tshogs rngam stabs gar dgu bsgyur: mthu rtsal thogs med 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: sprul pa yang sprul pha rol rgol tshogs 'joms: bzhengs shig 'chi bdag pho brang dbus nas bzhengs: yab mchog zla gsang nag po dbyings nas bzhengs: yum mchog gshor sang dmar mo dbyings nas bzhengs: dpal chen dug ri me 'bar dbyings nas bzhengs: gsung mchog tshe bdag 'bar ba dbyings nas bzhengs: thugs mchog khro chu dug gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: yon tan dgra nag stobs ldan dbyings nas bzhengs: phrin las me yi spu gri dbyings nas bzhengs: sgo skyong sha za mched bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs: sprul pa yang sprul dmag tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dbyings nas bzhengs la rbad bskul las la chos: pha rol dam nyams ru tra gdug pa'i tshogs: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe: bsam sbyor ngan pa 'chang ba'i byad ma rnams: lo zla zhag dus tshes las ma 'da' bar: sgrol zhing brlags nas ming yang med par mdzod: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dus la bab bo 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs: stong gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka a kro te ka sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi bla srog dbugs la thun thun sha khrag la khā hi:

gnyis pa zor 'phang ba ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ rab 'jigs dur khrod klong dkyil nas: 'chi bdag las la bzhengs pa'i sku: sgrol byed gshin rje dug gdong can: phyag na gsod byed zor mda' thogs: gzir 'debs rngam stabs khyugs se khyug: 'chi bdag dgra la dmod pa'i mtshon: btab bo ru tra'i snying la ya: myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ya ma rā dza he ka thun bh+yoḥ ki kang kā la rak+sha dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa la thun thun bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: gsum pa chad mdo gtong ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe gsang chen khro bo rol pa yi: drag po e yi dur khrod chen po ru: bcom ldan rdo rje dug ri me 'bar dang : yum mchog dug ti dur khrod bdag mo gnyis: las gshin srid pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' sdod bye ba 'bum: so so'i gzugs bstan srog snying phul ba bzhin: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol rgol ba 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og brag dmar ār+ya pā gling du: rig 'dzin chen po pad 'byung yab yum gyis: zla gsang dug ri'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: slob ma'i dwangs ma sangs rgyas ye shes la: kha byang lung gi bka' rgya gtad pa'i tshe: bya rog gdong sogs chos skyong gter srung gis: so so'i gzugs bstan tha tshig khas blangs bzhin: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol rgol ba 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: sbas gnas chen po pad+ma bkod pa yi: khrom gzigs 'jam dpal sku yi gnas mchog nas: rig 'dzin pad+ma gter bdag gling pa dang : gsang ba'i ḍāk+ki gdong can mkha' 'gro gnyis: rgya mtsho'i klong nas shog ser bton pa'i tshe: mtsho la me 'bar gter srung gzugs bstan nas: bstan pa srung bar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol rgol ba 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzod:

om̐ kro ta kro ti sarba i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: bzhi pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: bdud kyi ma bzhi gnod sbyin ma bzhi dang : gshin rje ma bzhi la sogs 'khor dang bcas: glu len bro rdung bshugs sgra di ri ri: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: la la ye shes la la 'jig rten tshul: la la srin mo la la sha za ma: la la mtshan mo rab rgyu dur khrod 'grim: don la 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' nyan ma: bstan pa srung ba'i ma sring 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: om̐ ma ma shag shag dum dum le le tang ting dza dza i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: lnga pa rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po ru: rngam chen 'jigs byed gshin rje'i lha tshogs kyi: dbal ldan ru tra'i snying khar bro rdung bas: ma rungs gdug pa'i bgegs srin phye mar bcom: phyin chad dam sri ma ldang rgyas gdab bo: om̐ ya ma ya nan: wa ru ṇa nan: ma ru nan: ru tra laṃ nan: dam sri mā ra ya nan: drug pa dbang blang dang dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: bde chen gsang ba snying po rdo rje'i mkha': yang dag ye shes 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi: sku gsung thugs yon 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mthu rtsal gzi byin chen po'i dpal yon gyis: deng 'dir dbang bskur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: 'dod don yid bzhin kun kyang lhun grub nas: zab gsang dpal rab smin grol dga' ston stsol: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bdun pa bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: sku mchog gzhon nu gzi 'od rab 'khyil ba: thugs rje klong yangs drwa ba'i 'od zer gyis: srid pa ma dag lteng ka rab bskams te: lham mer rtag tu gsal mdzad bkra shis shog: bla med theg chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho yi: thos bsam sgom sgrub nyams len gling zhugs nas:

don gnyis mchog la spyod pa'i nor bu nyid: nam yang mi 'bral dge legs bkra shis shog: brgyad pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ snang stong lha sku sgyu ma'i ngang tshul las: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug spro bsdu'i 'du tshan dag: dgongs pa zang thal dmigs med mkha' ru bsdu: a a āḥ dgu pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ bdag blo gti mug 'thug pos rab rmongs nas: bskyed rdzogs bsgrub pa'i dam bca' g.yel ba dang : tshul bzhin ma ldan bag med dbang gyur tshogs: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas bshags: bcu pa bsngo ba ni: hoḥ mtha' yas 'gro kun tshogs zhing pad+mo'i tshal: thugs rje'i sprin gtibs byin rlabs char chen pos: smin grol zab mo'i 'bras bu rab smin te: bcud kyi ting 'dzin ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: bcu gcig smon lam bya ba ni: hoḥ shes rab ye shes dpa' bo 'jam mgon gyi: go 'phang 'grub ste don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i: gdeng chen mi g.yo rtogs pa'i 'bras bu nyid: nam yang bdag gzhan dge ba'i mthu ldan shog: ces pa bsngo smon dge tshogs rnam dkar nyer mkho dam pa phan bde'i rtsa lag tu rem blo'i 'dun pa cher 'dud par bya: sa ma ya: e maḥ zab yangs nam mkha' dpag par dka' ba yi: rang bzhin khyon rtse rgyas pa'i mdzod gling nas: 'dod rgu yid gter mchog gi dga' ston nyid: mkhyen rab thugs rje'i 'gro la smin char che'i: rgyun bzang rab g.yo'i bde ster stobs chen po: snyan brgyud dbyangs can dpa' mo'i rta ring dag: rtog ge legs sbyangs rgol ba rab gzhom phyir: mi nub rtag tu rgyas mdzad cod pan bzhag: kun gyi mthong bkur gtsug rgyan cher 'os pa'i: dpal la rab tu bzhad phyir ti la kaḥ nyi 'od rgyas 'di las bdag mgon des srungs: yang dus sprul pa'i zlos gar bdag der sprod: the tshom rmongs tshogs dri 'gengs nyams des byos: 'dzin rtags rgya chings rgyan kun bkra la spel:

bsil rgyun g.yo bas khyab bo zab mo rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos glang lor sbas yul gshin rje khrom gzigs kyi gnas me 'bar mtsho nas gdan drangs shing bal yul yang le chos sdings gzim chung pad+ma 'od 'khyil lhun rtse mngon dga' ru shog ser nas dag par zhal bshus so// bkra shis/ dge'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // nga) 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi sgrub pa ngan sngags zhag sgrub dug gi par bu nag po spu gri'i mtshon cha bzhugs so: rgya rgya: rgya rgya rgya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po khro rgyal rdo rje yi: sku mchog rab 'jigs srid gsum 'bar la rngam: drag sngags me ris nam mkha' gling bzhi 'jig: yang gsang drag po dug ri nag po gcig: kho bo drag sngags pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: dug ri nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi: gshin rje dug gi zhag sgrub par bu'am: dug sgrub reg phung nag po'i gzer bu ni: las byang bsgrub pa man ngag gsal bkod bstan: ye shes mchog khyod ma yengs legs par nyon: phyi sgrub gshin rje nag po khro 'dus dang : gsang sgrub kī la dmar nag rdzas sgrub dang : nang sgrub rdo rje khro bo gtso gcig gi: las byang bka' y-i brda 'di snying la thob: ma 'ongs sum cu kha dar yang mtha' la: rigs ldan khyod nyid zhe sdang lo 'dzin tshe: sa rtags dus kyi 'phel 'grib rtags mthun dus: brtul zhugs smyon spyod lta bur spyod bgyis la: dga' nas rab brtson rin chen snying lta bu'i: gza' rgod nag po dug rlangs rgyas 'dra ba'i: ki kang shar bu gsum gyi tshul rol na: dug gi bye ma nag po'i sbyor mtshams su: dug ri 'di sbas khyod kyi spyod ldan 'byung : 'di nyid 'don dang phab cing spel ba'i dus: khyab 'jug shan pa spun gsum drag tu mchod:

gsang rgya rim ltar bsgrub tshul dam par spyod: skal ldan las bzhi'i brda chos go bar gyis: da lta lha lcam nā ga dha ra 'di: skye ba phyi ma chos 'di'i grogs su 'bab: rten 'brel chos 'dir phul byung legs par bsgrig: dam rdzas shog ser dbang bzhi longs gyis la: yang gter sbas shing chos skyong bka' gter mchod: e ma: mu stegs dmag g.yos mtha' bzhi 'khor ba'i tshe: bud+dha dzñā na'i skye ba rigs ldan la: sprod cig shan pa gza' rgod khyab 'jug rgya: nus rtags thon cig dregs pa a thaṃ rgya: sras la sprod cig smon lam bka' gtad rgya: thathathatha : dang po sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni: drag po srog la rngam 'dra'i dur khrod du: phung shul nag po chu sgra 'byin pa'i sa: bya nag gshog rdeb gcan gzan ngar ba'i yul: gru gsum phug pa chos 'byung kha 'dra ba'i: gnas dben tshul bzhin yengs med mtshams bcad nas: dkyil 'khor drag rdzas gnam lcags ma traṃ steng : dug khrag ro sol gri dur phung shul sa: chag chag gdab cing drag po'i rdzas bsregs nas: pho brang gru bzhi thig rtsa gzhung mthun bya: de nas pho 'khor mo 'khor dbyibs su bris: de'i steng thod ngan nam ni lcags hom du: liṅga dpe'u ris lta bu bris byas nas: 'gugs gzhug drag bstim phur pa'i rgya bcas bzhag: de'ang drag po re g.yam snod nang du: de'i steng drag po'i lcags la 'geng gsum bca': mu stegs thod par gshin rje drag rdzas la: gri khrag ril bu sran ma tsam du bsgril: dar nag kha bcad rdo rje'i rgya yang gdab: de'i steng 'bru nag zan la dpal gtor ni: phur bu bslangs 'dra khram ris legs bkod pa: gtso bo yab yum khru re'i bzhi cha la: 'khor rnams mtho re me ri shwa rgyan dang : dar nag gdugs phub gri rgod snying gis brgyan: gshin rje'i bla rdo khram ris nag po dang : bla 'khor dpe'u ris ltar bris la gzugs: de'i steng 'jam dpal yab yum 'khor bcas la:

dpal gtor phyed la ral gris mtshan par byas: mdun du yum dang 'khor ni lha grangs ltar: legs par bca' zhing bdud rtsi rak+tas gtams: sna lnga 'ja' tshon gur phub legs bkod cing : dal gyi 'khor nang 'os pa'i mchod pa bshams: phyag mtshan gzugs shing rab 'bar rtsang gis brgyan: phyi rol las mkhan gter bdag rgyud ltar bkod: de nas dkar bgegs mtshams gcod grub rjes su: ngag gdams dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs par: bsrung mtshams med pas las byang rdzogs rjes su: drag sngags gong 'og sham bur 'os ltar sbyar: gdab las la sogs drag sngags gzhung dang bstun: tshogs gtor tshad ldan yid la shes par bya: zhag sgrub bya na spros med lta bur bsgrub: sngags kyi sham bu bsgyur zhing dgra ling bsgral: zhag bdun dag nas bsnyen tshad rtags thon 'byung : sa ma ya: ྀatsha: rgya: sngon 'gro skyabs sems ni: na moḥ 'di bzung byang chub snying po ma thob bar: bla ma mchog gsum 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: kun 'dus khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: gus pas skyabs mchi 'jam dpal mchog 'grub shog: gnyis pa ni:

hūm̐: bdag nyid khro bo rdo rje nag po yi: thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya skar ltar 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs: gtor ma len phyir skad cig myur du 'dus: oṃ ya mān+ta ka bhū ta rā dza dza dzaḥ gsum pa: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ nyon cig bgegs dang lan chags mgron: dug gsum gtor ma 'di longs la: so sor rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste bka' 'gal dam nyams na: nga nyid gshin rje khro rgyal gyi: sku gsung thugs sprul steng 'og khengs: khro chu'i mtshon cha me 'od 'khrugs: lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du rlog: de bas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa: hūm̐: bdag nyid 'jam dpal khro bo nag po yi: thugs las srung ba'i gur khang nag po 'phros: dum bu rim dgu rngams shing 'jigs rung ni: phyi rol dang po ye nas stong pa'i gur: gnyis pa gnam lcags ur mo mchod rten gur: gsum pa dug rlangs khro bo nag po'i gur: bzhi pa ral gri bsam chod rdo rje'i gur: lnga pa gri gug rdo rje gtun shing gur: drug pa me ri stong nyid ka li'i gur: bdun pa 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gur: brgyad pa khro bo dkar po nang gzigs gur: dgu pa 'jam dpal dkar po shel gyi gur: de nang bsrung bya tshud nas rdo rje yi: lte ba hūm̐ du gshin rje'i pho brang gyur: oṃ badz+ra ya mān+ta ka e ka ya ma du ru tsakra rak+ṣa: lnga pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dug lnga rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i: sku lnga ye shes mchod sprin rgya mtsho ni: phyi nang dpag med khengs pa'i bdud rtsi mchog: sku mchog bdud rtsi gnyis bsdus thabs shes 'bar: zung 'jug gnyis med dgyes pa chen por bskyed: oṃ sarba pañtsa pū dza a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: drug pa ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: hūm̐: rang byung kun gzhi mkha' ltar khyab:

de las dbyings rig rtsal snang spros: kun rgyu sprul pa'i sa bon hūm̐: dbyings gyur kun snang skye med rdzogs: oṃ badz+ra shrī dzñā na hūm̐: bdun pa gzhal yas lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid gdod nas e yi klong : rgyu rkyen spros pa sa bon shar: de 'gyur dug gi rlung dmar 'tshubs: zhe sdang me 'bar 'ur 'ur chem: 'dod chags rak+ta rlabs chen 'phyo: phrag dog keng rus ri rab brjid: ru tra sa gzhi 'khor lo bskor: rdo rje rmang gzhi khro chu'i dal: gru bzhi dug rlangs sngo dmar 'tsher: zur brgyad lcags bsregs dmar zhing rngam: ka gdung las gshin khro zhing gtum: nang du dur khrod brgyad ldan mdzes: thog steng don snying tsit+tas brgyan: srin po'i pho brang ltar snang ba: phyi nang dur khrod chas rdzogs gsal: de dbus khro chu lcags khang nang : dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum gsal: de'i steng gnam lcags 'khor lo ni: spu gri'i drwa ba g.yas g.yon 'khor: de dbus gnam lcags rdo rje ni: lte ba hūm̐ dang ya yis mtshan: gnas gyur skad cig gshin rje'i gshed: 'jigs byed dug ri nag po'i sku: kham nag dug gi gdong pa can: zhal dgu rngam zhing khro gtum pa: rtsa zhal dbus gdong ma he khro: g.yas g.yon kham nag srog la rngam: de'i steng dug gdong dmar nag mthing : de'i steng rigs gsum dkar dmar ser: 'jam dpal nag po'i dbang rtags rdzogs: dmar nag ral pas 'dzam gling khyab: thod skam khro rol sprul char 'bebs: sbrul nag zhags 'dren gling bzhi gtams: shangs nas dug rlangs bgegs dpung 'gyel: zhal bgrad dgra snying srog la rol: mche gtsigs sma ra smin ma mthing : dgyes pa'i gad mos stong gsum g.yo: rab 'bar bden gnyis gdug pa 'dul: rtsa phyag rdo rje phur pa 'dril: g.yas pa bcu drug mtshon cha ni: gri khug ral gri chu gri me: kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje 'khor lo mdung : lcags kyu spu gri dbyug to dkar:

ḍā ru dgra satwa zhags pa 'khyugs: tho ba gsal shing rgyal mtshan phyar: phyag g.yon bcu drug las kyi mtshon: thod khrag snying phreng rgyu ma 'dren: gtun khung lcags sgrog rnga chung ldir: mgo phreng ru mtshon dug rlangs nag: dril bu me long kong zor dmar: khram shing shwa rdel rtsis rdo nag: g.yang gzhi rdeb cing dgra yul 'joms: glang ko zhing lpags gdug pa 'dul: mgo phreng sbrul rgyan klu bdud 'dar: khrag thig zo ris dar nag brjid: tshom bu rtags rgya me dpung 'bar: spu gri'i sgro gshog stong khams g.yo: lte bar chu srin khro zhal gdangs: sku stod las kyi rtags rgya gsal: sku smad gnam lcags dbal phur rngam: byad ma dgra bo'i snying khar brdzis: sbyor yum dug ti khro mo dmar: zhal gsum sngo dmar nag la khro: spyan dgu sdang mig srid gsum g.yo: dmar nag ral pa nam mkhar khyab: thod skam dbu rgyan dug lnga 'dul: shangs nas rlung g.yos zhal gdangs bgrad: rtsa phyag gri thod yab la 'khyud: g.yas gnyis rdo rje 'khor lo phyar: g.yon gnyis phur pa ral gri brdegs: rus rgyan ga shal dar dpyangs dmar: sbrul chun gzig sham khrag zhag thig: thal tshom mi sdug rtags kyis spras: zhabs gnyis dpa' stobs yab la 'khril: kun 'dus khro bo'i thugs ka ru: khro chu dug gdong dmar nag 'bar: dbus mthing g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal: zhal gdangs spyan dgu dbu skra bskyod: rigs gsum mchod rten dbang rtags rdzogs: g.yas gsum dgra satwa g.yon gsum snying : dur khrod chas kyis sku la brgyan: sgro gshog brgyangs shing mchu sder khro: dbal phur dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: de yi thugs kar 'khor lo'i dbus: tshe bdag khro bo mthing nag 'bar: g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo gri: g.yon gsum dgra satwa sdigs mdzub me: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs gnyis rol stabs me dpung 'bar: de yi thugs kar rdo rje yi: lte bar srid pa'i 'khor lo dmar:

zhal gcig phyag bzhi sgeg cing khro: g.yas gnyis me dpung rdo rje gdengs: g.yon gnyis rtse gsum tsit+ta 'bar: dur khrod chas rdzogs rol stabs bzhugs: de yi thugs kar thig le'i dbus: hūm̐ yig mthing nag ya yig mtshan: gsal 'tsher gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: gtso bo'i spyi gtsug dmar nag me klong dbus: 'jam dpal nag po 'jigs rung mthing nag rngams: zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs byed dpal chas rdzogs: g.yas su ral gri gri gug rdo rje 'bar: g.yon gsum po ti snying phreng thod khrag 'thung : sgro gshog brgyangs shing rdo rje'i dbal zur ldan: de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dbus: rta mgrin dmar smug zhal gsum phyag drug ni: g.yas gsum dbyug to rdo rje tho ba phyar: g.yon gsum lcags sgrog zhags pa dril bu 'khrol: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum me dpung klong na brjid: de yi thugs kar zla gdan 'khor lo'i dbus: gsang bdag mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub bsgrengs: dur khrod chas rdzogs rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: de yi thugs kar nā da thig le'i dbus: hrīḥyig dmar ser bkrag mdangs lam mer gsal: hūm̐: gtso bo'i spyi gtsug 'ja' zer klong : 'jam dpal dkar po phyag bzhi pa: g.yas gnyis ral gri shel phreng dkar: g.yon gnyis po ti ut+pal dmar: skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: de yi thugs kar 'od kyi klong : rdo rje dkar po gsal stong bsgom: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng : shar du dgra nag khro bo gtum: zhal gsum phyag drug phur gsham brjid: g.yas gsum sbrul zhags rgyal mtshan gri: g.yon gsum khyab 'jug zhags pa me: dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs par bsgom: lho ru ki kang dmar nag rngam: zhal gsum phyag drug dur khrod chas: g.yas gsum gsal shing gtun dang mdung : g.yon gsum rgyu zhags mgo snying dmar: dbal ldan drag tu rngam par bskyed:

nub tu me yi spu gri kham: zhal gsum phyag drug phur gsham ldan: g.yas gsum spu gri dkar dmar sngo: g.yon gsum chu gri sngo nag ljang : dur khrod chas rdzogs dpa' zhing brjid: byang du gdong drug mthing nag rngam: g.yas gsum dug mda' rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum lcags gzhu dril bu thod: dur khrod chas ldan rngam zur bskyed: mtshams bzhir dug ti rtsa 'jib bzhi: rdo rje phur pa 'dril zhing khro: yab la dgyes shing dur khrod chas: me chu dug mtshon dbus su brjid: phyi rol sgo ma gdong can bzhi: bya rog kaṅka 'ug pa khyung : gcer mo mi sdug gzugs 'chang zhing : phyag mtshan sgo bzhi'i phyag rgya ldan: gzhan yang las gshin dmag tshogs rnams: dgra bo'i sha khrag srog la rngam: las bcol bka' bzhin sgrub par gyur: spo bo'i lugs su/ dug ri khro 'dus kyi mdun bskyed skabs su gzhung nas/ de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum? spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod bstod 'dzab bskul bcas sogs nas mchan/ gtso 'khor de dag thugs ka ru: drag sngags spu gris gtams pa bzhin: 'brug ltar sgra sgrogs 'khor bar gyur: dang po sgrub pa'i sngags ni: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ki kang du tri ya ma rā dza sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes sgrub sngags yengs med chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bzla: dmigs pa spro bsdu sgrub pa'i gzhung dang bstun: bskyed rim gsal bas zhag 'grub the tshom med: de nas rbad sngags ni: dm-igs pa gsal zhing thugs ka nas las kyi gshin rje dpag med 'phros pas dgra bo'i rnam shes liṅga la bkug par bsam zhing : om̐ ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha e ka ya ma ki kang hring kā la du ru dzaḥ pha la dzaḥ dgra bo'i bla srog la dza dzaḥ trag rak+sha kā la du tri dgra bo'i snying la dza dza khug: ya ma du ru dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: snying la bh+yo thun thun: ya ma raṃ shag du dgra bo dza dzaḥ

zhes 'gugs sngags bgrang zhing drag bstim bya: de nas dgra bo'i bla khug rtags su ri dwags ded pa: long ba mi nag 'du ba: cho nge 'debs pa: 'ur sgra 'byin pa sogs byung na khug rtags yin pas: sgrol ba'i thun sngags pa rnams liṅga la sngags shing brdeg pa ni: om̐ ya mān+ta ka yak+sha ya ma rā dza dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: snying la chod chod: e ka ya ma du ru nā ga dgra bo'i sha la rbad rbad: tsit+ta zungs zungs: chum nā ga sha tri dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ki kang kā la rak+sha byad ma'i yul zhing la bh+yo bh+yoḥ raṃ ha la du byad ma'i snying rtsa la chod chod: ma mo mu kha dun+ting dgra bo'i sha la rbad: rtsa la yam yam: ra tsa snying ya ma du nag po shag tshal pa ha la ha la rak+sha rbad chod: bhan+dha bhan+dha nṛ tri khroṃ mā ra ya byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ zhes thun gyi brdeg drag sngags bgrang : de nas dgra bo sod rtags ni: dmag g.yo ba mgo dang nang rol ster ba: sha rul gyi dri bsnams pa sogs 'byung : de ltar rdzogs nas drag po'-i phur bu thogs te bsgral zhing gtub: liṅga drag po'i shing hom gyi nang du bsreg cing : thal ba cha gcig rlung la bskur: cha gcig lam rgya gram du mnan: cha gcig la btsas 'og tu mnan: cha gcig lha 'dre drag po 'gyu srang du mnan: rjes su rdo rje nag po'i mchod rten gyis rgyas gdab ste mi mthong bar byas: e ma dug gi par bu las: zhag sgrub ngan sngags sa ma ya: dgra bor than ltas gtong 'dod na: shog bu gru gang gru bzhi la: dgra gzugs liṅga than gyis bskor: gong gi 'bod sngags rbad sngags bzlas: skyer shing 'khor lo bskor bar bya: ltas ngan 'byung bar the tshom med: than ltas sham bur 'os pa sbyar: rdzogs nas 'khor lo sbyin sreg bya: dgra bor thog ser 'bebs 'dod na: gri khrag drag sngags bsgrub pa yi: ril bu chu mig nang du bskyur: mtsho la drag sngags thun gyis brab: bye ma zhe sdang sbrul du bsam:

rang nyid 'jam dpal nag por bsgoms: myur du drag 'bebs the tshom med: dgra la thog rgod 'bebs 'dod na: rang nyid dug ri khro bor bsam: mdun du dgra bo'i khang khyim brtsegs: dmar nag 'khro ba'i rwa gnyis nas: ram̐ dmar tshwa tshwa ldan pa 'phros: dgra bo sde brgyad g.yul bcas phog: khro zhing dmag dpung bskyed nas kyang : thog dbub dgra yul bshig par bsam: yungs thun gtor zhing drag sngags bzlas: gshin rje'i sde 'khor drag tu brdab: myur du 'joms par the tshom med: dgra bo zha reng smyo 'bog na: liṅga dag la smyo khrag dang : gzhan yang dur phag nag po'i khrag: dug rdzas ril bu 'phang zhing bskul: ma ning shing la liṅga ni: 'khor lo bon 'khor rlung la btsugs: myur du 'grub par the tshom med: dgra bo'i dmag jag kha 'gyed ni: yul bdag lha 'dre'i srog yig dang : dgra bo'i bla rus gang 'dod dang : mo shing dag la 'khor lo bskor: rdeb 'khor nag po lan gsum ni: zhing gnya' dag tu brdab par bya: myur du drag 'byung the tshom med: dgra bo mthun gnyis dbye ba la: pho shing mo shing byang bu'i bar: dgra chings bzhag cing thun gyis brab: dgra bo shag phyes brag la brgyan: myur du 'byung bar the tshom med: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud bcad 'dod na: liṅga'i mngal du gza' rgod ni: ki kang nag po rngam pa'i gzugs: 'khor du dred mong mgo can gyi: sham bu 'os pa sngags brgya bzlas: gshin rje nag po'i gre bar brdzangs: myur du 'byung bar the tshom med: bh+yo: dgra bo mnan gtad byed pa la: drag sngags dug gi par bu ni: dug rdzas dgu yi liṅga la: dgra bo'i bla dwags tshang bar bris: sny-ing ga sbal pa nag po yi: lto bar dgra bo'i ming rus bris: yan lag bzhi la lcags sdig bzhi: sdig sdom sgrol ba'i sngags dag bris: phyi rol dug sbrul pho mos dkris: dar ri gsang gnas dang khug bris: sbrul gyi khog par klu sngags bris:
