phyi rim dza khraṃ khor yug dag gi bris: 'gugs gzhug drag po gong bzhin la: thun gyis legs par lha dbye na: rang gi 'bag btsog ma shor gces: khyi nag phag nag ra rog khrag: yugs sa'i skra yis chings brgyab nas: rdza yi sbal pa'i nang du bzhag: la chas kha bkag zha nyes btum: mtha' med rgya mtsho'i gting du 'phang : yang na chu mig gnyan sar mnan: drag po'i klu la gnyer gtad bya: mi shor chu srin gre bar brdzangs: phyi mig mi lta log par bya: dus ni nam phyed nyin phyed dang : srod 'phros lha 'dre rgyu dus gtad: yang na nyi ma nub mtshams gtad: de dag gzhan gyis mi mthong bya: dgra bo bsod nams che na lan gsum sba: sngags pa nang rgyas lnga sbas so: phal pa dag ni gcig gis thub: byis pa rnams ni lta ci smos: dug gi par bu'i las rim ste: 'di dag las rim bdun pa'o: bdag 'dra drag sngags thod phreng ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu slob la: dam chos bgegs byed dgra bo yis: bstan dang bstan 'dzin yongs la 'tshe: dgra kun jag pas ting 'dzin 'phrog: de phyir bstan dgra bsgral ba yi: dug mtsho par bu nag po 'di: ma 'ongs bu yi don du bzhag: bstan dgra bsgral ba'i mtshon cha yin: zhag sgrub gshin rje'i zhags pa 'di: bka' bab ye shes khyod la gdams: gnas yang rdzong shel gy-i brag phug 'di: chos ngan sngags sgrub gnas ma lags cing : phyis ma 'ongs pa yi don du bstan: gza' ki kang khyab 'jug nag po dang : btsan rol pa skya bdun khyod la gtad: dus drag spyod sum cu'i kha dar la: dgra byad ma bsgral ba'i mtshon cha 'di: don smon lam hūm̐ gi mtshan can 'byung : chos bdag 'dzin la sprod cig a thaṃ rgya:

kha rgya rgyaḥ chos ldan ye shes bu la sprod: thub par srungs shig ki kang rgya: bu la sprod cig tsa tri rgya: sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag po karma las 'brel rtsal gyis rga rgyal gza' bdud nag po'i lto ba nas gdan drangs shing drag sngags gza'i nyin lhag chad med par shog ser ru phab pas sangs rgyas bstan dgra bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: sarba maṅga laṃ// // ca) 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar las: khro chu dug gdong gi mngon rtogs las sngags dang bcas pa bzhugs so: bla ma dang gshin rje'i gshed la gus pas 'dud: de'ang 'jam dpal dpa' bo rab tu khros pa'i bdag nyid khro chu dug gdong chen po'i bskyed chog la mngon par rtogs pa rtsom par mos pa dag gis: thog mar sgo gsum a 'thas su mi btang zhing bag yod go cha btsan pos spobs pa lhur blangs te: rang bzhin gdod nas phyi'i snod dang nang gi bcud ma lus kun gshin rje srid pa'i 'khor lo bya ba 'phro 'dus sgyu ma'i gar ltar 'byung bar ma zad: deng phan chad 'gong por re zhig la gol nas sku'i rol pa rtsal gyis spro bsdu he ru ka ma mthong na skye 'chi la ya nga nas bar gcod la zad mi long ba'i rnal 'byor pa de: sbyangs spel bsgyur gsum gyi lam dang las su 'jug pa ni: sku gshin rje bzhad pa khro bo'i nyams kyi lus sprul bsgyur bgyis pas bdag gi gnyan po gdod nas rang shar yin pas bar gcod bdud las rgyal ba dang : gsung 'byung ba lnga'i rlung gi rang sgra: rtsa'i lam bha ga'i sbubs su 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi rang bzhin chu klung rgya mtsho'i rgyun ltar gyur pa: gzungs sngags me ltar mched pas phas kyi rgol ba shugs las bcom ste: ngag gi bzlas pa rgyun mi chad pas: gzhan gyis dmod pa'i gnyan po de khas bzlog pa dang : thugs gshin rje mkha' ltar g.yo med phyogs lhung bral ba'i sems kyi de nyid gdod ma'i gshis lugs gnyug ma'i lhan skyes la 'chi bdag bdud kyi duḥkha dang bral bas:

ye nas skye ba med cing phyis kyang 'gag pa zad pas shi 'phos sogs 'jig rten gyis ltar snang ltar mi mngon pa rgya mtsho smig rgyu'i rnam pa dang : gya gyur snang ba ltar shes pas nga bdag gi sems su snang ba de: rtog med kyi shes pa rang byung ba'i gnas su khegs pas ming bdag gi mtha' las 'das pa: 'chi bral rang byung : stong pa'i cha ma 'gags pa gsal ba'i nyams su mi zhen pa'i dgongs klong de las mi g.yo bas na pha rol pos bgyis pa'i gdug rtsub shugs la bsal ba'o: de ltar nyams su myong bar 'dod pas: bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum spros med kyi char 'gro bas rdzas la mi brten zhing rang nyid kyis yi dam gyi bdag 'jug gi cho ga 'bral blag med par bsgrub bya spro bsdu'i rnal 'byor gyis: thog mar gnas gang rung ngam: yang na phrin las dang mthun par: shes pa bag phebs pas gdan du 'khod: 'don sgom tshig don dran rdzogs su: gsal gdab pa ni: hūm̐: skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkha' yangs pa ru: rtsa ba'i bla ma rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dmar smug lha lcam mthing 'od 'khril: de la 'jam dpal bka' bab brgyud pas bskor: phyogs dus rgyal kun byin rlabs 'dus pa la: bdag dang 'gro kun byang chub snying po'i bar: rtag par rtse gcig gdung bas skyabs su mchi: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i 'dun pa sems bskyed kyis: kun kyang 'jam mgon go 'phang mchog 'grub shog: gnyis pa ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yo bh+rūm̐ : snod bcud thams cad drag po e yi zhing : mthing nag zur gsum dug gi dud sprin gtibs: 'byung ba tsha grang g.yo ba'i ngar sgra sgrogs: khro chu'i zi ra me dpung phyogs bcur 'khrigs: phyi rol mtshon cha sna tshogs drwa mig gtams: me ri 'tshub cing lcags sdig bya khyung 'phro: srid pa'i rlung yang mi bgrod gur khang nang : de dbus gnam lcags rgya gram ti ra'i steng : rdo rje mthing nag rab 'bar lte ba'i srog:

yi ge hūm̐ ya bh+yo dang phyag mtshan las: 'od zer lnga ldan me ltar phyogs bcur 'phros: dgra bgegs tshar bcad tshe bsod 'ub kyis bsdus: phyag mtshan sa bon la thim gnas gyur te: dran rdzogs skad cig 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: khro chu dug gdong mthing nag rngam pa'i sku: g.yas dkar g.yon ljang zhal gsum gtum la 'bar: spyan rtsa rab g.yo sdang mig phyogs bcur bgrad: shangs nas dud sprin gtib cing sgrol mche gtsigs: dbu skra dmar ser thod skam phreng bas brgyan: spyi bor dug dang khro chu gnam lcags kyi: mchod rten gsum ldan de nang rigs gsum mgon: rang sngags ye shes rang sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs: phyag drug g.yas gsum gnam lcags dgra satwa gdengs: g.yon gsum byad ma'i tsit+ta srog snying bsnams: spu gri chu gri'i sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs: dur khrod chas brgyad 'jigs pa'i gar dgu ldan: dpal chas rngam pa'i snang srid skar ltar 'khrugs: lte bar las kyi chu srin sgrol mche gtsigs: sku smad gnam lcags dbal gsham thog ltar 'bebs: dam sri byad ma'i snying khar bsnun par gsal: pang du 'khyud pa'i yum mchog srid pa'i bdag: dmar nag gri thod 'dzin pas mgul du 'khyud: dur khrod chas ldan zung 'jug gtum pa mo: stong khams sreg pa'i tshwa tshwa sku la 'phro: yab yum me dpung dug rlang dbus su gsal: hūm̐: g.yas su sku dang gsung gi sprul: 'chi bdag nag cing tshe bdag dmar: g.yon du thugs dang yon tan sprul: srog bdag ser nag be wa khams: mdun du za ba ljang nag ste: lnga po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: gtso bor chas mthun rab tu rngam: rgyab tu ya ma rā dza mthing : g.yas g.yon seṅge phag gi gdong : rtsa zhal las kyi chu srin khro: g.yas gsum ral gri khyung sdig thogs: g.yon gsum sbrul zhags glog ltar 'khyug: kun kyang byad ma 'joms par gsal: hūm̐: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros 'og min zhing khams nas:

'jam dpal khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sku: gshin rje'i gshed po'i dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes gnas nas spyan drangs te: bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: sku gsung thugs kyi nus pa bskyed: phrin las rnam bzhi'i rtsal phyungs la: phyi nang mi mthun bar chad sol: dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar bcad nas: sku gsum lha ru bdag gyur te: bskyed pa'i khro rgyal sku ru shar: drag sngags rdo rje'i rang sgra sgrog: gnas pa hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du la: bdag med ye shes me dpung 'bar: snod bcud gshin rje'i gshed po yi: rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ngang du gsal: oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti: kā la rū pa a kro rā dza ya ma rā dza sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa'i snying po gcig tu bsgril te nyams len rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bya zhing : spros bcas sgrub chen ltar bcad rgyar gnas skabs sam: spros med rgyun du nyin re bzhin bskyed rim tshar re nas bzlas pa la 'bung bar bya'o: yang gnas skabs su sgrub pa po'i phyi nang gi bar chad bzlog pa ni: sngags stong tshar song nas sham bu 'di sbyar te lag rdeb dang bcas pa bya: e ka ya ma du ru tsa sha na byad ma nṛ tri trig nan e hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags zlog: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags zlog: yi dam lha yis bka' chad zlog: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i sun kha zlog: gshin rje dregs pa'i khram kha zlog: bdud kyis bar du gcod pa zlog: btsan gyis shwa rdel sprugs pa zlog: sde brgyad rtsis la thebs pa zlog: 'byung pos thod zor 'phen pa zlog: lha min dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: phyogs skyong bcu yis hom yar zlog: rgya gar yi ges dmod pa zlog: rgya nag bsgyur gto gtong ba zlog: zhang zhung dzo zor 'phen pa zlog:

sum pas glang zor 'phen pa zlog: ban+des sngags zor 'phen pa zlog: bon pos gtor zor 'phen pa zlog: drang srong dmod pa zug pa zlog: skye bos mda' zor 'phen pa zlog: bud med dmod zor 'phen pa zlog: dmag jag dgra rkun thams cad zlog: brgya yis ya kha dmod pa zlog: stong gis bram mchu sdig pa zlog: gson 'dre pho mos gdug rtsub zlog: gnam gyis dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa zlog: lo nyes sad ser mu ge zlog: sme ba spar kha ngan pa zlog: skeg dang phung sri lang ba zlog: god sri gyod byur thams cad zlog: gri sris shes rgyud dkrugs pa zlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: byad zor phur kha thams cad zlog: ban gyi byad kha dgra la zlog: bon gyi byad kha dgra la zlog: pho bdud mo bdud dal kha zlog: spyi bdud chung bdud dal kha zlog: bzlog cig bsgyur cig mā ra ya: e ka du na e sa bh+yo zlog: ces sngags lan gsum bzlas nas bzlog pa bya: byad ma 'bum rdeg gi sngags zlog yin pas rnal 'byor pa gang la la zhig gis rgyun du mi chag par bzlog pa 'di bgyis na phur thogs stong la 'gras kyang byad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro: yang sde brgyad kyis rgyun du za kha zug na sngags 'di la bzlog pa sbyar te: e ka sa du mā ra ya a sha ru tri tsa na sde brgyad yongs kyi byad kha zug pa thams cad e thum khroṃ ya zlog zlog: des ni sde brgyad kyis 'tshe ba thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro: yang dur sri dang shi sris rgyun du gnod na sngags 'di bzlas la bzlog pa gong bzhin bya ste: oṃ pra sod: chu sod: dur rta sod: dur mi sod: snying mgo la chod: snying mgo la rbad: ka la dzaḥ kaṃ shaṃ tri rbad phaṭ swā hā: des ni shi ba'i gshed kha dang dur sgo bye na nges par bzlog go:

yang dgra dang rkun jag gis sdang na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: oṃ e hri hūm̐ thun ta sha kra ru ya phyogs thams cad kyi dgra sri ya ma nan brub bzlog yaḥ e thum tso ra mi li mi li thar ni thar ni dgra rkun thams cad ching ya zlog zlog: des ni dgra sri langs pa thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro: yang yul la 'khrug rtsod kyi sri che na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: a tri la dri sha dri ya 'byung po kha kha ru ṇi gri sri phe sha dur kha trig ya ma ya yul gyi 'dre chag dang 'khrug rtsod gri sri thams cad zlog zlog: yang zhing khang nor rdzas la dbul sri zhugs na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e kra ma kra ma pri ta ki ra ya dbul sri mi la dri thun da ra da ra bsod nams dang phyugs g.yang nyams pa thams cad zlog zlog: yang mi kha gleng gzhi sgrogs shing g.yeng na: sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e kha thun he brub ti laṃ tha raṃ yaṃ khaṃ mu ra tri ya snang srid yongs kyis dmod pa'i mi kha thams cad zlog zlog: des ni gleng gzhi'i mi kha las grol bar 'gyur ro: yang gson 'dre pho mos gnod pa byung na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e ha sa ha sa ka la ku ru bhū ta nan ka li shaṃ du ru nan mi pa kā ya 'jig rten srid pa'i sdug 'dre pho mo'i gdug pa zlog zlog: des ni gson 'dre'i gnod pa las grol lo: yang lo dgra gshed 'phrad pas gnod na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e ya ma su tri ra tri sha ma sha na su ma tri ya ma yo ra tri ye 'byung ba dgra gshed 'phrad pa'i gdug pa thams cad zlog zlog: des ni 'byung ba dgra gshed 'phrad pa las grol lo: yang rmi lam rtags dang mtshan ma ngan pa byung na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e bh+yo thum rbad lok+t+ri pā la baṃ shag ru lu this pa de ya ma tri ya ma tri thun nan rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad zlog zlog:

des ni rmi ltas mtshan ngan las grol lo: yang pha rol gyis gtad khram du tshud na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e ka ya he kro ta kā la ya ghṛr ma ṇa ma ru ti sarba satwaṃ bha ya pha rol gyi byad gtad du bcug cing khram la btab pa thams cad mā ra ya zlog zlog: des ni byad gtad du bcug pa las grol lo: yang chos sgrub pa rnams la bar chad kyi bgegs zhugs na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e ya ma a ti sha trig thun ya ma kha thun nṛ tri ra ha la ma dkar po'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad mā ra ya zlog zlog: des ni chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad las grol lo: de ltar phrin las so so'i sham bur gzhung sngags kyi mjug tu sbyar zhing gnad che na bzlog pa brgya re bya ba khyad chos yin no: gzhan gzhung du sngags dang bzlog bya rnams rlung la bskur kyang rung : yang pha rol gyis dmod pa zhi bar 'dod na bzlog pa'i tshig kha bsgyur byas nas 'di ltar shes par bya: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags zhi bar gyur cig: ces thams cad kha sgyur bya yang rung : rlung 'khor mi bya na zhi ba zhes mi dgos: spyir gang zag so so'i blo dang bstun: spros med kyi sgrub pa bya ba'i tshe bzlog pa'i sham bu 'di dgos par ma lags kyang spyir them byang ma bral nas rang gi las phran de ltar 'khor los bzhag pa yin: de'ang las phran dgos sam mi dgos gang zag so so'i lta ba rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad la rag las: rab lta ba rang byung gyad kyi lha yin zhing de la snod bcud thams cad dag pa chos sku 'ba' zhig mthong bas zlog byed kyi gnyen po mi dgos te lta ci smos: 'bring phra rags kyi rtags phra mo nyi ma shar ba'i zer gzengs pa lta bu'i rnam pa sna tshogs 'char ba rnams kyis bdag 'dzin gyi duḥkha bzlog pa ste shin tu dgos pa che: tha ma sngon las 'phral rkyen zad mi shes pa chu bo gcong rong du 'gro ba'i gnyer ma 'byung ba rnams la bden pa'i tshig brjod pa kho na gtso che de'i ched du las phran gyi sham bu nges par dgos pa'o:

khyad par gshin rje khro chu 'di kun gyi nang nas thun mong ma yin pa'i lha yin: ci zhe na rigs bdag sku gsum gyis mtshan pas brgyud pa'i brgyud pa gzhan nas mi dgos: sku stod khro rgyal me ltar 'bar bas stobs bcu gzhan nas mi dgos: sgyu 'phrul dbal gshog ldan pas bgrod 'gyu'i rtsal mi dgos: lte ba chu srin rngam zhal ldan pas za byed las mkhan gzhan nas mi dgos: sku smad mtshon phur zur gsum ldan pas gsod byed pho nya gzhan nas mi dgos: rang bzhin khro chu'i ngar dang ldan pas srung 'khor gur khang gzhan nas mi dgos: shugs la me dpung dug rlung gtibs pas sreg gtor las mtha' gzhan nas mi dgos: sku la rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pas bsgral ba'i tshe lung spar chog mi dgos: snying po'i stobs kyis sa bcur bsnyegs pas rgya khyon a 'thas dmigs pa mi dgos: ci zhe na nges don ltar rang sar gdod nas sprul pa'i khro rgyal chen po 'di shin tu byin rlabs dang nus pa che zhing gzhan la ma 'brel khungs brda yod pa'i mtshan nyid kyang de lta bu ste man ngag zab pa'i lo rgyus so:

sa ma ya: e maḥ gsang bcud snying po yid bzhin nor 'jo las: zab pa'i mthar thug srog 'dzin nā da'i khrag: las 'phro can la brda bzhin mngon phyung nas: snyigs dus yid kyi sgron me rab tu bsngags: ma 'ongs yang mtha' rtsod ldan tha ma ru: rigs sras rgyud 'dzin zhig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos glang lor khrom gzigs me 'bar mtsho nas gdan drangs shing*/ 'brug lor sbrul gyi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin dpal bde chen bdud 'dul gling gi gzim chung lhun grub mngon dga' ru shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // cha) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: bskang ba rngam phreng 'bar ba gdug pa'i g.yul las rgyal byed chen po bzhugs so: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dregs pa mngon spyod bgyi ba'i lha la 'dud: de nas yang 'jam dpal gshin rje gdug pa'i g.yul las rgyal byed chen po'i bskang ba brtsam pa ni: dgyes pa'i spyan gzigs du ma bkram zhing : mkho ba'i mchod rdzas spyi mthun las rim ltar bkram: khyad par khrag sna dang sha chen gyi gsur btang : nga rgyal bskyed cing bskang mchod bkram: rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ hriṣ+ṭi wi kri ta na na hūm̐ phaṭḥ lan gsum: om̐ swa bhā shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā shud+dho haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bhan+dha yangs shing rgya che ba lcang lo can stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten phyam gcig tu bsdus pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang om̐ āḥhūm̐ ya bh+yo dza ti taṃ yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i bskang rdzas bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'jigs byed rdo rje khro bo dug ri nag po'i lha tshogs rnams mnyes pa'i mchod sprin bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur:

gzhan yang dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag klad rus ri rab ltar mtho zhing rgya mtsho ltar zab par gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: zhes byin gyis brlabs: rang nyid rdo rje khro bo ya ga dang bcas te gzi byin nus pa'i shugs bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ e ya bh+yoḥ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma lho phyogs pha ki na: gshin yul zhes bya 'jigs pa'i gling : dur khrod rngam drag 'bar ba'i tshul: de yi mkha' dbyings pho brang du: bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rig 'dzin tshogs: dus gsum sangs rgyas gshegs su gsol: rigs gsum mgon po gshegs su gsol: 'jam dpal rigs lnga gshegs su gsol: aiḥ 'chi bdag las kyi pho brang nas: 'jigs byed dug ri gshegs su gsol: go cha khro bcu gshegs su gsol: tshe bdag 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: khro chu dug gdong gshegs su gsol: dgra 'dul nag po gshegs su gsol: me yi spu gri gshegs su gsol: pho gshin mo gshin gshegs su gsol: sgo ba sgo ma gshegs su gsol: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gshegs su gsol: dur khrod pho brang dbus su bzhugs: bam ro brtsegs pa'i khri la bzhugs: dam sri bsgral phyir gnas su bzhugs: khrag zhag 'khyil ba'i klong du bzhugs: dug rlangs 'khrugs pa'i dal du bzhugs: phyi mchod lha mo gar bsgyur 'bul: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta 'bul: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po 'bul: bsgral mchod māṃ sa sha chen 'bul: bskang mchod tshogs dang gtor ma 'bul: spyan gzigs bkram pa sna tshogs 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: om̐ sarba bhi dh+wa dha ra ma ti taṃ swā hā: e phaiṃ phaiṃ badz+ra a ra li li hriṃ hriṃ sarba pū dza hoḥ de nas bskang ba ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: pha rol dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can gyi: srog rtsa bcad pa'i 'khor lo'i gtor gzhong du:

tsit+ta dmar po nam mkha' khrag ris can: 'thib pa'i 'dab ma bzhi yis rtsa ba bskor: sbug pa'i pags pa zlum pos phyi nas g.yogs: gshin rje brgya stong 'du byed sbu gus brgyan: nang du snying khrag dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: dgra bgegs sha yi rang byung me tog 'dis: bcom ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum thugs dam bskang : go cha khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro chu dug gdong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dgra nag gdong drug yab yum thugs dam bskang : me yi spu gri yab yum thugs dam bskang : sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed bdud pho sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya a tsar sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang : mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i thugs dam bskang : las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskang ngo gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : mdzod cig drag po las kyi mngon spyod mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can gyi: skye 'chi srid pa bcad pa'i rdzas chen po: lte ba nyon mongs 'khor ba'i me chen gyis:

dbu ma bsregs pa'i gti mug dud sprin 'khrigs: ro ma bsregs pa'i 'dod chags dud sprin 'khrigs: rkyang ma bsregs pa'i zhe sdang dud sprin 'khrigs: drug cu'i rtsa bsregs nyon mongs dud sprin 'khrigs: rdzas chen lnga sogs ngad bzang rang byung spos: dgra bgegs phung khams rang byung dri mchog 'dis: bcom ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum thugs dam bskang : go cha khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro chu dug gdong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dgra nag gdong drug yab yum thugs dam bskang : me yi spu gri yab yum thugs dam bskang : sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed bdud pho sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya a tsar sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang : mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i thugs dam bskang : las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskang ngo gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : mdzod cig drag po las kyi mngon spyod mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: gnam lcags snod kyi kong bu hom yangs su: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sgal tshig sdong bu la:

mi lpags rta lpags la sogs ro ras dkris: rkang dang lha ba sa bon khu ba zhag: chu ser la sogs btul ba'i bsdus khu'i bcud: mdangs ldan khrag gi 'od ltar 'gengs pa la: rang bzhin 'bar ba sbyar dug me btab pas: tsha ngar 'khrigs pa'i snang gsal sgron me 'di: bcom ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum thugs dam bskang : go cha khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro chu dug gdong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dgra nag gdong drug yab yum thugs dam bskang : me yi spu gri yab yum thugs dam bskang : sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed bdud pho sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya a tsar sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang : mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i thugs dam bskang : las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskang ngo gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : mdzod cig drag po las kyi mngon spyod mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: 'phro 'du rdzing ltar bskyil ba'i snod mchog ru: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma bsgral ba yi: zungs khrag dmar nag rol chu lta bu 'khyil:

mchin khrag smug nag dud khu bzhin du g.yo: glo khrag skya bo khu rlangs bzhin du 'phyur: mkhal khrag nar ma lu ma bzhin du babs: mtsher khrag ser skya mtsho bun bzhin du chags: rgyu khrag nag po khron pa bzhin du 'khyil: mngal khrag sil ma da chu bzhin du mkhar: dug gi ngad bun dri chab dam pa 'dis: bcom ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum thugs dam bskang : go cha khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro chu dug gdong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dgra nag gdong drug yab yum thugs dam bskang : me yi spu gri yab yum thugs dam bskang : sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed bdud pho sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya a tsar sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang : mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i thugs dam bskang : las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskang ngo gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : mdzod cig drag po las kyi mngon spyod mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: byad ma sdig can bsgral ba'i bhan+dha ru: nas nag bra bo sran ma ram bu la: gla rtsi gu gul spru nag dug gi khrag:

shing kun thang khrom dug gi me tog dang : rgya rtsi dug lo khyi dug phag dug pa: thams cad bsdus pa'i phye mar brlan pa'i rdzas: gri khrag rta khrag 'brong khrag ma he'i khrag: ngad ldan bcud chang du mas sbrus pa 'di: dmar nag zhi rgyas dbang gi gzugs can la: mtha' gnyis sgo bzhi rgya yi khram ris gzugs: sha yi ba dan khrag gis yur ba 'then: rgyu ma'i drwa khug la sogs bris pa yi: bha ling+ta yi gtor chen 'bar ba 'dis: bcom ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum thugs dam bskang : go cha khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro chu dug gdong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dgra nag gdong drug yab yum thugs dam bskang : me yi spu gri yab yum thugs dam bskang : sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed bdud pho sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya a tsar sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang : mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i thugs dam bskang : las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskang ngo gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : mdzod cig drag po las kyi mngon spyod mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas:

srin po pho mo bhan+dha ltag sprod la: byad ma bsgral ba'i mkhal ma'i 'phan rdo sbyar: sor bcus 'khrol tshe stong sgra khra la la: dug shing ngar ldan dgu yi rnga shing la: pho mo zhe sdang mtshon gyis bsad pa yis: gri lpags dmar pos g.yogs te ro skras brgyan: gri lag g.yas pa mchog gis brdung ba yis: snang srid sngangs ba'i sgra skad phyogs bcur sgrog: pho lcags mo lcags gri lcags zhun ldan la: gser dngul zangs rag rin chen rdzas kyis spras: sna lnga'i rgya chings ldan pa'i rnga shing la: stag g.yag ngar 'dzing shi ba'i pags pas g.yogs: mi rgod g.yang du lhung ba'i lag pas brdung : dmod pa'i ngan sngags rang sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: bsad pa mngon spyod sna tshogs rnga chen 'dis: bcom ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum thugs dam bskang : go cha khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro chu dug gdong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dgra nag gdong drug yab yum thugs dam bskang : me yi spu gri yab yum thugs dam bskang : sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed bdud pho sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya a tsar sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang : mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i thugs dam bskang : las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong thugs dam bskang :

'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskang ngo gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : mdzod cig drag po las kyi mngon spyod mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: bdud kyi mi nag go khrab sna tshogs thogs: btsan gyi mi dmar sho rdel ri ltar spungs: klu mo nag mo rtsis kyi sho khram thogs: gshin rje pho nya mo rnams rngam skad sgrog: gnod sbyin nag po me 'bud sgra skad sgrog: ma mo nag mos nad kyi rlangs pa btang : mkha' yi las byed yams kyi par bu thogs: gza' yi bu mos dgra bo'i glo snying khur: the'u rang bu mos dgra bo'i 'dus brgya thogs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i drag mchod 'dis: bcom ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum thugs dam bskang : go cha khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro chu dug gdong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dgra nag gdong drug yab yum thugs dam bskang : me yi spu gri yab yum thugs dam bskang : sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed bdud pho sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya a tsar sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang : mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i thugs dam bskang :

las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskang ngo gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : mdzod cig drag po las kyi mngon spyod mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: dgra bo'i pho rgyud thams cad bsgral ba yi: bam ril nag po ya kha'i snod mchod du: dug khrag bcud dang ldan pa'i myos byed po: rdzas chen du ma'i zung dang lhan cig du: sbyar ba'i dza gad bhi sha bdud rtsi che: bsil ldan chu yi lbu ltar phyu ru ru: dgra bo'i mo rgyud thams cad bsgral ba yi: bhan+dha skam rlon skra yi lan tshar can: yangs shing rgya che'i nang du dgra bo'i khrag: dmar chen rak+ta rgya mtsho kyi li li: khrag gi lbu ba lha min gnas su 'khrigs: lbu ba'i rtse mo dbang po'i me tog ni: lang ling sna tshogs chang 'gag sbang ltar 'phyur: mthong na mi bzod dmar 'od ta la la: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud thams cad bsgral ba yi: bam shun snod mchog gling bzhi ltar yangs pa'i: nang du dgra bo'i mi rabs bdun rgyud kyi: sha yi phung po ri rab lta bur spungs: khrag gi rgya mtsho zham chu lta bur 'khyil: rus pa khral khrol rdza rud sha ltar nyil: rnam shes srog 'dzin bskal pa'i rlung ltar 'tshubs: don snying rnam lnga'i rgyan 'phyang nyi li li: lta bas mi khyab sman gtor rak+ta 'dis: bcom ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum thugs dam bskang : go cha khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro chu dug gdong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dgra nag gdong drug yab yum thugs dam bskang : me yi spu gri yab yum thugs dam bskang : sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang :

khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed bdud pho sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya a tsar sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang : mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i thugs dam bskang : las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskang ngo gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : mdzod cig drag po las kyi mngon spyod mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: snang srid thams cad dur khrod gzhal yas khang : snod bcud thams cad skye 'chi rlung ltar 'tshubs: nyi ma bsad cing zla ba gum pa yi: mun pa'i g.yang gzhi bla bre mkha' la bris: skar ma gtor zhing dgu tshigs gtub pa yi: dbyings kyi rtsa mdud drwa ba'i 'phan rdo 'phyangs: tshangs pa'i gnas rnams bcom pa'i pho brang dang : lha min 'thab pa'i dur khrod thod pa'i mkhar: gri lpags rgyal mtshan gdugs dang thod pa'i tog: srin po'i g.yang gzhi yol ba khyon du brgyangs: dgra bo'i mgo lag rgyu drwas mtha' ru brgyan: don snying sna tshogs 'phan rdo grangs med spras: bya gcan sha gzan pags pas phyogs kun brgyan: sa gzhi thams cad keng rus gar thabs bsgyur: dur bya dur phag dug sbrul nyi li li: dur gyi lce spyang lag ring cho nge 'debs: gshin rje'i gnas nyul ma mo sprin ltar 'thibs: dur khrod pho brang rgyan bkod du ma 'dis: bcom ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang :

rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum thugs dam bskang : go cha khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro chu dug gdong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dgra nag gdong drug yab yum thugs dam bskang : me yi spu gri yab yum thugs dam bskang : sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed bdud pho sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya a tsar sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang : mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i thugs dam bskang : las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskang ngo gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : mdzod cig drag po las kyi mngon spyod mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: pha rol dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbal ldan mtshon: gnam lcags rdo rje ral gri thog ltar 'bebs: gri gug dgra satwa kha ṭ+wāṃ char ltar 'khrugs: tho ba gsal shing be con skyogs ltar bsgreng : spu gri chu srin lcags kyu sog le 'tshubs: zangs lcags 'khor lo phur bu las chas bkram: dbyug pa gtun shing hom gzar 'jib mchu can: sho rdel rtsis khram las kyi byang bu bcas: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu dang : gzhan yang kun tu de srid sna tshogs mtshon:

dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i spyan gzigs 'dis: bcom ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum thugs dam bskang : go cha khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro chu dug gdong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dgra nag gdong drug yab yum thugs dam bskang : me yi spu gri yab yum thugs dam bskang : sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed bdud pho sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya a tsar sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang : mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i thugs dam bskang : las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskang ngo gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : mdzod cig drag po las kyi mngon spyod mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: chu glang sngo nag ngar sgras sa gzhi khyab: g.yag sngon lug sngon ra sngon bya sngon dang : rta sngon khyi sngon sbal sbrul sngon po sogs: gzhan yang 'dzam gling khams 'dir srid pa yis: bdag tu bzung dang ma bzung dud 'gro'i rigs: rwa can rmig can sna tshogs gar rtsed bsgyur: 'dab chags sna tshogs 'phur 'phyo 'jums shing lding : sder chags sna tshogs rngam zhing dgra sha za:

sdug dang mi sdug sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: gzhan yang gshin rje'i las byed pho nya ba: mi dkar glu len zhags pa thogs pa 'bum: mi nag khram thogs khrag bam khur ba 'bum: mi dmar ral bsigs sho rdel thogs pa 'bum: mi sngon sbrul zhags sdom nag thogs pa 'bum: mi ser ri rab zor ltar thogs pa 'bum: mi ljang mdung dmar dgra la 'phen pa 'bum: phag sbrul sdom sdig la sogs bye ba'i tshogs: drag po dgyes pa'i spyan gzigs du ma 'dis: bcom ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum thugs dam bskang : go cha khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro chu dug gdong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dgra nag gdong drug yab yum thugs dam bskang : me yi spu gri yab yum thugs dam bskang : sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed bdud pho sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya a tsar sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang : mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i thugs dam bskang : las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskang ngo gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : mdzod cig drag po las kyi mngon spyod mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ

'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i lha tshogs rnams: phyi yi rdzas mchog thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: phyi yi bar chad dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: nang gi rdzas mchog thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: nang gi bar chad dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: gsang ba'i rdzas mchog thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: gsang ba'i bar chad dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: sbyor ba'i rdzas mchog thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: zung 'jug bar chad dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: sgrol ba'i mchod pas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: sgrub pa'i bar chad dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: spyan gzigs mchod pas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: las kyi bar chad dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: sna tshogs mchod pas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed khro bo'i rgyal: las kyi gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi: rigs kyi bdag po'i thugs dam bskang ba ni: sngar 'das chos rnams ye sangs rgyas pa'i phyir: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : da lta'i dngos 'dzin ngo bo bdag med phyir: rig 'dzin brda brgyud rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : phyi 'byung ma nges ci yang ston pa'i phyir: gang zag snyan brgyud rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : sems can zhe sdang gdug pa tshar gcod phyir: khrag 'thung 'jam dpal nag po'i thugs dam bskang : sems can 'dod chags g.yo ba 'dul ba'i phyir: byams mgon spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : sems can gti mug 'thibs pa gzhom pa'i phyir: gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i thugs dam bskang : nyon mongs 'jigs brgyad bcu drug zhi ba'i phyir: 'jam dpal dpa' bo dkar po'i thugs dam bskang : tshe bsod dpal dang 'byor drug rgyas pa'i phyir: 'jam dpal dpa' bo ser po'i thugs dam bskang : rang snang dbang 'dus gzhan snang zil gnon phyir: 'jam dpal dpa' bo dmar po'i thugs dam bskang :

drag po las kyi dgra bgegs tshar gcod phyir: 'jam dpal dpa' bo ljang gu'i thugs dam bskang : skye med snying pos 'gro ba bsgral ba'i phyir: 'jam dpal dpa' bo mthing nag thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing phrin las bcol ba ni: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bla med a ti zla gsang thig le yi: mchog thun 'bras bu bdag gis 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ dpal chen mngon spyod chen po'i phrin las pa: ye shes 'jig rten 'gran zla bral ba'i phyir: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar thugs dam bskang : srid pa rgyas 'debs skye 'gro dbang bsgyur phyir: rdo rje dur khrod bdag mo'i thugs dam bskang : ma mo 'bum gyi gtso mo las byed ma: sgrol yum ro langs ma yi thugs dam bskang : spyi bo'i gnas su badz+ra gshin rje'i gshed: ma mo chu yi las byed yum dang sbyor: khro bo me long dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang : mgrin pa'i gnas su pad+ma gshin rje'i gshed: ma mo me yi las byed yum dang sbyor: khro bo sor rtog dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang : snying kha'i gnas su bud+dha gshin rje'i gshed: ma mo nam mkha'i las kyi yum dang sbyor: khro bo ye shes dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang : lte ba'i gnas su rat+na gshin rje'i gshed: ma mo sa yi las byed yum dang sbyor: khro bo mnyam nyid dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i gnas su karma gshin rje'i gshed: ma mo rlung gi las byed yum dang sbyor: khro bo bya grub dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang : dpung pa g.yas su zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed: ma mo za byed nag mo yum dang sbyor: pho rgyud zil gnon khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : dpung pa g.yon du 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed: ma mo gsod byed nag mo yum dang sbyor: mo rgyud zil gnon khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : brla g.yas dag la nga rgyal gshin rje'i gshed: ma mo sgrol byed nag mo yum dang sbyor:

snang srid zil gnon khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : brla g.yon dag la phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed: ma mo las byed nag mo yum dang sbyor: snod bcud zil gnon khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : gnas su khyab pa'i gti mug gshin rje'i gshed: ma mo 'dod khams gtso mo yum dang sbyor: 'khor 'das zil gnon khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ shar phyogs gshin rje 'dzam gling dbang sgyur ba: tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang : shar phyogs skye 'gro kun la rgyas 'debs pa'i: yum mchog khrag mig ma yi thugs dam bskang : shar phyogs dgra bgegs rtsis la 'debs pa'i phyir: sgrol yum srid pa dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang : lho phyogs gshin rje 'dzam gling dbang sgyur ba: khro chu dug gi sdong po'i thugs dam bskang : lho phyogs skye 'gro kun la rgyas 'debs pa'i: yum mchog bhe ta nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : lho phyogs dgra bgegs rtsis la 'debs pa'i phyir: sgrol yum me yi kha rlangs thugs dam bskang : nub phyogs gshin rje 'dzam gling dbang sgyur ba: dgra nag gdong drug chen po'i thugs dam bskang : nub phyogs skye 'gro kun la rgyas 'debs pa'i: yum mchog ya ma tsaṇ+ḍi thugs dam bskang : nub phyogs dgra bgegs rtsis la 'debs pa'i phyir: sgrol yum glog ma sprin gyi thugs dam bskang : byang phyogs gshin rje 'dzam gling dbang sgyur ba: ki kang me yi spu gri'i thugs dam bskang : byang phyogs skye 'gro kun la rgyas 'debs pa'i: yum mchog srid pa stobs ldan thugs dam bskang : byang phyogs dgra bgegs rtsis la 'debs pa'i phyir: sgrol yum dug gi mche can thugs dam bskang : hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ rngam byed chen pos shar gyi dgra bgegs sgrol: sras mchog ya ma rā dza'i thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum khrag gi ral can thugs dam bskang : sgrol yum gshin rje yak+sha'i thugs dam bskang :

gtum byed chen pos lho phyogs dgra bgegs sgrol: sras mchog myos byed 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum dug sbrul gos gyon thugs dam bskang : sgrol yum pra ma dun+ti'i thugs dam bskang : dgyes byed chen pos nub kyi dgra bgegs sgrol: sras mchog me ru rtse yi thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum ye shes mkha' 'gying thugs dam bskang : sgrol yum ham sham ra tri thugs dam bskang : gshe byed chen pos byang gi dgra bgegs sgrol: sras mchog ral pa tshar dgu'i thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum srid pa kun rgyu'i thugs dam bskang : sgrol yum nā ga tri sha'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ gza' yi sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje dregs byed nag po'i thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum srin mo khrag 'thung thugs dam bskang : lha yi sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje phya sang gdong dgu'i thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum khams gsum rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje ti la bag 'joms thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum brag srin sman mo'i thugs dam bskang : gshin rje sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje a wa glang mgo'i thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum ya ma du ti'i thugs dam bskang : bdud kyi sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje ya ba til gyi thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum zangs mche btsan mo'i thugs dam bskang : btsan gyi sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje bho ba mig dmar thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum thog gi bu yug thugs dam bskang : ma mo sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje rmigs pa dung ka'i thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum srid pa'i dug mda' thugs dam bskang : klu yi sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje ti li til pa'i thugs dam bskang :

sbyor yum gza' srin kun rgyu'i thugs dam bskang : gnyan gyi sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje thar pa bdud 'joms thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum chu srin 'bar ma'i thugs dam bskang : rgyal po sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje chos rgyal 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum nam gru ma mo'i thugs dam bskang : dam can sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje 'bar ba zor gdong thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum glog lce 'bar ma'i thugs dam bskang : sa bdag sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje sgrol byed thod dbyug thugs dam bskang : sbyor yum phung byed nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : pho brang shar gyi sgo skyong las byed ma: ma mo bya rgod mgo can thugs dam bskang : pho brang lho yi sgo skyong las byed ma: ma mo stag gi gdong can thugs dam bskang : pho brang nub kyi sgo skyong las byed ma: ma mo kaṅka'i mgo can thugs dam bskang : pho brang byang gi sgo skyong las byed ma: ma mo spyang ki'i mgo can thugs dam bskang : hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ bstan pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ging chen ni: dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : byad ma khram la 'debs pa'i bdud pho bzhi: lo zla zhag dus khram bdag thugs dam bskang : sdig can rtsis la 'debs pa'i 'chi bdag bzhi: dus bzhi sho thog ru tra'i thugs dam bskang : ma rungs srog rtsa gcod pa'i shan pa bzhi: ma btsan klu mo gza' yi thugs dam bskang : dmigs pa'i byad ma rtsad gcod mon pa bzhi: rlung gi las mkhan rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pha rol bla srog 'phrog pa'i a tsa ra: glog gi pho nya sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul las byed ni: dug gi phag rgod bswe yi sbal pa dang : dug sbrul lcags sdig rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : gshin rje 'chi bdag dgra la 'gyed pa'i phyir: bla 'gugs las kyi pho nya'i thugs dam bskang :

bla 'bod mi reng srin po'i thugs dam bskang : srid pa las kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang : gsal shing dug gi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang : spu gri me yi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang : khrag mtsho chu yi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang : smyo 'bog rlung gi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum thugs dam bskang : gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

zhes pas: gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang zhing rab tu dgyes nas: pha rol gdug pa'i byad ma 'byung po thams cad bsgral bar bsam: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: ho dgongs su gsol lo dpa' bo rigs kyi bdag: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs gsan du gsol: bdag gis bla med snying po sgor zhugs nas: bskyed rim ma gsal rdzogs rim ma rtogs dang : bzlas brjod grangs nyung sgrub rdzas g.yel ba dang : dam bca' khas blangs dus las 'das pa dang : mngon spyod drag las dus min sbyar ba dang : bskang mchod tshogs bsags mchod gtor chag pa dang : shes bzhin ma bgyis bag med dbang gyur pa'i: le lo rtog tshogs 'khrul pa ci mchis pa: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha la bzod par gsol: bshags pa bzhes nas tshangs par stsal du gsol: ces yig brgya rgyas bsdus gang rung brjod: 'jam dpal ye shes rol pa'i zhal lung rgya mtsho'i dgongs don la mnyam par bzhag pas: yi dam lha yi dam tshig 'gal 'khrul byang zhing mngon spyod las kyi nyes pa phra mo las grol bar 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug gsang mdzod nor bu'i klung : mkha' ltar 'khyil ba'i gdengs ka 'bar ba na: dgos 'dod kun 'byung 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang can: yid can ral pa'i rtse ru son dka' bas: shes rab 'khrul zhing dga' ma'i dbyangs 'khyud 'di: ma 'ongs ral gri pu ti 'dzin la sprod: nag po gsum gyis bka' yi rgya 'di srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra dus mtha'i gter ston gnam lcags thog gi phyung rdeg btab pa len med kyis spu gri bsad pa'i las sbyor rngam pa dug gdong zhes pa lcags sgrom bcu gsum gyi rgya 'dzin 'di ni khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gi gshin rje rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i gnas nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ / sarba maṅga laṃ// // ja) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las:

dpal khrag 'thung mgon po ma hā kā la legs ldan bya rog gdong gi gsol mchod srog gzan nag po byad ma rtsad brlag bzhugs so: khrag 'thung chen po g.yul las rgyal la 'dud: sa ma ya: de'ang khrag 'thung legs ldan ma hā kā la'i gsol mchod brtsam pa'i rim pa ni: lcags sam bhan+dha'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: 'bru nag gi ngar phye la dpal gtor zlum po khram ris can g.yas gcus: gdan chos 'byung gi kha ru bzhag: mdun du khrag kong lhan du 'brang rgyas tshe nyungs kyis mtshan pa bzhag: 'khor dpal gtor bzhi dang kyu gu bzhi mtheb skyu brgyad gzhan yang sha sna snying sna ke tshe shang tshes brgyan: nyungs dkar nag gi rkang bu kyang gzugs: phud rgod sna tshogs gtams shing rol mo sgrogs gu gul dang sha chen gyi dud pa bdug: tshil chen gyi mar me gtams: khrag chen gyi yon chab bsham: dgyes pa'i dar phyar rngam pa'i dbyangs dang bcas nas legs ldan he ru ka chen po'i thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing phrin las kyi bya ba sna tshogs bsgrub phyir spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen 'bar ba'i mdun: khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du: dur khrod e yi pho brang ni: mi mgo'i sku mkhar rgyan dang ldan: de dbus pad nyi ro gdan du: hūm̐ las legs ldan bya rog gdong : dur khrod chas ldan yum dang sbyor: 'khor du las byed pho nya ba: bya rog khros pa'i gdong can bzhi: mtshams su rang 'dra 'bar ma gnas: gzhan yang bya gcan yang sprul bcas: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros chos skyong spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra ma hā kā la kau bha ma dāk+ṣi ya k+ṣa tsa tur li ha ho shwa ri ya badz+ra sa mā ya dza dza dzaḥ hūm̐: 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas mchog nas: khams gsum yongs kyi ded dpon che: mthu chen ma hā kā la ni: khrag 'thung nag po mi bsrun pa: dur khrod tshogs bdag skur bzhengs shig: nag po chen po gshegs su gsol:

legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol: dpal mgon nag po gshegs su gsol: bdud rgyal thod phreng gshegs su gsol: bya rog ming can gshegs su gsol: gnam lcags spu gri gshegs su gsol: srog bdud 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: rngam chen bkrag med gshegs su gsol: las mkhan me 'bar gshegs su gsol: sprul pa yang sprul gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas dur khrod pho brang 'dir: mi g.yo dgyes pas gdan la bzhugs: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes legs ldan mgon po'i dmag tshogs rnams sprin chen rlung gis bskyod pa ltar byon nas bzhugs par bsam: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: ma hā kā la dgongs su gsol: dpal mgon chen po dgongs su gsol: khrag 'thung rgyal po dgongs su gsol: bya rog ming can dgongs su gsol: dam can rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: hūm̐: khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: bhan+dha lcang lo'i gtor gzhong du: 'bru nag ngar phye'i myos chang la: gri khrag la sogs dug rigs sbyor: kha zhing ngar ldan bam pa'i rigs: shin tu bstar ba'i gtor mchod 'di: dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: khyed la mnyes pa'i dam rdzas ni: bum ril 'bar ba'i snod yangs su: mi khrag rta khrag glang po'i khrag: khyi khrag la sogs khrag chen la: thang khrom re lcag bong nga dang : sman chen dang bcas sbyor ba'i khrag: ru tra'i snying khrag dmar chen 'di: dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma hā rak+ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: mtshan ldan zhal bu'i ka pā lar: ga pur dzā ti a ga ru: 'bras dkar dmar nag 'bru yi chang : rin chen zhun gyi brdar phye dang : byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i rgyun: rdzas mchog lnga sogs bdud rtsi 'di:

dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: 'bru bcud sna tshogs phye ma'i rigs: bcud g.yo zhag gis sbags pa'i zan: dkar dmar brgyan pa'i zhal zas tshogs: dgra bgegs don snying dbang pos brgyan: tshil chen mar me gsur chen spos: rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra bcas 'di: dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya ga ṇa tsakra ma hā pū dza ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bskang bstod bya ba ni: g.yag nag la bam ros brgyan pa de'i steng du dpal gtor zur gsum zhig la/ dkar me bya rog gsum gyis brgyan: sha dum dang mtheb skyus bskor ba'i mdun du gser skyems bshams la: hūm̐: rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i dur khrod bsil ba tshal: khrag gi rgya mtsho bam ro ri ltar nyil: keng rus khral khrol rus pa gram ltar bdal: steng du lho sprin ngam nag bun ltar gtibs: 'khor yug kun kyang mi sdug rlung dmar 'tshubs: de dbus drag po'i pho brang gzhal yas ni: rmang gzhi nag po klu dang sa bdag bsnol: de'i steng gnam lcags rdo rje'i rgya gram bkod: zur bzhi khro chu mdzes pa'i so phag ldan: shar phyogs mi mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: dur khrod bdag mo'i gad mo ya la la: lho phyogs rta mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: gyi ling cang shes mtsher rgyangs tse re re: nub phyogs g.yag mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: kho mo 'brong gi ngar sgra 'u ru ru: byang phyogs stag mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: gcan gzan gdug pa'i ngar sgra di ri ri: ka gdung gza' dang rgyu skar bris pa la: 'brug glog thog ser zi ra chi li li: kha bad srin po'i thod pa bsgrigs pa la: rak+sha pho mo sprin ltar gtibs se gtib:

g.yang gzhi 'phan dar ro skra'i ba dan la: mi mgo'i rgyan tog du ma rongs se rong : tri shul la sogs mtshon chas brgyan pa la: 'phyang ba'i cod pan nag po pu ru ru: de ltar pho brang sna tshogs rgyan ldan gyi: bkod pa yo byad bdag gis bshams pa 'dis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : sras mchog bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang : yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang : bdud po sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa bya rog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gcan spyang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: hūm̐: de dbus khrag mtsho pad nyi ti ra'i steng : hūm̐ las skyes pa'i myur mgyogs mthu bo che: las kyi mgon po dpal ldan bya rog gdong : mthing nag rngam pa srog bdag khros pa'i gzugs: khā kha mu kha rab 'jigs zhal gdangs shing : dmar zlum spyan 'khyil shangs nas 'brug stong ldir: dbu skra ser nag nam mkha'i dbyings su bskyod: thod skam dbyings nas bya rog sprin ltar gtibs: phyag g.yas gri gug srid gsum mthongs la phyar: g.yon pa'i bhan dmar gdug pa'i snying khrag 'thung : gti mug tshar gcod glang ko stod la g.yogs: pha rol gzhom phyir zhing lpags sked la dkris: zhe sdang tshogs 'joms sbrul gyi 'ching rgyan 'khyugs: nga rgyal mthar byed stag gi sham thabs dkris: nyon mongs mtsho skem mgo rlon phreng bas brgyan: bag chags gtor byed khrag zhag thal tshom spras: myur mgyogs shugs 'chang sgro gshog dbyings su brgyangs: log lta tshar gcod me ri smug nag 'bar: tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo srin gzugs pang du 'khyud: gri thod 'dzin cing rgyan drug chas kyis spras: zung 'jug ngang ldan khrag 'thung dor thabs can: las mdzad chen po gar dgus dgyes pa yi: bskyed rdzogs brtan po'i yid kyis sprul pa 'dis:

yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : sras mchog bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang : yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang : bdud po sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa bya rog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gcan spyang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i g.yas kyi bka' nyan pa: sku mdog dmar nag nyin gyi pho nya ba: bdud po sgrol byed 'bar ba satwa re thogs: nad kyi rlangs pa dgra dang bgegs la bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i g.yon gyi bka' nyan pa: sku mdog dkar sngon mtshan gyi pho nya ba: las mkhan 'bar ba lag na spu gri thogs: mtshon gyi gru gu dgra dang bgegs la phob: hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i rgyab kyi bka' nyan pa: sku mdog ser nag dus kyi pho nya ba: shan pa srog bdag las byed ral gri thogs: dmod pa'i dug mda' sngo dmar dgra la gtong : hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i mdun gyi bka' nyan pa: sku mdog mthing nag gnas nyul pho nya ba: las mkhan myur mgyogs gnam lcags phur pa thogs: mngon spyod chen pos dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: kun kyang gcer bu 'jigs pa'i nyams gyur can: g.yon pa thams cad lcags kyu 'bar ba thogs: rus pa'i rgyan ldan za byed srin po'i tshul: me ltar mched cing dgra bo'i snying khrag 'thung : hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i mtshams kyi bka' nyan pa: shar lho 'bar ba ma mos zor ba thogs: lho nub ma mos kha rlangs sog le thogs: nub byang dur khrod ma mos be con thogs: byang shar srin mo gser mig khram shing thogs: kun kyang nag mo bya rog khros pa'i gdong : g.yon pa thams cad dgra bo'i tsit+ta bsnams: mi sdug gzugs can ma mo rngam pa'i tshul: byad ma mthar byed sprul pa sgyu ma'i sku: bka' yi 'khor du gnas pa'i srung ma'i tshogs:

dgyes pa'i yid la bkod pa'i bka' sdod kyi: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams? sras mchog? yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi? bdud po sde bzhi? sprul pa bya rog? yang sprul gcan spyang? thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs? hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i sprul pa yang sprul po: dgra sha za byed bya rog nag po bzhi: dgra khrag 'thung byed bya rog dmar po bzhi: kun kyang mchu sder bgrad cing dgra la rngam: dgra bo'i snying nas 'dren pa'i stag mo bzhi: dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i dom nag bzhi: kun kyang kha gdangs mche gtsigs bam ro 'drad: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams 'gugs pa'i lcags spyang bzhi: dgra bo'i tshe len zangs kyi 'phar ba bzhi: kun kyang ngu 'dur brgyugs shing gshin skad 'don: dgra la phung thal 'gyed pa'i spre'u bzhi: dgra la cho 'phrul 'gyed pa'i srin bya bzhi: kun kyang mi rung sna tshogs cha lugs ston: gzhan yang nyid sprul ma lus rlung ltar 'tshubs: ma nges gar gyi 'phrul 'khor ltar bsgyur nas: sna tshogs dgra la dmar 'gyed sprul 'khor 'dis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams? sras mchog bya rog? yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo'i? bdud po sde bzhi? sprul pa bya rog rnams? yang sprul gcan spyang rnams? thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i dam skong rdzas mchog ni: gling gi gling mchog 'dzam gling kha ba can: dbus 'gyur chen po'i dpag tshad gsum mtho'i gnas: 'khor yug gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba ru: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i dal zhing gnas: phyi nang pho brang rgyan sogs bskyod pa'i mthar: rgya che dpangs mtho'i dur khrod gling bzhi'i bskor: gnyis mched tshul du yid dpyod mtha' yas kyi: grangs med blo yis sprul te bskang ba ni: sna tshogs spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: yid kyi me tog tsit+ta'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs:

mkhal ma'i me tog rna ba rdza ltar nyil: srog rtsa'i me tog mig 'bras phung por spungs: mchin pa'i me tog lce yi pur len phyur: glo ba'i me tog sna yi zur bu 'khrigs: dbyings ltar mtho ba'i me tog sna tshogs 'dis: thugs rje'i spyan gyis bdag la gzigs pa'i phyir: dbang po'i me tog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : tsan+dan dkar dmar dkon mchog mnyes pa'i spos: ga pur dzā ti yi dam mnyes pa'i spos: li shi sug smel mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i spos: gri snying na gi dpal mgon mnyes pa'i spos: gu gul shing kun bgegs srin tshar gcod spos: sha chen sna tshogs dregs pa mnyes pa'i spos: sprin ltar gtibs pa'i dri mchog sna tshogs 'dis: brtse ba'i dgongs pa bdag la dgyes pa'i phyir: dri mchog sna tshogs spos kyis thugs dam bskang : nyi zla'i zhun me 'dzam gling gsal ba'i mdangs: sems nyid zhun me 'khor 'das gsal ba'i mdangs: 'bri mar zhun me smag rum gsal ba'i mdangs: til mar zhun me zor mda' gsal ba'i mdangs: tshil chen zhun me dpal mgon mnyes pa'i mdangs: rkang dmar zhun me dregs pa mnyes pa'i mdangs: dbyings ltar gsal ba'i sna tshogs zhun me 'dis: gnas lugs dgongs pas bdag la skyong ba'i phyir: dkar me sna tshogs gtams pas thugs dam bskang : mkha' yi chu 'dzin dag gtsang dri yi chab: lha yi bdud rtsi brgyad ldan dri yi chab: byang sems bdud rtsi 'chi med bdud rtsi che: rol mtsho phyur 'khyil mchod 'os dri yi chab: dug khrag gri khrag dpal mgon dri yi chab: khrag chen du ma shan pa dri yi chab: bsil ldan ma nges sbyar zhing gtams pa 'dis: mdangs bzang rdzas kyi dngos grub 'byung ba'i phyir: dri chab sna tshogs gtams pas thugs dam bskang : shing 'bras lha yi zhal zas bcud dang ldan: 'bras dkar drang srong zhal zas bcud dang ldan: gro nas tshogs kyi zhal zas bcud dang ldan: khre til rdzas kyi zhal zas bcud dang ldan:

se 'bru mchod pa'i zhal zas bcud dang ldan: bra sran dpal mgon zhal zas bcud dang ldan: bu ram mtha' yi zhal zas bcud dang ldan: 'bru mar 'bras bu'i zhal zas bcud dang ldan: dgyes pa'i bsod nams dpal rten bskyed pa'i phyir: ro bcud zhal zas rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : lha yi rnga chen mkha' spyod dgyes pa'i sgra: dbyar gyi rnga chen 'byung lnga bskyed pa'i sgra: ghaṇ+ḍi'i rnga chen chos 'khor bskor ba'i sgra: drag shing rnga chen yi dam dgyes pa'i sgra: rin chen rnga zlum mkha' 'gro bskul ba'i sgra: thod pa'i rnga chen dpal mgon dgyes pa'i sgra: rdza yi rnga chen gar dang mchod pa'i sgra: lcags kyi hom rnga mthu gtad nag po'i sgra: 'brug ltar grags pa'i rol mo sna tshogs 'dis: snyan pa'i dung chen sna tshogs bsgrag pa'i phyir: rol mo 'brug ltar grags pas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rang bzhin khyon yangs mtshan ldan ka pā la: rgya che'i nang du sman mchod gtams pa ni: dzā ti rgyal po rlung sman bdud rtsi che: gi wang rgyal po mkhris sman bdud rtsi che: li shi rgyal po bad kan bdud rtsi che: a ru rgyal po 'dus pa'i bdud rtsi che: tsan+dan ga pur tshad pa'i bdud rtsi che: ka ko sug smel grang ba'i bdud rtsi che: gur gum cu gang snyoms pa'i bdud rtsi che: dbang ril sbyor ba zhi ba'i bdud rtsi che: chig thub sbyor ba drag po'i bdud rtsi che: glang chen sbyor ba mngon spyod bdud rtsi che: phyi nang bzang ldan bdud rtsi sna tshogs 'dis: rang gzhan nyon mongs nad las bskyab pa'i phyir: bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil bas thugs dam bskang : lcags zangs drag po'i snod mchog zur gsum du: bskyed pa'i rang bzhin gtor ma spungs pa ni: dbyings ltar mtho ba ri rab bha ling+ta: zhi la zlum pa'i lus 'phags bha ling+ta: rgyas la gru bzhi 'dzam gling bha ling+ta: dbang la zla gam ba glang bha ling+ta: drag po zur gsum sgra mi'i bha ling+ta:

gangs dkar rtse mtho sgrub pa'i bha ling+ta: ri nag rngams 'thug bskang ba'i bha ling+ta: brag dmar dbal ldan rbad pa'i bha ling+ta: g.ya' sngo rtse gzengs bsad pa'i bha ling+ta: shing nags tshal gzengs bha ling brgyan pa'i rdzas: 'bru rigs ma nges bha ling las kyi thun: dur sa phung sa bha ling las kyi zor: g.yul sa'i lcags ri bha ling bzhugs pa'i gdan: dkar thig zlas brgyan dmar lam nyi zlas byugs: mkha' yi dmar 'od 'khyugs pa'i zhags pas dkris: de ltar rang byung bha ling gtor ma 'di: gdod nas dgyes shing brtse bas dgongs pa'i phyir: bha ling lhun mtho sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : bum ril dung dmar rgya che'i snod mchog tu: mkha' yi dbang mo'i mu khā las byung ba: a haṃ rak+ta rgyal ba bsgrub pa'i rdzas: ma hā rak+ta yi dam bsgrub pa'i rdzas: mu la rak+ta dpa' bo bsgrub pa'i rdzas: gu h+ya rak+ta mkha' 'gro bsgrub pa'i rdzas: mā ra rak+ta dpal mgon bsgrub pa'i rdzas: du na rak+ta chos skyong bsgrub pa'i rdzas: an+dza rak+ta dam can bsgrub pa'i rdzas: dza la rak+ta gter srung bsgrub pa'i rdzas: ha la rak+ta dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rdzas: bhi shwa rak+ta dam can bsgrub pa'i rdzas: e ma rak+ta dam tshig bskang ba'i rdzas: du mas sbyor ba'i rmad byung rak+ta 'di: chag nyams bag sgrib ma lus bsal ba'i phyir: mdangs ldan rak+ta sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: sgrub cing bskang ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: rang bzhin mkha' yi spyan gzigs thugs dam bskang : bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: dur khrod pho brang 'bar bas thugs dam bskang : skyon gyis ma gos rang bzhin gsal ba'i phyir: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan gyis thugs dam bskang : sgrib pa'i g.ya' bral rtog med don ldan phyir: zla rgyas bam ro'i gdan gyis thugs dam bskang : phyi nang sgrib gnyis ka nas dag pa'i phyir: me rlung dkar ltar 'khrugs pas thugs dam bskang : srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i rmang nas skem pa'i phyir:

rak+ta zham chu 'khyil bas thugs dam bskang : dgyes pa'i gar gyis sa bcu gnon pa'i phyir: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis thugs dam bskang : pho rgyud thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir: rab 'bar gnam lcags gri gug thugs dam bskang : mo rgyud thams cad dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir: bhan dmar rak+ta phyur bas thugs dam bskang : dug gsum mtshan ma'i bag chags 'joms pa'i phyir: ngar ldan tri shul rtse gsum thugs dam bskang : dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: phyung rdeg ral gri 'bar bas thugs dam bskang : ma rungs bgegs srin snying la bsnun pa'i phyir: gdab pa ri rab phur bus thugs dam bskang : byad ma sdig can snying la bsnun pa'i phyir: ru mtshon gzir 'debs nag pos thugs dam bskang : pha rol rgol ba cham la dbab pa'i phyir: spu gri'i mtshon cha du mas thugs dam bskang : sgrub cing 'khor ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir: mda' mo dar nag brgyan pas thugs dam bskang : gtan du mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs pa'i phyir: srog 'khor bla rdo rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : nam mkha'i rgyan gyur rang bzhin pho nya'i phyir: mkha' lding gser mig nag pos thugs dam bskang : ngar sgras sa gzhi ma lus g.yo ba'i phyir: g.yag rog zhol chen rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : bya lam yud ldang rlung gshog myur ba'i phyir: cang shes rta mchog rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : srid la 'jol ba'i rnga yab sham bu can: sa le zal mo 'bri yis thugs dam bskang : 'ba' sgra'i tser skad gdangs snyan len pa'i phyir: 'jam legs shel sgong lug gis thugs dam bskang : snang glu ki sgra sang sang bsgrag pa'i phyir: tsa ra rog po mkhal dkar thugs dam bskang : snang ba'i yid spyod dgyes shing dgyes pa'i phyir: gzugs 'gros 'phur bskyod sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs ma nges pa: mkha' ltar yangs shing gling ltar phyug pa'i tshogs:

bskyed cing spel nas legs par bkram pa 'dis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : sras mchog bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang : yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang : bdud po sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa'i bya rog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gcan spyang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: nyams chag bshags shing mi sgrib dag par stsol:

ces yi ge brgya pas chad lhag bkang : de nas mgon po'i gtor bskul bya ba la: gtor ma mañdzi'i khar bzhag nas 'gugs gzhug bya ba ni: phaṭḥ na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan bya rog gi gdong pa can bka' 'khor las kyi pho nya dang bcas pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po gdug cing sdang ba'i tshogs thams cad drag po thun gyi gtor ma 'di la rang dbang med par khug cig: badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ de nas gtor ma de dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus par bsam: om̐ āḥhūm̐: mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: phyag bzhi ma hā kā la'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: phyag drug yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: ma ning srog bdag nag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dpal 'bar gdong bzhi chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bram ze dur khrod bdag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: las kyi mgon po chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: myur mgyogs bya rog gdong can gyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: sgrol byed gdong can bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: 'bar ba nag mo rnam bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bya rog rngam pa du ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi:

gcan spyang 'dur byed du ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yang sprul las kyi bya ra du ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hoḥ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma phul bas: gdug cing sdang ba'i dgra bo thams cad tshar gcod pa'i mngon spyod kyi las dang ldan par gyur cig: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la sha sa naṃ u pa ha ri ṇi e ka a pa tsi ma hā kā la e yaṃ kā la khā kha mu bh+yo ma tri san+dha li ku lu ku lu du pra ma ya sarba i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes pas bdud rtsis bran te gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog u tsa la: dur khrod chen po phra men kun tu rgyu: nye zhing tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i gnas kyi mchog: shin tu rngam pa'i 'byung 'jug bsil ba'i tshal: gling gi dbang gyur laṅka'i yul dang nye: srid pa 'di ru ji srid gling gi cha: 'khor 'das sa mtshams bral ba'i zhing mchog ni: mtshan ma gzugs bral g.yul las rgyal ba'i gnas: nyon mongs dug rlung ngam nag sprin ltar g.yo: mtshan mor srid pa'i me chen mched cing 'bar: dus drug rlung nag sngo dmar bu yug 'tshubs: ri bo thams cad keng rus rus pa brtsegs: 'bab chu thams cad khrag gi rba klung 'khrugs: rang bzhin 'byung ba'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrog: de ru ye shes 'jig rten 'dus pa yi: tsan dan las grub dur shing rkang gcig pa: mi bzad rtsub pa'i rno ngar rab tu gzengs: rtse mor dur bya sha gzan skar ltar 'khrugs: rtsa bar dur khyi gcan spyang rlung ltar 'tshubs: mche gtsigs dur phag 'khyugs shing dug sbrul gtibs: gzhan yang mi sdug dur gyi las byed sogs: ro za rnams kyis ngar skad stong ldir ba: de 'dra'i gnas su bzhugs pa'i nag po che: srog bdag chen po las mgon bya rog gdong : mi bsrun khros pa'i khrag 'thung mthu bo che: mun nag lta bu'i rnam par sgyur ba po:

za byed yum dang sprul pa du ma'i tshogs: bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs: mthu ldan khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: ma g.yel dam tshig gnyan po'i dus la bab: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs sdig can 'di: bla tshe rnam shes srog dbugs 'gyu ba'i tshe: da lta nyid du khug cig sgrol bar mdzod: srog la rngam par rol te rkan sgra rdeb: sha la dgyes pa'i rngam zhal mkha' ltar gdangs: khrag la btung ba'i ljags dmar glog ltar 'khyugs: rus la dkrig pa'i mche ba zangs yag gtsigs: 'dus byas gtor ba'i shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub: ma rungs sngangs byed snyan nas 'brug stong ldir: gcod byed gri gug mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: rgyas byed bhan dmar rak+ta zhal du 'dren: thogs med spu gri'i sgro gshog dbyings su brgyangs: dpa' ba'i dur khrod chas rdzogs gtum pa po: tsaṇ+ḍi las byed ma mos pang du 'khyud: phyag na mthu ldan las kyi mtshon cha 'dzin: brkyang bskum gar ldan stob 'chang zung du 'jug: 'khrigs pa'i rang bzhin me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil: las mdzad nag po yab yum dus la bab: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sdang zhing gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rnams: myur du sgrol mdzad las mgon mthu ma chung : zhing bcu'i byad ma sgrol mdzad las la ya: hūm̐: sgrol byed satwa re thogs pa'i dus la bab: de ring dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: las mkhan spu gri thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: srog bdag ral gri thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i mo rgyud rnams kyi mngal nas skoms: las mkhan phur bu thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod: hūm̐: 'bar ba zor thogs khyod kyi dus la bab: dgra bo'i mkhar khang thams cad mgo mjug ldog: me yi kha rlangs sog thogs dus la bab: dgra bo'i sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dur khrod be con thogs pa'i dus la bab:

dgra bo'i nang spyad ka cha phung bshig thongs: gser mig khram shing thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i yul zhing thams cad ser bas khongs: bya rog nag po sde bzhi'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i pha tshan thal ba'i rdul du rlog: bya rog dmar po sde bzhi'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: snying 'dren stag mo mched bzhi'i dus la bab: dam nyams slob ma snying ngan srog rtsa chod: rtsad gcod dom nag mched bzhi'i dus la bab: byad ma yon bdag gzhung ngan rtsad nas chod: 'gugs byed lcags spyang sde bzhi'i dus la bab: kha 'jam snying rtsub dgra bo'i bla tshe sdud: zangs kyi 'phar ba sde bzhi'i dus la bab: yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bo phung bar gyis: phung byed spre'u sde bzhi'i dus la bab: ma rungs dgra la ltas ngan sna tshogs thongs: ltas ngan srin bya rnam bzhi'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra la cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs: sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi dus la bab: dam nyams dgra la mi rung sna dgu thongs: mthu rtsal myur mgyogs chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams: sprin ltar gtibs shing rlung ltar 'tshubs pa yi: las mdzad chen po 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying khrag 'di bzhes la: ma rungs log 'dren srog dbugs 'di bzhes la: sdig can bsgral ba'i phung po 'di bzhes shig: ru tra'i skye mched rnam shes 'di bzhes la: pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: ban bon sngags pa'i byad kha bzlog tu gsol: gling bzhi'i yul gyi mi kha bzlog tu gsol: rgya 'dre dam sri'i smyo 'bog bzlog tu gsol: 'byung po rnams kyi sgab 'dre bzlog tu gsol: mi min lha 'dre'i za kha bzlog tu gsol: srin pos tshe la rku ba bzlog tu gsol: mu stegs nag po'i gtad khram bzlog tu gsol: gshin rje bdud kyi khram kha bzlog tu gsol:

klu btsan the'u rang bar chad bzlog tu gsol: yul lha sa bdag gdug pa bzlog tu gsol: mo 'dre sman mo'i 'tshe ba bzlog tu gsol: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs bzlog tu gsol: mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog tu gsol: gdug cing sdang ba'i byad ma dgra bgegs rnams: bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes: dam bca' dus la ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la karma he ru ka khā kha mu kha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ka li tsaṇ+ḍi ma ma tri mu kha ya baṃ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ om̐ du ma pra ma rak+sha tsa du yak+sha trag rak+mo mu kha li bh+yo bh+yoḥ byad ma nṛ tri ha la ham shang rbad ki kang shag shag du ru du ru hag hu lu ya pha rol byad ma thams cad zlog zlog: rbad nan mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngam gang rung bgyis: dpal khrag 'thung bya rog srog gzan nag po byad ma rtsad brlag ces bya ba chos skyong thun mong ma yin pa kun las 'phags pa 'di nyid: sgrub cing mchod pa'i gang zag rnams la nus mthu me las ngar tsha zhing myur mgyogs glog las bang mgyogs par 'byung zhing : las kyi he ru ka chen po'i dgongs pa dang nges par mnyam mo: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug legs ldan rngam klong las: mchod bskang bsgrigs chog yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i bum: kun 'byung nor bu rin chen 'od rab gsal: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: dus bdag chen po'i tha tshig bya ra srungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan gter bdag gling pas khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gi gnas mchog nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // nya) khyab 'jug dug mtsho khol ma las: bstod bskul me rlung thog char rab tu 'bar ba bzhugs so: klong chen srid pa rnam rgyal sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: de la bsang mchod snang srid dbyings kyi bdag po chen po drang srong sngags bdag 'bar ba chen po'i gsol mchod bya ba ni:

zhe sdang sbrul lam 'dod chags bya rog nag po'i thod pa: 'bru nag gi ngar phye gri khrag gis sbrus pa'i gtor ma nag po zur gsum pa bya rog gi mgos mtshan pa: g.yas gcus can 'khor brgyad dang khrag kyu bzhis skor ba: tshe yungs kyis brgyan par bsham: dmar gyi rgyan legs par spras shing byang g.yag gi gong mañdza'i kha ru bzhag: rang nyid khro bo srid gsum las rnam par rgyal ba bsgom zhing drag sngags dmod pa'i rang bzhin dang bcas nas: rol mo bsgrags shing khrag chang gis bran te: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod: hoḥ mdun du zhe sdang drag po'i snod dug gsum 'bar ba'i nang du byad ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: om̐ tre tri tri yak+sha kha la ya he pa ram gra ha ni pri thi tsa swā hā: de nas mngon brjod bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la: pha ni zhe sdang srin po ste: yak+sha rdo rje glog phreng dang : ma ni sa srin 'bar ma ste: klu mo ha shang sbal mgo ma: de gnyis ri rab chen po'i zom: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: ma rig ngang gis 'khrig pa las: ming sring rnam pa lnga ru srid: ming po khyab mjug 'phrog byed pa: sring mo 'brog srin bdud srin gdong : de 'og stag srin zor ba'i gdong : de 'og kong srin ba glang gdong : de 'og bam srin dred kyi gdong : rang bzhin khyab pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: ri rab chen por bskor ba las: dpyid ra tshes bdun dus kyi tshe: nyin phyed ri rab shar phyogs su: zor ba gdong dang ming sring bshos: lus 'phags gling du dug chen phyur: steng 'og 'byung lnga'i rlung chen 'khrugs: dpyid 'bring tshes pa bcu bzhi'i stod: dug shing nag po'i sgong bu skyes: shar lho kha cher dgra nyi shar: dpyid kyi tha chung nyer gcig tu: nam phyed sgong bu brdol ba'i nang : chu bdud zor ba gdong can rigs:

gza' rgod spen pa pa sangs skyes: ma rig pa yis 'dzam gling phung : de 'og dbyar ra'i tshes brgyad kyi: nyi dros ri rab lho phyogs su: bam srin dred gdong bshos pa las: 'dzam gling me yi tsha zer 'khrugs: dbyar 'bring bcu drug nyin phyed su: khrag gi sgo nga nag po skyes: lho nub o rgyan yul dag tu: phyogs bzhir bdud dgra nyi ma shar: dbyar tha tshes bzhi'i srod 'khor du: sgo nga rdol ba'i nang shed nas: lo bdud me yi ze ba can: gza' rgod nyi ma mig dmar skyes: 'dzam gling tshad than bun ltar phyur: ston ra tshes dgu'i nyi shar la: ri rab nub phyogs kong sring bshos: ba glang dmag tshogs dgra nyi shar: ston 'bring tshes pa bco brgyad kyi: tho rangs lcags kyi sgong bu skyes: nub byang bhe ltar dug chu phyur: ston tha nyer bdun zla shar tshes: bka' thebs khrag mdog glang gdong rigs: gza' rgod zla ba lag pa skyes: 'dzam gling dug chu'i rdzing bu 'khyil: dgun ra tshes bcu'i srod 'phros la: byang du chu srin gdong du bshos: rgyal po dgra yi nyi ma shar: dgun 'bring nyi shu'i zla shar la: bswe yi sgong bu smug po skyes: byang shar nyi mar chu bdud shar: dgun tha gnam stong nam phyed la: bswe sgong rdol ba'i nang shed nas: kun phung dug gi kha rlangs can: gza' rgod phur bu sgra gcan skyes: de ltar mngon spyod chen po'i lha: skar zla nyi ma 'dzin pa'i tshe: shar phyogs mtha' yas klu dang bcas: mngon spyod lho nub mtshams su rgyu: nor rgyas klu'i dpung bcas te: mngon spyod byang rgyu 'jog por bsdong : shar lhor rgyu la stobs rgyur gnas: mngon spyod nub rgyu pad+mor bsdong : byang shar rgyu ste pad chen gnas: mngon spyod lhor 'gro dung skyong bsdong : nub byang rgyu la rigs ldan bsdong : shar du mngon spyod dkar phyogs nyin: nyin mo g.yas la mtshan mo rgyu: nag po'i nyi ma shar ba'i tshe:
