nyin g.yas mtshan mo g.yon du spyod: gzhan yang gza' chen rnam pa brgyad: gza' rgod nyi ma rigs ldan klu: chu tshod gcig dang thun bdun dus: mngon spyod nyi ma brgal te nyul: zla ba thun brgyad nyi myur dus: mig dmar thun drug phyed yol gtum: lhag pa thun gnyis nyin phyed rngam: phur bu thun gsum phyed yol dus: pa sangs thun bzhi nyi dros bzlog: spen pa thun bzhi nyi shar dus: mngon spyod sde brgyad dmag dpon 'gyed: dpyid zla stag sprel nyi ma la: lho nas byang 'gyu log 'gro bcom: dbyar gsum glang lug nyi ma la: nub nas shar 'gyu rgol ba gzhig: ston gsum khyi 'brug nyi ma la: byang nas lho 'gyu spyod par byed: dgun gsum phag sbrul nyi ma la: shar nas nub 'gyu mtshams su 'phro: khrag mig nag mo las byed ma: zla ba cha drug rim pa bzhin: stag rta khyi gsum tshe gnyis dang : bcu bdun nyer bdun bcu gnyis sogs: bcu gsum mngon spyod phrin las bskul: byi 'brug sprel gsum las su chas: bco brgyad nyer brgyad bya ra byed: bya glang sbrul gsum dus kyi tshes: bcu drug nyer drug dmag tu bskyal: nyi mas smin drug non pa bzhin: dgra bo'i lha gsol bdud du 'bebs: zla bas dbo ni non pa bzhin: dgra bo'i bu sring byur du skyel: mig dmar gro bzhin non pa bzhin: dgra bo'i dmag dpon cham la 'beb: lag pas chu stod non pa bzhin: dgra bo'i bang khang 'bru bcud brlag: phur bus mgo bo non pa bzhin: dgra bo ban bon cham la 'beb: pa sangs dag gis rgyal mnan bzhin: dgra bo dur gshin logs su spyod: mngon spyod dgra la rang gshed 'bebs: khyad par myur mgyogs che ba'i lha: drang srong thugs dam dus la bab: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: drag po mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: dzaḥ 'jigs byed me 'bar mthu bo che: ljang sngon chen po'i thugs dam bskul: lho nub me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus:

srog bdag gza' bdud rā hu la: mgo dgu srin lus sbrul mjug 'khyil: phyag bzhi ral gri chu srin rgyal: thog mda' sbrul zhags dgra la 'bebs: sku lus spyan stong 'gro la gzigs: ma rungs dgra la thogs ser 'beb: dug rlangs phyur zhing mkha' la 'gyu: sde brgyad yongs kyi dmag dpon che: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: drang srong dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ khyab 'jug nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ ki kang nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ khro tsha nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ bhi tri nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ byad ma nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ zin phung nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ hal khyi nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ sa yi lto 'phye dgra la bh+yoḥ bar gyi phung byed dgra la bh+yoḥ mngon spyod chen po phrin las mdzod: om̐ ki kang hri shag ru raṃ ke sha la ke ta ke ta sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo dgra la bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: me gholka shaṃ traṃ shu rak+ta ga ku mā ra bud+dha bṛ hap+pa tri a su darto ma kriṣ+ṇa bar+ṇa mṛ ta pri ya dz+yo ti ke ru gra ha ya ma ra ma ra e du ru du dgra la bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

ces gtor ma dgra phyogs su gza' 'gyu ba'i phyogs su 'phang : dmigs pa ni khyab mjug nag po gtsos pa'i sde brgyad thams cad dgra bo'i steng du chas te ming med du brlags par bsam: drag sngags tshar gsum bzlas la gtor ma 'phang : sa ma ya: zab gsang snying po kun 'dus thugs: rol pa las byung ki kang 'khor lo'i rgya: them byang med pa'i las byang drwa mig ste: 'gyu ba'i dus bdag chen po des srungs shig: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ta) gza' yi gtor 'bul gnam lcags ral gri bzhugs so: hūm̐ dza bh+yoḥ mkha' klong gnas bzhugs stong khams mnga' bdag rje: khyab 'jug chen po gza' bdud rā hu la: spyan 'dren 'bod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: mchod rdzas dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: don snying dbang po khrum khrum nang rol bcas: lhag ma med par gza' bdud tshogs la 'bul: dza bh+yoḥ me gza' dmar po btsan dmag 'bum gyis bskor: nyi ma'i zer chibs dgra la zha ring phob: chu gza' sngo nag klu srin 'bum gyis bskor: zla ba'i zer chibs dgra la gegs char thongs: rlung gza' ljang nag dus 'khrug skar ltar 'khrugs: bu yug rta chibs dgra la smyo 'bog thongs: dzaḥbh+yoḥ gza' bdud gnas nas bskul zhing rbad pa'i tshe: dud sprin me lce dmar nag nam mkhar 'bar: 'bebs pa'i ser chen rlung nag 'u ru ru: 'khyugs pa'i glog zhags dgra bo'i klad khrag 'gems: 'phen pa'i thog chen dgra mkhar mgo mjug bsgyur: dmag dpon khyab 'jug chen po dgra la rgyugs: yum chen gdong mo mched bzhi dgra la rbad: khyod la drag rtsal yod na nga la mkho: nga yi bstan dgra gar yod longs la shog: rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje'i bka' byung bas: ngos bstod lkog smad dmag jag dgra dpung dang :

kha 'jam zhe nag yon bdag gzhungs ngan dang : nor rdzas 'phrog bcom slob bu dam log dang : bran g.yog grwa 'khor ngo log rgyab ston rigs: bdag la gnod byed thams cad khyed la gtad: drag rtsal gshin rje'i las kyi 'khor los khrid: byin pa'i zas zo bcol ba'i las 'di sgrubs: sdang dgra bdun rgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod: rā hu la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: zhes pa 'di yang mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po gsang sngags bstan skyong gis bkas nye bar bskul ngor/ khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gi skyed tshal nas gza' 'dud kyi rgyal po hūm̐ kā la artsig gis sbyar bas ma rungs bstan dgra sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog/ // tha) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen gyi gsol mchod bzhugs so: dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed sku la 'dud: de'ang gter srung chen po'i gsol mchod la brtson pa ni: rus sbal sgal snod dam: yang na rin chen rang byung snod du bshos bu nag po zur gsum pa rtse la sbrul gdengs dang ldan pa: sbrul gnyis bsnol gyis dkris pa: g.yas g.yon du dmar gtor la dgra bo liṅga dang sdig pas brgyan pa: 'khor mtheb skyu bcu gnyis skyems dang bcas pa bsham: rnga shang drag tu sbir te: bdag mdun gsal rdzogs bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed sku: mthing nag rab khros za byed ma he'-i zhal: phyag gnyis dpa' ba'i mtshon cha gri thod 'dzin: gtum rngam mi bzad dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: dor stabs zhabs kyis dam sri pho mo mnan: dur khrod bdag mo ro langs yum dang sbyor: sku las skyes pa'i rdzu 'phrul me dpung 'khrigs: snang srid zil gnon gar gyi nyams su bsgom: om̐ ya ma rā dza sa twa me ya ya me dho ru ṇa yo dha ya ya dha yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya yak+ṣe ya tsa ṇi ra ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: de nas gter srung bskyed pa ni:

hūm̐: mdun du rgya mtsho mer ba'i klong : rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du: na las skyes pa'i mthu bo che: pha ni bdud dang ma ni klu: gnyis med bshol zhing 'tshogs pa'i bu: ngam rje 'bar ba drag shul can: gter srung myur mgyogs mi bsrun pa: sku mdog ha la dug can dag: ro stod srin po khros pa'i gzugs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis shin tu gtum: sbrul nag ral pa mun ltar gtibs: phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo ni: rtsibs ldan dgra bo'i klad la bskor: g.yon pas sbrul nag zhags pa 'phen: 'debs shing dgra bo'i mgul nas 'ching : yan lag lhu tshigs mig gis brgyan: sku smad sbrul mjug rta nag zhon: gong smad sbrul nag 'ching rgyan 'khyugs: rnga rngog gseb nas sdom sdig 'phro: me yi tshwa tshwa 'bum phrag 'khyil: yum mchog nor seng sngon mo lcam: dmar mo chu srin gdong pa can: phyag gnyis sbrul zhags nad rkyal bsnams: sbrul mjug rus sbal dmar po zhon: man tri dmar pos ga shal 'phyangs: 'od dmar 'tshub ma kyi li li: res 'ga' sprul pa 'gyed tsa na: sku mdog dmar nag rak+ta'i mdog: dbu dgu srid pa'i dbyings su bsnyegs: phyag bzhi gri gug lcags phur dang : sdig rgod sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs: zha long mdze pho pha bu dang : sbal sdig sbrul nag 'bum gyis bskor: gshin rje'i pho nya glog zhags can: gter srung chen po'i 'khor 'bangs tshogs: ma thogs yud kyis gnas 'dir byon: sngon tshe gsang bdag gtum po dang : bar du rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: che mchog nyid kyi dam bzhag gam: khyad par rlangs chen dpal seng gis: sde brgyad dam la btags pa'i tshe: rang rtags srog snying phul ba ltar: khas blangs bzhin du dam ma g.yel: gnod sbyin chen po gnas 'dir byon: dge bsnyen chen po gnas 'dir byon: dgra lha chen po gnas 'dir byon: dmag dpon chen po gnas 'dir byon: gter bdag chen po gnas 'dir byon:

'dir gshegs dam bskang phrin las sgrubs: om̐ nag po ti pa ra tsa ya badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas gtor ma bran zhing : hūm̐: dug mtsho khol ma'i dbus shed nas: bzhengs shig ti pa ra tsa bzhengs: khams gsum 'di na myur mgyogs che: bdud dang klu yi bshos pa'i bu: che btsan khyod la bdag gi bstod: bskul ba'i phrin las gnas bskyod 'tshal: lha yi dge bsnyen dung thod can: lha dmag ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: dri za'i dge bsnyen zur phud can: lha min dal kha kyi li li: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: mkhar chu'i dge bsnyen smyo kha ba: klu yi pho nya phyu ru ru: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: lho yi dge bsnyen zla ba'i gdong : bdud dmag jag pa sha ra ra: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: pho mar dge bsnyen mgo dgu ba: dmu yi las byed nyi li li: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: seng rdzong dge bsnyen zu ra ba: btsan gyi ling pa tshubs se tshub: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: mon kha'i dge bsnyen bkrag med pa: sa bdag gtad khram thibs se thib: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: lci shod dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal: gnyan gyi las byed khyugs se khyug: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: ngom gyi dge bsnyen bdud 'joms pa: gza' yi las byed nyi li li: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: lci yi dge bsnyen zla skyong ba: gnam smin bu yug thibs se thib: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: spu rong dge bsnyen dregs pa can: dregs pa'i bu mo las la 'gyed: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: mtsho nag dge bsnyen nya nag gdong : klu gnyan sa bdag las la bskul: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: ya bdud mkha' la 'gyu ba'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: ma bdud sa la rgyu ba'i tshe: smag rum mun pa'i rta la zhon:

de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: spyi bdud bar la 'gyu ba'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la zhon: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: skye 'gro srog la dbang sgyur tshe: 'brug glog thog gi rta la zhon: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: nyams pa'i dgra bo bsgral ba'i tshe: lhog yams dmar nad char du 'bebs: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i byad ma sdig can la: mdze dmar me ltar 'bar du chug: mdze skya rlung ltar 'tshubs su chug: dmu chu rdzing ltar 'khyil du chug: zha grum rdul ltar nyil du chug: dmigs pa'i dgra bo las ngan gyi: lus la mdze rigs bco brgyad thob: byad ma mi rabs phung bar gyis: ka cha dkor nor phyi la rgyugs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: klu bdud dmag tshogs dgra la chos: dgra bo'i yul khams phung bar gy-is: mngon spyod rtags dang mthun par mdzod: gang bcol las rnams myur du sgrubs: om̐ nā ga rak+sha he traṃ ka la nag po ti pa ra tsa tri yang trag rak+sha sha ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ nā ga ti pa ye dun dun dgra bo'i srog la bh+yoḥ sha khrag la bh+yo tsa trum trig thun nā ga shag thun hi pra ma nan haṃ he phu lu bh+yo bh+yo dgra la bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la zlog zlog: ces thal mo brdab: g.yab dar g.yab: byad ma sdig can thams cad nges par sgrol ba'i ngan sngags 'dis thams cad phung bar nus so: dus snyigs ma'i skabs su gza' klu dang rgyal po 'di rang chos skyong myur mgyogs che bas: des na phyis 'byung skal ldan rnams kyi snying du chongs shig: ma 'ongs dgra bgegs tshar gcod shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: zhes pa 'di sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rje'i tho lum gyis lcags glang lor khrom gzigs dge bsnyen gyi pho brang bar ma rgyab ri rdo rje btsan drag gi mgul nas gdan drangs shing chu stag lor shog ser nas bsgyur ba'o/

/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // da) 'jam dpal dug ri nag po'i srung bzlog gi dmigs rim bzhugs so// 'jam dpal zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /bdud dpung dgra bgegs 'dul phyir 'jigs byed khros/ /dug ri yab yum las gshin rnams la bstod/ gang zhig gisadug ri nag po pha rol dpung 'jaums kyi 'don sgom mos na mchod gtor zin bris nang ltar bshams/ rgyud 'debs nas dkar bgegs mtshams gcod gzhung ltar bya zhing bsnyen mtshams su rang nyid dug ri'i sgrub gzhung ltar bskyed/ de nas/ thugs kar dam tshig sems dpa' mthing nag rdo rje dang bhan dmar 'dzin pa dug ri'i thugs kar rtsa sngags 'khor ba las 'od kyi sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor: 'od zer dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag 'phros pas 'jam dpal rigs lnga sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad 'od zer gyis mchod de thugs rgyud bskul bas rang bzhin gyidabyings nas spyan drangs shing thim par bsgoms pa dug ri bla ma kun 'dus so: yang 'od zer 'phros pas tshe bdag khro chu: gshed dmar: gdong dmar: 'char ka thams cad byon te thim par bsgoms pa yi dam kun 'dus so: yang 'od zer 'phros pas mgon po pho rgyud: lha mo mo rgyud: ye shes kyi gshin rje'i ṛgs: dregs pa'i gshin rje thams cad dang : lha srin dregs pa bco brgyad thams cad byon cing bka' nyan las byed 'dar phril phril byed par bsgoms pa chos skyong kun 'dus so: yang dug ri'i sku las 'od zer dmar nag 'phros pas tshe bdag la phog: tshe bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer mthing ga 'phros pas 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma dang : lha srin gyi nus pa thams cad bsdus nas rang dang bsrung bya la thim par bsgoms la tshe bdag gi sngags sham du: ā yu bh+rūm̐ nṛ rak+ṣa hūm̐: btags te brjod pas tshe bsod 'phel ba srung ba'i mchog go /yang 'od zer 'phros pas khro chu'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar ljang 'phros pas byad kha ston pa'i ban bon gnod cing 'tshe ba'i lha 'dre thams cad bya sgro me la bsregs pa ltar

bsgoms shing khro chu'i sngags sham du/ byad phur bsam ngan thams cad mā ra ya rbad bh+yo zlog phaṭḥ sogs brjod pas byad bzlog gi mchog go / yang 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas ki kang dgra nag gnyis kyi thugs rgyud bskul: sku las 'od zer dang mtshon cha me dpung 'phros te rang la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum brlag: lha dang phral bar bsgoms la ki kang dgra nag gnyis kyi sngags sham du/ dgra bo lha srung dang bcas pa sod rbad bh+yo phaṭḥ ces brjod cing dgra bgegs dgugs gzhug bya zhing bskul pa bya/ gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang zhing bsad sngags bzlas pas dgra bgegs rdul du brlag par the tshom med do/ /de nas bka' gter tshogs bskang skong bya'o/ /lhag ma chad tho/ brtan skyong bya/ bkra shis bsngo smon mtha' rgyas bya/ zhes pa 'di chos bdag mtsho sman rdo rje sogs 'gas bskul ngor rig 'dzin chen po rtsa gsum gling pas zhal shes tshul du mgyogs par bris so/ /dam med rnams la gsang rgya: ྀatsha na) bsad pa'i dmigs pa ni: dgra bo'i steng na zangs kyi 'khor lo me las grub pa lcags bsregs kyi rang bzhin g.yas su 'khor ba: 'og lcags kyi 'khor lo rlung las grub pa dug gi sog le ltar g.yon du 'khor ba: bar thams cad dgra bgegs kyi phung pos gang ba bar med du 'khor zhing phye mar 'thag pas rdul phran bzhin brlags pa las byed pho nya rnams kyi hab sgra dir gyis lhag med rol par bsam mo: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa a kro rā dza ya ma rā dza sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ byad ma nṛ tri trig nan bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: thun sngags sogs so// // pa) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: bskul pa me rlung thog char bzhugs so: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis:

'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: bskul pa me rlung thog char bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: las bskul bya ba'i rim pa ni: gtor ma bdud rtsi rak+tas bran: gu gul sha chen dud pa phyur: rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog: dar phyar ru mtshon sna tshogs bsgreng : bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor ngang : mi dmigs dbyings nas 'di ltar bskul: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang bas: 'jigs byed khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar skur bzhengs shig: rdo rje dur khrod bdag mo skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad phur zor kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsad bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ya ma rā dza kī la ya rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang bas: khro rgyal khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: tshe bdag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: yum mchog khrag mig ma yang skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams:

bsregs bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kī la ya rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: ser nag rab 'jigs gru gsum dur khrod nas: khro chu dug gi gdong can skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang bas: khro rgyal khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: khro chu dug gi gdong can skur bzhengs shig: yum mchog bhe ta nag mo skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsregs bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ du tri ya ma rā dza ya mān+ta ka kī la ya rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: dgra nag gdong drug chen po skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang bas: khro rgyal khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: dgra nag gdong drug chen po skur bzhengs shig: yum mchog ya ma tsaṇ+ḍi skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsregs bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ya ma rā dza kā la rū pa ya mān+ta ka kī la ya rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: ljang nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: ki kang me yi spu gri skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis:

gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang bas: khro rgyal khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: ki kang me yi spu gri skur bzhengs shig: yum mchog srid pa stobs ldan skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsregs bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ki kang ya ma rak+sha a kro te ka kī la ya rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi zhi rgyas dbang drag sgo srung ma: las mdzad ma mo rigs bzhi skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra sdang bas: sgo skyong rigs bzhi'i phrin las dus la bab: lcags kyu zhags pa ma yi skur bzhengs shig: lcags sgrog dril bu ma yi skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsregs bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma tri ya ma rak+sha ni ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rak+ta bha ling+ta la khā hi:

zhes 'jam dpal gshin rje lha tshogs rnams pha rol dgra bgegs kyi srog la rngam zhing las la chas par bsam: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra gnam lcags rdo rjes khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gi gshin rje rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i gnas nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // pha) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: bzlog pa spu gri 'khor lo bzhugs so: 'jam dpal dug ri'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bzlog pa bya ba'i rim pa ni: gtor ma dgra ling rak+tas bran: gu gul sha chen spos kyang bsreg: rkang gling thod rnga drag tu sbir: rngam brjid dbyangs kyi nga ro yis: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs ti ra'i steng : gnam lcags rdo rje mthing nag rtse dgu pa: me zor rab 'bar lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan: de nyid lugs 'byung 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: 'jigs byed khro rgyal dug ri me 'bar sku: sku ni rab 'jigs khams gsum zil gyis gnon: gsung ni drag sngags hūm̐ phaṭ 'brug sgra sgrog: thugs ni chos dbyings mi g.yo mnyam nyid ngang : yon tan re skong sgrub la bar chad bsal: phrin las gang la gang 'dul rdzu 'phrul ston: lha mchog khyed kyi thugs rje'i nus rtsal gyis: bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: mi mthun bdud kyi bar chad zhi bar mdzod: sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rtsa zhal mthing nag ma he'i gdong can gyis: gshin rje yongs kyi dmod pa dgra la zlog: zhal dgu rngam zhing khros la 'jigs pa yis: khro bo yongs kyi dmod pa dgra la zlog: rigs bdag 'jam dpal rdo rje dpa' bo yis: rgya nag rtsis kyi bsgyur gto dgra la zlog: tshe bdag dmar ser mnyam par bzhag pa yis: dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad dgra la zlog:

dbu skra dmar ser dbyings la bskyod pa yis: gza' dang rgyu skar gnod pa dgra la zlog: g.yas pa dang pos gri gug bsnams pa yis: snang srid yongs kyi bka' chad dgra la zlog: gnyis pas ral gri 'bar ba bsnams pa yis: lha rnams yongs kyi bka' chad dgra la zlog: gsum pas chu gri dgye mor bsnams pa yis: klu rnams yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bzhi pas me dpung 'bar ba bsnams pa yis: lha min yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: lnga pas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams pa yis: rtsa rlung thig le'i gegs skyon dgra la zlog: drug pas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa yis: ma rungs bdud kyi cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: bdun pas gnam lcags 'khor lo bsnams pa yis: ban bon yongs kyi byad kha dgra la zlog: brgyad pas mdung thung rtse rnon bsnams pa yis: mu stegs yongs kyi byad kha dgra la zlog: dgu pas lcags kyu 'gugs byed bsnams pa yis: mo rgyud ma mo'i cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: bcu pas spu gri reg chod bsnams pa yis: pha rol sbyor ba ngan pa dgra la zlog: bcu gcig mi mgo'i dbyug to bsnams pa yis: btsan rnams yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bcu gnyis ḍā ru drag tu 'khrol ba yis: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma dgra la zlog: bcu gsum dgra satwa 'bar ba bsnams pa yis: gre bo yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bcu bzhis 'ching byed zhags pa bsnams pa yis: srin mo yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bco lngas gnam lcags tho ba bsnams pa yis: za 'dre shi gshed gnod pa dgra la zlog: bcu drug zhing gi rgya mtshan bsnams pa yis: sde brgyad yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: pho rgyud khro bo'i byad kha dgra la zlog: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: g.yon pa dang pos thod khrag bsnams pa yis: 'gong po yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: gnyis pas snying gi phreng ba bsnams pa yis:

dregs pa yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: gsum pas rgyu ma'i zhags pa bsnams pa yis: ma bdud yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bzhi pas lcags kyi gtun khung bsnams pa yis: gson 'dre yongs kyiganod pa dgra la zlog: lnga pas lcags sgrog sdom byed bsnams pa yis: yul 'dre yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: drug pas gsang ba'i rnga chung bsnams pa yis: nam gru'i gdon tshogs gnod pa dgra la zlog: bdun pas mi mgo'i phreng ba bsnams pa yis: bse rag yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: brgyad pas ru mtshon 'bar ba bsnams pa yis: yul lhas bar chad gtong ba dgra la zlog: dgu pas dug rlangs smyo byed bsnams pa yis: sa bdag yongs kyi g.yo 'khrugs dgra la zlog: bcu pas dril bu drag tu 'khrol ba yis: dpa' bo yongs kyi bsu ma dgra la zlog: bcu gcig snang gsal me long bsnams pa yis: srid pa'i dal kha nad yams dgra la zlog: bcu gnyis kong zor dmar nag bsnams pa yis: ngag mnan gtad khram 'bebs pa dgra la zlog: bcu gsum khram sh-ing mkha' la gdengs pa yis: gshin rje yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bcu bzhis shwa rdel dkar nag bsnams pa yis: the'u rang yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bco lnga'i phyag na rtsis rdo bsnams pa yis: spar sme dur du tshud pa dgra la zlog: bcu drug phyag na g.yang gzhi bsnams pa yis: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs dgra la zlog: rtsa phyag ri rab phur bu bsgril ba yis: dam sri 'gong po'i gnod pa dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mo rgyud khro mo'i byad kha dgra la zlog: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: spu gri'i sgro gshog tshwa tshwa 'thor ba yis: gdon chen bco lnga'i gnod pa dgra la zlog: yan lag lhu tshigs sbrul gyis brgyan pa yis: sa bdag klu yi gtad khram dgra la zlog: thod rlon phreng ba'i do shal brgyan pa yis: snang srid yongs kyi bka' chad dgra la zlog:

thod skam phreng ba'i rgyan 'phyangs spras pa yis: rigs bzhi ma mo'i yams nad dgra la zlog: glang chen ko rlon stod du gsol ba yis: nyon mongs dug lnga'i bar chad dgra la zlog: zhing lpags g.yang gzhi rked la dkris pa yis: 'dod chags srid pa'i bar chad dgra la zlog: khrag thig zhag zo thal chen brgyan pa yis: yams nad sna dgu sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal gdangs pa yis: klu bdud pho mo'i gnod pa dgra la zlog: chu srin zhal nas sbrul zhags 'khyugs pa yis: gdol pa dkar nag gnod pa dgra la zlog: sku smad phur bu rno dbal zur gsum gyis: bstan dgra sgos dgras 'tshe ba dgra la zlog: phur rtse ru tra'i snying gar bsnun pa yis: lo rtog bdud rigs gnod pa dgra la zlog: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa yis: dug gsum las kyi bag chags ngan pa zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: ma rig nyon mongs bdag 'dzin dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: dgra bgegs ru tra ti ra'i gdan steng du: gsung gi dbang phyug khro rgyal tshe bdag sku: dbus mthing g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khros pa'i zhal: g.yas gsum mtshon cha mkha' la gdengs pa yis: steng gi lha dang lha min 'khrugs pa zlog: g.yon gsum mtshon cha mkha' la gdengs pa yis: 'og gi klu dang sa bdag 'khrugs pa zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: khams gsum g.yo 'khrugs sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: bar nas btsan dang rgyal po 'khrugs pa zlog: sku smad phur gsham dgra la bsnun pa yis: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: zhe sdang gdug pa'i dmag tshogs dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

hūm̐: nga rgyal ri ltar nyil ba'i klong dkyil nas: dgra bgegs ru tra bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng : thugs kyi dbang phyug khro chu dug gdong can: mthing dkar dmar ba rab khros rngam zhal bgrad: g.yas gsum mtshon cha mkha' la gdengs pa yis: rgya gar chos kyi yi ge'i dmod pa zlog: g.yon gsum mtshon cha mkha' la gdengs pa yis: rgya nag rtsis kyi bsgyur gto dgra la zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: dgra bo'i mthu stobs gzi brjid dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: bon gyi ngan mthu sgrub pa dgra la zlog: sku smad phur gsham dgra snying bsnun pa yis: bla ma'i sku dgra thams cad dgra la zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: nga rgyal mtshan 'dzin dmag tshogs dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: 'dod chags khrag mtsho mer ba'i klong dkyil nas: dgra bgegs ru tra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: yon tan dbang phyug dgra nag dregs 'dul sku: mthing dkar dmar ba rab khros rngam zhal bgrad: g.yas gsum mtshon cha mkha' la phyar ba yis: stag gzig zor mda' 'phen pa dgra la zlog: g.yon gsum mtshon cha mkha' la gdengs pa yis: me nyag sog mo 'debs pa dgra la zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: dgra bo ban bon lha srung ma lus zlog: dur khrod chas kyis sku la brgyan pa yis: sum pa'i glang zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: sku smad phur gsham dgra snying bsnun pa yis: dge 'dun spyi dgra langs pa dgra la zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: 'dod chags srid pa'i bdag 'dzin dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshubs pa'i dur khrod nas: phrin las dbang phyug me yi spu gri can: mthing dkar dmar ba rab khros rngam zhal bgrad:

g.yas gsum mtshon cha mkha' la phyar ba yis: sngags nag hom zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: g.yon gsum mtshon cha mkha' la phyar ba yis: li yi spar sme gdan bgos dgra la zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: ngag mnan gtad khram sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: za hor sog mo bkod pa dgra la zlog: sku smad phur bu dgra snying bsnun pa yis: rnal 'byor sgos dgra thams cad dgra la zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: phrag dog gdug sems 'chang ba dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: yum mchog khro mo rigs bzhi 'khril ba yis: rtsa rlung 'byung ba rgud pa dgra la zlog: gri thod yab 'khyud rgyan kun rdzogs pa yis: srid pa las kyi byad kha dgra la zlog: hūm̐: rab 'jigs rngam pa'i phyogs bzhi dur khrod nas: las bzhi sgo skyong srog bdag ma mo bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang rang rtags phyag mtshan 'dzin: shar sgo'i khro mo lcags kyu bsnams pa yis: zhi ba'i phrin las sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: lho sgo'i khro mo zhags pa bsnams pa yis: rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: nub sgo'i khro mo lcags sgrog bsnams pa yis: dbang gi phrin las sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: byang sgo'i khro mo dril bu bsnams pa yis: drag po'i phrin las sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: sgo skyong ma mo rigs bzhi 'khor bcas rnams: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: lha chen drag po'i gdug rtsub zlog: lha ma yin gyi bsgyur thabs zlog: sa bdag klu yi gdug rtsub zlog: pho nya'i rbod gtong 'byung ba zlog: phur pa'i dbal kha 'phen pa zlog: nyungs dkar zor kha 'phen pa zlog: mu stegs bon po'i byad zor zlog:

dus 'khrug mtshon char 'bebs pa zlog: gri btsan bsha' gri brdar ba zlog: skye bo'i mda' zor 'phen pa zlog: bud med dmod zor 'phen pa zlog: yul mi'i m-i kha bram mchu zlog: gnam nas bdud kyi 'bebs pa zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa zlog: bya khyung gshog sgra brdebs pa zlog: dur phag ro la 'khun pa zlog: lo khyim rten phur bud pa zlog: srung rgya tshe rgya ral ba zlog: yar gyi gnam sgo bye ba zlog: mar gyi sa sgo bye ba zlog: ma mo sman mo 'khrugs pa zlog: pha mes dur sri langs pa zlog: phyugs kyi g.yang kha nyams pa zlog: nor gyi god kha phyur ba zlog: yul la 'dre rgod chags pa zlog: sri dang mi rabs chad pa zlog: phyogs nas dgra dpung g.yo ba zlog: mtshams nas byur bzhi langs pa zlog: phug la 'chi bdud zhugs pa zlog: mo rtsis pra rtags ngan pa zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur: mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: e ka du na e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: yang mtha' dus kyi mtha' ma la: bzlog pa spu gri 'khor lo 'di: rno myur zab khyad e ma hoḥ las can thugs kyi sras la sprod: skal med lag tu ma shor rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra dus mtha'i gter ston drag po gnam lcags rdo rje thog gi phyung rdeg btab pa lan med kyis/ spu gri bsad pa'i las sbyor rngam pa dug gdong zhes pa lcags sgrom bcu gsum gyi rgya 'dzin 'di khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gi gshin rje rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i gnas nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ba) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: srin mo za lam zor gyi sgo 'byed bzhugs pa'i dbu ldeb:

'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha la 'dud: bag zan khro mo'i gzugs la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon pa: phyag g.yas gtor zor dang g.yon pas kong zor thogs pa gcig la 'khor du las bzhi rang 'dra bskyed de dmigs: rten la stim zhing gsol ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo za lam gom pa bdun cu 'das pa'i pha rol nas: snang srid kun gyi srog gi bdag mo ste: las kyi ma mo dmar nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin: ye shes grub kyang las kyi shugs 'gro ma: zor sna 'dren pa'i stobs ldan dbang mo che: phyag g.yas dmar chen gtor zor me 'bar bsnams: g.yon pas kong zor dmar nag yugs se yug: 'khor du ma mo yang 'khor bye ba 'bum: thams cad thun rdzas dug mda' sha ra ra: dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: zor gyi sna 'dren bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yoḥ rdo rje shugs 'chang las kyi sha za 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: de ring mdos zor shar du drangs pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna 'dren bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yoḥ rin chen shugs 'chang rngam byed sha za 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhais: de ring mdos zor lho ru drangs pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna 'dren bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yoḥ pad+ma'i shugs 'chang gtum byed sha za 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: de ring mdos zor nub tu drangs pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna 'dren bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yoḥ las kyi shugs 'chang drag byed sha za 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: de ring mdos zor byang du drangs pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna 'dren bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: de ring mdos zor byang du drangs pa'i tshe: zor gyis sna 'dren bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo ma mo rak+mo ru lu dgra bo'i yul du bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog:

las kyi ma mo gtso 'khor thams cad kyis zor gyi sna drangs te: las la chas pa'i tshe: gdong la gnas shing 'gyu ba thams cad g.yas g.yon du sku bzur nas bdag gi rogs dan phrin las bsgrubs par bsam mo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas yul rngam pa rong gi tshal: khrom gzigs me 'bar mtsho nas gdan drangs shing bal yul yang le chos sdings gzim chung pad+ma 'od 'khyil du shog ser nas phab pa'o// // ma) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: dgongs gsol dgra bgegs dpung 'joms bzhugs so: ho dgongs su gsol lo: gsan du gsol lo: gzigs su gsol lo: gzu dang dpang po mdzod cig: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma: rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma: gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma: rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs: sku 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po: gsung dbang chen rta mchog rol pa: thugs yang dag rdo rje gtum po: yon tan ma mo za byed rnam rgyal: phrin las gsod byed rdo rje gzhon nu: sprul pa 'jig rten srog bdag dregs pa: yang sprul dmod pa las kyi spu gri la sogs pa: sgrub chen bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga 'bum phrag so bdun gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo: khyad par du 'chi bdag las kyi srin po 'jam dpal khro bo dug ri me 'bar srid pa gsum gyi srog bdag yab zla gsang thig le khro chu dkar po'i lha tshogs: yum gshor gsang nyi ma khros ma khro chu dmar po'i lha tshogs: sras bzhi khro chu nag po'i rang bzhin: tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po: khro chu dug gi sdong po: dgra nag dregs pa 'dul byed: ki kang me yi spu gri: dug ti ma tshogs rigs lnga: gshed chen 'bar ba sde bzhi: srid pa las kyi 'khor lo: gsal shing dug gi 'khor lo: spu gri me'i 'khor lo: khrag mtsho chu'i 'khor lo:

smyo 'bog rlung gi 'khor lo la sogs pa 'joms byed gshin rje 'bar ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo: khyad par bka' srung kun gyi sde dpon dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po: srog bdag las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong : gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu: sngags bdag ma mo ral gcig: skyes bu rdo rje legs pa: shan pa btsan rgod 'bar ba: gter srung dge bsnyen me rlung spu gri sogs: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo: gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po mngon spyod sgrub pa'i grogs dang mthu dpung skyed cig: hoḥ ye shes dang las la grub pa'i srung ma mthu rtsal can khyed rnams la gsol zhing mchod de phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: ma nyes pa rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la sdang zhing 'tshe ba: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa: bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdo ba: dge 'dun gyi spyi dgra byed pa: rnal 'byor bdag la ya bo bzung ba: snga dgra lag gis brdar ba: phyi dgra zhe la brnag pa: da dgra thad nas langs pa: spyi dgra rlung ltar 'tshubs pa: sgos dgra rbab ltar rgyug pa: zur dgra khyi ltar zug pa: sngon sgug dang rgyab 'ded byed mi: lo dgra lo las bab pa: zla dgra zla bar bab pa: zhag dgra zhag nas langs pa: bsam sbyor log par lta ba'i dgra bo: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha dang srung ma la mthu med zer ba: dmod pa ngan pa'i mi kha gleng ba: lag sdug pas 'phrog bcom byed mi: phu'i chos g.yag la 'tshe ba: mda' yi chos zhing 'phrog pa: bar du grwa slob bcom pa: rkun sna jag sna dgra sna ston par byed pa'i dgra bo: ngan sngags kyi 'khor lo bskor ba: skam gtad dang gsher gtad byed pa'i byad ma'i gzugs dmigs yul du bcug pa 'di'i skyes pa pho rgyud za ma mo rgyud byis pa chung rgyud skyob byed kyi ban bon lha srung yul mkhar phyugs zhing dang bcas pa de rnams kyi gnam gyi 'ju thag chod cig:

sa yi rten phur phyungs shig: nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma bzung sa gzhi dron mo la rjes ma bzhag tshe phyi ma la dus ma btab mthu bu lon bzhin du snyog pa'i dgra bo 'di rnams thams cad 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje pho nya sprul pa yang sprul nyi khri dgu 'bum khyed rnams kyis: gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs: gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar tsam gyi ljags rkyongs la: dmigs yul dam nyams dgra bo 'di rnams thams cad za ma chu tshod tsam yang ma 'gyang bar da lta nyid du bzhes shig: rol cig dgra bo'i bla srog rnam par shes pa la kha raṃ khā hi: de nas bsregs pa ltar na: drag po hom brtsegs la: e raṃ raṃ dz+wa la ram̐: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las e mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba raṃ gyis mtshan pa bskal pa'i me ri smug nag tsha zhing rtsub pa'i ngar dang ldan pa de'i dbus su gshin rje bhe wa sa twa kham nag dug gi gdong pa can g.yas ral gri g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa: gcer bu srin po'i cha byad can dgra bo'i srog la dbang zhing : 'chi bdag kha gdangs pa de'i zhal du dgra bo byad ma lha srung bcas pa bstabs pas: zhal du bzhes te lhag ma med par mdzod cig: oṃ ya ma rā dza a kro ti ka bhi wa sa twa ya dgra bgegs kyi gzugs phung rnam shes dang bcas pa la kha kha khā hi: raṃ a hu ti dz+wa la raṃ i daṃ du khā hi: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya raṃ: zhes bsregs te thal ba cha gsum du bya: cha gcig lam rgya gram du sbas: cha gcig rlung la phyar: cha gcig chu la gdab: ces gtor chen sreg skabs 'phang ba'i dmigs pa ni: rang gi rgyab tu yi dam g.yas su chos skyong pho rgyud g.yon du mo rgyud: mdun du chos skyong gter srung las mkhan pho nya rnams kyis mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs te dgra bo mkhar dang bcas pa ming shul tsam yang med par rmang nas brlags par bsam: yang na gtor 'bul tshul du 'phang :

yang na gtor ma 'phen yul me hom de nyid 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul las byed pho nya dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad kyis: gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdangs: gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar bzhin du ljags brkyangs nas: dgra bgegs gdug pa can byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa zhal du bstabs pas ming shul tsam yang med par zhal du bzhes par bsams la 'phang ba'o: zhes pa 'di rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas khrom gzigs rngam pa rong nas gdan drangs pa gong 'og 'khrugs rigs skyid grong smyon pas bsgrigs chog tu spel ba/ maṅga laṃ// // tsa) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: dgra brub dang mnan pa'i las rim dug mda' nag po bzhugs so: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i sku la 'dud: e maḥ kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: sku yi bkod pa bdag nyid mngon phyung phyir: rtsal bcu'i nus pas srid gsum kun kyang 'gengs: thogs med shugs kyis stong khams ru tra 'joms: dmod pa spu gris mu stegs kun kyang brlag: de phyir gshin rje'i gshed kyi las tshogs 'di: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : sangs rgyas ye shes thugs kyi sras la gdams: 'di nyid bstan pa'i bye brag dgos ched ni: rdo rje theg chen sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: pha rol rgol ba'i bdud kyis g.yengs nas su: dkar po dge ba'i las la bar gcod cing : sdang sems gdug pa'i 'tshe ba brtsam srid na: dgra bo brub cing mnan pa'i las 'di zab: de bas yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs las 'phro can gyi don du bzhag: bka' yi rgya 'di gza' bdud mgo dgus srungs: log lta bdud rigs lag tu ma gtad rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de'ang 'jam dpal dug ri me 'bar gyi las mtha' dgra bo mnan pa'i man ngag las: dang po dgra gang yin pa de'i lo dang spar kha bla dwags sogs shes par bya:

de'ang 'phrad par byung na: dgra bo'i bdun zur ram lo gshed shar ba'i tshe: dus tshes kyang dgra bo'i nyi ma dang bla gza' bcas 'phrod par bya: de'ang lo nag dang gza' thebs shing sgra gcan rgyu ba'i dus: zla nag zla zad kyi dus bag nyi shu'i skabs khyad par dmod pa'i las 'grub pa'i nyi mar brtsam/ thog mar dgos rim rdzas kyi rnam dbye bstan pa ni: dgra bo'i yul zhing dang khang pa'i sa: dgra bo'i gos dang bshang lci dor ba'i sa: khyad par dgra bo'i mtshon cha: rab ltar na dgra bo'i pha tshan gyi thod pa: khyad par pho shing shug pa seng ldeng skyer pa tsher nag mo shing lcang ma glang ma spen ma snyug ma: rabs chad rgya shing bcas la pho ling mo ling brgyad bu ling dang dgu bya: dug shing phur pa gri lcags kyi tho ba skam pa bsad pa'i ral gri: rdung ba'i gtun khung 'thag pa'i 'khor lo brub pa'i g.yag ru g.yas: mnan pa'i thod pa bya gcan gzan gyi mgo: nyin srib bar nas dgra bo'i bla rdel nag po dgu pho byang gi lcags: mo byang gi zangs: mda' gzhu cha dgu: ral gri cha dgu: 'phang cha dgu: pho mo'i bla rdel: dung srin med dgu: khyi ra phag gsum gyi spu la byas pa'i zhags pa 'dom dgu: thun rdzas dur rdo: rbab rdo rud rdo: ke tshe shang tshe dug dang thang phrom mtshe dang re lcags yungs dkar nag lcags phye zangs phye: mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi: mnan pa'i sāts+tsha nag po: byin rlabs kyi rdzas ma 'dres pa dug rdzas kyis brlan pa: dgra bo'i bla snod khrag gi grod pa: bla thag ring cha dkar dmar: bla rten srog gi mda' mo bla 'bod gri rkang gling bu: dgra bo brub pa'i rdzas g.yer ma dgu: sgong ba dgu: sgog pa dgu: tshwa thun dgu ram pa thun dgu sre long dum bu dgu: bra nag thun dgu: thal ba thun dgu: mda' chag gzhu chag dgu: brub pa'i hom khung lnga dgra mkhar dgu: dgra bo pho mo cha dgu: g.yab pa'i rnga ma dkar nag gnyis: gri lag dang dar nag po kha gang :

dug shog kha do la bsad ling brub ling bya: thog mar rdzas rim gyi gzhung bsrang skabs re zung yod pa ma gtogs nyer mkho rnams zhib tu bsags: yar gzhi bkod pa ni zur du gsal: sa ma ya: da ni dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa bstan cing 'god: thog mar phung shul sa dang gsang gsum gyi: lam du 'dre rgod 'gyu ba'i sa bcas la: stegs bu nag po 'dom gang tshad du bya: dbus su hom khung chos 'byung bsnol mar bya: de'i phyi rol rtsibs dgu thog tu ni: g.yam pa dgu'i steng du mkhar dgu bya: de nas dgra bo rim par bzhag par bya: de'i phyi rol rtsang phur drug cus bskor: steng du pho nya lha grangs gtor zlog bzhag: mdun du dgra bo dmod chas thams cad bzhag: de ltar lag len dag ni zhib tu bya: sa ma ya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas liṅga bri ba ni: thog mar dug shog ngar ma la: drag po'i shing smyug dag gis bris: gri khrag snag tshar dug khrag btab: 'bri tshe gnam gyis mi mthong bya: liṅga bris pa'i mtshan nyid ni: thog mar srid pa'i sa bon phyir: mtshan mar bris nas yi ge gzugs: kaṃ shaṃ tri dza: de nas srid pa lus la 'jug phyir: lte bar bris nas sngags 'di bkod: suṃ tri trag rak+sha mā ra ya e hur thuṃ rbad nan: de nas srid pa chags pa'i rten: snying gar bris nas sngags 'di dgod: nṛ tri pra ma ma tri sha truṃ da ha mā ra ya trig thuṃ nṛ myog rbad rbad: de nas tshogs drug dod pa'i phyir: mgul ba bris te sngags 'di bkod: bhi shwa tsakra tri tri waka thaṃ kha trun nan: de nas rtsa gsum chags pa'i phyir: kha'i dkyil du sngags 'di bris: du pra ma shan thun kha thaṃ nan: sna'i sgo ru sngags 'di bris: e ghan+dha ha ri nan: mig 'bras gnyis su sngags 'di bri: e tsak+ṣu ka ran tri ha ra bh+yoḥ rna ba gnyis su sngags 'di bri: e shrī dza kha tri bhi thum nan: de nas srid par mi zlog phyir: mgo bo bris te spyi gtsug la sngags 'di bri:

e badz+ra tsakra haṃ pra ma rak+sha bhan+dha rbad nan: de nas mtha' bzhi sdud pa'i phyir: yan lag bzhi bris sngags 'di dgod: lag pa g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: e tri dza la nṛ tri rbad: e thum kha la nṛ tri rbad: rkang pa g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: e thum nan tri baṃ bh+yo rbad: om̐ trum tri ho nṛ tri rbad: de nas srid pa mtha' sdud phyir: lus kun tshang nas sgrog tu gzhug: lcags sgrog gnyis su sngags 'di bri: dang po stod kyi lcags sgrog gnyis la: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dgra bo khug nan: om̐ rat+na pā sha hūm̐ dgra bo chings nan: de nas smad kyi lcags sgrog gnyis la: om̐ pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ dgra bo sdom nan: om̐ karma ghaṇ+ḍe ho dgra bo myos nan: de nas brlag cing ming med phyir: dug sbrul dkar nag gnyis kyis dkri: dug sbrul dkar po'i khog par sngags 'di bri: om̐ nā ga ti pa ra ha thun dgra bo bla yid thun dzaḥ nā ga si pa ya kha trun dgra bo'i srog la rbad mā ra ya nan: dug sbrul nag po'i khog par sngags 'di bris: om̐ nā ga trag rak+ṣa ya dgra bo'i bla yid thun: nā ga te dz+wa gardza tri ya dgra bo srog la mā ra ya rbad nan: de nas rlung la bskur ba'i phyir: lus nang khyab par sngags 'dis bskor: om̐ ya ma a pa ka ri nan dgra bo'i srog la dza dzaḥ srog la rbad rbad mā ra ya nṛ tri sha truṃ trig nan: e baṃ tshes this pa de ya ma thun ya thun dgra bo'i srog la dza dzaḥ dgra bo'i snying la rbad chod: e khaṃ he thun nan tri ya dgra bo'i srog la dza dzaḥ thun thun mā ra ya nṛ tri byad ma dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: e raṃ tri kha sha ha thun dgra bo'i snying la dza dzaḥ nṛ pa shaṃ ku ru dza thum dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: e ha la sarba nā ga tra tri nag po ta pa rā dza dgra bo'i srog la thun thun mā ra ya byad ma kha la dgra bo'i snying dang mgo chod dgra bo'i chaiga'i lus la thun thun: dgra bo'i ngag la thun thun:

dgra bo'i yid la thun thun: dgra bo phung po lnga la thun thun: rnam shes brgyad la thun thun: khams lnga la thun thun: 'du ba bcu gnyis la thun thun: dgra bo'i chaiga'i srog lus dbang thang rlung rta sme ba thams cad dur mig tu tshud par gyur cig: 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje la dgra bo chaiga'i zas skal du gtod ya ma he'i phrum: dgra skal du gtad do nṛ tri shag thun rbad ya: dgra bo byad ma gri ru sod cig ya ma tsa tri e khrom rbad bh+yoḥ dgra bo chaig pho rgyud mo rgyud rigs rgyud thams cad la dza dzaḥ om̐ ki kang ya ma rā dza e phru lu dgra bo'i srog la trig thum: phyin chad dgra bo mi 'byung ba'i phyir: phyi rol rim bzhin sngags 'di bkod: e a tri thun ma tri thun nṛ tsa dz+wa la thun e had had pa ka la ya ma rā dza dgra bo he brub nṛ brub khaṃ brub dgra bo dza bh+yo thun: dgra bo ma bh+yo e thun: lo rgyal po la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: zla ba blon po la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: zhag dmag mi la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dus tshod mtshon cha la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: snga dgra yid la sems pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: phyi dgra zhe la 'chang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: da dgra thad du langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dgra mgo thog nas babs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dgra zur bab kyis gleng ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: shar shing khams kyi dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: lho me khams kyi dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: nub lcags khams kyi dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: byang chu khams kyi dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: mtshams bzhi sa khams kyi dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: phyogs nas dmag chen g.yos pa'i dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dgra sgo dang gyod sgo bye ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub:

dgra bo'i pho lha thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dgra bo'i ma lha thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dgra bo skyes lha thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dgra bo'i yul zhing mkhar dang bcas pa mā ra ya nan brub: dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya nan brub: 'byung po mkha' ru 'gyu bas dgra sna khrid pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: om̐ lok+t+ri pā la nan: nā ga du shan nan: a mu ka pur thum nan: bigh+nān trig nan rbad nan bzlog nan: mā ra ya nan: dgra bo ka wa tsiḥ satwaṃ bha ya nan:

phyi rol shog lhag mi bzhag cing : dkar cha gang 'dug dza khraṃ btab: phyed tsam gshin rje dza khraṃ 'di ltar bya: dzaḥ de nas ling khrus bya ba ni: lcags snod du chu gtsang la: sngags 'di brgya'am stong byin gyis brlab: oṃ shrī bhi shwa dha ye swā hā: de nas me long 'jings logs la: chu gtsang de yis khrus kyang bya: sngags chu liṅgar ma 'thor bya: hūm̐: ye shes rab 'bar chu rgyun gyis: bla gzugs 'di la khrus bgyi bas: dgra ling 'di yi lha rnams phyes: snag shog 'di yi 'bag pa sol: oṃ khaṃ shud+dhe ye swā hā: de nas zan gtsang gang rung gis: ling khrus byas te me ru bsregs: om̐ āḥ bdag sgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas liṅga 'di la 'bag pa thim par gyur na: ag+ne ye dz+wa la raṃ da ha da ha haṃ: zhes gsum bzlas: de nas sre mong sha dang ni: bya gag sha yi dud rdzas bdug: liṅga shin tu mnol bar bya: de nas yugs sa rang 'thag gi: thur du dmigs nas lan gsum drangs: de nas thang phrom dug rdzas bdug: dgra bo'i khang khyim nye bar yod na bskor ba lan gsum byed pa gnad yin: sla nga'i 'og tu lan gsum sbub: de nas 'ug sha'i dud pa bdug: dgra bo'i rdzas rnams gang yod blugs: thog mar mgo bo phyed nas lteb: ske phyed snying phyed sked pa phyed: lte ba brla dang rje ngar phyed: thams cad thur du lteb par bya: g.yas nas g.yon du drug tu lteb: lteb chags bdun dang drug 'byung ste: de nas phyed lteb zur gsum bya: byad thag sna lnga'i ring chas dkri: yang na nag po gsum gyis dkri: dkri tshe dbyangs gsal snying po dang : rten 'brel snying po mgo mjug ldog: lan dgu bzlas nas dkri bar bya: mchil ma mid par btang mi bya: liṅga bri ba'i gnas skabs ni: snga dro las byang btang nas su: sngags la bskyal te phyi dro yi: mar 'grib dus su bri ba dang : mun rub lha dbye'i rdzas bdug go: liṅga mi 'gom sa ru bzhag:

rang grib ma phog pa ru gces: sa ma ya: de nas bca' gzhi tshang ba'i tshe: gshin rje'i gtor 'bul lha grangs ltar: bskul chung snod cig nang du bsham: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyangs nas su: lan gsum dgra 'gugs gtor mar bstim: phaṭ nṛ tri dzaḥ na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pas dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad drag po thun gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ lan gsum: na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa dang : gshin rje gshed po za byed me gdong can: dug ri nag po pha rol rgol 'joms kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus: dmigs pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs thams cad kun: drag po thun gtor 'di la myur du khug: om̐ ya ma rā dza bh+yo dgra bo'i bla srog khug dza dzaḥ lan gsum: hūm̐: dza yig dmar nag 'phros pas gtor mar thim: spu gri'i rang bzhin gyur nas dgra bgegs gtub: tshe bsod 'ub bsdus rnal 'byor bdag la thim: sha khrag gshin rje mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gtor ma sman raka dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta khā hi: de nas thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo ya: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rtsa brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol: 'jam dpal nag po gshegs su gsol: rigs bdag dmar po gshegs su gsol: e yaḥ gru gsum snang srid spu gri'i zhing : 'byung ba mtshon cha rang bzhin 'khrugs: me chu sgra skad 'brug ltar sgrog: dug gi rlangs pa mun ltar gtibs: gshin rje'i pho nya rlung nag 'tshubs: de 'dra 'jigs pa'i gling chen po: 'chi bdag las kyi pho brang nas: dug ri me 'bar gshegs su gsol:

tshe bdag nag po gshegs su gsol: khro chu dug gdong gshegs su gsol: dgra nag dregs 'dul gshegs su gsol: ki kang nag po gshegs su gsol: 'khor gyi gshin rje gshegs su gsol: sprul pa'i las mkhan gshegs su gsol: dgra bgegs bsgral phyir dbyings nas bzhengs: rak+ta khrag gi mchod pa bzhes: dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i phrin las mdzod: e bh+yoḥ lho phyogs bdag po dug gi sdong : 'chi bdag khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed: pho nya drug cu gnas kyi bdag: dug rlangs 'khrigs pa'i pho brang nas: srog bdag me 'bar skur bzhengs shig: 'joms byed tshe bdag skur bzhengs shig: 'chi bdag dug gdong skur bzhengs shig: sgrol byed dgra nag skur bzhengs shig: las byed ki kang skur bzhengs shig: thugs dam ma g.yel gnad nas bzhengs: mngon spyod chen po'i dus la bab: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gshin rje'i pho nya dgra la 'gyed: 'chi bdag sprul pa skar ltar 'khrugs: las byed chen po mi bsrun pa: ya ma rā dza las la chos: byad ma dam nyams sdig can 'di: bla tshe rnam shes rten dang phrol: do nub nam gyi srod thun la: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: nyin mo dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer zhon la: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: nub mo dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: smag rum mun pa'i rta la zhon: dgra bo'i bla srog khug la shog: sdig can dgra bo shor ra re: da lta nyid du khug la shog: dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya ba: nag po lcags kyi a tsa ra: g.yas pas spu gri sog le 'dzin: g.yon pas 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'debs: myur mgyogs las kyi pho nya bdun: rol du lcags spyang sngon mo khrid: klad nas lcags kyi bya khra lding : rlung nag 'tshub ma'i nang du rgyug: dmod pa chen po'i drang mkhan pa: srid pa 'di yi srog gi bdag: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: dmigs pa'i byad ma khug la shog:

dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya ba: lag dmar zangs kyi a tsa ra: g.yas pas zangs kyi ral gri thogs: g.yon pas zangs kyi zhags pa 'debs: shan pa zangs kyi pho nya bdun: rol du zangs 'phar dmar po khrid: klad na zangs kyi bya khra lding : shwa rbud dmar po'i nang du rgyug: dmod pa dus kyi las mkhan pa: byad ma 'gugs pa'i gshed po che: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: dmigs pa'i byad ma khug la shog: dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya ba: dug gi phag rgod nag po bdun: ngar sgras sa gzhi kun kyang g.yo: bswe yi sbal pa dmar po bdun: rkan sgra 'jig rten khyab par brdeb: 'khyugs pa'i dug sbrul nag po bdun: 'gyu bas ri rab 'ur gyis 'gengs: lcags kyi sdig pa nag po bdun: rbad pas gling bzhi chol bur 'phen: sprul pa sde bzhi'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: dmigs pa'i byad ma khug la shog: dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs las la bskul: dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: de ring thugs dam dus la bab: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: pha rol byad ma dam nyams kyi: bla srog don snying phrol la shog: gling bzhi 'di yi sa 'og tu: rim pa dgu yi mtshams shed na: gshin rje yi dwags dud kha can: cho nge 'o dod ldir ba'i gnas: de yi nang du dgra bo brub: pho brang lcags mkhar 'og tu non: dam nyams dgra bo byad du chug: kha la rgyas 'debs ma he'i gdong : dam nyams dgra bgegs zhal du thob: nyi khri dgu 'bum sa ya stong : las gshin sde tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: mngon spyodachen po'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka a kro te ka du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa badz+ra kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan hūm̐ phaṭḥ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ kiṃ ra e tri kā la ya byad ma nṛ tri trig thuṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad:

dam nyams dgra bgegs kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa la kha kha khā hi: bha ling+ta pū dza khā hi: zhes pas bskul gyi gtor ma 'bul zhing gshin rje'i dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum 'gyed cing : rngon pa ri dwags la rngam pa lta bu'i tshul gyis stong khams gling 'dir khyab par khengs te byad ma dgra bgegs dbang med du 'gugs pa'i las brtson par bsam: sa ma ya: de nas liṅga 'gugs pa ni: las kyi bdud ging dkar nag gis: gri lcags skam pas liṅga bzung : hom bskyed phyag rgya bgyis nas su: cung zad mdun du ling thabs bya: phaṭ tri khaṃ nṛ tri dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags 'di lan gsum bgrang : de nas hom gyi nang du bcug: byad thag dug shing phur pa btags: steng gi ri rab rtse ru 'dzugs: de nas bskyed chog bya ba ni: om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bskal pa'i me rlung dmar nag drag tu 'tshubs shing 'khyil ba'i dbus su gru gsum mthing nag raṃ gyis mtshan pa'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag dang ya dmar nag yongs su gyur pa las: 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje nag po dud kha ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can: zhal dgu po thams cad kyang drag po shin tu khros pa'i gzugs can dgra bgegs gdug pa'i srog la dbang zhing rngam pa: phyag bcu drug gi g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug gnyis pas ral gri gsum pas chu gri bzhi pas me dpung lnga pas kha ṭ+wāṃ drug pas rdo rje bdun pas 'khor lo brgyad pas mdung thung dgu pas lcags kyu bcu pas spu gri bcu gcig pas dbyug to bcu gnyis pas ḍā ru bcu gsum pas dgra satwa bcu bzhi pas zhags pa bco lnga pas zhing gi rgyal mtshan thogs pa'o: g.yon bcu drug gi dang pos thod khrag gnyis pas snying phreng gsum pas rgyu ma bzhi pas gtun khung lnga pas lcags sgrog drug pas rnga chung bdun pas mgo phreng brgyad pas ru mtshon dgu pas dug rlangs bcu pas dril bu bcu gcig pas kong zor bcu gnyis pas khram shing bcu gsum pas sho rdel bcu bzhi pas rtsis rdo bco lnga pas g.yang gzhi me rab tu 'bar ba can bsnams pa'o:

rtsa phyag gnyis kyis ri rab phur pa 'dril ba'o: dur khrod kyi chas bcus brgyan cing lte bar chu srin gdug pa'i zhal za byed kyi rang bzhin gdang bas pha rol mi rabs bdun rgyud za ba: sku smad gnam lcags las kyi phur gsham rno dbal spu gri'i ngar dang ldan pa byad ma gdug pa'i snying khar bsnun pas rak+ta rlabs su g.yo ba: pang du 'khyud pa'i yum gcig ma mo dug ti ma zhal gsum mi bzad pa'i khro gnyer can: phyag drug gri gug thod khrag rdo rje 'khor lo phur bu ral gri 'dzin pa: dur khrod kyi chas dang ldan zhing zhabs bzhis sked la 'khril ba: yab yum bskal pa'i me ri smug nag phyogs bcur g.yo ba'i dbus su gsal bar gyur: om̐ hriṣ+ṭi wi kri ta na na ya ma rā dza badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ: de nas rten liṅga bskyed pa ni: rang nyid gshin rje'i nga rgyal dang bcas te: hoḥ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'jigs byed chen po drag tu khros pa'i mdun du: kaṃ kaṃ dmar nag las grub pa'i gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po rngam la 'thug pa bskal pa'i mun nag 'tshub mar gtibs pa phyi thams cad dus mthar 'byung ba sdud pa'i me ltar dmar nag tshwa tshwa skar ltar du 'khrugs shing gtibs pa: bar thams cad 'byung ba chu rlung rba 'tshubs pa'i skad ltar dug gi rlangs pa sngo dmar drag tu 'phyur ba: de'i nang thams cad spu gri dang ral gri chu gri'i tshogs thams cad gzengs shing skar ltar du 'khrugs pa shin tu mi bzad pa: bdud kyi bsha' ra: btsan gyi bsad khang : gshin rje'i brub khung : ma mo'i 'gyu lam: gza' bdud kyi lte ba: srin po'i za lam: pho nya'i rgyun lam: sde brgyad kyi 'du sa: srog bdag gi tshogs khang : shin tu ya nga ba de'i nang du nṛ tri dmar nag yongs su gyur pa las: dam nyams pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs chaiga'i kho'i phung khams skye mched dbang po thams cad mngon sum du gsal ba:

shin tu nyam thag pa'i gzugs can gcer bu byang thang gi lhag pas bsdams pa lta bu: lus sngo zhing ham pa: yan lag thams cad lcags sgrog gis bkyigs shing dmyal srung gshin rje'i pho nyas drag tu bsdams pa 'dar phri le ba: kha 'o dod mig shi mig lus mya ngan bug pa dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa mgon skyabs kyi lha dang bral ba: srog chad la khad pa dbugs bral la khad pa lha srin sde brgyad kyi zas skal gtad pa'i rang bzhin can zhig tu gyur: nṛ tri dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ mā ra ya dzaḥ mā ra ya thun: de nas dmod pas 'gugs pa ni: na mo: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma: rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma: gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma: rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang : sku 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po: gsung dbang chen rta mchog rol pa: thugs yang dag rdo rje gtum po: yon tan ma mo za byed rnam rgyal: phrin las gsod byed rdo rje gzhon nu: sprul pa 'jig rten srog bdag dregs pa: yang sprul dmod pa las kyi spu gri la sogs pa: sgrub chen bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga 'bum phrag sum cu so bdun la sogs pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par 'chi bdag las kyi srin po 'jam dpal khro bo dug ri me 'bar srid pa gsum gyi srog bdag: yab zla gsang thig le khro chu dkar po'i lha tshogs: yum gshor sang nyi ma khros ma khro chu dmar mo'i lha tshogs: sras bzhi khro chu nag po'i rang bzhin: tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po: khro chu dug gi sdong po: dgra nag dregs pa 'dul byed ki kang me'i spu gri dug ti ma mo rigs lnga: gshed chen 'bar ba sde bzhi: 'chi bdag khram thogs bcu gnyis: dus kyi pho nya drug cu: srog bdag bdud po sde bzhi: dbugs len ru tra sde bzhi: shan pa pho nya sde bzhi: a tsar mon pa sde bzhi:

las byed nyi khri dgu 'bum: sprul pa phag sdig sbal sbrul: bla 'gugs las kyi pho nya: bla 'bod mi reng dmar po: srid pa las kyi 'khor lo: gsal shing dug gi 'khor lo: spu gri me'i 'khor lo: khrag mtsho chu'i 'khor lo: smyo 'bog rlung gi 'khor lo la sogs pa 'joms byed gshin rje 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par bka' srung kun gyi sde dpon dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po: srog bdag bya rog gdong can gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu: sngags bdag ma mo ral gcig: skyes bu rdo rje legs pa: shan pa btsan rgod 'bar ba la sogs bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang : chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas: deng 'dir dgug pa'i yul du mchis pa ni: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa dge 'dun gyi sde la smod pa khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la sdang zhing gdug pa'i bsam sbyor 'chang ba: snga dgra yid la sems pa phyi dgra zhe la bzhag pa: da dgra thad nas langs pa: spyi dgra rlung ltar 'tshubs pa: sgos dgra rbab ltar rgyug pa: zur dgra khyi ltar zug pa: mtho gong nas rgol ba: dma' khyad du 'bebs pa: gyod phyogs nas langs pa: sri phug tu tshud pa: snyad tsher ltar 'dzu+ugs pa: mdun sgug dang rgyab 'ded byed pa: lo dgra lo nas dar ba: zla dgra zla ba ru babs pa: zhag dgra zhag nas langs pa: dus dgra dus su 'gyu ba: dgra thog 'gel du byung ba: dgra rkang zhabs nas langs pa: dgra phyogs bzhi nas langs pa: dgra mtshams bzhi nas langs pa: dgra ri rtse nas langs pa: dgra la so nas langs pa: dgra lung gsum nas langs pa: dgra yul mi nas langs pa: dgra pha spun nas langs pa: dgra 'khor g.yog nas langs pa: dgra mdun rgyab nas langs pa: dgra mthun gsum nas langs pa:

dgra sgo them nas langs pa: dgra rlung dmar ltar g.yo ba: dgra chu bo ltar 'bab pa: dgra me dpung ltar 'bar ba: dgra bu yug ltar 'tshub pa: dgra khram kha ltar bstan pa: la sogs pa rnams dang khyad par bsam sbyor ngan pa la sogs 'chang zhing gdug pa yid du bkod pa'i pha rol gyi dgra bo byad ma: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: mthu bu lon bzhin du snyog pa: kha dmod pa'i ya kha byed pa: lag gdug pas 'phrog bcom byed pa: khyad par bslab pa'i slob bu dam log: bzhag pa'i bran g.yog snying rangs: nyos pa'i chung ma blo log: gtam pa'i shag rogs mna' gzan: skyabs pa'i yon bdag gzhungs ngan: tshe rabs sngon gyi lan chags: smon lam log pa'i bdud rigs: khyad par nad kha dang yams kha phye ba: dgra kha dang gyod kha bye ba: khyim sgo lam gsum du chag che ba: nyam nga ba: g.yer ma bzhin du dgra kha gdangs pa: bra bo bzhin du zur btsugs pa: rtsang dmar bzhin du dbal kha 'debs pa: skra nag bzhin du mgo nas g.yab pa: shing rta bzhin du 'gyu log byed pa: dbyar gnam bzhin du mgo skor byed pa: rta rnga bzhin du rgyud la 'khril ba: thog ser bzhin du phyogs nas g.yo ba la sogs pa dang : pha rol byad ma bsam sbyor ngan pa la sogs pa 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs

chaiga'i skyes pa pho rgyud za ma mo rgyud: byis pa chung rgyud: pha tsho mthun grogs dang bcas pa srung skyob ban bon dang bcas pa: sgo nor phyug zhing dang bcas pa thams cad rang dbang med par steng nas gnam gyi 'ju thag chod: 'og nas sa yi rten phur phud: las rlung drag po'i rta la bskyon: pho nya shan pas mdun nas khrid: mun nag 'thib pas rgyab nas ded: gling bzhir gar gnas kyang gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig: lha'i dkar byang 'di la phob cig: btsan gyi dmar byang 'di la phob cig: bdud kyi nag byang 'di la phob cig: skad cig da lta nyid du ming byang bu la btab pa 'di la khug cig stims shig: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ om̐ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: om̐ badz+ra karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ a sa ka ra dza dzaḥ dgra bo shak+ti rur+ṇa dza dzaḥ dgra bo bha bi ta sarba dzaḥ dgra bo bha wā tsit+ta dza dzaḥ dgra bo tri tri aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ sarba nṛ tri khug dza satwaṃ bha ya nan: zhes lan gsum gyis bkug cing dgra bo shin tu bstims pa'i dmigs pa bya: de nas pho nya bskyed pa ni: mdun du rak+ta bshams la tshig 'di'i mtshams su mchod: hūm̐ ya eḥ thugs nyid dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : thabs kyi cho 'phrul gang 'dul phyir: de ring dgra la sprul pa 'gyed: 'joms byed chen po'i sku ru gsal: dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: yi ge pho nya dzaḥzhig 'phros: dzaḥlas rdo rje lcags kyu ma: khro chu dkar po'i pho nya ste: lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu la: gshin rje dug ti dkar mos zhon: bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs: bla 'ching zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs: bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab tu khur: bla bya dkar po sngun nas 'jums: bla khyi dkar po rgyab nas 'gyu: 'khor du srin mo dkar nag gnyis: bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re: gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de: las rlung dmar pos thums la shog:

drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog: lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog: zhags pa nag pos chings la shog: gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung : dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: dug ti ma mo rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yo ya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla dwags a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ zhes dgra bo mngon sum 'gugs par bsams la dmigs pa gnad du bsnun par bya: dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: yi ge pho nya hūm̐ zhig 'phros: hūm̐ las rin chen zhags pa ma: khro chu ser po'i pho nya ste: gser gyi rgya stag mgo dgu la: gshin rje dug ti ser mos zhon: bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs: bla 'ching zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs: bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab tu khur: bla bya ser po sngun nas 'jums: bla khyi ser po rgyab nas 'gyu: 'khor du srin mo ser nag gnyis: bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re: gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de: las rlung dmar pos thums la shog: drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog: lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog: zhags pa nag pos chings la shog: gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung : dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: dug ti ma mo rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yo ya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla dwags a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: yi ge pho nya baṃ zhig 'phros: bam las rdo rje lcags sgrog ma: khro chu dmar po'i pho nya ste: zangs kyi 'phar wa mgo dgu la: gshin rje dug ti dmar mos zhon: bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs: bla 'ching zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs: bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab tu khur: bla bya dmar po sngun nas 'jums: bla khyi dmar po rgyab nas 'gyu: 'khor du srin mo dmar nag gnyis:

bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re: gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de: las rlung dmar pos thums la shog: drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog: lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog: zhags pa nag pos chings la shog: gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung : dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: dug ti nag mo rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yo ya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla dwags a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: yi ge pho nya ho zhig 'phros: ho las karma dril bu ma: khro chu nag po'i pho nya ste: dug gi dom nag mgo dgu la: gshin rje dug ti nag mos zhon: bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs: bla 'ching zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs: bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab tu khur: bla bya nag po sngun nas 'jums: bla khyi nag po rgyab nas 'gyu: 'khor du srin mo sngo nag gnyis: bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re: gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de: las rlung dmar pos thums la shog: drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog: lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog: zhags pa nag pos chings la shog: gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung : dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: dug ti nag mo rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yo ya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla dwags a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ zhes las kyi ma bzhi bskul bas srog bdag 'gyu ba'i ma mo thams cad sprin ltar 'khrigs nas dgra bo'i bla rtags rnams dbang med 'gugs par bsam: de nas skabs su 'gugs sngags ni: dmod pa'i lcags kyu 'di bzhin bzlas: om̐ e thun he thun he ya ma rā dza thun: ka la ha la mu kha kha thun: ki kang ru tra pra ṇa ya thun: ha la ti ka li ru tra shag ti thun: ru tra a pa ka ra rur+ṇa ya thun:

ki kang he pra ma thun: ru tra chaig nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya thun thun: sngags 'di brgya phrag tsam song nas: dgra bo'i bla 'gugs kyi sngags ni: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ki kang ya ma tri dza dgra bo srog rtsa khrag thig snying rtsa la dza dzaḥ ya ma dgra bo'i srog la shag dza dzaḥ dug ti ma tri shwa na rak+sha ru tra kha thun dgra bo'i srog la dza dzaḥ e bha wa ya ma kha thun dgra bo'i srog la breng breng shag dza dzaḥ ai ya ma a ri sha dgra bo'i srog snying baṃ ril shag dza dzaḥ e ma tri ha la bh+ri ku tri ya dgra bo'i bla srog la dza dzaḥ e ya ma rā dza dgra bo'i tsa truṃ tri thum dza dzaḥ de nas dgra bo lha dang dbye ba'i sngags ni: thun rgod phye ma gtor zhing : e ya ma rā dza ma ma trag rak+sha mā ra ya phyes phyes: ya ma pra ma dgra bo skyob byed lha thams cad phyes phyes: ki kang ka la hring dgra bo srog la nṛ tri trig nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya sha truṃ rbad rbad: ya ma rā dza ha la du tri ka la dgra bo byad ma lha dang phyes phyes: srog snying mgo chod tri thuṃ thuṃ: zhes dgra bo lha dang phyes 'chi bdag gshin rje bdud dang sprad par bsam: bya rog dang 'ug sgros liṅga la lan dgu g.yab: gong gi 'gugs sngags mang nyung gang bsgrubs kyi phyed cha tsam lha dbye la bzlas: de nas bsad sngags bzla ba ni: mdun du gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rnams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las byed cing : byad ma rdul du brlags par bsam: om̐ ya ma rā dza a kro rā dza dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ya ma ka la du tri rā dza dgra bo'i snying la breng breng : ya ma he thun dgra bo'i rtsa thib srog la breng shag rbad rbad: ya ma rā dza dgra bo'i tsit+ta laṃ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ suṃ nṛ tri thun: ha ra ha ra byad ma'i srog la du nan sod: du tri ya ma rak+sha dgra bo byad ma nṛ tri trig nan: e hur thum rbad rbad: ya ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ kha la du tra dgra bo'i snying khrag phyung phyung :

e ta sha ku ru tra dgra bo'i bla srog chod chod: rak+mo ya ma dz+wa la dgra bo'i rtsa thun rbad rbad: om̐ ki kang kha trun nṛ myog dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i dbugs la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i snying la rbad rbad: ya ma a ri sha dgra bo'i srog dbugs la hab sha hab sha: snying kha rak+mo rak+sha srog snying khrag shaṃ longs rbad rbad: de nas thun rgod kyis brab cing brdeg: thun sngags ni: om̐ ya ma rā dza ha la ka la phe sha ka bha ru tra ma rā ya pra wa e ka nan: thun bh+yo rbad bh+yoḥ ya ma rā dza a kro ta ka dgra bo byad ma nṛ myog: ki kang ha la kha truṃ nṛ tri myog: dgra bo byad ma waka satwaṃ bha ya nan: truṃ truṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: ha la kha gha ya dgra bo dun+t+ri dun+t+ri rbad: pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la dgra bo nṛ tri sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: dgra bo'i bla pañtsa ya ya ma u grwa dgra bo'i srog la thun bh+yo rbad bh+yoḥ de nas yungs dkar nag gis cung zad gtor la: om̐ mañdzu shrī ri ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ta kā la rū pa a kro rā dza ya ma rā dza hūm̐ sa ma ya phaṭḥ dgra bo byad ma thams cad nṛ tri trig nan e thum mā ra ya bzlog nan nan: zhes thun brdegs pas dgra bo byad ma'i srog snying phral zhing phye mar rdul phran bzhin du brlags par bsam: thun sngags tshe dmigs pa ni: dgra bo'i steng zangs kyi 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor: 'og tu lcags kyi 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor: bar thams cad dgra bgegs kyi phung pos gang bar 'thag pas phye ma rdul phran bzhin du brlags par bsam: zhes las kyi ma mo bzhi bskul bas srog bdag 'gyu ba'i ma mo thams cad sprin ltar du 'khrigs nas dgra bo'i bla dwags rnams dbang med du bkug par bsam: skabs su dgra bo'i bla rtags 'gugs pa ni: pho nya'i gtor 'bul bshams la: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:

mi bzad khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: dug gi spu gri nag po ma he'i gdong : za byed dgra srog rngam phyir las la bzhengs: 'chi bdag gshed chen sde bzhi skur bzhengs shig: sprul pa'i las mkhan dmag tshogs skur bzhengs shig: deng 'dir dgra la myur mgyogs pho nya 'gyed: dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: sprul pa'i pho nya lcags kyi a tsa ra: dgra bo 'gugs phyir lag na lcags kyu thogs: de ring nyi ma snga dro'i dus kyi tshe: dgra bo las la g.yeng zhing bying rgod dus: bla rtags dud 'gro ri khar 'khyams pa'i dus: sprul pa gcan spyang pho nyar brdzus nas kyang : rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byad ma'i ming byang gzugs ling 'di la phob: khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: sprul pa'i pho nya dug phag nag po bdun: dgra bo 'gugs phyir dug gi mche zor rngam: de ring nyi ma phyed pa'i dus kyi tshe: dgra bo'i khams nyog shes pa 'thibs pa'i dus: bla rtags khang khyim had por sdod pa'i skabs: sprul pa rlung dmar pho nya brdzus nas kyang : rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byad ma ming byang gzugs ling 'di la phob: khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: sprul pa'i pho nya bswe sbal dmar po bdun: dgra bo 'gugs phyir gnam lcags rkan sgra rdeb: de ring nyi ma phyi dro nub pa'i tshe: dgra bo'i snying gzer shes pa 'tshubs pa'i dus: bla rtags bya rigs rnams kyang 'du ba'i skabs: sprul pa za byed srin bya rdzus nas kyang : rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byad ma'i ming byang gzugs ling 'di la phob: khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ

ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: sprul pa'i pho nya zangs kyi a tsa ra: dgra bgegs 'gugs phyir lag na zangs zhags thogs: do nub mun rub nam stod dus kyi tshe: dgra bo gnyid 'thibs rig pa 'thor ba'i dus: bla rtags gza' skar rnams kyang bkram pa'i skabs: sprul pa sgra gcan rlung dmar brdzus nas kyang : rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byad ma'i ming byang gzugs ling 'di la phob: khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: sprul pa'i pho nya dug sbrul nag po bdun: dgra bo 'gugs phyir myur mgyogs gling bzhir rgyug: do nub chu srang nam phyed dus kyi tshe: dgra bo sngangs shing spu zing byed pa'i dus: bla rtags spyi bdud rnams kyang g.yeng ba'i skabs: sprul pa bu yug 'tshub mar brdzus nas kyang : rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byad ma'i ming byang gzugs ling 'di la khug: khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: sprul pa'i pho nya lcags sdig nag po dgu: dgra bo 'gugs phyir rwa rnams bco brgyad gzengs: do nub phyed yol tho rangs sdud pa'i tshe: dgra bo'i lus grang nyon mongs 'khrigs pa'i dus: bla rtags khams rnams srid par 'jug pa'i skabs: sprul pa sman 'brong srin mor brdzus nas kyang : rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byad ma bla gzugs liṅga 'di la phob: khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas rol mo drag tu brdung zhing dgra bo'i bla 'gugs rtags ma byung bar 'gugs: 'jam dpal gshin rje 'bar bas dgra bo'i bla khug: des dmigs rkang nges par zin nas:

dgra bo dpung tshan mang nyung gang yin yang khug par the tshom med do: dus drug gshin rje'i pho nya srid pa kun la 'gyu: khyad par nyin mo lcags kyi a tsa ra: gshin rje pho rgyud kyi sprul pa: mtshan mo zangs kyi a tsa ra: gshin rje mo rgyud kyi sprul pa: skabs su 'gyu ba'i pho nya bzhi ni: gshed chen sde bzhi'i sprul pa: khyad par gshin rje'i pho nya 'di me chu go ldog gi tshul du yod pa 'di: pho gshed mo la 'bebs: mo gshed pho la 'bebs: lha pho spyang mo stag mo spyang pho stag pa ni thabs shes ye nas 'du 'bral med pa'i brda ste shin tu phrin las myur: rgyun du dgra bo 'gugs pa'i tshe: pho nya 'gyed pa'i gong 'og gsum yod pa ni: 'gugs thebs gang byas kyang sngags bzlas skabs dang bstun par bya: bya 'ug pa'i sgro gnyis lha dbye'i phyag rgya dang bcas te: hūm̐: kha khā mu kha bya rog gdong : khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di: lha dang phyes shing bdud dang sprod: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: ban bon srung ba'i lha dang phrol: pho lha phrag pa g.yas nas phyes: mo lha phrag pa g.yon nas phyes: skyes lha rten yul mkhar nas phyes: zhang lha gnyan po rgyab nas phyes: ma lha lte ba'i khong nas phyes: srog lha snying gi dkyil nas phyes: rigs lha gsang ba'i gnas nas phyes: srung lha spyi bo'i gtsug nas phyes: bskyab pa'i lha dang da phyes shig: mgon pa'i lha dang da phyes shig: brten pa'i lha dang da phyes shig: yul zhing mkhar dang da phyes shig: pha mtshun rus dang da phyes shig: mthun grogs mdza' dang da phyes shig: skyob byed lha srung ban bon rigs: bya spu rlung gis khyer bzhin gtor: kha khā mu kha mthu ma chung : phyes shig bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ kha khā mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: ru tra mā ra ya shag phyes: rbad dza thun bh+yo dgra bo shag phyes:

lha dang phyes te hu lu mu kha mas bdud dang sprad par bsam: hūm̐: hu lu mu kha 'ug pa'i gdong : khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di: mnyam por 'gro ba'i bdud dang sprod: 'chi bdag bdud dang da sprod cig: srog bdag bdud dang da sprod cig: bar chad bdud dang da sprod cig: ma rungs bdud dang da sprod cig: khyer bde'i bdud dang da sprod cig: las ngan bdud dang da sprod cig: sngon gyi bdud dang da sprod cig: 'phral gyi bdud dang da sprod cig: za ba'i bdud dang da sprod cig: cher ba'i bdud dang da sprod cig: gshin lcags bdud dang da sprod cig: sprod cig dgra bo ma shor dza: shan pa lag dmar lag tu sprod: mon pa pho mo'i lag tu sprod: srog gcod 'bum gyi lag tu sprod: sprod cig hu lu mu kha ma: dus las ma 'da' dam la nyon: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: myur du sprod cig med par mdzod: om̐ hu lu mu kha dun dun pra mo rak+ṣa ya ma kha la dun shig rbad bh+yoḥ zhes dgra bo bdud dang sprad nas myur du bsgral bar bsam: gong gi thun rdeg pa'i skabs su: nyin re lan gsum du thun bskul 'di ltar bya: thog mar drag po'i bskyed rim dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas: hūm̐ e bh+yoḥ snang srid 'byung ba skar ltar 'khrugs: srid pa'i nyi zla cha lang rdeb: gnam sa kun kyang lto ba sbyor: brjid pa'i ri rab mgo mjug ldog: snod kyi rgya mtsho kun kyang skem: rtsi shing nags tshal bun ltar bskyod: las kyi me rlung stobs ldan 'ur: dug gi rlangs pas snang srid brgyal: mtshon gyi char pas skye 'gro gum: phyogs bcu kun kyang gshin rje'i zhing : 'chi bdag gad mo 'brug stong ldir: srog bdag bskal pa'i mun ltar 'khrigs: 'joms byed pho nya glog ltar 'khyugs: gnam lcags dug thun thog ltar 'bebs: zi ra tshwa tshwa khor yug khengs: btab bo dgra bgegs snying la ya: e thun ban+de'i byad ma rbad:
