bh+yo bzlog ban+de'i byad kha zlog: e thun bon po'i byad ma rbad: bh+yo bzlog bon po'i byad kha zlog: e thun mu stegs byad ma rbad: bh+yo bzlog mu stegs byad kha zlog: e thun skye bo'i byad ma rbad: bh+yo bzlog skye bo'i mda' zor zlog: e thun bud med byad ma rbad: bh+yo bzlog bud med byad kha zlog: e thun gshin rjes dmod pa'i mtshon: e thun dam nyams snying la 'debs: e thun dgra bo'i srog la ya: e thun byad ma myur du sgrol: e ya gshin rjes dmod pa'i thun: e ya dmigs pa'i dgra la 'debs: e ya ming shul med par mdzod: e thun bzlog bzlog mā ra ya: e thun dgra bo bhan+dha rbad: e thun dgra bo tshan+dha rbad: e thun dgra bo ma tha rbad: e thun dgra bo da ha rbad: e thun dgra bo ha ra rbad: e thun dgra bo pa tsa rbad: e thun dgra bo shag ti rbad: e thun dgra bo a ri rbad: e thun dgra bo k+sha na rbad: e thun dgra bo tur+ṇa rbad: e thun dgra bo rba wa rbad: e thun dgra bo i daṃ rbad: e thun dgra bo'i tsit+ta rbad: e thun dgra bo nṛ myog rbad: ces thun gyis drag tu brab cing byad ma ming shul med par bsgom: 'di ni dgra chos bar ba'i las so: sa ma ya: de nas dgra bo'i mkhar khang sogs yul thams cad mngon sum bzos pa de la dgra gzugs bskyed bstim bya ba ni: hoḥ rang nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i mdun du 'chi bdag me ltar 'bar zhing chu ltar 'brub pa'i nang du dgra bo chaiga'i mthar mkhar khang zhing pa phyug nor srung skyob dgra bo pho mo'i rigs rgyud dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur: e khaṃ dgra bo nṛ tri dza dzaḥ zhes gong gi bden stobs de lan gsum brjod: gzhung ltar sngags kyi grangs tshang bar bgyis shing thun gyis brdeg: de nas dgra bo brub pa ni: mdun du mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i steng du sla nga nag po lcags kyi snod gri dang bcas pa bya:

de nas shing byang la dgra ling dug shog gi liṅga thams cad cha gcig tu hom̐ du bzhag: phyi rol mtshon cha dang mi kha brub pa'i rdzas kyis bskor: gong bzhin bskyed chog dang 'gugs gzhug cha tshang la thun bcas thogs nas: mdun du gri bo gsum mam skyes pa stag lo pa gsum hom̐ khung gi tshul du sdod: de'ang sdod pa'i gdan nag po bya: de'i dbus su g.yag ru la zhags nag gi thag pa btags: g.yas su brdung ba'i tho ba dang gtun: g.yon du 'thag pa'i 'khor lo: mdun du khrag grod kha thag pas bsdams pa dang bsad pa'i ral gri bri: khrag grod kyi g.yas su skyes pa'i chas ka: g.yon du bud med kyi chas ka: liṅga g.yas su gril: g.yon du rnga ma dmar nag: bla srog rten la mda' g.yas: bla 'bod g.yon du bzhag par gces: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na: mi bzad khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: 'khor 'das kun la che btsan 'gran zla bral: snying rje bzhed pas skye 'gro'i srog bdag tshul: so so'i snang ngor sprul pa'i rtsal 'gyed phyir: srid pa yongs kyi 'chi bdag dug gi gdong : me 'bar chen po snang srid 'joms byed pa: deng 'dir dgra bo brub phyir gnas 'dir bzhengs: lho phyogs bdag po khyod kyi dus la bab: gshed chen sde bzhi 'chi bdag 'bum gyis bskor: pho nya zangs lcags a tsar mon pa'i tshogs: ru tra bye ba sprul pa 'bum sde rnams: dmod las dus las ma 'da' da bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gshin rje dug mda' bzlog med dgra la brub: ma g.yel skur bzhengs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de nas lag len gzhung tshig dang bstun: dzaḥ srid gsum khams 'di drag po e yi zhing : snang srid thams cad dug gi rlangs pa 'khrigs: snod bcud thams cad gshin rje pho mo 'tshubs: sgra grags thams cad 'chi bdag gad mo ldir: 'gyu ba'i yid snang skye 'gro'i srog la rngam:

tshogs drug gang shar dug lnga chu ltar khol: dmod dang las kun mngon spyod rig sngags brtsam: de 'dra srid pa gling khams bdag po'i tshogs: gnad nas bskul lo dgra la dal kha phob: e bh+yo bh+yoḥ snang srid snod kyi dgra bo brub pa'i khung : lcags khang nag po mun pa dgu rim can: shor med gshin rje'i btson khang nang du brub: brubs shig dgra bo mi nor 'khor bcas brub: dgra bo srung skyob thams cad da brubs shig: dzaḥ gshin rje'i mtshon gyis stabs pa'i zhe sdang snod: byang g.yag nag po kham pa ru ring la: gzir 'debs dug mda' nag pos snying la brgyab: mtshon 'khrugs dgra dang gri sri thog ma ste: de yang gshin rjes dmod pa'i rdzas su gyur: bsad pa'i sha khrag gshin rje dgyes pa'i phud: snying dang rwa co dgra bo brub pa'i snod: rwa co g.yas pa gnam lcags hom yangs su: de ring dgra bo brub pa'i snod du bshams: nang du dgra bo mi nor brubs nas kyang : dmyal srung gshin rje'i zhags pa nag pos bsdam: srog gcod shan pa rnams kyis da zungs shig: dzaḥ gshin rje'i tho ba gnam lcags dug gi ri: mkha' la phyar bas steng phyogs lha srin brgyal: bar du phab pas bar snang skye 'gro 'joms: gtun du dgra la thog ltar 'bebs pa'i tshe: byad ma mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas bshig: dzaḥ gshin rje'i gtun khung srid pa'i brub khung snod: zangs dang khro chu dmar po'i zhun la grub: mthong nas mi bzod dug rlangs rim dgu 'khrigs: de yi nang du dgra bo byad ma yi: pho rgyud mo rgyud mi rabs da brubs shig: rdungs shig phye mar rdul phran bzhin du rlog: e thun bh+yo bzlog byad ma nṛ tri zlog: dzaḥ gshin rje'i 'khor lo steng gi spu gri ni: me las grub pa lcags bsregs rang bzhin ltar: g.yas bskor dgra bo'i pho rgyud rtsad nas chod: gshin rje 'khor lo 'og gi spu gri ni: rlung las grub pa dug gi sog le ltar:

g.yon bskor dgra bo'i mo rgyud rtsad nas chod: gshin rjes dmod pa'i mtshon cha 'khor lo ni: bar med 'khor bas dgra bo'i rigs rgyud gtub: gshin rjes 'thab pa'i 'khor lo da skor la: byad ma'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: e thun bh+yo bzlog byad ma nṛ tri zlog: dzaḥ gshin rje'i thun snod srid pa'i grod pa ru: smyo 'bog nag po nad rlangs sprin ltar gtibs: reg pa tsam gyis dran med brgyal ba'i nang : dam nyams dgra bo mi nor 'khor bcas brub: rlugs shig brubs shig smyo 'bog khrag tu bskyil: dmyal srung gshin rje nag pos zhags pas sdoms: gsod byed shan pa spu gri thogs pas zungs: rdungs shig rdegs shig dgra bo da sdoms shig: lan gsum dkrugs shing dgra bo da sdoms shig: e thun bh+yo bzlog byad ma nṛ tri zlog: dzaḥ gshin rje'i pho nya dgra la 'gyed pa'i phyir: byad ma bla 'bod gri rkang tse re re: bos shing dkrugs te g.yag ru nang du brub: dgra bo'i pho rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: bdud kyi rnga ma nag po g.yab pa'i tshe: dgra bo'i pho rgyud g.yag ru nang du brub: dgra bo'i mo rgyud mngal nas skam pa'i phyir: btsan gyi rnga ma dmar po g.yab pa yis: dgra bo'i mo rgyud g.yag ru nang du brub: dgra bo'i rigs dang bdun rgyud gcod pa'i phyir: byad ma'i srog gi mda' mo bcag cing gtub: de yang g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: dgra bo'i pho lha srog gi rten mkhar ni: lcags kyi byang bu gzugs ling dkar po ste: de yang g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: dgra bo'i ma lha srog gi rten mkhar ni: zangs kyi gzugs ling byang bu dmar po ste: de yang g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: dzaḥ gshin rje pho rgyud dmod pa'i mda': dgra bo skyes pa'i bla rdel dgu: de yang g.yag ru nang du brub: gshin rje mo rgyud dmod pa yi: dgra bo bud med bla rdel dgu:

de yang g.yag ru nang du brub: dzaḥ gshin rjes dmod pa'i mngon spyod mthu: de ring dam nyams dgra la 'bebs: dgra bo'i yul zhing bcom pa'i phyir: dgra mkhar mgo mjug ldog nas brub: de yang g.yag ru nang du brub: dgra bo'i pho rgyud bcom pa'i phyir: mtshon cha mda' gzhu phye mar rdung : dgra gzugs pho rgyud g.yag rur brub: dgra bo'i mo rgyud bcom pa'i phyir: 'phang zhud dbal mtshon phye mar rdung : dgra gzugs mo rgyud g.yag rur brub: dzaḥ dgra la ltas ngan 'bebs pa yi: gshin rjes dmod pa'i brub rdzas dgu: g.yer ma dgra kha phye ba'i ltas: de yang gnam lcags tho bas rdung : lo yi dgra sgo bye ba rnams: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: sgo nga dgra mkhar brtsegs pa'i ltas: de yang gnam lcags tho bas rdung : zla ba'i dgra sgo bye ba rnams: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: sgog pa dgra dmag chas pa'i chas: de yang gnam lcags tho bas rdung : zhag gi dgra sgo bye ba rnams: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: tshwa ni mtshon cha 'khrug pa'i ltas: de yang gnam lcags tho bas rdung : dus kyi dgra sgo bye ba rnams: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: ram pa phung sri lang ba'i ltas: de yang gnam lcags tho bas rdung : za ma'i dgra sgo bye ba rnams: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: sre long yul gru 'khrugs pa'i ltas: de yang gnam lcags tho bas rdung : yul gyi dgra sgo bye ba rnams: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: bra bo mi kha gling gzhi'i ltas: de yang gnam lcags tho bas rdung : grong la dgra sgo bye ba rnams: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: thal ba nad mug 'byung ba'i ltas: de yang gnam lcags tho bas rdung : khyim gyi dgra sgo bye ba rnams: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: mda' chag gzhu chag nang 'khrugs ltas: de yang gnam lcags tho bas rdung : phyogs dang dus kyi dgra sgo rnams: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: dzaḥ snga dgra thams cad da brubs shig:

phyi dgra thams cad da brubs shig: 'phral gyi dgra rnams da brubs shig: dgra bo'i dmag dpon da brubs shig: dgra bo'i dmag mi da brubs shig: dgra bo'i spun tshan da brubs shig: dgra bo'i yul zhing da brubs shig: dgra bo'i mkhar zhing da brubs shig: dgra sgo nor dang da brubs shig: brubs shig g.yag ru nang du brub: mnan no mchod rten nag pos mnan: nam yang dgra bo ma ldang zhig: e ka ya ma du tri tsa na sarba ru tra nṛ tri bh+yo bzlog nan: zhes gong gi tshig la gang 'dug pa'i phyag len zhib tu bya: 'di yan nyin re bzhin rgyun 'don bya: g.yag ru dang bsgral ling sngar ltar rtsang ra nang du bzhag: dgra mnan ma ran gyi bar rdzas thams cad brda tsam ma gtogs pa bcag dkrugs mi bya: sa ma ya: de nas sgrub pa mthar phyin gyis: sngags bzlas thams cad 'grub pa'i tshe: bsad ling phur bus bsgral ba ni: gong gi bsad sngags de yi mthar: thams cad tshigs bcad 'di ltar bskul: e ya bh+yo dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya ba: srog bdag ya ma rā dza'i sku: zhal gsum phyag drug gnam lcags dbal: zur gsum dug gi me dpung 'bar: rtse mo las kyi mtshon char 'bebs: byad ma dam nyams sdig can gyi: bla srog rnam shes bshig pa'i phyir: dkar nag gnyis la kī la ya: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa a kro rā dza ya ma rā dza sa ma ya dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad nṛ tri trig nan e hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces pas bsgral te dgra bo'i dbang po thams cad la khyab par phur bu 'bebs: de nas ling ro bsreg gam zor sna ru bzhag kyang rung : sreg pa ltar na drag po hom du bsregs la: e ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las e mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las bskal pa'i me smug nag tsha zhing rtsub pa'i ngar dang ldan pa de'i dbus su:

gshin rje be wa swa ta kham nag dug gi gdong pa can g.yas ral gri g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o: gcer bu srin po'i cha byad can dgra bo'i srog la dbang zhing 'chi bdag kha gdangs pa de'i zhal du byad ma lha srung mi nor thams cad bstabs pas bzhes te lhag ma med par mdzod cig: om̐ ya ma rā dza a kro te ka be wa swa ta ya: dgra bgegs kyi gzugs phung rnam shes dang bcas pa la kha kha khā hi ram̐ a hu ti dz+wa la ram̐ i daṃ du khā hi: om̐ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka dgra bo byad ma mā ra ya ram̐: zhes pas bsregs te thal ba cha gsum bya: cha gcig lam rgya gram du sba: cha gcig chu la gtab: cha gcig rlung la phyar: de nas sgo ru dgra chos bya ba ni: gang 'khod pa'i sa gzhi ru: sa la 'khod pa'i hom khung bya: yang na ri mo bris: de'i shar du gri hom: lho ru chu hom: nub tu me hom: byang du shing hom bya: dbus kyi hom yang de'i nang sngar gyi liṅga chas thams cad de ru skya: hom nang ma zhig khar phur pas mnan: liṅga bsad sngags bzlas shing thebs par btsugs: kha thams cad la chas bcad de re bas gtum: sgo them la mnan na phyi rol dgra chos la ma 'gro bar mtshams su mnan: phyi rol du mnan na thams cad mnyam par khyer: dgra chos thon pa dang mnan dmigs su dmigs rim bskyal te mnan: de nas phyi rol dgra chos byed pa ni: sngags pa zhwa nag gos nag gis brgyan pa dmod pa byed pa dgu: btsun pa dam ldan sher snying 'don pa dgu: bon po nag po rnga gshang thogs pa dgu: skyes pa mi nag mtshon cha thogs pa dgu: bud med yugs sa thal sle thogs pa dgu: g.yab pa'i dar nag po dgu: mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa gang mang gis tshig mtshams dang bstun pa'i dgra bo brab pa'i bswo sgra bya: thog mar nang nas dgra chos thams cad thogs te 'jam dpal gshin rje'i nga rgyal gyis:

hūm̐ e ya bh+yoḥ snang srid khyon ltar khor yug gshin rje'i zhing : snod gzugs gshin rje khro bo khro mo'i sku: sgra rnams kun kyang gshin rje'i drag sngags ldir: 'gyu ba kun kyang srog bdag spu gri 'phro: ris med srid par bsnyegs pa'i lcags mkhar nas: yab cig zla gsang thig le skur bzhengs shig: yum cig gshor sang nyi ma skur bzhengs shig: 'chi bdag nag po dug gdong skur bzhengs shig: tshe bdag nag po 'bar ba skur bzhengs shig: srog bdag nag po khro chu skur bzhengs shig: drag byed 'bar ba dgra nag skur bzhengs shig: 'joms byed nag po ki kang skur bzhengs shig: brlag byed khro mo rigs lnga skur bzhengs shig: gsod byed pho nya yang sprul skur bzhengs shig: dug mtsho dmar nag 'khrigs pa'i dbus nas bzhengs: pha rol dgra dpung 'joms phyir thugs dam bskul: byad ma cham la 'bebs pa'i mtshon cha gzengs: 'chi bdag dmag dpung char sprin bun ltar gtibs: pho nya las mkhan srog bdag rlung ltar 'tshubs: las la chas phyir shan pa me ltar 'bar: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dmag dpung mthu bo che: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir mngon spyod phrin las dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dmag tshogs cham la phob: bskul lo rbad do g.yab bo rgyang ma ring : thugs dam sngon gyi bka' rtags tha tshig bzhin: deng 'dir drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ya ma rā dza kro ta ha la mu kha ka la ya i daṃ du sarba bha ling+ta khā hi: zhes pas gtor ma dgra phyogs sam: mngon spyod kyi phyogs su bskyal: de nas phyi rol du sleb pa dang : liṅga dgra mkhar bkram la 'gugs gzhug tshar gcig btang thun gyis brab: de nas byang ling bsgral ba la 'jug pa ni: thog mar mchod g.yog pas g.yag ru 'dogs pa'i zhags pa de gral gong du gang 'dug pa de la gtad: de nas skyes pa dgu'i rkang pa g.yon pa'i 'og tu drangs te sngar gyi las byed pa gsum la gtad:

stag lo pa gsum la zer rgyu red/ mchan/ hūm̐ e ya dzaḥ 'chi bdag 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: sprul pa'i gshin rje za byed gdong : khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: dgra kha mtshon kha brub pa'i phyir: gri rgod g.yag ru nag por brubs: dgra bo mi nor dgug pa'i phyir: byad kyi zhags pa nag po sdogs: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan chings: dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i pho rgyud byad du chug: steng nas gnam lcags tho ba yis: 'og gi gtun du byad ma rdungs: dgra bo'i dmag dpon da sgrol cig: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brubs: dgra bo'i dmag mi da sgrol cig: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brubs: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud da sgrol cig: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brubs: rlog cig dgra bo'i pho rgyud brubs: dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i dus la bab: dgra bo mo'i rgyud byad du chug: steng na gnam lcags tho ba yis: 'og gi gtun du byad ma rdungs: dgra bo'i ma lha da sgrol cig: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brubs: dgra bo'i chung ma da sgrol cig: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brubs: dgra bo'i chung rgyud da sgrol cig: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brubs: brubs shig dgra bo mo rgyud brubs: dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i dmod pa'i las: dgra bo'i pho rgyud brlag pa'i phyir: bla yi rde'u nag po dgu: byad du bcug nas da rdungs shig: brub bo dgra bo'i pho rgyud brubs: dgra bo'i mo rgyud brlag pa'i phyir: bla yi rde'u dkar po dgu: byad du bcug nas da rdungs shig: brub bo dgra bo'i mo rgyud brubs: dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i dmod pa'i las: dgra bo'i bla rtags 'phrog pa'i phyir: pho byang zhe sdang lcags las grub: byad du bcug nas da rdungs shig: brub bo g.yag ru nang du brubs: mo byang 'dod chags zangs las grub: byad du bcug nas da rdungs shig: brub bo g.yag ru nang du brubs: dzaḥ

gshin rje 'bar ba'i dmod pa'i las: dgra bo'i go cha 'phrog pa'i phyir: byad ma'i ral gri mda' mdung rnams: byad du bcug nas da rdungs shig: brub bo g.yag ru+u nang du brubs: dgra bo'i chung ma phral ba'i phyir: byad ma 'phang zhud mo yi chas: byad du bcug nas da rdungs shig: g.yag ru nag po'i nang du brub: dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba dmod pa'i las: mtshan ngan dgra la brab pa'i phyir: g.yer ma dgra kha phye ba yis: mi rung ltas ngan sna tshogs de: brdungs nas dgra la da brobs shig: brub bo g.yag ru nang du brubs: sgo nga dgra mkhar brtsegs pa yi: mi rung ltas ngan sna tshogs de: brdungs nas dgra la da brobs shig: brub bo g.yag ru+u nang du brubs: sgog pa dgra dmag chas pa yi: mi rung ltas ngan sna tshogs de: brdungs nas dgra la da brobs shig: brub bo g.yag ru+u nang du brubs: tshwa ni mtshon cha 'khrugs pa yi: mi rung ltas ngan sna tshogs de: brdungs nas dgra la da brobs shig: brub bo g.yag ru nang du brubs: ram pa phung sri lang ba yi: mi rung ltas ngan sna tshogs de: brdungs nas dgra la da brobs shig: brub bo g.yag ru nang du brubs: sre long yul gru 'khrugs pa'i ltas: mi rung ltas ngan sna tshogs de: brdungs nas dgra la da brobs shig: brub bo g.yag ru+u nang du brubs: bra bo mi kha gling bzhi yi: mi rung ltas ngan sna tshogs de: brdungs nas dgra la da brobs shig: brub bo g.yag ru nang du brubs: thal ba nad mug 'byung ba yi: mi rung ltas ngan sna tshogs de: brdungs nas dgra la da brobs shig: brub bo g.yag ru nang du brubs: mda' chag gzhu chag dmag 'khrugs kyi: mi rung ltas ngan sna tshogs te: brdungs nas dgra la da brobs shig: brub bo g.yag ru nang du brubs: zhes liṅga dang mi kha'i rdzas thams cad brdungs shing : thams cad g.yag ru nang dus gcig tu brub: de nas shin tu phye mar 'thag ste liṅga bzo: mnan pa mi bya na g.yag ru nang du bcug la 'gugs gzhug lan gcig bya la:

mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis brdeg: da ni dgra bo 'thag pa ni: dzaḥ gshin rje'i pho nya gling bzhi 'gyu ba'i tshogs: skar ltar 'khrugs pa khyod kyi dus la bab: deng 'dir dgra bo byad ma sdig can gyi: phung khams skye mched gnam lcags 'khor los gtubs: mi rung sna dgu rdzas dang bsres nas kyang : dgra bo byad ma smyo 'bog snying gzer 'khrugs: dug sna dgu yi brgyal zhing rengs nas kyang : dgra bo byad ma rjes shul med par mdzod: raṃ ha la ya bi shwa tsakra ru tra mā ra ya tshin+dha tshin+dha mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas gong gi yig chung ltar bya: de nas khrag gi grod pa la mtshon gyis brdeg pa ni: dzaḥ 'chi bdag me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: las kyi shan pa za byed me yi gdong : srog bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum las la bskul: rno dbal spu gri'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: phyung rdeg dgra la 'bebs pa'i dus la bab: byad ma dgra bo'i bla snod grod pa ru: dgra bo'i ming byang snying khrag bskyil ba 'di: de ring gnam lcags mtshon chas gtub pa 'dis: dgra bo'i yul zhing khrag mtsho dmar pos khongs: dmag 'khrugs mtshon cha'i bskal pa dgra la brobs: dgra bo bdun rgyud dmyal thag da chod cig: gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya mi bzad tshogs: de ring dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can gyi: bla snod khrag gi grod pa da rdol cig: bla thag ring cha dkar dmar da chod cig: byad ma dgra bo'i snying khrag da bzhes shig: mngon spyod mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: ram̐ khaḍ+ga ha la ya dz+wa la ya dgra bo'i srog snying la rbad rbad chod chod gtub bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces grod pa khrag brdol dgra bo'i bla thag bcad: dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i dus la bab: nyams pa'i dgra bo dam nyams sdig can gyi: bla srog rnam shes don snying phral ba'i phyir: dgra bo'i srog gi mda' mo da chog cig: mon pa nag po lcags kyi a tsa ra: dgra bo brub pa'i rnga nag da g.yobs shig:

shan pa mi reng zangs kyi a tsa ra: brlag pa'i rnga ma dmar po da g.yobs shig: khram thogs nag po gshin rje'i las byed rnams: gri rgod lag pas dgra bo da g.yobs shig: dgra mkhar nag po byad ma'i yul zhing la: gnam lcags mtshon gyi char pa da phob cig: srid pa'i ri rab sbyor gto da non cig: me chu rlung gsum sbyor bas da brobs shig: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog byad ma thal bar rlog: dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i dus la bab: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra la thun char phob: dmod pa las grub drag po dbal gyi thun: rbab rdo rud rdo thog rdo sha ra ra: dur rdo phung rdo ro dud chi li li: yungs dkar yungs nag ser ba khra la la: ke tshe shang tshe spu gri tshubs se tshub: dug khrag thang phrom na bun thu lu lu: me thun khrag thun 'tshub ma 'u ru ru: zangs thun lcags thun tshwa tshwa spungs se spung : mtshon thun drag po skar ltar 'khrugs se 'khrug: de ring gshin rje las kyi thun rdzas kyis: dam nyams dgra la thog ltar myur du phob: phye mar brlags shing dgra bor da brobs shig: thun bh+yo raṃ bh+yo rbad bh+yo mā ra ya: de nas 'byung ba go ldog ni: dzaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i dus la bab: de ring phyogs bcu'i dgra bo sgrol bar mdzod: shar phyogs shing khams dgra bo byad ma rnams: gnam lcags spu gri ngar mas da chod cig: lho phyogs me khams dgra bo byad ma rnams: dug chu khol ma'i rlabs kyis da bshal cig: nub phyogs lcags khams dgra bo byad ma rnams: bskal pa'i me yis gzhom zhing da shig cig: byang phyogs chu khams dgra bo byad ma rnams: drag po shing gis brlags nas da skoms shig: mtshams bzhi sa khams dgra bo byad ma rnams: ri rab mchod rten 'bar bas da non cig: de nas shog bu'i liṅga drag po sbyin sreg bya ba ni: bskyed chog gong ltar byas nas dbus kyi hom̐ du bsreg: g.yag ru mnan na liṅga zor sna ru bzhag:

g.yag rur mi mnan na'ang liṅga zor sna ru bzhag: de nas las kyi mtshon zor 'bebs pa ni: dzaḥ dbyings nas skur bzhengs drag po'i mngon spyod mdzod: dmod pa'i las byed sngags pa nag po dgu: dam nyams dgra la thun zor char ltar phob: nyan thos byang sems dge slong dgra bcom dgu: dam nyams dgra la bden pa'i bzlog zor ya: bon po gshang thogs bswo sgra sgrog pa dgu: dam nyams dgra la mu stegs dug mda' phob: skyes pa spu gri'i mtshon cha thogs pa dgu: dam nyams dgra la dbal kha char ltar phob: bud med nag mo thal sle thogs pa dgu: mya ngan dmod tshig rkyen chag dgra la phob: lo skag zla skag zhag skag dgra la phob: dus skag nad skag mtshon skag dgra la phob: rma ngo khrag ngo thams cad dgra la phob: mi shi rta chag thams cad dgra la phob: mda' chag gzhu chag kha smra dgra la phob: g.yul 'khrugs mtshon gyi bskal pa dgra la phob: brub bo gling bzhi'i dgra bo da brubs shig: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog byad ma nṛ tri zlog: de nas zor bzlog la: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ mthing nag rab 'jigs me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus: gnam lcags 'phro ba'i thod mkhar pho brang nas: 'jigs byed khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: mngon spyod mthu rtsal thugs dam dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dgra la zor mda' ya: tshe bdag chen po'i thugs dam dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dmag dpon sgrol bar gyis: dgra nag 'bar ba'i thugs dam dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dmag mi dgra bo gtor: khro chu dug gdong thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i go mtshon phye mar thong : ki kang spu gri'i thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bo'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: sha za rigs lnga'i thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bo'i rten mkhar yul zhing phyags mas thob: pha rol ban+de dgra bo byad ma rnams: lcags kyi a tsar nag pos sgrol bar gyis:

pha rol bon po dgra bo byad ma rnams: zangs kyi a tsar dmar pos sgrol bar gyis: pha rol mi nag dgra bo byad ma rnams: dug gi phag rgod nag pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo'i bud med byad ma rnams: bswe yi sbal pa dmar pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo'i chung rgyud byad ma rnams: gdug pa'i dug sbrul nag pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo'i sgo nor zhing phyugs rnams: lcags kyi sdig rgod 'bar bas za bar gyis: dam nyams dgra bo byad ma lha srung rnams: 'joms byed gshin rje'i tshogs kyis sgrol bar mdzod: ma rungs bdud kyi sde dpung cham la phob: dmigs pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs shor ra re: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa ti kā la rū pa a kro rā dza ya ma rā dza sa ma ye hūm̐ hūm̐ byad ma nṛ tri trig nan bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces pas zor 'phang : dgra bo'i ming shul yang med par bya: sa ma ya: de nas mnan pa bya ba ni: dus nag 'gyu ba mar 'grib tshe: sde brgyad dam ni gshin rje la: dgra bo gtad pa'i man ngag ni: lo gza' gdong thug mi bya zhing : dus gza' 'gyu phyogs dag dang bstun: brtan ma sa bdag de yi don: gang zhig dgra bo'i lo rtags dang : spar sme 'byung khams shes pa na: bdud nyid dgra gshed sprad ste sba: lo shing la sogs ma shes na: phung zor nag po'i skabs su sba: dang po sba bar chas pa'i tshe: bsad bcad gtub sogs mthong ba dang : na 'chi rkyen sogs zer ba dang : ma he ba glang 'phrad pa dang : rlung g.yo kha char mun rub gtibs: ri 'gyel rgyud chad shing chen 'gyel: de sogs 'phrad na dgra bo 'chi: dgra bo dpung tshan che ba yi: dmag dpon sogs la sba ba na: gangs ri spang ri rdza ri la: rtse mor nags sogs 'dug pas na: mgo chad mdun phog ri yin pas: de yi 'og na dgra bo mnan:

dgra bo dpung tshan chung ba dang : yul mi la sogs dgra yi rigs: mi nag mtshon cha brab 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: phung sri langs dang nang 'khrugs la: gnam lcags mchod rten brtsegs 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: gri sri gzhon sri langs pa na: chos 'byung dgu brtsegs bsnol 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: chung sri bud med sri yin na: btsun mo brang rgyan btags 'dra'i ri: mdun sham 'og tu dgra bo mnan: sgo nor phyugs kyi sri yin na: sprel dkar bya ra btab 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: yul dang zhing gi sri yin na: seṅge gnam du mchong 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: kha mchu mi kha'i sri yin na: bya nag sha la rngam 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: dam pa chos kyi sri yin na: glegs bam po ti bshibs 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: chos sgrub bar chod sri yin na: bla ma khri khar bzhugs 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: phyogs zas mtho non sri yin na: rgyal pos la thod bsdams 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: de bzhin sa rtags nyung ngu ste: 'gag 'dug tsam du tshigs su bcad: rgyas pa spyi rgyud dag la bstun: da ni mnan pa'i sa mig ste: brag ri yang ngam phug pa'am: spang thig mdangs 'dra byung bar gnad: shing nag stug po'i mthongs skar ni: gzhan dang mi 'dra rtags de gnad: shing med yul gyi shing gcig dang : rdo med yul gyi rdo gcig gnad: thang gyi 'bur dang 'bur gyi gshong : grong gi phyogs dang phyogs kyi grangs: ri sna zad pa'i mtshams su gnad: lung 'dus chu 'dus zur 'dus gnad: de dag rnams su sba bar bya: sa ma ya: sba ba'i bskyed chog bstan par bya: thog mar sba ba'i sa mig tu gzhi bdag dkar gtor 'bul bar bya: de nas gnam lcags satwa re thogs: 'don bsgom sbrags mar 'di ltar bya:

hūm̐: bdag ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: deng 'dir drag po'i las byed phyir: phyag g.yas gnam lcags satwa re thogs: g.yon pas me yi zhags pa 'dzin: g.yas kyi gnam lcags satwa re de: srid gsum nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar: thog ltar sa la phog pa'i tshe: ri rab gling bzhi phyed du gas: 'og tu rgya mtsho mer gyis gsal: de nang gshin rje ma lus kun: gnas pas 'gro dbang med pa yi: mtha' rnams me yi zhags pas bskor: 'chi bdag pho brang mngon sum gsal: de nas gtad pa ni: dzaḥ gshin rje'i pho brang srog bdag gnas mchog nas: srid pa srog gi bdag po mthu bo che: srid pa'i 'khor lo 'jigs byed ma he'i gdong : gshin rje a wa glang mgo da bzhengs shig: za byed 'chi bdag 'bar ba'i kha gdongs la: de ring pha rol dgra bgegs byad ma yi: dmag dpon dmag mi mkhar khang yul zhing bcas: gshin rje a wa glang mgo'i zhal du bstab: dgra bo'i pho rgyud thams cad zhal du bstab: dgra bo'i mo rgyud thams cad zhal du bstab: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud thams cad zhal du bstab: dgra bo'i gnyen 'brel thams cad zhal du bstab: dgra bo'i phyugs zhing sgo nor zhal du bstab: brubs shig 'chi bdag gshin rje'i kha ru brub: btab bo gtad do nam yang ma shor cig: srid pa spu gri 'khor los rgyas thob la: snod kyi 'jig rten ma stongs bar du rgya: steng nas srid pa'i ri rab las grub pa'i: gnam lcags mchod rten rtsibs stong 'bar bas non: rgyas btab mnan no nam yang ma ldang cig: hūm̐ nan: ya nan: e nan: saṃ nan: khaṃ nan: raṃ nan: yaṃ nan: mā ra ya nan nan: de'i steng du hom khung sum brtsegs bya: hom khung steng du sāts+tsha rnams kyis mnan: de'i dkyil du stag shing gi phur bu 'dzugs: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje las kyi dmod pa'i mtshon: srid pa'i ri rab las grub dug phur 'di: ma rungs dam sri 'byung po mnan phyir gdab: nam yang ru tra ldang bar ma gyur cig:

om̐ ya ma rā dza kī li kī la ya i daṃ ha la khaḍ+ga ya sarba duṣ+ṭan nan laṃ bha ya nan: satwaṃ bha nan: mo ha ya nan: ya ma ye nan: ma ru tri ba ru ṇa ya tsakra ya nan nan: zhes pas dgra bo byad ma thams cad 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje la gtad de rgyas btab pas nam yang mi shor bar bsgom: gong gi bsad ling mnan ling gnyis ka mnan kyang bskyed chog gzhung gang rung gis bya: brub thod gang rnyed kyang byed lugs 'dra: de'ang mnan thod gyi rnam bshad phran bu ni: dgra bo yul gru mi mthun pa yin na: dgra bo'i yul gru gang zhig thod par mnan: dgra bo'i dmag dpon dred mong gi thod par mnan: dmag mi rnams dom gyi thod par mnan: yul mkhar dang nor rdzas rnams spre'u'i thod par mnan: khyad par gang rung gi dgra dang sri mnan yin na: dgra bo'i che rgyud dang rgan sri dom mgo'i nang du mnan: dgra bo chung rgyud mo sri rnams phag mgo'i nang du mnan: dgra sgo bye ba gnam sgo bye ba rnams khyi mgo'i nang du mnan: sa sgo bye ba dur sgo bye ba rnams lug mgo'i nang du mnan: gzhon sri dang dbul sri rnams spyang ki'i thod par gnon: chung sri dang the'u rang rnams sre mong gi mgor mnan: god sri dang nad sri langs pa rnams bya rog gi mgor mnan: mi kha dang kha mchu langs pa rnams ba yi mgor mnan: nad yams dang zhing khang gi sri rnams bong bu'i mgor mnan: khyim du 'dre chag 'gong po'i sri zhugs na ri bong gi mgor mnan: rgyal bsen dang 'byung po rgyun du za kha zug na khwa ta'i mgor mnan: sun kha gshed kha sdang na 'ug pa'i mgor mnan: sgrub la phyi nang bar du gcod par byung na ra mgor mnan: pha rol gyis byad zor dang dmod pa rgyun du zug na lcung ka dang bya rog dur bya rnams kyi mgor liṅga bzhag cing mi mgo'i nang du bcug ste mnan: de rnams kyi mgo dang bsgrub pa'i rdzas sngags 'dzoms na gshin rjes dmod pa'i dug mda' yin pas thogs med 'byung ngo :

khyad par las gzhung gi sngags sna kha bsgyur bgyi na gang la yang byed chog par nges so: 'di dag sgrub pa'i don dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku don ma yin par bya mi rung zhing : 'di nyid rgyun du bsgrubs te grong nag phal pa'i mdun gros bgyis na skye ba 'di 'phos nas gshin rje mi bzad pa'i yi dwags kyi rgyal po'i lag tu spu gri thogs pa phan sems bral ba'i gdug rtsub can gyi lus bag chags kyi gdug 'drer skye bar 'gyur ro: des na gshin rje'i las rgyun du mi bya: khyad par gong gi sgrub pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar las sbyor gar thod bya mi rung : spyir gshin rje las rgyud mang du yod kyang 'di nyid spu gri gsal shing 'khor lo'i rgyud yin pas shin tu bka' gnyan pa yin: de bas dus mtha' ban sngags dug sbrul 'dra ba'i rigs phyi spyod 'jam zhing zhe nag rtsub pa khong nas dug lnga'i rlangs pa reg phung gyi ngad ldan pa gang nye ba'i phyogs su gtor zhing : ring ba rnams la yang la yog ltar sgug ste mtshams sbyor mi mthun pa byed cing khong srin lcags kyi mdud pa dam pos bsgrogs shing snying rje phan sems chung ba rnams la 'di nyid shin tu gsang dam por gsang : sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma zab snying zla gsang 'o ma'i thigs pa 'di: shel gyi snod du lang long gzhil bsrubs nas: dwangs ma'i bcud du smin pa'i ngar bzang pos: pha rol dmod pa'i tshogs las phyung brdeg cing : dmar 'od mdangs ldan phyug pa'i yun ldang zhing : lho phyogs bdag pos rlung zhags 'gengs pa 'di: byad zor rgol ba'i rtsam zhing snyog ma byos: ha la mu kha bi shwa tsakra rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: rab brtan zhes pa glang gi lo hor zla bdun pa'i tshes la 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gnas khrom gzigs gsang sngags pho brang nas ma hā a shwa ra bhṛ ku tri badz+ras gdan drangs shing rnam mkhyen thar pa bde chen gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so//

// tsha) dpal chen 'jigs byed rngam pa las: dgra bo klu la gtad pa nyi ma'i 'khor lo bzhugs so// dpal 'jigs byed rngam pa la phyag 'tshal lo: dgra bo klu la gtad pa ni: gza' gtad nyi ma'i 'khor lo 'di: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : rnal 'byor srog la 'tshe ba'i dgra: blo bur dag la dgra byung na: tsakra la sogs gsang ba'i las 'di bya: de nyid gsang ba ldog med las: bsnyen sgrub dag la rag ma las: dus tshes bzang ngan rtsis gdab med: sa tshad dag la 'jal mi dgos: ldog mi gong dang 'jam mi gtong : klu gnyan gnas sar gtad pa yin: rang la nyes med theb pa yin: bsko ba'i sa la gting tshad med: chod dmigs gnyan sa gcig tu bsgyur bas chog: de'ang 'di bri ba'i gzhi dang rdzas dang bri ba'i rgyu dang bsgom pa'i lha dang bzhi ste: dri ma mi sang ba'i gro shog bya'o: snag tsha ni gri khrag mdze khrag rme khrag du ma las bya'o: bsgom pa'i lha ni gsum yin te: rta mgrin phyag rdor rdo rje khyung : yang na klu bdud nag po bsgom: rang nyid klu khyung nag por bskyed: dgra bo lo dus 'gyang mi srid: sbal pa nag po'i lte bar mu khyud gsum gyis bskor: dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar la byugs: lte bar liṅga ming rus bris la: gang yin de'i dri ma dang khang zhing la sogs tsakra'i mu khyud gtums: khyad par dgra ling khrag gis bris: dug chu dang mdze khrag gis byugs: dus ni nam phyed nyin phyed la gtad: dgra bo'i ming rus ma shes na: gnad kyi man ngag 'di yin no: gnod byed a mu ka nan: ces liṅga'i sbrul gseb kun tu bris: khyi'i khar zan bskyel ba dang 'dra bas: dgra ni byung ba'i dus la 'di bya'o: tsakra dpe'u chung ltar bris la: the tshom med par gnyan sar gtad par bya'o: liṅga bri rdzas la: gri khrag rme khrag la sogs khrag sna rnyed tshad kyis bya'o: khyad par khyi nag rta nag ra bong bu la sogs khrag sna dug sna'i tshogs rnyed tshad kyis bri dgos:

sa bon rnam gsum zhing rgyus kyis mdzer bar bya'o: de'ang khroṃ phu nṛ gsum gri rgyus kyis mdzer bar bya'o: ma rnyed na yugs sa ma'i skra shad kyis mdzer bar bya'o: klu khyung gi bar du liṅga bcug ste de ltar bya'o: de nas rang nyid phyag rdor rta mgrin khyung gang rung bskyed: mdun du dgra bo bskyed: klu khyung gi 'khor lor klu khyung gnyis bskyed: de nas klu gnas la nges par liṅga gtad mnan sogs spu gri ngar ma dang 'dra'o: khyung gi lte bar khroṃ bris: de'i phyi rim mu khyud la: dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba'i ming rus bla dwags dang bcas pa gza' brgyad la gtod ma shor cig: sdoms shig ces bri'o: de'i phyi rim rtsibs brgyad la: gza' nyi ma la gtod ma shor cig: de bzhin ran 'thag 'khor la bya khyung mchu'i 'og nas: zla ba la gtod ma shor cig: mig dmar la gtod: lhag pa la: phur bu la: pa sangs la: spen pa la: rā hu la la: sogs rtsibs brgyad la gong gis 'gre'o: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: dgra bo'i snying kha la rak+sha sogs bris: khroṃ gyi 'og phyogs steng nas len: sbal pa'i lto bar phu bri'o: de'i phyi rim mu khyud la: dgra bo'i ming rus 'di zhes bya ba klu brgyad la gtod ma shor cig: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: phu'i 'og phyogs nas rim bzhin chos 'khor du: klu dga' bo la gtod ma shor cig: de bzhin du nor rgyas la gtod ma shor cig: mtha' yas la: dung skyong la: 'jog pa la: stobs rgyu la: rig ldan la: pad chen la: de'i phyi rim mu khyud du: dgra bo'i snying kha la rak+sha sogs bri'o: de'i phyi rim mu khyud la: sbal sbrul mjug can bris: kun kyang sngags mgo phyi ru bstan: bla shing bla rdo gtad pa ni: dug shing gcig la bla shing gzugs: khrag dang dug khrag sna tshogs pa logs gcig tu: klu bdud nag po khyod la gtod bya ba bris: bla rdo ni rde'u rtags can la dgra bo'i dri ma'am rjes sa gang rnyed gcig yi ges gtums la 'phen par bya'o:

sprengs yig ni: dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba'i bla rdo gtod ma shor cig: bla rdo bla shing man ngag yin: dug sna tshogs khyung gi phyi la byugs: mngar sna tshogs sbal pa'i phyi la byugs: khyung khros nas sbrul zhal du gsol ba bris: kun gyi yig mgo nang du bstan: dong du bcug: rgya zam 'og tu'am ri rgyud sgang sna gnyis lta bu'i ri gdug pa can gyi skar khang du'am rgya lam bzhi gram: klu bdud gnas pa'i chu mig gam mtsho gang rung gnyan sar gtod: btsal gtad drag po bya'o: klu khyung bar gyi liṅga 'di: dgra gshed yin no shin tu zab bo: gsang bar bya'o/ /ྀatsha: rgya rgya rgya: rtsa gsum gling pa'i khrom gzigs rngam rong gi gter ma'o// // ༈ gab yig yin: dgra bo'i snying kha la rak+sha khrag la rbad rbad thum thum ril ril rbad gtsug gtig sa mun te 'bum tig sa mun ti chod mug tig bstab re ling rbad: ya ma snying zin ma dgra bo snying la bh+yo kha 'dar ma bh+yo ru lu ru lu bh+yoḥ man man bh+yoḥ shig shig shar shar rag mo rag mo thum thum hūm̐ shi ma trig ni dgra bo mā ra ya dza dzaḥ mā ra ya ya ma snying la dza dza ya ma khrag la dza dzaḥ ya ma dgra bo'i snying khrag tshal baṃ ril ril gzer dum sa dum sa mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'og ling gi rgyab tu lha dbye'i sngags yig mgo nang du bstan pa bris: gsang rgya: rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter ma'o// // dza) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: las kyi gshin rje nag po'i thebs ldog rgyu gsum bzhugs so: ya ma rā dza la na mo: las kyi gshin rje nag po 'di la thebs ldog 'gyu gsum ston pa ni: nyi ma nag po dang bsdongs nas 'gyu ba dang gcig: zin phung nag po dang bsdongs nas 'gyu ba dang gnyis: sa yi phung byed nag po dang bsdongs nas 'gyu ba dang gsum mo: las kyi gshin rje nag po 'di rgyu ba'i dus su: 'di yi mdos sbyin sreg bsad las: drag las sogs ci byas kyang lo dgus mi 'grub pa zhag gcig gis 'grub pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis gsungs:

de phyir gnubs ban bdag gi khyad chos yin: 'di gsum gang dang bsdongs nas byung dus: gshin rje'i drag las sbyin sreg mdos bzlog ci byas kyang : bsad pa spu gri gcig bshur yin: shan pa'i lag tu spu gri bzhag pa dang spre'u lag tu me sgron bzhag pa dang dpa' bo lag tu bsad mtshon bzhag pa dang 'dra: de phyir dus tshod 'di la brtson par gyis: nyi nag dang bsdongs nas 'gyu dus bstan pa ni: dpyid ra ba'i tshes bdun nyin phyed: 'bring po bcu gnyis nam langs: tha chung nyi shu gcig gi nam langs nas mun rub kyi bar du rgyu: dbyar ra ba'i tshes brgyad nam langs: 'bring po'i bcu gcig nyin phyed dang tha chung nyi shu bzhi'i nyi ma phyed yol: ston ra ba'i tshes dgu'i mun rub: 'bring po'i bco brgyad nyi ma phyed yol: tha chung gi nyi shu'i mun rub: dgun ra ba'i tshes bcu'i srod la: 'bring po'i nyi shu'i nyin phyed: tha chung gi gnam stong srod la: zin phung dang bsdongs nas 'gyu ba'i rtsis bstan pa ni: dbyar ra ba'i tshes gcig: bdun: bcu gsum: nyi shu lnga ste: de rnams su bya nyal dus rgyu: 'bring po'i tshes grangs gong dang 'dra la nam phyed: tha chung gi tshes grangs gong dang 'dra la tho rangs rgyu: dbyar ra ba'i tshes drug dang lnga'i smad: 'bring po'i nyi ma rtse shar: tha chung gi nyi dros: ston ra ba'i tshes gsum dang dgu dang bco lnga nyer gcig nyi shu bdun la sa dros: 'bring po tha chung gnyis de dang 'dra: dgun ra ba'i tshes bzhi dang bcu bcu drug nyer gnyis nyer brgyad rnams kyi nam phyed: tha chung srod dpyid gsum stag sprel lho nas byang : dbyar gsum glang lug nub nas shar: ston gsum khyi 'brug byang nas lho: dgun gsum phag sbrul shar nas nub: dpyid gsum byi rta bya yos rnams dbus su tshogs dus: drag las thams cad la shis: khyad par gshin rje las la shis: ya mān+ta ka la na mo: las kyi gshin rje nag po 'di sa yi phung byed nag mo dang bsdongs nas 'gyu dus bstan pa ni:

zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du rgyu'o: de yang tshes gcig gi nyin phyed: gnyis pa'i nam phyed gsum gyi srod: bzhi pa'i tho rangs lnga'i nyi dros: drug gi tho rangs bdun gyi nyi ma'i dgong mo'i dus tsam la: brgyad pa'i skya rengs shar tsam la: dgu'i srod chen bcu'i nam gung bcu gcig pa'i nam phyed bcu gnyis pa'i nam gung : bcu gsum gyi nyi shar bcu bzhi'i nyin phyed bco lnga'i nyi dros bcu drug gi nyin gung : bcu bdun gyi nam phyed bco brgyad kyi sa sros bcu dgu'i nam phyed nyi shu'i nyin phyed nyer gcig gi tho rangs: nyer gsum pa'i nam gyi phyed yol nyer bzhi'i tho rangs nyer lnga'i nyi shar nyer drug gi nam langs nyer bdun gyi nam phyed nyer dgu'i tho rangs gnam stong gi srod la rgyu'o: gshin rje'i gshed kyi thebs ldog 'gyu gsum 'di: gshin rje yan chad kyi las thams cad 'di la bstun na legs shin tu shis: 'di yis bzang po'i las thams cad dang drag las thams cad la shis so: gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis lung du bstan nas snyan du brgyud: phyis rgya zhang khrom gyis yi ger bkod: las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: āḥ

dpa' bo'i mtshon cha yod do// // wa) 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi ngan sngags zhag sgrub chog bsgrigs bklag chog tu bkod pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dang gnyis su med pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ 'dir 'jigs byed dug ri nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi ngan sngags zhag sgrub dug gi par bu mtshon cha'i las byang bklag chog tu bkod pa la gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la drug gi thog mar ji ltar 'os pa'i gnas su stegs bu kheb dmar nag gis bkab pa'i khar/ mchod gtor sman raka bka' gter chos srung gi gtor ma dang*/ spyi mchod sogs bshams pa'i g.yas g.yon gang babs su phung shul gyi sa stegs dur sol gyis byugs pa'i khar hom khung dgra ling lteb pa'i khar zan gyi nya bo khrag gis byugs pa bzhag cing*/ byad thag gi sne mo dur g.yam gyi thun lam nas drangs pa rten gtor gyi res la gzugs/ khor yug tu rtsang dmar bsnol srin mo'i 'gros dang bya 'ug gi sgro dang thun rdzas sogs mthong rgyud ltar bsham pa phung shul gyi ras gur phub/ gzhan yang gser skyems thun gtor dkar bgegs chad brtan tshogs kyi yo byad la sogs 'du bya'o/ /thog mar brgyud 'debs ni/ e ma hoḥ sangs rgyas spyi mes rang bzhin dbyings la shar: mgon po gdod ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: rigs lnga'i gtso bo longs sku'i ston pa mchog: mi 'gyur rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs: rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad: sprul sku rdo rje sems la gsol ba 'debs: de nyid rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i rnam rgyal bum: las kyi dbang mo che la gsol ba 'debs: sde snod ma lus dgongs pa'i klong las shar: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs: mkhyen gnyis gnas lugs nyi ma mkha' la shar: mkhas pa shrī singhar gsol ba 'debs:

shes rab rtse mo sku bzhi yongs la 'gengs: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes la gsol ba 'debs: lha srin btul mdzad sde snod gcig tu bsdus: rdo rje gro bo lod la gsol ba 'debs: lha srin btul ba'i dkyil 'khor phyag rgya'i bdag: rdo rje be con ma la gsol ba 'debs: khyad chos rnam gsum gdams pa'i bka' chen bab: bal po bha su dha rar gsol ba 'debs: gshin rje 'dul rgyud so drug bka' chen bab: gnubs chen bud+dha dzñā nar gsol ba 'debs: bka' dgongs sgyu gsum zab chos bka' chen bab: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling la gsol ba 'debs: sku yi 'dul rgyud rdo rje rnam par rol: 'jigs byed he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs: sku yi dkyil 'khor bla med don gyis rdzogs: dug ri'i dkyil 'khor tshogs la gsol ba 'debs: zla gsang thig le dkar nag dmar po sogs: 'dus pa spyi rgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs: thugs rje'i brtse bas dgongs shing byin gyis rlobs: bum pa'i dbang bskur lha dang gnyis su med: gsang dbang ye shes bde stong zung du 'jug: sher dbang ka dag dbyings rig bya rtsol bral: tshig dbang rin chen 'khor ba yongs su grol: dbang lnga'i rjes gnang mtshams sbyor phyir mi ldog: rim skyes 'dam chu'i sbal ltar mi bying bar: gcig shar gcig po'i nya ldang ci lta bu: thod rgal nyams zad a ti'i 'bras bu 'di: rtsol med sa lam rdzogs pa'i go 'phang du: dge bas yongs su khyab pa'i don thob shog: gnyis pa skyabs sems ni/ na mo: 'di bzung byang chub snying po ma thob bar: bla ma mchog gsum 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: kun 'dus khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: gus pas skyabs mchi 'jam dpal mchog bsgrub bgyi: dkar gtor sngon du 'gro bas/ bgegs gtor bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo?khaṃ swā hā/ gsum pa bgegs 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid khro bo rdo rje nag po yi: thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya skar ltar 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs: gtor ma len phyir skad cig myur du 'dus: oṃ ya mān+ta ka bhū ta rā dza dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ nyon cig bgegs dang lan chags mgron: dug gsum gtor ma 'di longs la: so sor rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste bka' 'gal dam nyams na: nga nyid gshin rje khro rgyal gyi: sku gsung thugs sprul steng 'og khengs: khro chu'i mtshon cha me 'od 'khrugs: lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du rlog: de bas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor bsgoms pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'jam dpal khro bo nag po yi: thugs las srung ba'i gur khang nag po 'phros: dum bu rim dgu rngam par 'jigs rung ni: phyi rol dang po ye nas stong pa'i gur: gnyis pa gnam lcags ur mo mchod rten gur: gsum pa dug rlangs khro bo nag po'i gur: bzhi pa ral gri bsam chod rdo rje'i gur: lnga pa gri gug rdo rje gtun shing gur: drug pa me ri stong nyid kā li'i gur: bdun pa 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gur: brgyad pa khro bo dkar po nang gzigs gur: dgu pa 'jam dpal dkar po shel gyi gur: de nang bsrung bya tshud nas rdo rje yi: lte ba hūm̐ du gshin rje'i pho brang gyur: oṃ badz+ra ya mān+ta ka e ka ya ma du ru tsakra rak+ṣa: drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: gdug pa'i dug lnga rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i: sku lnga ye shes mchod sprin rgya mtsho ni: phyi nang dpag med khengs pa'i bdud rtsi mchog: sku mchog bdud rtsi gnyis bsdus thabs shes 'bar: zung 'jug gnyis med dgyes pa chen por bskyed: oṃ sarba pañtsa pū dza a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐:

gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa la bdun las/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: rang byung kun gzhi mkha' ltar khyab: de las dbyings rig rtsal snang spros: kun rgyu sprul pa'i sa bon hūm̐: dbyings gyur kun snang skye med rdzogs: oṃ badz+ra shrī dzñā na hūm̐: gnyis pa gzhal yas lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: snang srid gdod nas e yi klong : rgyu rkyen spros pas sa bon shar: de 'gyur dug gi rlung dmar 'tshubs: zhe sdang me 'bar 'ur 'ur chem: 'dod chags rak+ta rlabs chen 'phyo: phrag dog keng rus ri rab brjid: ru tra sa gzhi 'khor lo bskor: rdo rje'i rmang gzhi khro chu'i dal: gru bzhi dug rlangs sngo dmar 'tsher: zur brgyad lcags bsregs dmar zhing rngam: ka gdung las gshin khro zhing gtum: nang du dur khrod brgyad ldan mdzes: thog steng don snying tsit+tas brgyan: srin po'i pho brang ltar snang ba: phyi nang dur khrod chas rdzogs gsal: de dbus khro chu lcags khang nang : dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum gsal: de'i steng gnam lcags 'khor lo ni: spu gri'i drwa ba g.yas g.yon 'khor: de dbus gnam lcags rdo rje ni: lte ba hūm̐ dang ya yis mtshan: gnas gyur skad cig gshin rje'i gshed: 'jigs byed dug ri nag po'i sku: kham nag dug gi gdong pa can: zhal dgu rngam zhing khro gtum pa: rtsa zhal dbus gdong ma he khro: g.yas g.yon kham nag srog la rngam: de'i steng dug gdong dmar nag mthing : de'i steng rigs gsum dkar dmar ser: 'jam dpal nag po'i dbang rtags rdzogs: dmar nag ral pas 'dzam gling khyab: thod skam khro rol sprul char 'bebs: sbrul nag zhags 'dren gling bzhi gtams: shangs nas dug rlangs bgegs dpung 'gyel: zhal bgrad dgra snying srog la rol: mche gtsigs sma ra smin ma mthing : dgyes pa'i gad mos stong gsum g.yo: rab 'bar bden gnyis gdug pa 'dul: rtsa phyag rdo rje phur pa 'dril:

g.yas pa bcu drug mtshon cha ni: gri khug ral gri chu gri me: kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje 'khor lo mdung : lcags kyu spu gri dbyug to dkar: ḍā ru dgra satwa zhags pa 'khyugs: tho ba gsal shing rgyal mtshan phyar: phyag g.yon bcu drug las kyi mtshon: thod khrag snying phreng rgyu ma 'dren: gtun khung lcags sgrog rnga chung ldir: mgo phreng ru mtshon dug rlangs nag: dril bu me long kong zor dmar: khram shing shwa rdel rtsis rdo nag: g.yang gzhi rdeb cing dgra yul 'joms: glang ko zhing lpags gdug pa 'dul: mgo phreng sbrul rgyan klu bdud 'dar: khrag thig zo ris dar nag brjid: tshom bu rtags rgya me dpung 'bar: spu gri'i sgro gshog stong khams g.yo: lte bar chu srin khro zhal gdangs: sku stod las kyi rtags rgya gsal: sku smad gnam lcags dbal phur rngam: byad ma dgra bo'i snying khar brdzis: sbyor yum dug ti khro mo dmar: zhal gsum sngo dmar nag la khro: spyan dgu sdang mig srid gsum g.yo: dmar nag ral pa nam mkhar khyab: thod skam dbu rgyan dug lnga 'dul: shangs nas rlung g.yos zhal gdangs bgrad: rtsa phyag gri thod yab la 'khyud: g.yas gnyis rdo rje 'khor lo phyar: g.yon gnyis phur pa ral gri brdegs: rus rgyan ga shal dar dpyangs dmar: sbrul chun gzig sham khrag zhag thig: thal tshom mi sdug rtags kyis spras: zhabs gnyis dpa' stobs yab la 'khril: kun 'dus khro bo'i thugs ka ru: khro chu dug gdong dmar nag 'bar: dbus mthing g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal: zhal gdangs spyan dgu dbu skra bskyod: rigs gsum mchod rten dbang rtags rdzogs: g.yas gsum dgra satwa g.yon gsum snying : dur khrod chas kyis sku la brgyan: sgro gshog brgyangs shing mchu sder khro: dbal phur dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: de yi thugs kar 'khor lo'i dbus: tshe bdag khro bo mthing nag 'bar: g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo gri: g.yon gsum dgra satwa sdigs mdzub me:

sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs gnyis rol stabs me dpung 'bar: de yi thugs kar rdo rje yi: lte bar srid pa'i 'khor lo dmar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sgeg cing khro: g.yas gnyis me dpung rdo rje gdengs: g.yon gnyis rtse gsum tsit+ta 'bar: dur khrod chas rdzogs rol stabs bzhugs: de yi thugs kar thig le'i dbus: hūm̐ yig mthing nag ya yig mtshan: gsal 'tsher gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: gtso bo'i spyi gtsug dmar nag me klong dbus: 'jam dpal nag po 'jigs rung mthing nag rngam: zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs byed dpal chas rdzogs: g.yas gsum ral gri gri gug rdo rje 'bar: g.yon gsum po ti snying phreng thod khrag 'thung : sgro gshog brgyangs shing rdo rje'i dbal zur ldan: de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dbus: rta mgrin dmar smug zhal gsum phyag drug ni: g.yas gsum dbyug to rdo rje tho ba phyar: g.yon gsum lcags sgrog zhags pa dril bu 'khrol: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum me dpung klong na brjid: de yi thugs kar zla gdan 'khor lo'i dbus: gsang bdag mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub bsgrengs: dur khrod chas rdzogs rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: de yi thugs kar nā da thig le'i dbus: hrīḥyig dmar ser bkrag mdangs lam mer gsal: hūm̐: gtso bo'i spyi gtsug 'ja' zer klong : 'jam dpal dkar po phyag bzhi pa: g.yas gnyis ral gri shel phreng dkar: g.yon gnyis po ti ut+pal dmar: skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: de yi thugs kar 'od kyi klong : rdo rje dkar po gsal stong bsgom: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng : shar du dgra nag khro bo gtum: zhal gsum phyag drug phur gsham brjid: g.yas gsum sbrul zhags rgyal mtshan gri: g.yon gsum khyab 'jug zhags pa me: dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs par bsgom: lho ru ki kang dmar nag rngam:

zhal gsum phyag drug dur khrod chas: g.yas gsum gsal shing gtun dang mdung : g.yon gsum rgyu zhags mgo snying dmar: dbal ldan drag tu rngam par bskyed: nub tu me yi spu gri kham: zhal gsum phyag drug phur gsham ldan: g.yas gsum spu gri dkar dmar sngo: g.yon gsum chu gri sngo nag ljang : dur khrod chas rdzogs dpa' zhing brjid: byang du gdong drug mthing nag rngam: g.yas gsum dug mda' rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum lcags gzhu dril bu thod: dur khrod chas ldan rngam zur bskyed: mtshams bzhir dug ti rtsa 'jib bzhi: rdo rje phur pa 'dril zhing khro: yab la dgyes shing dur khrod chas: me chu dug mtshon dbus su brjid: phyi rol sgo ma gdong can bzhi: bya rog kaṅka 'ug pa khyung : gcer mo mi sdug gzugs 'chang zhing : phyag mtshan sgo bzhi'i phyag rgya ldan: gzhan yang las gshin dmag tshogs rnams: dgra bo'i sha khrag srog la rngam: las bcol bka' bzhin sgrub par gyur: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros 'og min zhing khams nas: 'jam dpal khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sku: gshin rje'i gshed po'i dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes gnas nas spyan drangs te: bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: sku gsung thugs kyi nus pa bskyed: phrin las rnam bzhi'i rtsal phyungs la: phyi nang mi mthun bar chad sol: dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar bcad nas: sku gsum lha ru bdag gyur cig: gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: rigs bdag 'jam dpal gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs rab 'jigs dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed dug ri gshegs su gsol: gshin yul lcags mkhar nag po nas: sras mchog rigs bzhi gshegs su gsol: 'chi bdag las kyi pho brang nas: sgo skyong yang 'khor gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥdzaḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du:

las gshin dug ri khro bo'i rgyal: bdag la dbang bskur byin brlab phyir: rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir bzhugs: om̐ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rab tu dwang bas phyag bgyid do: om̐ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya: a ti pu hoḥ drug pa phyi nang gsang ba'i gtor tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba las/ dang po phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga dang : dur khrod bdag po dgra la rngam pa'i gar: pho nyas dgra bo'i bla 'bod 'debs pa'i gdangs: rtag tu dur khrod bdag mor sbyor ba sogs: drag po phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs 'di: khro rgyal dug ri'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti pū dza āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngo bo mchog: sha chen la sogs khu ba'i rdzas dang sbyar: sman mchog ngad ldan dug rigs sbyar ba'i phud: 'bru bcud myos pa'i dza gad chang la sogs: drag po nang gi mchod pa sna tshogs 'di: khro rgyal dug ri'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥkha kha khā hi:

gsum pa gsang mchod sbyor sgrol tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: lha mo dus mtshan nag mo'i mkha' lam nas: las kyi rlung gis bskyod pa'i bdud rtsi dang : rigs bzang a haṃ drug tu sbyor ba yi: bde stong dga' bzhi bsrubs pa'i bdud rtsi dang : gzhan yang ma chags chags pa chen po'i khrag: dga' chen ston pa'i gsang mchod sna tshogs 'di: khro rgyal dug ri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ a haṃ pañtsa rak+ta mu kha kun+da sa ma ya pū dza khā hi: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bhan+dha lcang lo ru: 'bru nag gri khrag brlan dang sbags pa yi: ba liṃ gtor ma sha sna snying snas brgyan: dar nag gdugs dang bla 'khor srog rten bkod: ma rungs gdug pa'i don snying 'bras bus brgyan: tshogs mchod la sogs dgyes shing mthun pa'i rdzas: thod rnga rkang gling rol mo sna tshogs dang : dur khrod bkod pa spyan gzigs sprin ltar 'khrigs: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'di: khro rgyal dug ri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bdun pa bstod cing bsngags pa ni/ hūm̐ e ya bh+yoḥ skye med ngang las ma g.yos rigs kyi bdag: bdud bzhi 'byung po'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod phyir: sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: ral gri shel phreng pu ti ut+pal bsnams: zhi 'dzum mdzes ldan gzhon nu'i rnam par rol: longs spyod rdzogs sku bde stong cha lugs 'chang : sgrub la shes rab dbang bzhi stsol ba'i lha: sku lnga ye shes rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: stobs ldan dbang phyug mu stegs rgol 'joms pa:

sku yi rang bzhin 'jigs byed gtum la rngam: gsung gi rang bzhin dbang chen drag sngags ldir: thugs kyi rang bzhin gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin: tshe yi rang bzhin gzi brjid dpal dang ldan: dur khrod dpal chas 'bar ba'i gar dgus brjid: ye shes me 'bar rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'khyil: rigs gsum dbang rtags rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ e ya: gtum drag khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: srog la rngam byed 'chi bdag gshin rje'i gshed: pha rol kun gyi gshed ma lho phyogs bdag: 'jigs byed kun gyi sde dpon khro bo'i rgyal: stobs ldan rdo rje dug ri mthu bo che: sku mdog dud kha me 'od chi li li: rtsa zhal khros pa ma he'i nga ro 'byin: ra gnyis rtse nas thog ser dgra la 'debs: rtsa zhal kham nag khro gnyis hūm̐ sgra sgrog: steng gsum dmar nag mthing bas bon byad 'joms: de'i steng dkar dmar ser bas ban byad 'joms: zhal dgu rab tu khros pas snang srid dngangs: dbu skra dmar nag bskyod pas lha srin 'dul: g.yas pa bcu drug mtshon cha 'khrugs pa yis: dgra bo'i pho rgyud rtsad gcod phye mar brlag: g.yon pa bcu drug mtshon cha 'khrugs pa yis: dgra bo'i mo rgyud rigs rgyud mngal nas skem: rtsa phyag ri rab phur bu bsgril ba yis: pha rol rgol ba'i tshogs rnams phyung zhing brdeg: spu gri'i sgro gshog tshwa tshwa 'thor ba yis: ma rungs gdon tshogs 'byung po klad nas skem: dur khrod dpal chas rngam pa'i gar ldan gyis: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha dgra la 'beb: lte bar chu srin rkan sgra rdeb pa yis: bsam pa tsam gyis ru tra'i snying khrag rol: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham ngar ma yis: dam nyams log 'dren bla srog gtub cing gcod: zur gsum dbal las thog ser g.yo ba yis: ma rungs bgegs tshogs phye mar rab tu 'thag: sku la dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba yis: pha rol kun gyi rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa:

'jigs byed chen po dug ri'i sku la 'dud: hūm̐ bh+yo ya: las kyi yum chen ma mo dur khrod bdag: dug ti nag mo rdo rje rab 'bar ma: snang srid yongs la dbang sgyur srog gi bdag: sku mdog dmar nag srin mo'i cha lugs 'chang : khams gsum za byed zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: dbus dmar g.yas dkar g.yon mthing srid gsum sngangs: g.yas gsum mtshon chas log lta phye mar bcom: g.yon gsum mtshon chas 'byung po'i klad khrag rol: dur khrod chas rdzogs dam nyams 'dre rgod dngangs: zhabs gnyis 'khril sbyor las kyi gshin rje bskul: ba spu'i gseb nas rang 'dra'i ma mo 'gyed: gshin rje'i lcam mo snang srid dbang mo che: dur khrod bdag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ ya: 'jigs byed sku yi 'khor lo yangs pa'i klong : thugs rje dbang phyug khro chu dug gdong sku: mthing nag dkar dmar rab khros rngam zhal bgrad: phyag drug mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'bebs: spu gri'i sgro gshog log 'dren rtsad nas gcod: dur khrod chas ldan ru tra phye mar brlag: chu srin zhal bgrad ma rungs snying khrag 'thung : gnam lcags dbal gsham bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: las kyi gshin rje pha rol rgol 'joms pa: khro chu dug gdong 'bar ba'i sku la bstod: hūm̐ ya: ye shes 'khor lo rab 'bar chos kyi dbyings: gsung gi dbang phyug tshe bdag 'bar ba'i sku: mthing nag dkar dmar rab rngam zhal gsum bgrad: phyag drug rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri dang : dgra satwa sdigs mdzub me dpung dgra bgegs 'joms: dur khrod chas ldan ru tra phye mar brlag: zhabs gnyis dor stabs sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem: las kyi gshin rje pha rol rgol 'joms pa: zil gnon tshe bdag 'bar ba'i sku la bstod: hūm̐ ya: dwangs ma'i thugs mchog rdo rje'i gzhal yas klong : srid gsum 'khor los sgyur rgyal dmar ser sgeg: bdud dang bar chad nyon mongs log 'dren gshed:

'jigs pa'i gzugs la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad: me dpung rdo rje rtse gsum dgra bgegs 'joms: tsit+ta dmar po nyon mongs zhal du rngub: zhi zhing 'dzum pas 'gro rnams thabs kyis skyong : khro zhing gtum pas log par 'dren byed 'dul: zhi khro 'bar ba'i gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: grub pa'i stobs 'byin rdo rje pha lam sku: dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ ya: khor yug gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la: las kyi khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: shar du dgra 'dul nag po gtum zhing khro: lho ru ki kang dmar nag srog la rngam: nub tu me yi spu gri kham nag 'jigs: byang du gdong drug mthing nag byad ma'i gshed: kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug dpal gyi chas: phyag mtshan mtshon cha 'bar bas log 'dren gzhom: gnam lcags dbal gsham bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod: sras mchog 'bar ba sde bzhi'i sku la bstod: mtshams bzhir dug ti ma mo rtsa 'jib bzhi: snang srid dbang sgyur srid gsum srog gi bdag: khro gtum nyams ldan rdo rje phur bu 'dril: dur khrod chas rdzogs me chu dug mtshon 'khrugs: dmar chen 'bar bas gtso bo mnyes mdzad pa: yum mchog brjid pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ ya: pho brang chen po'i phyogs bzhi sgo skyong ba: las kyi gshin rje ma mo srog gi bdag: srin mo'i gzugs can dgra sha khrag la dgyes: dur khrod g.yang gzhi'i gos gyon shams se sham: phyag g.yas rang rang sgo chas log 'dren gzhom: g.yon pa'i bhan dmar dgra bgegs rak+ta 'thung : rngam pa'i gar sgyur bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod: sgo skyong rigs bzhi ma mor phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gzhan yang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' sdod pa: pho nya las byed sprul pa bye ba 'bum: rlung ltar 'tshub cing dgra yul phye mar brlag: mi sdug gzugs 'chang 'jigs pa'i gad mo sgrog:

las kyi mtha' sdud shan pa bye ba 'bum: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'dus la bdag bstod do: bzlas pa la 'jug khar rang nyid gtso bo sku mdog zhal phyag la sogs pa'i rnam par gsal ba dang*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal shugs drag rgyun ci ring du bsgoms te de la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa bzlas pa sngags kyi rim pa la drug /dang po dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs: deng 'dir thugs dam gnyan po rgyud bskul na: rig 'dzin sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bstan la sdang ba'i log 'dren rtsad nas chod: thugs dam dus las ma 'da' sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gnyis pa bzlas pa ni/ gtso bo rnams kyi thugs kar thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor gyi lte bar yab rnams hūm̐ mthing khog par ya dmar nag gis mtshan pa dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar bh+yo dmar nag /rigs bdag gi thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar ser dbang rtags 'jam dpal nag po'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga sgo ma bzhi yi thugs kar dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes pa rnams rang mdog gsal 'tsher bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i mtha' skor du rang rang gi srog sngags rnams rang mdog la gting mdangs dmar ba tshwa zer 'khyugs pa g.yas bskor du rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar srid gsum 'gul ldeg chem chem du g.yo zhing 'khor bas/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul thugs srog gi 'od kyis sngags phreng rnams gsal ba'i stobs shugs bskyed/ sngags phreng rnams kyi 'od sgras thugs srog nus stobs rgyas/ zung 'jug gi 'od dang sgras nyi zla g.yo zhing tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i klong las drag sngags me dpung mtshon cha thog rgod tshwa tshwa drag tu 'khor zhing*/ mched pas srid pa gsum gyi bdud rigs log par 'dren pa thams cad bsad gtubs thal bar brlag cing de dag gi stobs rtsal nus pa rang la thim pas gzi brjid ches cher rgyas par

bsams la sngags bzla/ oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ki kang du tri ya ma rā dza sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes chu bo'i rgyun ltar bzla'o/ /yang skabs su thugs srog sngags phreng 'od kyis rtsa khams bskul bas sku'i dpa' stobs cher g.yos pa'i shugs kyis phyi dbyings 'byung ba'i khams rnams g.yo zhing 'khrugs pas/ log 'dren byad ma rnams 'byung ba rang gshed du gyur nas rang byung gi mtshon chas gtubs shing gtor te las byed kyi pho nyas hub kyis lhag med du zos nas/ lhag mar 'dzin pa'i snang ba yang las rlung gis spur/ ngar 'dzin gyi rtog pa phra rags ye shes 'bar ba'i dbus su bsregs/ tshe srog gi dwangs ma bkrag mdangs 'od lnga'i thig ler g.yo ba rnams rigs bdag gi 'od zer gyis 'ub 'ub bsdus te/ bum pa'i bcud 'khyil zhing rgyas te lud pa rnams tshangs bug nas dbu mar brgyud de/ rtsa chen rtsa phran sogs rtsa gnas thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams pas gzi brjid rngam pa'i stobs shugs ches cher 'bar zhing*/ khyad par du yang bsgrub bya dang srid gsum gyi khams na gnas pa'i byang chub sgrub pa sogs/ rnam dkar gyi mos 'dun phra rags dang ldan pa rnams kyi 'byung khams stobs su smin te/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor nus stobs dkar po dge ba'i rten 'brel thams cad 'phel ba'i shugs dang*/ spobs pa'i stobs rgyas te snang stong khro rgyal gyi sku'i rnam rol gtso 'khor tha mi dad pa yom yom shig shig 'khrug 'khrug pa bro 'dus kyi rnam par gsal ba dang*/ yang skabs su dkyil 'khor lha'i 'khor lo'i rnam par mched de/ chos dbyings kyi khyon gang bar phyam brdal/ slar rim par tshur 'dus thugs srog yungs 'bru tsam la shes pa gtad pa sogs/ ting 'dzin 'phro 'du'i rtsal sbyong bar bya'o/ /bsnyen rkyang gi skabs gsham gsal rbad bsad kyi sngags rnams ma byas kyang rung ngo*/

/gsum pa las sbyor dang 'brel na rbad sngags bzla ba ni/ om̐ ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha e ka ya ma ki kang hring kā la du ru dzaḥ pha la dzaḥ dgra bo'i bla srog la dza dzaḥ trag rak+sha kā la du tri dgra bo'i snying la dza dzaḥkhug: ya ma du ru dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: snying la bh+yo thun thun: ya ma raṃ shag du dgra bo dza dzaḥ zhes bzlas shing 'gug gzhug drag po bya/ bzhi pa bsad sngags ni/ om̐ ya mān+ta ka yak+sha ya ma rā dza dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: snying la chod chod: e ka ya ma du ru nā ga dgra bo'i sha la rbad rbad: tsit+ta zungs zungs: chum nā ga sha tri dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ki kang kā la rak+sha byad ma'i yul zhing la bh+yo bh+yoḥ raṃ ha la du byad ma'i snying rtsa la chod chod: ma mo mu kha dun+ting dgra bo'i sha la rbad: rtsa la yam yam: ra tsa snying ya ma du nag po shag tshal pa ha la ha la rak+sha rbad chod: bhan+dha bhan+dha nṛ tri khroṃ mā ra ya byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ zhes bzlas shing thun gyis brab/ rbad bsad kyi sngags yod med gang ltar yang*/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya sbrel ba dang*/ rten 'brel snying po rnams gsum gsum bzla'o/ /lnga pa dzap kyi mchod bstod ni/ oṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas mchod/ hūm̐ yaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /rab gus dwang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/ drug pa thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa dang : gshin rje'i gshed po za byed me gdong can: dug ri nag po pha rol rgol 'joms kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus: dmigs pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs thams cad kun: drag po'i thun gtor 'di la myur du khug: om̐ ya ma rā dza bh+yo bh+yoḥ

dgra bo'i bla srog khug dza dzaḥ hūm̐: dzaḥyig dmar nag 'phros pa gtor mar thim: spu gri'i rang bzhin gyur nas dgra bgegs gtub: tshe bsod 'ub bsdus rnal 'byor bdag la thim: sha khrag gshin rje mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: sman raka gis bran la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gtor ma sman raka dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur/ dgra bgegs sha trum mā ra ya i daṃ bha ling+ta ghṛ h+ṇa sa ma ya khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: dgra bgegs gdug pa bdud kyi tshogs: sde dpung 'khor dang bcas pa yi: sha khrag bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'di: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i tshogs la 'bul: las dang bag chags dag pa dang : rang gshed bsam sbyor ngan pa kun: kho rang la ni bzlog pa dang : rang mtshon rang la zug pa dang : rang sha rang gis za bar mdzod: rang sde rang gis phye mar thongs: rdul cha tsam yang med par mdzod: hūm̐: gtum chen rab 'bar khro bo'i rje: dug ri khro 'dus kī la ya: sras 'khor gshed chen pho nya'i tshogs: 'jigs tshul rngam pa'i nga ro yis: gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba dang : bdag srungs rkyen dang bar chad zlog: om̐ badz+ra kro ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsrung bzlog phrin las bcol/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim par tshogs mchod dang bskul/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ dbang blang*/ bsdu rim bsngo smon bkra shis bcas las gzhung chen mo bzhin bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshogs mchod spro bar mos na/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyis byin brlab pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos rnams dmigs med de bzhin nyid: sme ba'i gtsang btsog ka nas dag: rang byung rgya yan lhun grub las: ting 'dzin tshogs kyi 'khor lor shar: ye nas zag med bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ dharma dzñā na pra ti pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rtsa gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa yi: bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rngam chen me ltar 'bar ba yi: dur khrod e yi klong dkyil nas: 'jigs byed dpa' bo gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar lha tshogs rnams/ tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ gsum pa tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ ya: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed chen po: 'jigs byed khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bskang ba bya ba ni/ hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi dbang po dang : byad ma'i sha khrag rus pa nang rol bcas: ga ṇa'i tshogs kyi mchod sogs mnyes pa'i rdzas: phyi nang gsang ba'i spyan gzigs du ma 'dis: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mi mthun gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar bcad cing : mthun rkyen bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ bdag blo gti mug 'thug pos rab rmongs nas: bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa'i dam bca' g.yel ba dang : tshul bzhin ma ldan bag med dbang gyur tshogs: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ drug pa tha ma bsgral ba ni/

hūm̐: khro rgyal 'jam dpal nag po'i sprul pa ni: 'chi bdag gshin rje dgra 'dul kī la ya: phyag gnyis 'joms byed las kyi phur bu 'dril: ru tra gdug pa'i snying la kī la ya: bcad gtub rdul du rlog cig mā ra ya: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ru tra trig nan gzer thum rbad myog: bdun pa bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: 'joms byed mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yis: dgra bgegs gzugs phung phye mar rab bshig ste: bhan+dhar bskyil ba'i sha khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta i daṃ bha ling+ta kha hi: zhes tshogs la rol/ brgyad pa lhag ma gtong ba ni/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ dur khrod 'bar ba'i pho brang mtha' skyong ba: ya ba ya ma dregs sde shan pa'i tshogs: sha za dmar nag zangs kyi mche ba can: mi sdug gzugs can dgra la bla 'gugs 'debs: rngam stabs lang ling g.yang gzhi dmar po gyon: mgo snying thogs nas rgyu ma 'dren zhing rgyug: ging chen dbyug pa thogs nas bshugs sgra 'debs: skra dmar ral bsigs srin po'i las nyul bzhin: gshin rje'i bka' sdod dregs sde bye ba 'bum: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: om̐ ya wa ha ri ya ma ra ti sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dgu pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ rnga brdung dung bus gtor ma la rak+tas bran zhing dpal 'bar 'dzugs la/ hūm̐ e ya: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: mi bzad khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: sprul pa yang sprul pha rol rgol tshogs 'joms: bzhengs shig 'chi bdag pho brang dbus nas bzhengs: dbyings nas bzhengs la rbad bskul las la chos: pha rol dam nyams ru tra gdug pa'i tshogs: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe:

bsam sbyor ngan pa 'chang ba'i byad ma rnams: lo zla zhag dus tshes las ma 'da' bar: sgrol zhing brlags nas ming yang med par mdzod: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dus la bab bo 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs: stong gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka a kro te ka sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi bla srog dbugs la thun thun sha khrag la khā hi: bcu pa chad mdo gtong ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa ru/ /gsang chen rol dang ar+ya pā lo'i gling*/ khrom gzigs 'jam dpal sku yi pho brang nas/ /'jam dpal gshin rje pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rtsa gsum gling sogs kyis/ /zla gsang gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes shing*/ /zab gter gtad cing gter du bzhes pa'i tshe/ /las gshin bya rog gdong dang gter srung bcas/ /so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang*/ /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /pha rol rgol ba 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzod/ om̐ kro ta kro ti sarba i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: bcu gcig pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: la la ye shes la la 'jig rten tshul: don la 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' nyan ma: bstan pa srung ba'i ma sring 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: om̐ ma ma shag shag dum dum le le ting ting dza dza i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: bcu gnyis pa rta bro bya ba ni/ hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po ru: rngam chen 'jigs byed gshin rje'i lha tshogs kyi: dbal ldan ru tra'i snying khar bro rdung bas: ma rungs gdug pa'i bgegs srin phye mar bcom: phyin chad dam sri ma ldang rgyas gdab bo: om̐ ya ma ya nan: wa ru ṇa nan: ma ru nan: ru tra laṃ nan: dam sri mā ra ya nan:

bcu gsum pa dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: bde chen gsang ba snying po rdo rje'i mkha': yang dag ye shes 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi: sku gsung thugs yon 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mthu rtsal gzi byin chen po'i dpal yon gyis: deng 'dir dbang bskur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: 'dod don yid bzhin kun kyang lhun grub nas: zab gsang dpal 'bar rgyas mdzad ston par stsol: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rjes chog la drug /dang po mchod bstod ni/ om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas mchod/ hūm̐ yaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ rab gus dwang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/ gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ bdag blo gti mug 'thug pos rab rmongs nas: bskyed rdzogs bsgrub pa'i dam bca' g.yel ba dang : tshul bzhin ma ldan bag med dbang gyur tshogs: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: yi ge brgya pas bshags/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar la/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ snang stong lha sku sgyu ma'i ngang tshul las: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug spro bsdu'i 'du tshan dag: dgongs pa zang thal dmigs med mkha' ru bsdu: a a āḥ zhes bsdus la/ slar yang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dpa' bo gcig pa'i skur lam gyis gsal la/ om̐ hriṣ+ṭi wi kri ta na na ya ma rā dza badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ go cha'i rgya dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rak+ṣa maṃ/ go bgo zhing lus srung*/ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ mtha' yas 'gro kun tshogs zhing pad+mo'i tshal: thugs rje'i sprin gtibs byin rlabs char chen po: smin grol zab mo'i 'bras bu rab smin te:

bcud kyi ting 'dzin ro brgya 'gro la bsngo: lnga pa smon lam bya ba ni/ hoḥ shes rab ye shes dpa' bo 'jam mgon gyi: go 'phang 'grub ste don gnyis gnas lnga yi: gdeng chen mi g.yo rtogs pa'i 'bras bu nyid: nam yang bag yod dge ba'i mthu ldan shog: drug pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: sku mchog gzhon nu gzi 'od rab 'khyil ba: thugs rje'i klong yangs drwa ba'i 'od zer gyis: srid pa'i ma dag lteng ka rab bskams te: lham mer rtag tu gsal mdzad bkra shis shog: bla med theg chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho yi: thos bsam sgom sgrub nyams len gling zhugs nas: don gnyis mchog la spyod pa'i nor bu nyid: nam yang kun 'grub dge legs bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis bsngo smon sogs kyis mtha' rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar 'jam dpal gshin rje khro 'dus kyi zhag sgrub chog bsgrigs bklag chog tu bkod pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal zhes pa 'di'ang bstan 'gror smin ched skyid grong smyon pas gzhung gi mtshams sbyor dang med du mi rung ba re zung bcas snga gter gong ma las blangs te rang gnas nor skyong klu'i gter phug tu bsgrigs shing nus ldan du grub pa 'dis kyang*/ bstan dgra'i bdud dpung rmang med du gzhom pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gong gsal rig 'dzin grub dbang thugs mchog rdo rje'i chog khrigs 'dir rjes kyi bya ba tshogs sogs gzhung la zhal 'phang mdzad pa rnams/ cung zad tshig sna bstung zhing dkyus su bkod la yig chung rnams kha gsal du btang nas gsar bu ba rnams 'jug bde ba'i dbang du byas te gu h+yas sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// zha) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi bsnyen sgrub sogs nyer mkho'i phrin las snying po gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// dpag yas mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang ches 'bar bas/ /log rtog smag rum mthar mdzad khro bo'i dbang*/ /'jigs byed dug ri'i lha la nyer btud nas/

/phrin las snying po gsal byed 'di na spro/ de'ang bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi tshe/ dang po ni las can dag thun drug gam thun bzhi nges pas rang lugs pa rnams kyis/ gzhung gi phrin las thun thams cad la bgyis na/ bsnyen grangs la gnod phyir mi lcogs pas/ de la thor thun snga thun la gter gzhung ltar dang*/ de phyin gyi thun lhag ma rnams 'di ltar 'jug pa bde phyir spros pa ste/ brgyud 'debs spyi ltar bya/ bsdu na/ 'jam dpal ya mān+ta ka'i dgongs pa yis: slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang : ro langs bde ba'i bar du byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: sku yi brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? mthing nag e las drag po'i gzhal yas na: gshin rje chu glang brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: 'jam dpal ya mān+ta ka gshin rje'i gshed: gshed po khro bo dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: gshin rje'i gshed po'i lha tshogs la gsol? 'og min chos kyi? sngon 'gro skyabs sems ni/ na moḥ 'di bzung byang chub snying po ma thob bar: bla ma mchog gsum 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: kun 'dus khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: gus pas skyabs mchis 'jam dpal mchog 'grub shog: gtor mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: gdug pa'i dug lnga rgyu can las byung ba'i/ sku dang ye shes mchod sprin rgya mtsho ni/ phyi nang dpag med khengs pa'i bdud rtsi mchog: sku mchog bdud rtsi gnyis bsdus thabs shes 'bar: zung 'jug gnyis med dgyes pa chen por bskyed: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum/ lha bskyed ni/ hūm̐: bskal par brtsegs pa'i zhing rdul 'byung lnga'i khams: ye nas e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ : nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ri rab steng : rdo rje rgya gram gzhal yas lte bar hūm̐: yongs gyur 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri nag: dbu dgu so bzhi'i phyag la sku smad dbal:

rdo rje dur khrod bdag mo zhal gsum sbyor: bde chen bskul ba'i mkha' nas sras bzhi 'gyed: sgo skyong las byed sprul pa bye ba 'bum: ma 'dres gtso 'khor dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas lnga'i sa bon gyis: 'og min zhing dang lho phyogs gshin rje'i gnas: rang rang pho brang klong nas spyan drangs gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: rigs bdag 'jam dpal gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs rab 'jigs dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed dug ri gshegs? sras mchog rigs bzhi? sgo skyong yang 'khor gshegs? oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol dang phyag mchod ni: hūm̐: las gshin dug ri khro bo'i tshogs: rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir bzhugs: rab gus dwang bas phyag bgyid do: phyi mchod lha mo gar sgyur 'bul: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta 'bul: spyan gzigs bkram pa sna tshogs 'bul/ bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: oṃ puṣ+pe sogs? rū pa sogs? oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta gu h+ya sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ skye med ngang las ma g.yos rigs kyi bdag: longs sku tshe yi mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod: stobs ldan dbyings phyug khro tshul dpa' stobs can/ mu stegs 'joms mdzad 'jam dpal nag por bstod: gtum drag khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: srog la rngam byed 'chi bdag gshin rje ni: phas rgol kun gyi gshed ma lho phyogs bdag: 'jigs byed kun gyi sde dpon khro bo'i rgyal: stobs ldan dug ri yab yum sku la bstod: shar lho nub byang gshin rje'i dur khrod nas: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rol pa'i gar: rigs bzhi yum sbyor ma sring dbang du sdud: sras mchog rigs bzhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

gzhan yang 'jig rten gshin rje'i bka' sdod pa: pho nya las byed sprul pa bye ba 'bum/ rlung ltar 'tshub cing dgra yul phye mar brlag /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'dus la bdag bstod do: 'dzab bskul ni: hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs: deng 'dir thugs dam gnyan po'i rgyud bskul nas: rig 'dzin sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bstan la sdang ba'i log 'dren rtsad nas chod: thugs dam dus las ma 'da' sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bzlas dmigs ni/ gtso 'khor de dag thugs ka ru: drag sngags spu gris gtams pa bzhin: 'brug ltar sgra sgrogs g.yas su 'khor: gnas pa hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las: bdag med ye shes me dpung 'bar: snod bcud gshin rje'i gshed po yi: rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ngang du gsal: oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka a kro ti ka du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzlas pa'i skyon drug spangs te gcig dril mos 'dun rtse gcig tu bsnyen pa dang*/ las rlung gi rdor bzlas dang*/ yid bzlas kyi skyo sangs dang*/ nyams kyi rtsal 'don phyir rngam dbyangs kyi bzlas pa sogs sgrub pa'i nyams dang sbyar te/ sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi srog thob nges su bsnyen cing bsgrub par bya/ gzhung las bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag bshad pa yang las rung tsam du dgongs pa las/ gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum gyi blo'i bsnyen tshad yang*/ gzhung tshig kho nar dpyod dus su 'dod pa ni ma lags so/ /de ltar lus snang stong lha sku/ ngag grags stong gsung sgra/ yid bde stong zung 'jug khyab brdal chen por dbang 'byor ba rnams gang 'dul der ston gyi ting 'dzin 'bum phrag cig car du 'gyed pa la 'di ltar spros pa che ba mi mtshar yang*/ dang po'i las can blo rmongs rnams zab lam du 'jug bde'i phyir/
