'jam dpal ye shes rol pa'i mdzod chen las/ cung zad phyung ba ste rang bzos sgro btags ni ma lags so/ /thun mtshams su mchod bstod bshags gsol ni/ ā li sku'i bskyed rim dang kā li gsung gi bzlas brjod/ yig brgya thugs kyi ting 'dzin zab mo'i klong du ma gyur bas nyams chag bshags shing*/ rten 'brel snying po'i sgo gsum ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas shing brtan par mos la/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya sbrel ba dang*/ rten 'brel snying po rnams gsum gsum bzla ba'o/ /

oṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas mchod/ hūm̐ yaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ rab gus dwang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/ āḥ 'khor 'das snang grags rdo rje gsum gyi dbyings/ sku gsum ngang rdzogs 'od gsal thig le gcig /ma skyes ma 'gags dran shes so ma'i ngang*/ mtha' yas 'gro rnams rtag tu la gnas shog / ces nyer bsdu dang bsngo ba bya ste thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug /bsnyen rtags rdzogs nas bskang brgya dang*/ me mchod ci nus su 'bad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang dmigs gsal gyi lam 'dir gcig dril rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du brtson pa/ la las bzhi lhun grub gcig chog yid bzhin nor bu'i ting 'dzin chos zab pa dang yon bdag sogs thag ring bar sgrub pa gal chen la/ tshe dbang brgya rtsa'i dmigs phran sogs zhib cha mtha' dag rdo rje slob dpon gyi zhal lung las longs shig /de ltar 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi/ phrin las zin bris snying po gsal byed ces bya ba dang*/ 'jam dpal ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du rnam par rol pa'i lta sgom gyi drod dang khungs ldan gyi man ngag zung 'brel du bkod pa 'di yang*/ 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i gsang mdzod gyis mngon par phyug pa/ me nyag sgom chen pad+ma rgya mtsho dang tshe rabs du mar mngon spyod dmod pa'i phrin las kyi bka' bab yongs su grub pa sngags 'chang kun dga' blo gros zung gis nan cher gyis bkas bskul ngo ma ldog par/ phyogs med spyod pa'i dā ri dra skyid grong smyon pas khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gshin rje rol pa'i pho brang du sbyar ba'o// // za) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed gyi rgyun khyer ni/ hūm̐:

bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed sku: mthing nag rab khros za byed ma he'i zhal: phyag gnyis dpa' ba'i mtshon cha gri thod 'dzin: gtum rngam mi bzad dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: dor stabs zhabs kyis dam sri pho mo mnan: dur khrod bdag mo ro langs yum dang sbyor: sku las skyes pa'i rdzu 'phrul me dpung 'khrigs: snang srid zil gnon gar gyi nyams su bsgom: oṃ ya ma rā dza sa twa me ya: ya me dho ru ṇa yo dha ya: ya dha yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya: yak+ṣe ya tsa ṇi ra ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā: zhes pa 'di sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rje'i zab gter las so// // 'a) ka ni shes rab bde ba chen po'i klong : pā ni thabs mchog yab kyi rdo rjes dkrugs: la ni bde stong gny-is med bdud rtsi'i mchog: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: longs sku rdo rje 'chang g-i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: mkhas pa shrī singha'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: gu ru rdo rje gro lod zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: phyag rgya rdo rje be con zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bal po bha su dha ra'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: gnubs chen bud+dha dzñā na'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: rgya ston dum rgya zhang khrom zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi:

drin chen rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: rigs kyi mgon po rnam gsum zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: go cha khro bcu yab yum zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: khro chu dug gdong yab yum zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: dgra nag gdong drug yab yum zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: me'i spu gri yab yum zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: sprul 'khor yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: sgo skyong srog bdag sde bzhi'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: las mgon bya rog gdong gi zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: drang srong khyab 'jug chen po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: gter srung klu bdud nag po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: yang 'khor dregs sde nyer gcig zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bka' gter chos skyong yongs rdzogs zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: gnas gsum du reg cing*/ bde stong gnyis med bdud rtsi'i sman mchod 'di/ /mtheb srin sbyar ba'i thabs shes phyag rgya yis/ /gnas gsum reg pas sku gsum dbang bzhi thob/ /myong ba dngos grub ma lus thob par bsam/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi ā: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrī: sman mchod 'di las mgon dang dge bsnyen gyi bsnyen sgrub la gnas tshe shrī'i ming gis sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ya) hūm̐: dam tshig mchog gi bdud rtsi 'di:

rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin brgyud bcas dang : yi dam 'jam dpal lha tshogs la: mchog thun dngos grub stsol phyir 'bul: om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos sku kun tu bzang po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: longs sku tshe bdag dbang phyug zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: sprul sku 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bdud 'joms khrag 'thung rdo rje'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: chos bdag 'jam dpal mtshan can zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: rig 'dzin mkhas mchog rdo rje'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: sngags 'chang kun dga' snying po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: mkhas grub don yod rgyal mtshan zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: kun mkhyen ngag dbang mtshan can zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: dpal ldan grags pa rnam rgyal zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: dge legs nyi ma rgyal mtshan zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: grub thob rdo rje'i mtshan can zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: yongs grags nam mkha' dbang phyug zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: kun bzang 'chi med nor bu'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi:

mtshungs med pad+ma mchog grub zhal du zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: sngags 'chang kun dga' blo gros zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: 'gro 'dul phrin las dbang phyug zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: pad+ma nges don bstan 'dzin zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: yi dam 'jam dpal khro bo dug ri me 'bar zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: khro chu dug gi sdong po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: dgra nag dregs pa 'dul byed zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: ki kang me'i spu gri'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: dug ti ma mo rigs bzhi'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: gzhan yang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bka' srung bya rog gdong gi zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: gter srung gza' klu dge bsnyen zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: bdud rtsi rang bzhin chos dbyings skye med ngang : bdud rtsi'i ngo bo yi dam lha yi dngos: bdud rtsi'i don ni mchog gi dngos grub stsol: sarba pañtsa sid+dhi pha la hoḥ ra) cho ga'i zur 'debs la/ thog mar 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid snod bcud ye nas khro bo'i sku: grags stong gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir: dran rtog g.yo med thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dal 'gro'i rgyun ltar yengs med rtse gcig tu: bsgrub la 'bad phyir 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskul: mchog thun 'dod don lhun gyis ma 'grub bar: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub lags kyi:

om̐ hriṣ+ṭi wi kri ta na na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor bcas la: khyad par mchod pa pañtsa a mṛ ta: ma hā bha ling rak+ta bcas te 'bul: bzhes nas bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: gtum chen rab 'bar gshin rje'i gshed mdzad lha: nyi ma 'bum las lhag pa'i gzi brjid can: phyag mtshan chas ldan bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: rab khros gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor bcas la: bsnyen sgrub phrin las gzhung bzhin bgyis pa la: bdag cag ma rig log rtog dbang song ba'i: 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis bzod par gsol: bzod par gsol lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pa la ya: badz+ra sogs? hūm̐: snang srid khro bo rol pa yi: sgra rnams drag sngags 'ur cher sgra: dran rtog dpa' ngar 'bar ba'i dbyings: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: rang mdangs rol gar tsam du bstod: gzhi bral gcig pa'i dngos grub stsol: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor bcas la: mthun pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po 'bul ba ni: phyi snod 'jig rten yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du: nang bcud sems can thams cad gtor mar bshams: rtsi bcud 'bru bcud 'bras bu sman gyis brgyan: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rgya mtsho 'di: khro rgyal dug ris 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs dang ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: sogs dang māṃ sa rak+ta sogs khā hi: hūm̐: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : log 'dren gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku: rab 'jigs mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams: gnam lcags dbal ldan gzi brjid me ltar 'bar:

khro rgyal dug ri'i sku la bdag bstod do: zhes so/ la) bskang rdzas rgyas pa'am mdor bsdu na tshogs rdzas tsam la dmigs nas bskang ba ni/ mar me sbar/ gsur chen gyi dud pa dang rol mo sna tshogs 'khrol zhing*/ hūm̐: gdod nas dag pa rang rig 'dus ma byas/ /rtogs na kun bzang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /ma rtogs bla tshe'i gshed po 'chi bdag nag /nyon mongs dug gsum rang shar 'gags med du/ /shar ba'i rgyud gsum sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /dar nag g.yab cing tshil chen dud pa 'thul/ khrag zhag skom sbreng rkang gling thod rnga sgrogs/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas 'bod byed na/ /dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas gnas mchog 'dir/ /dbyar gyi glog dmar bzhin du 'khyug cing byon/ /dgun gyi bu yug bzhin du 'tshub cing byon/ /thogs med 'dir byon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /rang rang dbang po rnam lnga tshim byed pa/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo/ /rab dbye dngos bsham yid kyis sprul byed nas/ /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam gnyen po bskang*/ /sman chab dri ngad 'thul ba'i mchod yon dang*/ /rnyog med bsil ba'i klung chen zhabs bsil sbreng*/ /pad dkar ku mud me tog sna tshogs phreng*/ /dri zhim sdong po bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'khrigs/ /nyi zla nor bu rtsi 'bru snang gsal 'bar/ /ga pur gur gum bsres pa bdug pa'i rdzas/ /brgya phrag ro bdas lha dang mi yi zas/ /snyan cing brjid pa'i rol mo 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /bsad khrag drod rlangs ma yal ar+ghaṃ dang*/ /mig lce rna ba sna snying me tog bshams/ /bam ro sbam po bsregs pa'i dud pa 'thul/ /tshil chen ro skra la sbar mar me gsal/ /mkhris zhag ngad pa ldan par byugs pa'i dri/ /nang rol sha rus bshos bu phreng ba bsgrigs/ /mi thod gsang ba'i rnga chung rkang gling sgra/ /gzugs mdzes lha mos gar bsgyur pi waṃ brdungs/

/bcud ldan lha mi'i bza' bcas gang ba'i snod/ /lha mis gos bzang 'jam pa'i reg bya bsdoms/ /mi sdug srin po'i drag shul gar stabs bsgyur/ /bla tshe 'gugs pa'i 'o dod phyogs bcur 'bod/ /lcang lo bhan+dha khrag zhag dri ldan phyur/ /glo snying sha khrag gtams pa'i yol gor btegs/ /dmar bshus pags pa rgyu ma'i thags par bkal/ /skam rlon thod pa bdun gyi rgyan drug bri/ /glang stag sna tshogs pags par khrag rgyun 'dzag /rtsa brgyad yan lag stong ldan a mṛ ta/ /pad rag dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khrugs/ /dam rdzas gtor ma ri bo mkha' la bsnyegs/ /stong phrag sha sna'i lhu dum brtsigs shing nyil/ /glo snying mkhal mchin mtsher pa phyur bur spungs/ /klad pa'i zhag tshil dkar dmar lha ba g.yo/ /sna tshogs sdud pa'i gram khrod sa gzhir g.yogs/ /rgyu ma'i srad bur brgyus pa'i nang khrol dang*/ /rkang lag spel mar byas pa'i lda ldi g.yo/ /zhing gi rgyal mtshan mi mgo'i tog gis mdzes/ /ro skra'i rnga yab rgyu pa'i yu ba can/ /zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod pa 'ja' ltar bkram/ /dza gad gser skyems chang phud chal chil g.yo/ /rta mchog rgyan gyis spras pa mkha' la 'phyo/ /'brong g.yag lcags ra rnon pos dgra snying 'bigs/ /'o ma'i rgyun 'dzags ba mo 'dod pa 'jo/ /'jam pa'i spu ldan lug nag rog po'i rwa/ /pho rog khra sogs gnam la 'phur dgu lding*/ /stag gzig khyi dang lce spyang seṅge sogs/ /sa la 'dzul dgu'i srog chags pha mtha' yas/ /sha rkyang la sogs ri dwags 'phyo dgu rgyug khrab rmog zhol rtags lcags phub rang srung go /mda' mdung gri sogs pha rol gcod pa'i mtshon/ /bla bre 'phan gdugs lda ldi bgrangs yas dang*/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rnam pa bdun/ /nye ba'i rin chen bdun dang glu gar ma/ /rin chen ri bo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing*/ /ma rmos lo tog gsal byed nyi zla zung*/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa'i/

/lha klu gnod sbyin dri za grul bum dang*/ /mi sogs mtho ris gnas kyi 'byor ba yis/ /rgyal ba dgongs pa brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rig 'dzin brda yi brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i? smon lam dbang bskur brgyud pa'i? bka' bab lung bstan brgyud pa'i? mkha' 'gro gtad rgya brgyud pa'i? las 'phro gtad rgya brgyud? shog ser tshig gi brgyud pa'i? rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum? 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs lnga'i? 'jigs byed dug ri yab yum? go cha khro bcu yab yum? tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum? khro chu dug gdong yab yum? dgra nag gdong drug yab yum? me yi spu gri yab yum? sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum? khram bdag bcu gnyis yab yum? sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i? sgrol byed ging chen sde bzhi'i? gsod byed bdud po sde bzhi'i? ru tra dgra mkhan sde bzhi'i? srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i? dbugs len ma mo sde bzhi'i? las byed a tsar sde bzhi'i? pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i? pho gshin sum brgya drug cu'i? mo gshin nyis stong brgyad brgya'i? las gshin brgyad khri bzhi stong? 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum? sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi? khyod kyi thugs dam bdag gis bskang lags kyi/ /bdag gi 'gal rkyen bar chad khyod kyis zlog /yar gnas pha khu bzhin du ngas mchod na/ /bu sdug tsha bo bzhin du khyod kyis skyongs/ /mkha' 'gro spun grogs bzhin du ngas bsten na/ /gdung ba'i gnyen ltar phan pa khyod kyis sgrubs/ /dam can mnga' 'bangs bzhin du ngas skyong na/ /snying nye'i bran ltar las rnams khyod kyis sgrubs/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su bskangs pa'i 'bras/ /mchod pa'i las rnams dgyes par rab bskyed de/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig sos gyur cig /mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsol ba dang*/
/byang chub sgrub pa'i sdong grogs gnyan po mdzod/ /

ces pa 'di zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis mdzad pa'i gshin rje dregs 'joms kyi bskang ba la rigs 'dres dug ri nag po'i cha lag tu bgyis pa'o// // sha) las mgon bya rog gdong gi bskang bstod ni/ hūm̐ e/ mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /pad nyi ro yi gdan steng du/ /dbyings las ma g.yos nag po che/ /legs ldan mgon po bya rog gdong*/ /shin tu khros pa'i bka' sdod gzugs/ /phyag mtshan rnon po ma rungs mthar/ /dpa' ba'i chas bcu'i rtags kyis spras/ /tsaṇ+ḍi yum 'khyud me dpung klong*/ /bzhugs mdzad stobs ldan yab yum sku/ /dpal mgon chen por bdag bstod do/ khyed kyi las byed pho nya ba/ /bdud po srog bdag mtshon gyi gzhi/ /nyin mtshan dus bzhir dgra srog nyul/ /de yi spyod pa'i ma mo bzhi/ /'bar ba dus mtshan gnas nyul ma/ /pha rol gdug pa'i srog la 'khu/ /sprul pa yab yum tshogs la bstod/ /za gsod sprul pa glog ltar 'khyugs/ /bya rog dmar nag sprin ltar gtibs/ /stag gdong dom gdong brangs se brang*/ /lcags spyang zangs 'phar 'dur ru ru/ /mon spra srin byas ku sgra sgrog /ma nges cho 'phrul 'gyed pa'i tshe/ /yang sprul tshogs la bdag bstod do/ / bya rog gdong gi bskang bstod mtshams su sbyar/ zhes pa 'di slob bu 'ga' yis bskul ngor rtsa gsum gling pas bris// // sa) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: bsnyen sgrub kha skong rten 'brel rnam gsum la brten pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'khor 'das rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid gzhi dbyings 'jam dpal dbyangs: ma 'gags rtsal snang rab 'bar gar dgus brjid: thugs rje'i sku mchog dug ri 'khor lo'i lha: man ngag don gyi 'jigs byed rang rig srog: rdo rje'i lus kyi rten 'brel la brten nas: cig car sgrub byed myur lam bskyed rdzogs kyi:

ngar 'dogs las mtha' dbyung phyir las 'di'i phrin: kun gyi kha skong ched du mdo tsam spro: de la snang cha phyi yi rten 'brel ni: gnam sa chu rlung ngam nag gru gsum sogs: rgyas pa spyi gzhung ltar gyi khyad par du: nyams dga' bag phebs ji ltar bab pa'i phyir: lo zla tshes la dbang ba'i rten 'brel lam: gang shar ma 'gags mdangs la lhums su zhugs: lus kyi chas gos stangs stabs gnas la sogs: ting 'dzin sprul sgyur nus rtsal che chung gi: yul dus babs dang bstun te brtsam bya zhing : mdun du gtsang ma'i sa stegs gru bzhi par: thig chen brgyad btab sum cha'i cha bgo zhing : lte ba'i cha la gru gsum ram̐ gyis mtshan: bar gyi cha la gnam lcags rtsibs bzhi pa: phyi 'khor cha la kha khyer gsum rim gyi: mu ran rdo rje'i phreng ba grwa bzhi ru: zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thab steng du: shing sna spang lci ci 'byor me thab brtsigs: zhi rgyas dbang drag mchog thun dngos grub sogs: nam mkha' mdzod kyi phrin las rtsal dbyung phyir: brda la brten nas 'bras bu rten 'brel bas: dkar dmar mngar skyur shing 'bras 'bru phye'i rigs: sman dug rin chen dar zab sna tshogs dang : bza' bca' ldag myong 'jam rtsub reg bya sogs: mdor na 'jig rten khams 'dir srid pa'i rdzas: rung dang mi rung blo yi kun rtog spang : tha na shing chu sa rdo hrul dor sogs: ji ltar 'byor pa de nyid tshogs su spel: g.yas su gtor tshogs g.yon du sreg rdzas bsham: gnyis pa gzhi snang lam gyi rten 'brel ni: 'khor 'das chos kun 'dzin pa rang gi sems: de nyid 'jigs byed khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du: shar tshe phyi nang bzang ngan blang dor bral: snod bcud tha dad 'dzin pa'i sems ma grub: dbyings las ma g.yos dbyings kyi rtsal snang ste: ma 'gags cho rol zang thal cir yang bsgyur: de phyir zung 'jug a ti'i sa ma dhi: skyabs sems bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod srung 'khor bsgom:

mchod bsreg rdzas rnams stabs gcig byin gyis brlab: byin 'bebs brda dbye bshags bstod dam bca' bzung : me thab bdud rtsi 'thor zhing sngags kyis sbyang : gtsang sme'i rtog spang byung rgyal me thab sbar: de nas dngos gzhi la 'jug par bya ba ste: dang po mchod rdzas byin brlab ni: oṃ badz+ra yaṃ kun ṭā k+ṣa: e wa yam shu swā hā: zhes lan gsum: thab sbyang ni: raṃ bhi wa k+ṣa swā hā: zhes lan bdun bzlas: me mgo mnan dūrba'i rgya gram thogs la: oṃ e yaṃ wa ti laṃ bha ni rak+ṣa: zhes so: de nas dgang gzar thogs la mchod rdzas rnams la reg tsam sbyangs: nī badz+ra shrī ye e raṃ laṃ bha ni badz+ra shrī ye swā hā: yam̐ bhi wa shu: ram̐ e ma u: kham̐ su wa kā swā hā: zhes rdzas rnams la reg pad kor phyag rgyas: g.yas g.yon du bskor: de nas thab la me 'jug pa ni: hūm̐: 'byung ba me yi lha mo'i tshogs: dug lnga sreg byed me thogs nas: phyogs bzhi rang rang gnas nas gshegs: 'dzin med chos dbyings ngang du sbor: raṃ ha la pañtsa swā hā: zhes me sbar zhing rlung g.yab thogs nas 'di skad do: hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar mo g.yo ba mo: gtang snyoms tshad med rlung g.yobs shig: lho phyogs ser mo spyod byed ma: dga' ba tshad med rlung g.yobs shig: nub phyogs dmar mo bde bskul ma: snying rje tshad med rlung g.yobs shig: byang phyogs ljang mo khams g.yo ma: las bzhi tshad med rlung g.yobs shig: oṃ shrī badz+ra yaṃ yaṃ ye swā hā: de nas mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐: ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: bdag gis sbyin sreg brtsam pa la: me yi 'jigs pa byung srid na: phyogs kyi sgo mas me mtshams srungs: oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes kyi me 'od mkha' ltar brdal ba 'od gsal 'bar ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor mu med 'byams klas par gyur: oṃ dzñā na dz+wa la ram̐ sarba shud+dhe āḥ de nas me lha bskyed pa ni:

hūm̐: snod kyi yangs pa 'di dag dbu ma'i zom: brdal khyab rlung ri g.yo byed 'khrugs pa'i ngar: tsha ba'i mdangs ldan 'bar mched me yi dal: ngad zil dmar chen mtsho zhag sha chen gzhi: 'byung lnga rim brtsegs ye shes 'od du 'bar: ye shes rlung lnga las grub gzhal med khang : zla phyed rdo rje kha khyer mu ran can: rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa ru: g.yo zhing 'khrugs pa'i bcud stobs ram̐ yig lnga: myur mgyogs las kun sgrub byed me yi lha: zhal phyag kun btags mtshan ma las 'das pa: 'bar mched srid pa'i ngar stobs 'khrigs pa'i klong : ram̐ yig dmar nag yongs su gyur pa las: dam tshig me lha sku mdog dmar ser can: zhal gcig phyag gnyis he ru ka pa'i chas: ral pa kham nag spyi bor gyen du bcings: g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis rdo rje bgrang phreng thogs: zhabs gnyis gar stabs gyad kyi tshul du gsal: skye med ngang nas 'bar ba'i gzi brjid bskyed: dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dug lnga bsreg pa'i phyir: ye shes me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka dzñā na ag+ne ye sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med gyur: mtshan 'dzin bud shing sreg mdzad brtan par bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bag grib a 'thas gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ ram̐ he ru ka a hūm̐ ti pū dza ye sarba sa mu tra kha kha khā hi: zhes byon skyems mar khu bsreg rdzas 'bul: bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras: me lha'i rgyal po mkha' 'grau dbang bsgyur ba: shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs sreg mdzad pa: gzi brjid me yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas bstod: me pra brtag pa sogs gzhan du shes: de nas gzhung la 'jug pa ni: hūm̐: bh+rūm̐ las gnam lcags pho brang gzhal yas khang : sogs gzhung la 'jug /spyan 'dren bya/ bzhugs gsol dang phyag 'tshal sogs nas:

hūm̐: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: 'bru bcud kun gyi bcud bsdus rtsi mchog mar: 'jigs byed dug ri'i tshogs la 'bul lags na: pha rol kun gyi gdug rtsub zhi gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye swā hā: gzhung la 'jug pa'i skabs rtsa sngags sbyar shes bya: sham bu la sgrub pa thon pa dang : sngags ma dag pa dang lhag chad kyi nyes ltung thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: mthu dbang dngos grub la bar du gcod pa sogs gong ltar/ sgrub pa la 'jug kha sbyin sreg bya na 'di ltar sham bu bya: bdag gi sgrub pa byed pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dgang gzar gyis blugs gzar gong ltar bkang la zhal du 'bul bar bsams te: oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā: phul: nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad? mchog thun mong gi dngos grub la bar du gcod pa thams cad? ces rigs 'gre bar bya: hūm̐: phyi yi mchod pa dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon: blo yis bzung dang ma bzung du ma'i tshogs: 'jam dpal gshin rje 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas phrin las lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod: dbang po rnam lnga ni: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: me tog phul: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: drag po'i sbyar spos so: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: mar me la'o: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: dug khrag gi dri chab: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: 'bru nag gi drag bshos: oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā: gri rkang gi gling bu sogs rol mo'i sgra: hūm̐: rang byung skye med chos dbyings bde ba'i snod: sha chen sman mchod ngad ldan dug rigs sbyor: 'bru bcud mnyes chang drag mchod sna tshogs 'di: khro rgyal dug ri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta swā hā: bdud rtsi sman dang bde chen nos: hūm̐: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bhan+dha'i snod mchog tu: dam nyams byad ma'i snying khrag srog gi khrag:

mkhal khrag rgyu khrag la sogs khrag rigs dang : gzhan yang ma chags chags pa chen po'i khrag: khro rgyal dug ri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra rak+ta ho swā hā: nya bo glang ma he sogs kyi sha khrag ma rul bar dam tshig go: de nas bsgral mchod 'bul ba ni bsad las ltar bya zhing : hūm̐: bhan+dha yangs pa gling bzhi'i snod mchog tu: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag ri ltar spungs: khro rgyal dug ri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ne tra ye? mig go: oṃ badz+ra gh+raṃ? rna ba'o: oṃ badz+ra ko pa t sna'o: oṃ badz+ra kin+tsa t snying ngo : de nas spyi'i rdzas la: hūm̐: phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa'i rdzas chen po: rten 'brel las byung kun kyang 'di ltar snang : khro rgyal dug ri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas phrin las lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod: oṃ kun tra sarba bo dhi bh-ik+ṣa ye swā hā: yam shing ngo : oṃ pa shu ta tri na la ye swā hā: ku sha'o: oṃ pu ki si sarba bhik+ṣa ye swā hā: dūrba'o/ /oṃ to la ka sarba saṃ bo te swā hā: zas mchog la'o: sman sna lnga ni: yid 'ong 'dod rgu las byung sna tshogs rdzas: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i sman mchog 'di: khro rgyal dug ri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas phrin las lhun gyis 'grub bar mdzod: oṃ e ma bhi wā bha saṇ+ṭa gh+raṃ ka ta mu la kāṃ swā hā: a ru ra dang dzā ti gur gum li shi tsan+dan no: 'bru sna lnga ni: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa te pu shi shwa swā hā: nas so: oṃ ma hā bha le bhi bu ku swā hā: sran ma'o: oṃ badz+ra gasma sha ka ri swā hā: gro'o: oṃ badz+ra bhi dza ri ka pu swā hā: khre'o: de nas rin chen lnga ni: oṃ swa pa ra ru shwa bhi ka shu dzu mu ku si swā hā: gser dngul zangs lcags mu tig go: sha lnga ni: oṃ na ga bha bī ka ki bh+ya shu ra swā hā:

mi rta 'brong dang bya gcan no: mngar gsum ni: oṃ ta shu kā smri ka smi pa k+ṣu swā hā: bu ram dang sbrang dkar 'o ma'o: dkar gsum ni: oṃ dha hi sa ri k+ṣu swā hā: mar dang thud gro ma'o: dar sna la ni: om̐ pa ti swa ti pa shu sa yaṃ sa maṃ ka swā hā: 'bras bu lnga ni: om̐ a pa ti kri ta ti swā hā: til dkar ro: om̐ par k+ṣa pa ka kri ta si swā hā: til nag go: om̐ pa sha ba shu da swā hā: nyungs dkar nag go: oṃ bhu wi kha pa shwa an swā hā: ke tshe shang tshe 'bras bu'o: oṃ bha ti ku la dhe hu k+ṣa swā hā: zas mchog zhun dang shing 'bras sna tshogs la'o: hūm̐: snang srid khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor la: 'jigs byed dug ri'i rnam par shar ba'i dbyings: bden rdzun gnyis 'dzin rtog tshogs phra rags dang : nam mkha' mdzod kyi mchod sprin 'od lngar 'khyil: kha mngar sku gsum ro bcud nus sbar ba: re dogs spang blang bral bar 'bul lags na: dug gsum sku gsum klong du bzhes su gsol: snang srid rdzogs pa chen por bzhes su gsol: rags pa lam la sgrib pa'i nyon mongs dang : phra ba shes sgrib lam du gol ba sogs: bag sgrib dbyings su dag par byin gyis rlobs: rim dgu'i theg pa'i dam sdom bral ba dang : khyad par gsang chen theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas: ma hā yo gar snang srid lhar ma shes: a nu yo gar sngags rlung las ma rung : a ti yo gar 'khor 'das ro ma snyoms: yo ga gsum gyi lam gyi gol sgrib rnams: spyi ti 'jam dpal dgongs dbyings rdzogs pa cher: yang ti blo 'das chen po'i klong du bshags: mngon spyod dmod pa drag po'i sgor zhugs nas: rdzong 'phrang srog gsum lta spyod gdeng ma ldan: zhing bcu ma bsgral rnam shes ma spar sogs: sku gsum sgyu ma'i klong du bshags par bgyi: tshig dang brjod pa'i dam tshig 'bum sde rnams: re dang dogs pa rang dag 'od gsal gshis: khyab bdal skye med chen po'i klong du bshags:

phyi nang snod bcud thig ler smin pa'i bcud: dbyings la 'khyil ba'i mchod sprin 'bum phrag gis: skye med chos sku'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'gag med longs sku'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : sgyu ma sprul sku'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : zhi ba dbyings kyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : phrin las pho nya'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : srid pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thugs dam bskang : 'khor 'das lam gyi mgron rigs thugs dam bskang : mchod cing bskang dang bshags pa'i 'dzin rtog kun: 'od gsal thig le chen por rdzogs sangs rgyas: chos dbyings kun tu bzang por rtag brtan shog: ces pas ting 'dzin dang bcas sreg rdzas rnams rtsa sngags kho nas 'bul: brgya rtsa'i mtshams su gzhung ltar bstod pa bya: hūm̐ ai ya bh+yoḥ skye med ngang las ma g.yos rigs kyi bdag: sogs kyis bstod: hoḥ ye shes 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: sbyin sreg mchod pa phul ba la brten nas: bdag gi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas: bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad kun: bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod klong du ma gyur pa'i: nyon grib kun rtog phra rags dang bcas pa: rang bzhin 'od gsal chen pos dag par mdzod: sarba dharma shud+dhe a āḥ

zhes bshags pa bya'o: de nas me lha gshegs gsol ni: hūm̐: nyon mongs bdud bzhi sreg byed me lha'i rgyal: dam tshig ye shes me lha 'khor bcas la: rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod gtor 'bul: 'dzin rtog phra rags med pa'i ngang du bzhes: 'jigs brgyad zhi phyir dgyes dgongs bzhes nas kyang : sbyin sreg brtsams pas las bzhi lhun grub cing : dkyil 'khor bya ba ma lus mthar phyin nas: dug lnga me dpung dbyings su bsdu bar mdzod: don gnyis yongs dag chos sku rab mngon shog: oṃ ag+ne ye a hu ti i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba sogs gzhung nas blang ngo*/ /de nas spyod lam rjes kyi rten 'brel ni/ me thab rang shi'am ni chus btul thal ba chu rlung chen por dor ram/ /yang na ri mtho'i rtse nas rlung la spur/ /phan byed rjes su bcang bar ci bder spyod/ /gzhan yang las kyi rten 'brel bca' gzhi rnams/ /dam med skye 'gros mi mthong sba ba sogs/ /sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par du/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi nyams dang sbyor/ /de ltar 'jigs byed dug ri'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bsnyen sgrub kha skong rten 'brel rnam gsum la/ /brten pa'i zhi sreg 'khor 'das rang grol zhes/ rgyud gzhung lta bu sngags tshig phyag rgya sogs/ /'thad ldan khrigs bsdebs blang dor gyis brgyan pa'i/ /dag dag ther gzugs dngos snang ma mchis kyang*/ /snang srid sku gsum rol pa'i rang mdangs tshig /'bras bu dgongs rgyan don la 'gal dang 'khrul/ /yod med don la mkhas pas rtog cing dpyod/ /nongs pa'i dri ma ci mchis bcos su 'tshal/ /rten 'brel tshig la zhen pa'i a 'thas can/ /dam nyams bdud dang 'gong pos bcos bslad na/ /nag po gsum gyis srog dbugs dga' ston rol/ /dmod pa'i bden tshig mod las 'grub gyur cig/ // ha) 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar gyi bsnyen yig yang snying kun 'dus bzhugs so//

bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dir dbang lung thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas bskyed bzlas kyi sgrub pa byed par 'dod pas/ thog mar dgra rkun la sogs kyis 'tshe ba med cing snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng sogs dang bral ba'i gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun pa rang dbang du gyur pa'i sar/ yang na gzhung las/ brag dmar chu 'gyu tsan+dan tshang tshing 'khrigs: shin tu gnyan pa srin po khros 'dra'i ri: yang na rab tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod dang : bya gcan sha gzan lha 'dre 'du ba'i gling : drag po mngon spyod 'grub pa'i gnas de ru: zhes pa ltar zla ba gang rung gi yar ngo'i gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang po dang ldan pa'i dus der/ mchod gtor gyi rgyu dang bza' btung gi yo byad sogs mthun rkyen du 'byor ba'i yo byad kyi dngos po ci dgos pa thams cad tshang dgos bsags/ grogs blo mthun zhing zhi dul kun spyod dang dam tshig dag pa mthun pa'i rkyen 'byor ba la/ skyo ngal med par bsten/ bsam pas bsnyen pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar/ stan thog 'di nyid las mi 'da' ba'i dam bca' zhing zhag zla grangs 'di tsam du 'gro bar byed ces ngang thung blos bcad kyi khrigs med par bya/ dgos nges yo byad sogs phyis gtong len dgos pa rnams thog ma nas mtshams khog tu 'jug cing*/ de ltar min pa rnams nang du btang na mtshams ral ba'i rgyur 'gro bas spang blang de dag dang ldan pa'i sgo nas mtshams la 'dug pa ni sbyor ba'i chos so/ dngos gzhi rang mdun gshin rje dug ri'i sku rab gnas can bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu ras dmar mthing gis bkab pa'i khar/ me tog gi sil ma bkram pa'i steng rin po che'i snod thod pa'i nang du dpal gtor rgyan ldan/ sku rten dar nag gi gdugs phub pa dang chos skyong spyi sger gyi gtor ma/ sman raka phyi nang gi mchod pa sogs bzang zhing rgya che ba bshams nas/

bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ thun mong gi lam gyi rgyud sbyangs pa dang*/ skyabs sems tshogs bsags rnams legs par byas nas gzhi bdag dang bgegs la gtor ma bsngo zhing*/ mtshams gcod srung 'khor saugs gzhung ltar nan tan du byed/ byin dbab pa dang mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pas bar ma chod pa rdzogs par sgom zhing bar chod na de nyid kyi slad du dran 'dun gyis bzung*/ bzlas pa la 'jug khar rang nyid gtso bo'i sku mdog dang zhal phyag la sogs pa'i rnam pa gsal ba dang*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal shugs drag po rgyun ci ring du bsgoms nas de la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /de nas ru rak+sha'i bgrang phreng snyim par bzung ste bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las phreng rdog re re bzhin hūm̐ yig las skyes pa'i gshin rje'i gshed po'i skur gyur/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa 'od du zhu ba las khrag 'dzags pa'i mgo bo'i phreng ba gyur par bsams la/ om̐ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra warta ye hūm̐ phaṭḥ lan bdun brjod de phu 'debs shing dbyangs gsal brjod/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ sngar gyi gsal snang dang nga rgyal dran bzhin pa las khyad par gtso bo'i thugs kar dmar 'od kyi 'khor lo'i gur khyim phub pa lta bu'i dbus su yab rnams hūm̐ mthing nag khog pa ya dmar nag gis mtshan pa/ yum rnams kyi thugs kar bh+yoḥdamar nag rigs bdag gi thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar ser dbang rtags 'jam dpal nag po'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag sgo ma bzhi'i thugs kar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spu shad kyis bris pa lta bu'i mthar sngags kyi phreng ba shin tu phra ba mthing zhun gyis bris pa lta bu rang mdog 'od lnga'i 'od zer 'bar ba g.yas su 'khor ba/ de las sngags kyi rang sgra dang bcas pa'i 'od zer mu med pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab par 'phros/

rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ mthu dbang byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ sems can thams cad kyi las sgrib sbyangs nas bde chen gyi zhing du drangs/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las dpag tu med pa bsgrubs nas brtan g.yo'i bcud kyi dwangs ma thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par bsdus te mtsho la char babs pa bzhin sngags phreng la thim pas 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi dbyig tu gyur/ de nas snang stong sgyu ma lta bur shar ba'i sku'i snang brnyan reg mthong gi mtshan ma yod pa ltar gsal ba las grags stong gzhom med sngags kyi rang sgra gtso 'khor thams cad kyi zhal dang*/ brtan g.yo'i dngos po thams cad las kyang bung ba'i tshang zhig pa ltar di ri ri sgrog par mos pa nan tan du byas la bzlas pa bya ste/ sngags tshig ni/ om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka a kro te ka du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa badz+ra kī li kī la sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rtsa sngags 'di 'bum phrag gsum 'gro dgos par bshad/ de'ang gang zag rab 'bring blos/ rab dgongs pa khor yug /'bring bskyed bzlas zung 'jug tha mas res gsal res mi gsal ba yengs bzlas ni lor bzlas kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung bas bskyed rdzogs la nan tan du bsgom pa shin tu gal che/ thun bsdu ba ni dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya'i mthar/ om̐ ya mān+ta ka sid+dhi ku ru swā hā/ zhes btags pa gsum mam bdun bzla/ de nas rdzogs rim bsgoms te de'i don nam lha'i rnam pa de thams cad gsal ba gzhan dbang gi rang bzhin kun brtags kyis stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug yongs grub kyi dgongs pa ltar gdod nas gnas pa'i nges shes brtan g.yo shugs drag tu bskyed pa ste/ rdo rje'i gsung tshig la/ de ltar bskyed cing gsal ba'i lha de kun/ /snang zhing stong la stong zhing kun nas snang*/

/snang stong gnyis med ngang du bskyed rim sbyang*/ zhes pa'i don bzhin bsgom pa las/ khams gsum gyi snang ba thams cad sems kyi rang mdangs su shes nas lha'i nga rgyal la brtan pa thob ste/ tha mal gyi shes pa rnam rtog mi skye zhing cung zad skyes kyang rang zhi la song ste snang ba lha'i rol par 'char bar byed pa'i gnad dam pa'o/ /rdzogs rim de las thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ste bsngo smon shis brjod dang spyod lam la 'jug /srod thun la sngar bzhin skyabs sems dang tshogs bsags tshogs zhing bsdu ba'i bar song nas srung 'khor gyi mjug tu mtshams kyi lha 'od gsal du bcug ste ting 'dzin gsum nas rdzogs rim gyi bar sngar bzhin bya chos skyong spyi sger gyi gtor bsngo byed/ 'di'i nub khro bo bsnyen pa'i zhag dang po yin tshogs bskul chad mdo brtan skyong nyer bsdu bsngo smon shis brjod kyi bar byas nas snying gar hūm̐ yig mthing ga gsal zhing dwangs pa gcig la 'dun pa rtse gcig tu gtad nas nyal lo/ /de nas tho rangs kyi thun la bab pa na/ rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed por ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la sngon gtor bzhag pa'i skyabs sems tshogs bsags srung 'khor byin dbab/ mchod rdzas brlab pa rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsum nas bzung 'od gsal du 'jug pa'i rjes su bsngo smon bya ba sogs sngar gyi dgong thun dang 'dra/ de nas snga thun phyi thun srod thun gsum la skyabs sems tshogs bsags tsam gyis chog /ting 'dzin gsum nas spyan 'dren gyi bar dkyus bzhin dang*/ mchod bstod sogs bzlas pa 'gro ched bsdus pa byed/ dam gsol dang phreng ba byin rlabs sogs mi dgos bskyed rim gyi gsal snang gi nga rgyal la nan tan bya/ bzlas mthar dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya spel tshig can dang bcas gsum re bzla/ thun bar ma gnyis la rdzogs rim gyi rjes su bsngo smon nas shis brjod dang thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang*/

thun tha ma'i rdzogs rim gyi rjes su chos skyong spyi sger gtor bsngo sogs byed/ tshogs mchod grub na legs ma grub kyang chog /gang ltar bsngo smon nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi bar sngar kho na bzhin no/ /de ltar thun bzhi'i nges pa de kho na ltar stan gyi drod ma yal ba dang thun gong du mi tshig gis bar ma chod par snying po chig dril du bzla ba gnad/ 'khor sngags rnams kyang gtso bo'i sum cha nges par 'gro dgos/ thun mtshams su bzlas pa bgyis pa ni rtsa ba'i grangs tshad la mi brtsi zhing*/ 'on kyang ngag nus bskyed pa sogs kyi dgos pa yod pas lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang skabs de dag tu yang bzlas pa bya'o/ /de ltar grangs dus mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa gsum po gang byed kyang rung ste nang par grol rgyu'i/ de ring gi dgong thun nas bzung slar yang mchod gtor gsar pa mang du bshams shing rnying pa rnams kyang kha gso/ thun bzhi'i babs spyi sngar dang 'dra ba la khyad par ni mdun gyi gtor ma yang bdag bskyed bsgom pa dang gnyis su 'jug pa gcig gi sgrub cing dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du zab mo dang sbyar te rtsa sngags rnams kyi mjug tu kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes btags pa bzla zhing las byang gzhung gi dngos grub bskul ba yang byed/ rdzogs rim yan sngar gyi thun bzhi lta bu las srod thun la tshogs mchod nges par bya/ de nas grol rgyu'i snga thun gyi dus mchod gtor gsar pa rgya chen bsham/ las byang rgyas pa btang nas chos skyong rang gzhung ltar bskang bshags tshogs mchod chad brtan sogs song rjes/ sgrub gtor lhar gsal ba la sman raka gtor mas mchod cing bstod/ mkhon bcugs sbyang phyir yi ge brgya pa mang du bzla/ de nas las byang nang ltar du/ hūm̐: bde chen gsang ba snying po rdo rje'i mkha' sogs/ om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dngos grub bskul/

rjes su mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i gnas nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ mthar lha 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas rang la thim pa'i mos pa bya zhing gtor ma sgrub rdzas rnams rang gi gnas gsum du 'jog lha 'od du zhu nas gtor ma dam rdzas bum chu dang thod rdzas sogs bdud rtsir mos la lce thog tu myangs te/ zag med kyi bdud rtsi cher 'phel bas lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad gang ba'i bde ba chen po la mnyam par bzhag /mjug chog shis brjod dang bcas pa gzhung bzhin no/ /lar zhi drag gang sgrub kyang sbyin sreg ni nges par dgos te/ ji skad du/ sbyin sreg lha rnams tshim par byed/ /tshims pa las ni dngos grub stsol/ /sngags ni lhag gam ma tshang na/ /thams cad sbyin sreg dag gis skong*/ zhes dang*/ gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing*/ /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin/ zhes pas sngags bzlas pa'i grangs kyi bcu cha'i sbyin sreg ni rang gzhung ngam/ gzhan mthun gang rigs kyang rung*/ 'das pa'i me lha go brje ba dang*/ rdzas gzhan rnams grangs ci 'byor dang*/ til gyi rdzas sngags bdun khrir laungs pa 'bul dgos la spel tshig ni/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang sngags kyi chad lhag gi nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbyar/ rjes su 'khor rnams la yang brgya rtsa re 'bul/ gal te sbyin sreg ma grub na sngags kyi kha skong tsam gyis kyang rung bar khungs yod do/ /de ltar las rnams mthar phyin nas mtshams grol ba'i tshe/ chos skyong gzhi bdag rnams la gtang rag gi mchod gtor dang*/ khyad par mtshams tho'i ye shes par mchod bstod nas gshegs gsol bar bya'o/ /spyir bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir shes par bya ba ni/ shes pa bying nas gnyid bro ba sogs byung na rig pa ngar bskyed de sngags sgra dang bcas pas bzla/

shes pa rgod cing dmigs pa mi gsal na/ ting 'dzin sems dpa' kho na la rtse gcig tu sems bzung nas shub bur bzla/ sun nyams byung na gong ma rnams kyis bzod bsran dka' spyad kyi tshul la gzhigs te hur bskyed/ rtsa khams dwangs pa dang lce bde ba'i dus sngags 'gro na myur du 'gro bar 'dug snyam pa'i brod pa mi bya/ de las ldog nas ngu dgos snyam byung na/ snying rus cher bskyed cing ngal ba mi bya/ skabs der shes pa nyog cing mi bde na ja gar ma btung ba sogs la brten/ g.yengs shing 'phyo na rus thang bu ram mur bas phan/ thun khung du kha'i phyed lag pas bkab nas gtam bya skad/ gzhan la byin rlabs dang srung mdud ster ba sogs mi bya/ thun mtshams ma gtogs bza' btung dang 'gro 'chag mang po mi bya/ nang gi yo byad kyi rigs kyang phyir mi gtong dngos grub yal ba'i rgyur 'gro ba'i mtshams khong du ma bcug pa'i mi dang yo byad nang du mi 'jug mod/ gal ste bcug na yang sang tsam yong rgyur de ring nas shes pa g.yengs shing nyog pa sems mi bde zhing gnyid yal ba sogs byung ba'i sang nyin mi dang yo byad sogs byung na/ de'i 'grul sna yin pas srung 'khor sgoms/ sngon la ma byung bar gting la byung na grib slong yin pas yig brgya mang du bzlas/ rdzas de dag kyang 'grub tu rung na zhag ma 'das par longs mi spyod/ spyir yang mtshams kyi mgo lhod pa/ bar du dam pa/ rjes su lhod par byed/ gang gi tshe yang dus gsum gyi rnam rtog che phra chu gnyer ltar shar na thol skyes de ga dran pas rtsis bzung yengs med kyi ngang nas lha dang sngags kyi sgra la sems gtad/ bde sdug dang mtho dman sna tshogs byung na 'dzin chags med par lhod kyis klod/ mtshams la thogs mar zhugs nas ma grol gyi bar du skra sen mi 'breg kha lag mi bkru/ stan mi sprug /gdan gyi drod ma yal ba byed/ mtshams grol nas kyang thogs mar dam tshig gtsang ba'i mi re gnyis dang 'phrad/

de nas rim bzhin yang par bya ste grim dang bags kyis 'dris su bcug pa gal che'o/ /de ltar tshul bzhin du legs par bsnyen pa las/ rdo rje theg pa'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub pa bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i dbang phyug chen por 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ /zhes rang nyid kyis dbang lung thob cing bsnyen sgrub song ba rnams dang*/ rig 'dzin mchog rnams kyi rdo rje'i gsung tshig la brtsam gzhi blangs nas sngags nag kun dga' blo gros kyis bris pas phyogs dus kun tu dge zhing rgyas par gyur cig/ //

a) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las/ smad las spu gri dmar po'i tha mar sbyar ba bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// na mo mañdzu shrī kro ta nirtsig ya/ 'jam dpal khro bo dug ri me 'bar gyi las mtha'/ smad las bsad pa spu gri dmar po'i tha mar sbyar ba ni/ dam tshig ldan pa'i sngags pas rang mdun du lcags kyi snod du dmar byang kheb ldan gri hom dang ldan pa la/ dbye rdzas bya 'ug gi sgro thun rdzas sna tshogs bshams nas/ rang nyid gshin rje sa ma ti'i gzi byin bskyed cing*/ bskul pa me rlung thog char gtong ba la/ las bskul bya ba'i rim pa ni: gtor ma bdud rtsi rak+tas bran: gu gul sha chen dud pa phyur: rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog: dar phyar ru mtshon sna tshogs bsgreng : bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor ngang : mi dmigs dbyings nas 'di ltar bskul: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang bas: 'jigs byed khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar skur bzhengs shig: rdo rje dur khrod bdag mo skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad phur zor kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsad bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ya ma rā dza kī la ya rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang bas:

khro rgyal khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: tshe bdag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: yum mchog khrag mig ma yang skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsregs bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kī la ya rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: ser nag rab 'jigs gru gsum dur khrod nas: khro chu dug gi gdong can skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang bas: khro rgyal khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: khro chu dug gi gdong can skur bzhengs shig: yum mchog bhe ta nag mo skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsregs bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ du tri ya ma rā dza ya mān+ta ka kī la ya rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: dgra nag gdong drug chen po skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang bas: khro rgyal khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: dgra nag gdong drug chen po skur bzhengs shig: yum mchog ya ma tsaṇ+ḍi skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang :

bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsregs bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ya ma rā dza kā la rū pa ya mān+ta ka kī la ya rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: ljang nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: ki kang me yi spu gri skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang bas: khro rgyal khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: ki kang me yi spu gri skur bzhengs shig: yum mchog srid pa stobs ldan skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsregs bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ki kang ya ma rak+sha a kro te ka kī la ya rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi zhi rgyas dbang drag sgo srung ma: las mdzad ma mo rigs bzhi skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra sdang bas: sgo skyong rigs bzhi'i phrin las dus la bab: lcags kyu zhags pa ma yi skur bzhengs shig: lcags sgrog dril bu ma yi skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa'i phung shig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsregs bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma tri ya ma rak+sha ni ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rak+ta bha ling+ta la khā hi: zhes 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams pha rol dgra bgegs kyi srog la rngam zhing las la chas par bsam/

de nas gser skyems dang gzu dpang ni/ hūm̐/ kun bzang rdor sems chos dang las kyi dbang*/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen pad 'byung mtsho rgyal ma/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gter ston 'dus pa bcas/ /rig sngags dmod pa'i brgyud gsum bla ma la/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug theg dgu'i lha tshogs dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /dug ri me 'bar dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi lhar/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul mngon spyod gzi byin bskyed/ /las mgon bya rog lha btsan dge bsnyen gza'/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang gtsang ris dpal mgon dang*/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes mthu dpung stobs rtsal bskyed/ /sa bdag rje 'khor 'bangs blon sde rigs bcas/ /lo zla zhag dus gnas 'gyu legs nyes ston/ /ko long sdom pa'i rigs kun gser skyems bzhes/ /ru nga kun spongs mthun pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ gzu dpang ni/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /zhi khro rab 'byams mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs/ /rig sngags dmod pa'i las kyi pho nya rnams/ /ma g.yel dbyings nas dus 'dir dgongs su gsol/ /sngon tshe bskal pa yar ldan dpal che yang*/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bdag cag bsod nams dman/ /jo bo dkon mchog gsum la skyabs zhus kyang*/ /lha srin 'byung pos gnod pa skyob ma thub/ /lus ngag dkar pos dge la 'bung bsam kyang*/ /grogs ngan dbang gis sdig pa'i las la bsgyur/ /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma gnong ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam ngan sbyor spangs kyang*/ /las ngan dbang gis rang dbang 'dug ma tshugs/ /de yi rgyab rten nag phyogs 'byung pos byed/ /thar pa bsgrubs kyang bar chad dbang btsan na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i dus shig nam yong ngam/

/kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma gnong ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /'dul khrims bsrungs kyang bslab sdom gnas ma nus/ /dben gnas 'grims kyang dgra jag chom rkun dar/ /lto gos mthun rkyen dam chos yal bar dor/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad sna tshogs pa/ /lo nad nor nad skye 'gro'i srog dbugs sdud/ /sdig sgrib bsags pa'i rgyu rkyen 'byung pos byas/ /sgo gsum dge la 'bad pa'i dbang mi 'dug /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma gnong ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen mtshams sbyar bas/ /bdud dgra dam sri 'byung pos 'tshe dang rgol/ /lo zla zhag dus skag sri mi mthun rnams/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i lha tshogs kyi/ /mngon spyod drag po'i stobs kyis 'dir khug la/ /bsgral zhing gsod pa'i phrin las dus la bab/ /thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo mā ra ya/ dmigs gsal mdun du dgra bgegs bskyed la/ hūm̐ yaḥ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po yi: mdun du brub khung gnam lcags hoṃ gyi nang : dgra bgegs ru tra mngon sum lta bur gsal: na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: khyad par za byed las kyi gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: bla ma'i sku dgra sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra: rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe: dgra sri phung sri dur sri sri can rigs: dmag sna ston dang jag rkun chom po'i tshogs: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gar gnas kyang : 'chi bdag pho nya rnams kyis khug la shog: dgra gzugs tha ma'i liṅga 'di la stims: dus la bab bo las mkhan mthu ma chung : oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya khug: ces rol mo drag rdung dang bcas pas/ rang nyid 'jam dpal gshed kyi thugs ka nas khro bo dang khro mo/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa lcags sgrog dang dril bu'i tshogs/

steng 'og phyogs mtshams su khyab par 'phros pas/ dgra bo byad ma'i bla yid srog gsum rang dbang med pa sbur ma rlung gis ded pa bzhin liṅga la thim par bsam/ lan lnga'am bdun dgu gsum sogs kyis gsal brtan thob par 'gugs/ spro na gzhung ltar pho nya 'gyed/ denas/ lha dbye'i rdzas bdug cing bya 'ug gi sgro thogs la/ hūm̐ yaḥ khā kha mu kha mthu mo che: mthing nag chen mo bya rog dbu: rtog med zas su sha za zhing : khyed rnams thugs dam dus la bab: hu lu mu kha mthu mo che: ser nag chen mo 'ug pa'i gdong : khyod gnyis nyin mtshan med par rgyug: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: dgra dang dgra lha phrol la shog: lus dang srung lha phrol la shog: khyo dang chung ma phrol la shog: pha dang bu gnyis phrol la shog: phu bo nu bo phrol la shog: gnyen dang nye du phrol la shog: dgra lha spyi bo'-i gtsug nas phyes: pho lha 'phrag pa g.yas nas phrol: yul lha 'phrag pa g.yon nas phrol: srog lha snying gi dkyil nas phrol: zhang lha lte ba'i dkyil nas phrol: mo lha gsang ba'i gnas nas phrol: ban bon la sogs mgon pa'i lha: rig 'dzin srung ma rgyab nas phrol: thun cung zad dang bya 'ug gi sgros g.yab/ e ya ma rā dza ma ma trag rak+sha mā ra ya phyes: ma tri ya trag rak+sha mā ra ya phyes: ya ma pra ma dgra bo skyob byed kyi lha thams cad dang phyes phyes: ki kang kā la hriṃ dgra bo'i srog la nṛ tri trig nan: e thum dzaḥ mā ra ya sha trun rbad rbad: ya ma rā dza ha la du tri kā la dgra bo byad ma lha dang phyes phyes: srog snying mgo chod tri thuṃ thuṃ: dgra bo lha dang phyes nas 'chi bdag bdud dang sprad par bsam/ thun rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i las byed sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyis/ mtshon thun sna tshogs thogs te gzugs phung tshal pa dum bur btang nas rnam shes 'pho la khad du bsams la/ thun brdeg pa ni/ hūm̐ yaḥ bzlog med khro bo nyungs dkar thun:

dmar nag ma mo khrag gi thun: mtshon thun gshin rjes dmod pa'i thun: dug thun 'chi bdag bu yug 'tshubs: mtshon thun tshwa tshwa si li li: rdo thun rbab rgod sha ra ra: me thun dbal kha lhabs se lhab: skam thun bu yug tshubs se tshub: rlon thun dug rlangs chi li li: dmod pa'i drag sngags 'u ru ru: bzlog med drag po'i thun rdzas kyis: chag che dam nyams dgra la phob: byad ma thal ba'i rdul du rlog: bh+yo bh+yo dun+tsi de ya byad ma trig trig bh+yo bh+yoḥ zhes bdud bzhi rang gshed la dbab par bsgom/ de nas gsal ba gsum dang ldan pa'i ngang du phur pa thogs te/ hūm̐: khro rgyal 'jam dpal nag po'i sprul pa ni: 'chi bdag gshin rje dgra la kī la ya: phyag gnyis 'joms byed las kyi phur bu bsgril: ru tra gdug pa'i snying la kī la ya: bcad gtub rdul du rlogs shig mā ra ya: zhes phur pa las 'od zer 'phros kho la phog /bdud bzhi rang gshed du babs nas/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa rnams bcad klad khrag dkrugs te 'dres/ gzugs phung gi 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma rim bzhin 'dus nas yal/ tshe rten āḥdang rnam shes nṛ'i rnam par 'dus pa phur pa'i rtse'i hūm̐ gis blangs nas rang la bstims pas/ āḥdakar po 'od kyi rang bzhin snying gar thim pas tshe dpal gzi brjid 'bar/ nṛ de phaṭ kyis 'phangs pas phur bu'i khong seng nas zhugs/ las ngan pa'i rnam smin bkrus/ dwangs ma hūm̐ du gyur/ rgya mdud kyi mgor thon nas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar thim par bsams la/ phaṭḥ oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan gzer thuṃ rbad myog: ces lung las/ tshe khrus dgongs pa mi ldan sngags pa ni/ sngags pa ma yin shan pa yin/ gsungs pa ltar shin tu gzab dgos/ de nas ling ro dgra bo'i sha khrag tu dmigs la zhal du bstab pa ni/ hūm̐ yaḥ 'joms byed mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yis:

dgra bgegs gzugs phung phye mar rab bshig nas: bhan+dhar bskyil ba'i sha khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes pas phul nas lhag med bzhes shing thugs dam bskang*/ ye shes 'jig rten sha khrag mchod pas 'tshengs/ /dam nyams dgra bo gzhi dbyings grol bas 'tshengs/ /bdag gi bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs 'tshengs/ /'tshengs pa rnam gsum mngon spyod khyad chos so/ /de nas tshogs la rol lhag ma btang bzlog par 'jug /zhes 'jam dpal dug ri me 'bar gyi smad las spu gri dmar po 'di nyid rang gzhung la gzhan gter mthun pas kha bkang ste/ drag po'i sbyin sreg skabs lag thogs phyir tshogs tha ma la brten nas/ rig 'dzin dam pa'i slob mar gyur pa sngags nag kun dga' blo gros kyis rang don du bris pas su yis ma mgu yang log 'dren tshar gcod par gyur cig khrom gzigs gsang sngags chos gling du bris so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// // ki) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las/ bzlog pa spu gri 'khor lo bklag chog tu bkod pa pha rol rgol 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dug gsum bdud kyi dpung tshogs thal ba ru/ /brlag mdzad 'jam dpal dug ri khro 'dus dang*/ /dbyer med gnubs ston mthu chen la btud de/ /bzlog pa spu gri'i 'phrul 'khor 'dir spros bya/

de la thog mar smad las bca' bsham ni/ grub na bzlog dkyil ma traṃ snying gar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi dang*/ de'i steng chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus su hūm̐ ya bh+yos mtshan pa sogs spyi mthun ltar bcos/ bsdu na gdan gru bzhi sum brtsegs steng rtsibs bzhi/ de'i steng chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng du khro zhal lam dmar gtor khru gang ba dang*/ yum gtor gtso bo'i phyed char slebs pa gnyis/ de'i phyi rol khro bcu/ shar du tshe bdag la gsum/ lho ru khro chu la gsum/ nub tu dgra nag la gsum/ byang du ki kang me'i spu gri la gsum/ phyogs bzhi sras bzhi la yab yum dang*/ de'i phyi rim khram bdag bcu gnyis/ sgo skyong bzhi/ ging bzhi/ bdud bzhi/ ru tra bzhi/ shan pa bzhi/ ma mo bzhi/ a tsar pho nya bzhi/ sgo ma bzhi sogs dmar gtor re dang*/ phyi rol du rtsang dmar drug cu rtsa bzhi/ phyag rtsang so gnyis/ phyogs rtsang bzhi/ rtse mor dar nag gi gdugs dang srung bzlog 'khor lo/ /sku tsaka khyung sogs drag brgyan/ sha khrag rgyu ma'i drwa ba/ bzlog mchod bsgral ling*/ srin mo za lam khro mo'i gzugs la gtor zor dang kong zor thogs pa/ 'khor las bzhir rang 'dra bya ba'am ma nus na dmar gtor gtso 'khor lnga/ 'og tu lcags hom nang liṅga bcug /phyi rol tu bsgras chas dang zor rdzas ni/ dang po kong zor la/ phung shul dgu yi sa la zur gsum khram ris can gri khrag ro sol gyis brgyan pa rtsang btsugs pa/ gshin rje'i khram zor skyer pa'i byang bu'i la khram ris btab pa/ phung rdzas sna dgu'i khu ba blug /ma mo'i dug zor btsan dug re lcag thar nu dang thang phrom re ral nag po sogs/ dug rigs ma lus lkug chur sbyar ba kong bur blugs pa/ bdud kyi rdo zor thog gis bshigs pa'i brag rdo'am/ mi bsad rbab rdo zur gsum la/ dug khrag rbad bh+yo bris/ btsan gyi snying zor 'bru nag dug khrag sbyar ba la tsit+ta zur brgyad ngos logs su rtsang gis brgyan pa/

srog bdag gi nyungs zor dur khrod byang du kha gtad pa'am/ drag po'i gnas su skyes pa'i nyungs dkar gyi gong bu btsugs pa/ gnod sbyin gyi thod zor thod par/ phung rdzas sna dgu sbrus pa thog mde'u dbyibs su bzos pa/ klu bdud khrag zor khrag sna kong bur blug pa/ gza' rgod rdor legs kyi mda' zor mda' gzhu bcas kyis bskor ba'i phyi rol drag mchod g.yon bskor bsham/ de nas dngos gzhi las kyi gzhung bsrang zhing mdun bskyed zhag sgrub ltar byas la/ bsnyen pa'i rjes rbad bsad sngags dang mchod bstod thun gtor phul la/ gsol kha spyi dang bye brag rnams song nas tshogs mchod skong bshags yan grub pa dang*/ smad las spu gri dmar po'i tha mar sbyar ba bzhin bsad pa'i rim pa grub pa dang*/ tshogs drang zhing lhag ma'i bar mthar chags su btang ngo*/ /de nas bzlog pa'i las rim dngos la 'jug pa ni/ dang po thugs dam bskul ba la/ rnga brdung dung bus gtor ma la rak+tas bran zhing dpal 'bar 'dzugs la/ hūm̐ e ya: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: mi bzad khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku mdog mun ltar 'khrugs shing stong khams g.yo: rwa gnyis rtse las bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: ma he drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: dbu dgu rab khros sa gsum sngangs shing 'dar: sum cu so bzhi'i mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: chu srin zhal nas 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: gnam lcags dbal las ser ba hri li li: zur gsum rtse nas thog ser dgra la 'bebs: srid pa 'joms byed dug ti nag mo sbyor: yab yum sku la khro chu'i tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: ba spu'i khrod nas bya khyung ya la la: rang 'dra'i khro tshogs rngam stabs gar dgu bsgyur: mthu rtsal thogs med 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: sprul pa yang sprul pha rol rgol tshogs 'joms: bzhengs shig 'chi bdag pho brang dbus nas bzhengs:

yab mchog zla gsang nag po dbyings nas bzhengs: yum mchog gshor sang dmar mo dbyings nas bzhengs: dpal chen dug ri me 'bar dbyings nas bzhengs: gsung mchog tshe bdag 'bar ba dbyings nas bzhengs: thugs mchog khro chu dug gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: yon tan dgra nag stobs ldan dbyings nas bzhengs: phrin las me yi spu gri dbyings nas bzhengs: sgo skyong sha za mched bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs: sprul pa yang sprul dmag tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dbyings nas bzhengs la rbad bskul las la chos: pha rol dam nyams ru tra gdug pa'i tshogs: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe: bsam sbyor ngan pa 'chang ba'i byad ma rnams: lo zla zhag dus tshes las ma 'da' bar: sgrol zhing brlags nas ming yang med par mdzod: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dus la bab bo 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs: stong gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka a kro te ka sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi bla srog dbugs la thun thun sha khrag la khā hi: de nas bzlog pa bya ba'i rim pa ni: gtor ma dgra ling rak+tas bran: gu gul sha chen spos kyang bsreg: rkang gling thod rnga drag tu sbir: rngam brjid dbyangs kyi nga ro yis: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs ti ra'i steng : gnam lcags rdo rje mthing nag rtse dgu pa: me zor rab 'bar lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan: de nyid lugs 'byung 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: 'jigs byed khro rgyal dug ri me 'bar sku: sku ni rab 'jigs khams gsum zil gyis gnon: gsung ni drag sngags hūm̐ phaṭ 'brug sgra sgrog: thugs ni chos dbyings mi g.yo mnyam nyid ngang : yon tan re skong sgrub la bar chad bsal: phrin las gang la gang 'dul rdzu 'phrul ston: lha mchog khyed kyi thugs rje'i nus rtsal gyis: bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la:

mi mthun bdud kyi bar chad zhi bar mdzod: sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rtsa zhal mthing nag ma he'i gdong can gyis: gshin rje yongs kyi dmod pa dgra la zlog: zhal dgu rngam zhing khros la 'jigs pa yis: khro bo yongs kyi dmod pa dgra la zlog: rigs bdag 'jam dpal rdo rje dpa' bo yis: rgya nag rtsis kyi bsgyur gto dgra la zlog: tshe bdag dmar ser mnyam par bzhag pa yis: dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad dgra la zlog: dbu skra dmar ser dbyings la bskyod pa yis: gza' dang rgyu skar gnod pa dgra la zlog: g.yas pa dang pos gri gug bsnams pa yis: snang srid yongs kyi bka' chad dgra la zlog: gnyis pas ral gri 'bar ba bsnams pa yis: lha rnams yongs kyi bka' chad dgra la zlog: gsum pas chu gri dgye mor bsnams pa yis: klu rnams yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bzhi pas me dpung 'bar ba bsnams pa yis: lha min yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: lnga pas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams pa yis: rtsa rlung thig le'i gegs skyon dgra la zlog: drug pas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa yis: ma rungs bdud kyi cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: bdun pas gnam lcags 'khor lo bsnams pa yis: ban bon yongs kyi byad kha dgra la zlog: brgyad pas mdung thung rtse rnon bsnams pa yis: mu stegs yongs kyi byad kha dgra la zlog: dgu pas lcags kyu 'gugs byed bsnams pa yis: mo rgyud ma mo'i cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: bcu pas spu gri reg chod bsnams pa yis: pha rol sbyor ba ngan pa dgra la zlog: bcu gcig mi mgo'i dbyug to bsnams pa yis: btsan rnams yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bcu gnyis ḍā ru drag tu 'khrol ba yis: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma dgra la zlog: bcu gsum dgra satwa 'bar ba bsnams pa yis: gre bo yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bcu bzhis 'ching byed zhags pa bsnams pa yis:

srin mo yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bco lngas gnam lcags tho ba bsnams pa yis: za 'dre shi gshed gnod pa dgra la zlog: bcu drug zhing gi rgya mtshan bsnams pa yis: sde brgyad yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: pho rgyud khro bo'i byad kha dgra la zlog: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: g.yon pa dang pos thod khrag bsnams pa yis: 'gong po yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: gnyis pas snying gi phreng ba bsnams pa yis: dregs pa yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: gsum pas rgyu ma'i zhags pa bsnams pa yis: ma bdud yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bzhi pas lcags kyi gtun khung bsnams pa yis: gson 'dre yongs kyiganod pa dgra la zlog: lnga pas lcags sgrog sdom byed bsnams pa yis: yul 'dre yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: drug pas gsang ba'i rnga chung bsnams pa yis: nam gru'i gdon tshogs gnod pa dgra la zlog: bdun pas mi mgo'i phreng ba bsnams pa yis: bse rag yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: brgyad pas ru mtshon 'bar ba bsnams pa yis: yul lhas bar chad gtong ba dgra la zlog: dgu pas dug rlangs smyo byed bsnams pa yis: sa bdag yongs kyi g.yo 'khrugs dgra la zlog: bcu pas dril bu drag tu 'khrol ba yis: dpa' bo yongs kyi bsu ma dgra la zlog: bcu gcig snang gsal me long bsnams pa yis: srid pa'i dal kha nad yams dgra la zlog: bcu gnyis kong zor dmar nag bsnams pa yis: ngag mnan gtad khram 'bebs pa dgra la zlog: bcu gsum khram sh-ing mkha' la gdengs pa yis: gshin rje yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bcu bzhis shwa rdel dkar nag bsnams pa yis: the'u rang yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bco lnga'i phyag na rtsis rdo bsnams pa yis: spar sme dur du tshud pa dgra la zlog: bcu drug phyag na g.yang gzhi bsnams pa yis: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs dgra la zlog:

rtsa phyag ri rab phur bu bsgril ba yis: dam sri 'gong po'i gnod pa dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mo rgyud khro mo'i byad kha dgra la zlog: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: spu gri'i sgro gshog tshwa tshwa 'thor ba yis: gdon chen bco lnga'i gnod pa dgra la zlog: yan lag lhu tshigs sbrul gyis brgyan pa yis: sa bdag klu yi gtad khram dgra la zlog: thod rlon phreng ba'i do shal brgyan pa yis: snang srid yongs kyi bka' chad dgra la zlog: thod skam phreng ba'i rgyan 'phyangs spras pa yis: rigs bzhi ma mo'i yams nad dgra la zlog: glang chen ko rlon stod du gsol ba yis: nyon mongs dug lnga'i bar chad dgra la zlog: zhing lpags g.yang gzhi rked la dkris pa yis: 'dod chags srid pa'i bar chad dgra la zlog: khrag thig zhag zo thal chen brgyan pa yis: yams nad sna dgu sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal gdangs pa yis: klu bdud pho mo'i gnod pa dgra la zlog: chu srin zhal nas sbrul zhags 'khyugs pa yis: gdol pa dkar nag gnod pa dgra la zlog: sku smad phur bu rno dbal zur gsum gyis: bstan dgra sgos dgras 'tshe ba dgra la zlog: phur rtse ru tra'i snying gar bsnun pa yis: lo rtog bdud rigs gnod pa dgra la zlog: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa yis: dug gsum las kyi bag chags ngan pa zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: ma rig nyon mongs bdag 'dzin dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: dgra bgegs ru tra ti ra'i gdan steng du: gsung gi dbang phyug khro rgyal tshe bdag sku: dbus mthing g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khros pa'i zhal: g.yas gsum mtshon cha mkha' la gdengs pa yis: steng gi lha dang lha min 'khrugs pa zlog:

g.yon gsum mtshon cha mkha' la gdengs pa yis: 'og gi klu dang sa bdag 'khrugs pa zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: khams gsum g.yo 'khrugs sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: bar nas btsan dang rgyal po 'khrugs pa zlog: sku smad phur gsham dgra la bsnun pa yis: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: zhe sdang gdug pa'i dmag tshogs dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: nga rgyal ri ltar nyil ba'i klong dkyil nas: dgra bgegs ru tra bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng : thugs kyi dbang phyug khro chu dug gdong can: mthing dkar dmar ba rab khros rngam zhal bgrad: g.yas gsum mtshon cha mkha' la gdengs pa yis: rgya gar chos kyi yi ge'i dmod pa zlog: g.yon gsum mtshon cha mkha' la gdengs pa yis: rgya nag rtsis kyi bsgyur gto dgra la zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: dgra bo'i mthu stobs gzi brjid dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: bon gyi ngan mthu sgrub pa dgra la zlog: sku smad phur gsham dgra snying bsnun pa yis: bla ma'i sku dgra thams cad dgra la zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: nga rgyal mtshan 'dzin dmag tshogs dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: 'dod chags khrag mtsho mer ba'i klong dkyil nas: dgra bgegs ru tra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: yon tan dbang phyug dgra nag dregs 'dul sku: mthing dkar dmar ba rab khros rngam zhal bgrad: g.yas gsum mtshon cha mkha' la phyar ba yis: stag gzig zor mda' 'phen pa dgra la zlog: g.yon gsum mtshon cha mkha' la gdengs pa yis: me nyag sog mo 'debs pa dgra la zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis:

dgra bo ban bon lha srung ma lus zlog: dur khrod chas kyis sku la brgyan pa yis: sum pa'i glang zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: sku smad phur gsham dgra snying bsnun pa yis: dge 'dun spyi dgra langs pa dgra la zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: 'dod chags srid pa'i bdag 'dzin dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshubs pa'i dur khrod nas: phrin las dbang phyug me yi spu gri can: mthing dkar dmar ba rab khros rngam zhal bgrad: g.yas gsum mtshon cha mkha' la phyar ba yis: sngags nag hom zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: g.yon gsum mtshon cha mkha' la phyar ba yis: li yi spar sme gdan bgos dgra la zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: ngag mnan gtad khram sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: za hor sog mo bkod pa dgra la zlog: sku smad phur bu dgra snying bsnun pa yis: rnal 'byor sgos dgra thams cad dgra la zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: phrag dog gdug sems 'chang ba dgra la zlog: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: yum mchog khro mo rigs bzhi 'khril ba yis: rtsa rlung 'byung ba rgud pa dgra la zlog: gri thod yab 'khyud rgyan kun rdzogs pa yis: srid pa las kyi byad kha dgra la zlog: hūm̐: rab 'jigs rngam pa'i phyogs bzhi dur khrod nas: las bzhi sgo skyong srog bdag ma mo bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang rang rtags phyag mtshan 'dzin: shar sgo khro mo lcags kyu bsnams pa yis: zhi ba'i phrin las sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: lho sgo khro mo zhags pa bsnams pa yis: rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: nub sgo khro mo lcags sgrog bsnams pa yis: dbang gi phrin las sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog:

byang sgo khro mo dril bu bsnams pa yis: drag po'i phrin las sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: sgo skyong ma mo rigs bzhi 'khor bcas rnams: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: lha chen drag po'i gdug rtsub zlog: lha ma yin gyi bsgyur thabs zlog: sa bdag klu yi gdug rtsub zlog: pho nya'i rbod gtong 'byung ba zlog: phur pa'i dbal kha 'phen pa zlog: nyungs dkar zor kha 'phen pa zlog: mu stegs bon po'i byad zor zlog: dus 'khrug mtshon char 'bebs pa zlog: gri btsan bsha' gri brdar ba zlog: skye bos mda' zor 'phen pa zlog: bud med dmod zor 'phen pa zlog: yul mi'i m-i kha bram mchu zlog: gnam nas bdud kyi 'bebs pa zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa zlog: bya khyung gshog sgra brdebs pa zlog: dur phag ro la 'khun pa zlog: lo khyim rten phur bud pa zlog: srung rgya tshe rgya ral ba zlog: yar gyi gnam sgo bye ba zlog: mar gyi sa sgo bye ba zlog: ma mo sman mo 'khrugs pa zlog: pha mes dur sri langs pa zlog: phyugs kyi g.yang kha nyams pa zlog: nor gyi god kha phyur ba zlog: yul la 'dre rgod chags pa zlog: sri dang mi rabs chad pa zlog: phyogs nas dgra dpung g.yo ba zlog: mtshams nas byur bzhi langs pa zlog: phugs la 'chi bdud zhugs pa zlog: mo rtsis pra rtags ngan pa zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur: mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: e ka du na e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

de nas yang bzlog rdo rje'i thog mda' ni/ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: ru tra dam sri bsnol ba ti ra'i steng : 'jigs byed khro rgyal dug ri me 'bar sku: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sku mdog dud kha ma he khros pa'i zhal: ye shes lha yi bka' chad dgra la zlog: zhal dgu rngam zhing spyan rtsa 'khrugs pa yis: steng gi lha gdon ma lus dgra la zlog: thod skam rigs lnga dar dpyangs cod pan gyis: lha min mtshon cha 'khrugs pa dgra la zlog: dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba yis: snang srid g.yo ba'i cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: snyan la drag po'i wang long brgyan pa yis: srid pa'i dal kha thams cad dgra la zlog: g.yas pa bcu drug mtshon cha gdengs pa yis: pho rgyud khro bo'i byad kha dgra la zlog: g.yon pa bcu drug mtshon cha gdengs pa yis: mo rgyud khro mo'i byad kha dgra la zlog: rtsa phyag ri rab phur bu bsgril ba yis: dam sri 'gong po'i gnod pa dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la gsol ba yis: sde brgyad 'khrugs pa'i gdug rtsub dgra la zlog: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal gdangs pa yis: za 'dre phung 'dre'i gnod pa dgra la zlog: sku smad phur bu rno dbal ldan pa yis: srid gsum gdug pa'i g.yul ngo dgra la zlog: phur rtse ru tra'i snying la gzir ba yis: dam sri'i cho 'phrul btang ba dgra la zlog: me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa yis: nyon mongs gdug pa'i dmag tshogs dgra la zlog: dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba'i sha khrag dang : dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bzlog bsgyur phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: pad+ma nyi zla ru tra'i gdan steng du: khro rgyal tshe bdag 'bar ba yab yum gyis:

sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: zhal gsum khro zhing spyan rtsa 'khrugs pa yis: zhe sdang gdug pa'i dgra dpung dgra la zlog: dur khrod dpal chas sku la gsol ba yis: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad dgra la zlog: phyag g.yas mtshon cha dgra la phyar ba yis: tshe bdud bar chad sna tshogs dgra la zlog: g.yon pas mtshon cha sna tshogs phyar ba yis: lo bdud tshe yi bar chad dgra la zlog: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal gdangs pa yis: zla bdud tshe yi bar chad dgra la zlog: sku smad phur bu me zer 'phro ba yis: dus bdud tshe yi bar chad dgra la zlog: phur rtse tshe bdud snying khar gzir ba yis: za ma chu tshod 'chi bdud dgra la zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: 'chi ltas sna dgu sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: khro rgyal tshe bdag yab yum 'khor bcas kyis: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag bzhes su gsol: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bzlog bsgyur phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: ser nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: pad+ma nyi zla ru tra'i gdan steng du: khro rgyal dug gdong yab yum skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: zhal gsum khro zhing spyan rtsa bgrad pa yis: gshin rje yongs kyi gdug rtsub dgra la zlog: dur khrod dpal chas sku la gsol ba yis: ma mo yongs kyi nad kha dgra la zlog: phyag g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs phyar ba yis: rgyal po yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: phyag g.yon mtshon cha sna tshogs phyar ba yis: btsan rnams yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal gdangs pa yis: gnod sbyin yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: sku smad phur pa'i rno dbal ldan pa yis: dri za yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: phur rtse ru tra'i snying khar bsnun pa yis:

grul bum yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: srin po yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: khro rgyal dug gdong yab yum 'khor bcas kyis: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bzlog bsgyur phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: pad+ma nyi zla ru tra'i gdan steng du: khro rgyal dgra nag dregs 'dul yab yum gyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: zhal gsum khro zhing spyan rtsa 'khrugs pa yis: rlung lha yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: dur khrod dpal chas sku la gsol ba yis: dbang ldan yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: phyag g.yas mtshon cha mkha' la phyar ba yis: gza' rnams yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: g.yon pas mtshon cha sna tshogs phyar ba yis: klu rnams yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: lte ba chu srin rngam zhal gdangs pa yis: sa bdag yongs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: sku smad phur bu zur gsum rno dbal gyis: gdon gyi gnod pa sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: phur rtse ru tra'i snying la bsnun pa yis: bdud kyi bla tshe rku ba dgra la zlog: khro rgyal dgra nag yab yum 'khor bcas kyis: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag bzhes su gsol: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bzlog bsgyur phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: ljang nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: pad+ma nyi zla ru tra'i gdan gyi steng : khro rgyal me yi spu gri yab yum gyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: zhal gsum khro zhing spyan rtsa 'khyil ba yis: snga dgra 'chang ba che sri dgra la zlog: dur khrod dpal chas sku la gsol ba yis: phyi dgra sems pa chung sri dgra la zlog:

g.yas pas mtshon cha sna tshogs phyar ba yis: da dgra byed pa rgan sri dgra la zlog: g.yon pas mtshon cha sna tshogs phyar ba yis: phyogs mtshams dgra dang gzhon sri dgra la zlog: kun kyang sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs pa yis: las bzhi sgrub pa'i bar chad dgra la zlog: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal gdangs pa yis: dur sri phung sri 'chi sri dgra la zlog: sku smad phur gsham rno dbal ldan pa yis: gri sri god sri rmang sri dgra la zlog: phur rtse ru tra'i snying la gzir ba yis: dbang thang phywa g.yang nyams pa dgra la zlog: me ri dmar nag dbus na bzhugs pa yis: chag che nyam nga thams dgra la zlog: khro rgyal spu gri yab yum 'khor bcas kyis: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag bzhes su gsol: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bzlog bsgyur phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags zlog: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags zlog: yi dam lha yi bka' chad zlog: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog: gshin rje dregs pa'i khram kha zlog: bdud kyi bar du gcod pa zlog: btsan gyi shwa rdel sprugs pa zlog: sde brgyad rtsis la thebs pa zlog: 'byung po'i thod zor 'phen pa zlog: lha min dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: phyogs skyong bcu yi hom sbar zlog: rgya gar yi ge'i dmod pa zlog: rgya nag bsgyur gto gtong ba zlog: zhang zhung dzo zor 'phen pa zlog: sum pas glang zor 'phen pa zlog: ban+des sngags zor 'phen pa zlog: bon pos gtor zor 'phen pa zlog: drang srong dmod pa zug pa zlog: skye bos mda' zor 'phen pa zlog: bud med dmod zor 'phen pa zlog: dmag jag dgra rkun thams cad zlog: brgya yi mi kha dmod pa zlog: stong gis bram mchu rdeg pa zlog: gson 'dre pho mo'i gdug rtsub zlog: gnam nas dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa zlog:
