lo nyes sad ser mu ge zlog: sme ba spar kha ngan pa zlog: skag dang phung sri langs pa zlog: god sri gyod byur thams cad zlog: gri sris shes rgyud dkrugs pa zlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: byad zor phur kha thams cad zlog: ban gyi byad kha dgra la zlog: bon gyi byad kha dgra la zlog: pho bdud mo bdud dal kha zlog: spyi bdud phung bdud dal kha zlog: bzlog cig bsgyur cig mā ra ya: e ka du na e sa bh+yo zlog zlog: rtsang bzlog pho nya bsgyur chog bya/ de nas grangs gsog ni bzlog mchod 'bul zhing*/ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: ru tra dam sri bsnol ba ti ra'i steng : 'jigs byed khro rgyal dug ri me 'bar sku: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags zlog: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags zlog: yi dam lha yis bka' chad zlog: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i sun kha zlog: gshin rje dregs pa'i khram kha zlog: bdud kyis bar du gcod pa zlog: btsan gyis shwa rdel sprugs pa zlog: sde brgyad rtsis la thebs pa zlog: 'byung pos thod zor 'phen pa zlog: lha min dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: phyogs skyong bcu yis hom yar zlog: rgya gar yi ges dmod pa zlog: rgya nag bsgyur gto gtong ba zlog: zhang zhung dzo zor 'phen pa zlog: sum pas glang zor 'phen pa zlog: ban+des sngags zor 'phen pa zlog: bon pos gtor zor 'phen pa zlog: drang srong dmod pa zug pa zlog: skye bos mda' zor 'phen pa zlog: bud med dmod zor 'phen pa zlog: dmag jag dgra rkun thams cad zlog: brgya yis ya kha dmod pa zlog:

stong gis bram mchu sdig pa zlog: gson 'dre pho mos gdug rtsub zlog: gnam gyis dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa zlog: lo nyes sad ser mu ge zlog: sme ba spar kha ngan pa zlog: skeg dang phung sri lang ba zlog: god sri gyod byur thams cad zlog: gri sris shes rgyud dkrugs pa zlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: byad zor phur kha thams cad zlog: ban gyi byad kha dgra la zlog: bon gyi byad kha dgra la zlog: pho bdud mo bdud dal kha zlog: spyi bdud chung bdud dal kha zlog: bzlog cig bsgyur cig mā ra ya: e ka du na e sa bh+yo zlog: grangs ci rigs bsag mthar dmar gtor 'phang ba ni/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ rab 'jigs dur khrod klong dkyil nas: 'chi bdag las la bzhengs pa'i sku: sgrol byed gshin rje dug gdong can: phyag na gsod byed zor mda' thogs: gzir 'debs rngam stabs khyugs se khyug: 'chi bdag dgra la dmod pa'i mtshon: btab bo ru tra'i snying la ya: myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ya ma rā dza he ka thun bh+yoḥ ki kang kā la rak+sha dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa la thun thun bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: thal brdeb bya zhing gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo*/ /de nas gsol kha mjug bsdu/ chad brtan rta bro mchod bstod sogs gzhung ltar mthar dbyung*/ ༈ nyin tha ma gtor rdzong nyin par/ bzlog pa yan gong ltar song nas bzlog pa'i mtshams su/ oṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas bzlog mchod rnams bzlog par stob/ hūm̐ yaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ rab gus dwang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/

s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kyis dbye ba'i rgyas: skad cig mdun bskyed gtor ma'i ye shes pa: nam mkhar gshegs shing gzu dpang mdzad par gyur: singha ra ṇa hūm̐ gis bsdu rgya bcas: mdun bskyed dmar chen gtor ma'i dam tshig pa: bdag gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur: sa ma ya dgra bgegs ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ slar yang sngar bzhin gtor chen skad cig gis: khro gtum mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba: 'phang ba tsam gyis stong gsum brlag nus pa'i: ha la ha la'i sdong po chen por gyur: om̐ ya mān+ta ka yak+sha ya ma rā dza dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: snying la chod chod: e ka ya ma du ru nā ga dgra bo'i sha la rbad rbad: tsit+ta zungs zungs: chum nā ga sha tri dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ki kang kā la rak+sha byad ma'i yul zhing la bh+yo bh+yoḥ raṃ ha la du byad ma'i snying rtsa la chod chod: ma mo mu kha dun+ting dgra bo'i sha la rbad: rtsa la yam yam: ra tsa snying ya ma du nag po shag tshal pa ha la ha la rak+sha rbad chod: bhan+dha bhan+dha nṛ tri khroṃ mā ra ya byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ sa ma ya ha la ha la zor ya zor ya thun ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri: sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad sod phaṭḥ thun zor gyi rdzas la sngags kyi rno ngar btags/ de nas las bskul bya ba'i rim pa ni/ gtor ma bdud rtsi rak+tas bran: gu gul sha chen dud pa phyur: rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog: phyag dar ru mtshon sna tshogs bsgreng : bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor dang : mi dmigs dbyings nas 'di ltar bskul: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang tshe: 'jigs byed khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar skur bzhengs shig:

rdo rje dur khrod bdag mo skur bzhengs shig: tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po skur bzhengs shig: khro chu dug gi gdong can skur bzhengs shig: dgra nag gdong drug chen po skur bzhengs shig: ki kang me yi spu gri skur bzhengs shig: las mdzad ma mo rig byed skur bzhengs shig: 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum skur bzhengs shig: lcags kyu zhags pa ma yi skur bzhengs shig: lcags sgrog dril bu ma yi skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa phung bshig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsad bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ki kang du tri ya ma rā dza rak+ta bha ling+ta la khā hi: bskul pa phul zhing 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams pha rol dgra bgegs kyi srog la rngam zhing las la chas par bsam/ sde brgyad gser skyems btang*/ de nas gser skyems snang srid sgo 'byed btang ba ni/ gser skyems mchod cing 'di skad do: hūm̐: phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing na bzhugs pa yi: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: yi dam chos skyong mthu ldan srung ma rnams: rnal 'byor bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol: bdag ni zol med don gyi rnal 'byor pa: byang chub sgrub cing 'gro don phan sems kyang : ma rungs bar chad sna tshogs brtsams lag pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring gtor zor dgra la 'phen pa'i tshe: dgongs brgyud slob dpon gzu dpang rgyab rten mdzod: bstan pa'i srog 'dzin gsang sngags bstan 'dzin la: dam sri bdud rigs sna tshogs brnyas btsugs nas: zab chos gnyan la sdang zhing 'tshe lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring gtor zor dgra la 'phen pa'i tshe:

brda brgyud slob dpon gzu dpang rgyab rten mdzod: 'dzam gling bstan pa'i sgron me sku gsung thugs: sdig can 'gong po'i sprul pas brnyas btsugs nas: gtsug lag dben ri gnyan po bshig lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring gtor ma dgra la 'phen pa'i tshe: snyan brgyud slob dpon gzu dpang rgyab rten mdzod: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rig 'dzin rnal 'byor la: dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams kyis brnyas btsugs nas: gdug sems ngan g.yos phung sbyor brtsams lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring gtor zor dgra la 'phen pa'i tshe: shog ser gter brgyud gzu dpang rgyab rten mdzod: nyes med rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la: gzugs can gzugs med dgra 'dres brnyas btsugs nas: tshe srog nor la bar chad sdang lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring gtor zor dgra la 'phen pa'i tshe: bka' gtad slob dpon gzu dpang rgyab rten mdzod: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di: dam sri 'dre rgod sna tshogs brnyas btsugs nas: sgrub la bar chad sna tshogs brtsams lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring gtor zor dgra la 'phen pa'i tshe: chos skyong gter srung gzu dpang rgyab rten mdzod: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang : gter bdag gzhi bdag phyogs mtshams la gnas pa'i: lha klu sa bdag lo zlar dbang ba'i lha: gdong la gnas shing 'gyu ba'i tshogs rnams kyang : rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring gtor zor dgra la 'phen pa'i tshe: g.yas g.yon steng 'og phyogs su sku bzur cig: gtor zor phog na ma nyes smras pa'i tshig: de phyir bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

de nas mdos kyi sgo dbye ba ni: sgo ma bzhi'i phyag rgya dang bcas te: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma shar phyogs pha ki na: sgo skyong dkar mo lcags kyu ma: phyag na dung gi lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs shel gyi sgo mo phyes: gshin rje'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dzaḥ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ༈ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma lho phyogs pha ki na: sgo skyong ser mo zhags pa ma: phyag na gser gyi lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs gser gyi sgo mo phyes: gshin rje'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ rat+na pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ༈ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na: sgo skyong dmar mo lcags sgrog ma: phyag na byi ru'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs zangs kyi sgo mo phyes: gshin rje'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: baṃ pad+ma pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ༈ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma byang phyogs pha ki na: sgo skyong ljang mo dril bu ma: phyag na g.yu yi lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs g.yu yi sgo mo phyes: gshin rje'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hoḥ karma pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ༈ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bskul ba'i tshe: khro bo'i lha tshogs g.yas nas bzhengs: drag sngags hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: khro mo'i lha tshogs g.yon nas bzhengs: drag mo'i bh+yo sgra de ri ri: pho nya las byed khyugs se khyug: zhing skyong dmag tshogs nyi li li: ging chen bshugs sgra tse re re: dgra lha rta rgyug brengs se breng : gzhi bdag go mtshon si li li: ba dan ru dar lhabs se lhab:

gtor zor me lce ta la la: thun zor tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: gshin rje'i gad mo di ri ri: ma mo'i srog len zhungs se zhung : dgra bo'i yul du dmag la chos: dgra dpung thal ba rdul du rlog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas za lam srin mo gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo za lam gom pa bdun cu 'das pa'i pha rol nas: snang srid kun gyi srog gi bdag mo ste: las kyi ma mo dmar nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin: ye shes grub kyang las kyi shugs 'gro ma: zor sna 'dren pa'i stobs ldan dbang mo che: phyag g.yas dmar chen gtor zor me 'bar bsnams: g.yon pas kong zor dmar nag yugs se yug: 'khor du ma mo yang 'khor bye ba 'bum: thams cad thun rdzas dug mda' sha ra ra: dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: zor gyi sna 'dren bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yoḥ rdo rje shugs 'chang las byed sha za 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: de ring mdos zor shar du drangs pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna 'dren bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yoḥ rin chen shugs 'chang rngam byed sha za 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: de ring mdos zor lho ru drangs pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna 'dren bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yoḥ pad+ma shugs 'chang gtum byed sha za 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: de ring mdos zor nub tu drangs pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna 'dren bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yoḥ las kyi shugs 'chang drag byed sha za 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: de ring mdos zor byang du drangs pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna 'dren bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma mo rak+mo ru lu dgra bo'i yul du bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces las kyi ma mo gtso 'khor thams cad kyis zor gyi sna drangs te las la chas pa'i tshe/ gdong la gnas shing 'gyu ba thams cad g.yas g.yon du sku bzur nas bdag gi rogs dan phrin las bsgrubs par bsam mo/

/gsol kha mthar dbyung*/ de nas chad tho'i bsgrags shing gtor ma bzlog par stob/ de nas ser sbreng dang bcas/ ru mtshon gzing*/ rkang gling 'bud/ dar nag g.yab/ 'phen sar 'byor ba na/ gser skyems dang gzu dpang ni/ hūm̐/ kun bzang rdor sems chos dang las kyi dbang*/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen pad 'byung mtsho rgyal ma/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gter ston 'dus pa bcas/ /rig sngags dmod pa'i brgyud gsum bla ma la/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug theg dgu'i lha tshogs dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /dug ri me 'bar dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi lhar/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul mngon spyod gzi byin bskyed/ /las mgon bya rog lha btsan dge bsnyen gza'/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang gtsang ris dpal mgon dang*/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes mthu dpung stobs rtsal bskyed/ /sa bdag rje 'khor 'bangs blon sde rigs bcas/ /lo zla zhag dus gnas 'gyu legs nyes ston/ /ko long sdom pa'i rigs kun gser skyems bzhes/ /ru nga kun spongs mthun pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ gzu dpang ni/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /zhi khro rab 'byams mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs/ /rig sngags dmod pa'i las kyi pho nya rnams/ /ma g.yel dbyings nas dus 'dir dgongs su gsol/ /sngon tshe bskal pa yar ldan dpal che yang*/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bdag cag bsod nams dman/ /jo bo dkon mchog gsum la skyabs zhus kyang*/ /lha srin 'byung pos gnod pa skyob ma thub/ /lus ngag dkar po'i dge la 'bung bsams kyang*/ /grogs ngan dbang gis sdig pa'i las la bsgyur/ /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma gnong ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam ngan sbyor spangs kyang*/ /las ngan dbang gis rang dbang 'dug ma tshugs/

/de yi rgyab rten nag phyogs 'byung pos byed/ /thar pa bsgrubs kyang bar chad dbang btsan na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i dus shig nam yong ngam/ /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma gnong ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /'dul khrims bsrungs kyang bslab sdom gnas ma nus/ /dben gnas 'grims kyang dgra jag chom rkun dar/ /lto gos mthun rkyen dam chos yal bar dor/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad sna tshogs pa/ /lo nad nor nad skye 'gro'i srog dbugs sdud/ /sdig sgrib bsags pa'i rgyu rkyen 'byung pos byas/ /sgo gsum dge la 'bad pa'i dbang mi 'dug /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma gnong ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen mtshams sbyar bas/ /bdud dgra dam sri 'byung pos 'tshe dang rgol/ /lo zla zhag dus skag sri mi mthun rnams/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i lha tshogs kyi/ /mngon spyod drag po'i stobs kyis 'dir khug la/ /bsgral zhing gsod pa'i phrin las dus la bab/ /thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo mā ra ya/ dmigs gsal mdun du hom tshang gi 'ben ling la dmigs te/ hūm̐ yaḥ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po yi: mdun du brub khung gnam lcags hom gyi nang : dgra bgegs ru tra mngon sum lta bur gsal: na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: khyad par za byed las kyi gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: bla ma'i sku dgra sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra: rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe: dgra sri phung sri dur sri sri can rigs: dmag sna ston dang jag rkun chom po'i tshogs: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gar gnas kyang : 'chi bdag pho nya rnams kyis khug la shog: dgra gzugs tha ma'i liṅga 'di la stims: dus la bab bo las mkhan mthu ma chung : oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya khug:

ces rol mo drag rdung bya/ de nas mtshon zor 'debs pa ni: sngags pa zhwa nag gos nag gis brgyan pa dmod pa byed pa dgu: btsun pa dam ldan sher snying 'don pa dgu: bon po nag po rnga gshang thogs pa dgu: skyes pa mi nag mtshon cha thogs pa dgu: bud med yug sa thal sle thogs pa dgu: g.yab pa'i dar nag po dgu: gzhan yang mtshon cha thogs pa gang mang gis tshig mtshams dang bstun pa'i bswo sgra byas la: dzaḥ dbyings nas skur bzhengs drag po'i mngon spyod mdzod: dmod pa'i las byed sngags pa nag po dgu: dam nyams dgra la thun zor char ltar phob: nyan thos byang sems dge slong dgra bcom dgu: dam nyams dgra la bden pa'-i bzlog zor ya: bon po gshang thogs bswo sgra sgrog pa dgu: dam nyams dgra la mu stegs dug mda' rgyob: skyes pa spu gri'i mtshon cha thogs pa dgu: dam nyams dgra la dbal kha char ltar phob: bud med nag mo thal sle thogs pa dgu: mya ngan dmod tshig rkyen chag dgra la phob: lo skag zla skag zhag skag dgra la phob: dus skag nad skag mtshon skag dgra la phob: rma ngo khrag ngo thams cad dgra la phob: mi shi rta chag thams cad dgra la phob: mda' chag gzhu chag thams cad dgra la phob: g.yul 'khrug mtshon gyi bskal pa dgra la phob: brub bo gling bzhi'i dgra bo da brubs shig: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog byad ma nṛ tri zlog: de nas zor rnams re re bzhin slob dpon gyi phyag tu phul la/ thog mar lha'i kong zor 'phen pa ni: phung shul dgu yi sa la zur gsum khram ris can gri khrag dang ro sol gyis brgyan par rtsang btsugs pa thogs: hūm̐: phung shul dgu las grub pa'i sa: drag po'i snying zor dmar po 'di: srid pa'i lha dmag bye ba stong : dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du 'phen: dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: oṃ de wa rā dza dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya hur thuṃ rbad: de nas gshin rje'i khram zor ni: skyer pa'i byang bu'i khram shing la:

'chi bdag nag po'i khram ris btab: phung rdzas sna dgu'i khu ba blug: khram shing lag tu thogs byas la: hūm̐: drag po tsher ma can gyi shing : 'chi bdag nag po'i khram ris btab: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs bye ba stong : dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la ya: dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: ya ma rā dza dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya hur thum rbad: ma mo'i dug zor ni: btsan dug re lcag thar nu dang : thang phrom re ral nag po sogs: dug rigs ma lus lkug chur sbyar: kong bur blugs pa thogs nas su: hūm̐: dug rdzas sna tshogs rdzas ngar btab: ma rungs yams nad 'bebs pa'i phyir: ma mo'i dmag tshogs bye ba stong : dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la ya: dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: ma mo ru lu ru lu dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya hur thuṃ rbad: de nas bdud kyi rdo zor ni: thog gis bshig pa'i brag rdo'am: mi bsad rbab rdo zur gsum la: dug khrag rbad bh+yo bris pa thogs: hūm̐: gnam lcags thog ltar 'bebs pa'i rdo: zur gsum me lce wa la la: bdud kyi dmag tshogs bye ba stong : dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la ya: dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: du pra ma yak+ṣa dgra bo byad ma'i srog la hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad: de nas btsan gyi snying zor ni: 'bru nag dug khrag sbyar ba ni: tsit+ta zur brgyad ngos logs su: drag po'i rtsang gis brgyan pa thogs: hūm̐: ru tra bsgral ba'i tsit+ta la: drag po'i mtshon cha 'phro ba 'di: btsan rgod dmag tshogs bye ba stong : dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la ya: dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: rā dza shu la raṃ dgra bo byad ma'i srog la hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad: srog bdag gi nyungs zor ni: dur khrod byang du kha gtad dang : drag po'i gnas su skyes pa yi: nyungs dkar khro zhal ldan pa ni: rkang bu btsugs pa lag tu thogs: hūm̐: sgrol ging nyungs dkar khro bo'i zhal: zur bzhi log brgyad gnam lcags 'khor:

rgyal po'i dmag tshogs bye ba stong : dam nyams dgra bo'i snying du ya: dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: nā ga rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya hur thum rbad: de nas gnod sbyin gyi thod zor ni: dam sri pho mo bsnol ba'i bu'i: ma rungs mtshan ngan thod pa ru: phung rdzas sna dgu sbrus pa la: thog mda'i dbyibs su bzo byas nas: rtsang gis brgyan pa thod nang btsugs: hūm̐: rigs ngan dam sri'i thod pa ru: thog mde'u mtshon cha gzengs pa 'di: gnod sbyin dmag tshogs bye ba stong : dam nyams dgra bo'i snying du ya: dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: sha yak+sha shu la dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya hur thum rbad: de nas klu bdud khrag zor ni: yugs sa dgu' yi mngal khrag dang : khrag sna kong bur blugs pa thogs: hūm̐: yugs sa dgu yi mngal gyi khrag: khrag sbyor nad rlangs sprin ltar gtibs: klu bdud dmag tshogs bye ba stong : dam nyams dgra bo'i snying du ya: dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: nā ga rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya hur thum rbad: de nas gza' rgod rdor legs kyi mda' zor ni: gri rgod rtsibs gzhu gri rgyus bring : gshin rje rngam rung skyes smyug la: srin bya 'ug pa pho rog sgro: gri lcags mde'u dug khrag byug: g.yas g.yon lan gsum bsgril nas ni: hūm̐: thabs kyi gzhu mchog rdo rje legs: gzhu breng ma mo sngags srung ma: gnyis med sras mchog rā hu la: mkha' la sgra gcan 'gyu bzhin du: las la thogs med ki kang rje: thabs shes yab yum khro bo yis: rbad cing las la mngags pa'i tshe: dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra sā dhu ru lu rak+mo e ka dzā ṭi rā hu la du pra ma rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas srung bzlog 'khor lo sogs bsdus la drag tu bskul pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ mthing nag rab 'jigs me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus: gnam lcags 'phro ba'i thod mkhar pho brang nas:

'jigs byed khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: mngon spyod mthu rtsal thugs dam dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dgra la zor mda' ya: tshe bdag chen po'i thugs dam dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dmag dpon sgrol bar gyi: dgra nag 'bar ba'i thugs dam dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dgra bo'i dmag mi gtor: khro chu dug gdong thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bo gdug pa'i go mtshon phye mar thongs: ki kang spu gri'i thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bo'i mi rabs bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod: sha za rigs lnga'i thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bo'i rten mkhar yul zhing phyags mas thob: pha rol ban+de dgra bo byad ma rnams: lcags kyi a tsar nag pos sgrol bar gyis: pha rol bon gyi dgra bo byad ma rnams: zangs kyi a tsar dmar pos sgrol bar gyis: pha rol mi nag dgra bo byad ma rnams: dug gi phag rgod nag pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo'i bud med byad ma rnams: bswe yi sbal pa dmar pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo'i chung rgyud byad ma rnams: gdug pa'i dug sbrul nag pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo'i sgo nor phyugs zhing rnams: lcags kyi sdig rgod 'bar bas za bar gyis: dam nyams dgra bo'i lha srung byad ma rnams: 'joms byed gshin rje tshogs kyis za bar gyis: ma rungs bdud kyi sde dpung cham la phob: dmigs pa'i byad ma dgra bo shor ra re: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa a kro rā dza ya ma ra dzaḥ sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ byad ma nṛ tri nan bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

de nas me hom sbar la/ e raṃ raṃ dz+wa la ram̐: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las e mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba ram̐ gyis mtshan pa bskal pa'i me ri smug nag tsha zhing rtsub pa'i ngar dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus su gshin rje be wa swa ta kham nag dug gi gdong pa can g.yas ral gri g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ gcer bu srin po'i cha byad can dgra bo'i srog la dbang zhing 'chi bdag gi kha gdangs pa/ de'i zhal du dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa bstabs pas zhal du bzhes te lhag ma med par mdzod cig: de nas bzlog gtor btegs la dgongs gsol ni/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: gsan du gsol lo: gzigs su gsol lo: gzu dang dpang po mdzod cig: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi bla ma: rig 'dzin brda brgyud kyi bla ma: gang zag snyan brgyud kyi bla ma: rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs: sku 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po: gsung dbang chen rta mchog rol pa: thugs yang dag rdo rje gtum po: yon tan ma mo za byed rnam rgyal: phrin las gsod byed rdo rje gzhon nu: sprul pa 'jig rten srog bdag dregs pa yang sprul dmod pa las kyi spu gri la sogs pa: sgrub chen bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga 'bum phrag so bdun gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis gsan cing dgongs su gsol: khyad par du 'chi bdag las kyi srin po 'jam dpal khro bo dug ri me 'bar srid pa gsum gyi srog bdag: yab zla gsang thig le khro chu dkar po'i lha tshogs: yum gshor sang nyi ma khros ma khro chu dmar mo'i lha tshogs: sras bzhi khro chu nag po'i rang bzhin ni: tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po: khro chu dug gi sdong po: dgra nag dregs pa 'dul byed: ki kang me'i spu gri: dug ti ma mo rigs lnga: gshed chen 'bar ba sde bzhi: srid pa las kyi 'khor lo: gsal shing dug gi 'khor lo: spu gri me'i 'khor lo: khrag mtsho chu'i 'khor lo:

smyo 'bog rlung gi 'khor lo la sogs pa 'joms byed gshin rje 'bar ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo: khyad par du bka' srung kun gyi sde dpon dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po: srog bdag bya rog gdong can: gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu: sngags bdag ma mo ral gcig: skyes bu rdo rje legs pa: shan pa btsan rgod 'bar ba: gter srung dge bsnyen me rlung spu gri la sogs pa bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams kyis gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo: gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po mngon spyod kyi las sgrub pa'i grogs dang mthu dpung bskyed cig: hoḥ ye shes dang las la grub pa'i srung ma mthu rtsal can khyed rnams la gsol zhing mchod de phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni/ ma nyes rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la sdang zhing 'tshe ba/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ dge 'dun gyi spyi dgra byed pa/ rnal 'byor bdag la ya bo bzung ba/ snga dgra yid la bsam pa/ phyi dgra zhe la bzhag pa/ da dgra thad nas langs pa/ spyi dgra rlung ltar 'tshubs pa/ sgos dgra rbab ltar rgyug pa/ zur dgra khyi ltar zug pa/ sngon sgug dang rgyab 'ded byed pa/ lo dgra lo las dar ba/ zla dgra zla bar bab pa/ zhag dgra zhag nas langs pa/ bsam sbyor log par 'chang ba'i dgra bo/ /mi nga la lha med zer ba/ lha dang srung mar mthu med zer ba/ kha dmod pas ya kha byed pa/ lag gdug pas 'phrog bcom byed pa/ phu'i chos g.yag la 'tshe ba/ mda' yi chos zhing 'phrog pa/ bar nas grwa slob bcom pa/ rkun sna jag sna ston par byed pa'i dgra bo byad ma'i gzugs dmigs yul du bcug pa/ skyes pa pho rgyud/ za ma mo rgyud/ byis pa chung rgyud/ skyob byed ban bon gyi lha srung*/ yul mkhar phyugs zhing dang bcas pa thams cad rnams kyi/

yar gnam gyi 'ju thag chod cig /mar sa'i rten phur phyungs shig /nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma bzung*/ sa gzhi dron mo la rjes ma bzhag /tshe phyi ma la dus ma btab/ mthu bu lon bzhin du snyog pa'i dgra bo 'di rnams thams cad 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje pho rgyud sprul pa yang sprul nyi khri dgu 'bum khyed rnams kyis gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs/ gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs/ glog dmar tsam gyi ljags rkyongs la za ma chu tshod tsam yang ma 'gyang par da lta nyid du bzhes shig /rol cig dgra bo'i bla srog rnam par shes pa la kha raṃ khā hi: oṃ ya ma rā dza a kro te ka be wa swa ta ya dgra bgegs kyi gzugs phung rnam shes dang bcas pa la kha kha khā hi: raṃ a hu ti dz+wa la ram̐ i daṃ du khā hi/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya ram̐: zhes gtor chen bsreg pa'am 'phang ba'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi rgyab tu yi dam g.yas su chos skyong pho rgyud/ g.yon du chos skyong mo rgyud/ mdun du chos skyong gter srung las mkhan pho nya rnams kyis mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs te dgra bo'i mkhar khang dang bcas pa ming shul tsam yang med pa rmang nas brlags par bsam/ yang na gtor ma 'bul tshul du 'phang*/ yang na gtor ma 'phen yul me hom de nyid 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul las byed pho nya dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad kyis gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdangs/ gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs/ glog dmar bzhin du ljags brkyangs nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa zhal du bstabs pas ming shul tsam yang med pa zhal du bzhes par bsams te 'phang ba'o/ /bsregs pa'i thal ba cha gsum bya/ cha gcig lam rgya gram du sba/ cha gcig chu la btab/ cha gcig rlung la phyar/ zhes gsungs so/ /de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa la kha nang du gyu nas/ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'jam dpal khro bo nag po yi:

thugs las srung ba'i gur khang nag po 'phros: dum bu rim dgu rngam pa 'jigs rung ni: phyi rol dang po ye nas stong pa'i gur: gnyis pa gnam lcags ur mo mchod rten gur: gsum pa dug rlangs khro bo nag po'i gur: bzhi pa ral gri bsam chod rdo rje'i gur: lnga pa gri gug rdo rje gtun shing gur: drug pa me ri stong nyid ka li'i gur: bdun pa 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gur: brgyad pa khro bo dkar po nang gzigs gur: dgu pa 'jam dpal dkar po shel gyi gur: de nang bsrung bya tshud nas rdo rje yi: lte ba'i hūm̐ ni gshin rje'i pho brang gyur: oṃ badz+ra ya mān+ta ka e ka ya ma du ru tsakra rak+ṣa: zhes srung 'khor bsgoms shing bsad dmigs kha phyir gyu la/ dgra bo'i steng na zangs kyi 'khor lo me las grub pa lcags bsregs kyi rang bzhin g.yas su 'khor ba: 'og lcags kyi 'khor lo rlung las grub pa dug gi sog le ltar g.yon du 'khor ba: bar thams cad dgra bgegs kyi phung pos gang ba bar med du 'khor zhing phye mar 'thags pas rdul phran bzhin brlags pa las byed pho nya rnams kyi hab sgra dir gyis lhag med rol par bsam mo: om̐ ya mān+ta ka yak+sha ya ma rā dza dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: snying la chod chod: e ka ya ma du ru nā ga dgra bo'i sha la rbad rbad: tsit+ta zungs zungs: chum nā ga sha tri dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ki kang kā la rak+sha byad ma'i yul zhing la bh+yo bh+yoḥ raṃ ha la du byad ma'i snying rtsa la chod chod: ma mo mu kha dun+ting dgra bo'i sha la rbad: rtsa la yam yam: ra tsa snying ya ma du nag po shag tshal pa ha la ha la rak+sha rbad chod: bhan+dha bhan+dha nṛ tri khroṃ mā ra ya byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ thal brdeb bya/ brtan ma skyong rta bro sogs bya ste nang du logs tshe 'gugs kyi dmigs pa ni/ dug ri'i sku las 'od zer dmar nag 'phros pas tshe bdag la phog: tshe bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer mthing ga 'phros pas 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma dang :

lha srin gyi nus pa thams cad bsdus nas rang dang bsrung bya la thim par bsgoms la/ om̐ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ā yu bh+rūm̐ nṛ rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas mchod bstod dngos grub len pa sogs las gzhung bzhin mthar dbyung ngo*/ /zhes pa 'di'ang 'jigs byed ya mān+ta ka'i grub brnyes gangs can sngags 'chang phur thogs yongs kyi rgyal po gnubs ston mthu chen slar yang sprul pa'i gter ston gyi rnam par bzhengs pa/ rig 'dzin pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'am gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes khrom gzigs rngam pa rong nas gdan drangs pa'i/ gshin rje dug ri nag po'i smad las bsad bzlog gi rim pa 'di'ang gter slob rig 'dzin chen po skyid grong smyon pas phyogs gcig tu bkod pa la gzhi bcol/ sogs khongs rnams nar gyis bshangs la kha 'geng dgos pa 'ga' zhig rang gzhung sogs las bsab ste/ gab bsdebs 'khrugs sel gyis bklag chog tu bsgrigs pa po ni gnam lcags pa 'jam dpal rdo rje ste 'dis kyang snyigs ma'i rgud tshogs ma lus dmigs med du zhi nas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid zhi blar bsgreng ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // khi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi rtsang bzlog pho nya bsgyur chog bzhugs so// 'jam dpal khro bo 'dus pa dug ri'i sku la 'dud/ sa ma ya/ zhes pa 'di yang dug ri nag po'i las rim rtsang gi bzlog pa bklag chog tu dgod pa la rnga gling rol mo drag po'i ngar sgra dang bcas pas rtsang bskul 'di ltar bya/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i pho brang e yi klong*/ /dug khrag rba rlabs stong gsum mer gyis khengs/ /dmar nag me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /las kyi 'chi bdag gshin rje'i pho brang nas/ /'jam dpal dug ri'i dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /myur mgyogs las mkhan dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /rtsal ldan dregs pa'i dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol/

/rtsang phur dur khrod gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ /dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'bul/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ hūm̐: dang po las kyi rtsang phur gang nas byung*/ /rtsang phur chos dbyings drag po'i dbyings nas byung*/ /de nas bar du rtsang phur gang nas byung*/ /lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i yul nas byung*/ /de nas mtha' ma rtsang phur gang nas byung*/ /las kyi mu stegs gshin rje'i yul nas byung*/ /ban dgra gyer tshe zhang zhung lung pa ru/ /mu stegs ston pa lnga brgya'i bla shing skyes/ /gdug rtsub phrag dog 'byung po 'tshogs pa'i gling*/ /de dag mu stegs can gyis rbad pa'i tshe/ /ngan pa'i ltas ngan sna tshogs 'thab pa'i dus/ /'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri nag po yis/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu las la bskul/ /sde brgyad snang srid snod kyi drag rtsal bsdus/ /dam can gshin rje spun dgus mgar bzo brgyab/ /sgrol byed gcod pa'i satwa re rngams chen brdungs/ /mu stegs srin po byad 'dre'i snying khrag gis/ /dgra satwa ngar btags bsgral ba'i dmod pa bor/ /de nas dregs pa srog gcod dmag la rbad/ /gshin rje dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yis/ /byad ma mu stegs bsgral zhing bla shing bcad/ /phyi pa ma hor dun ti nag po yi/ /bla srog tsit+ta dngos su blangs byas te/ /brlag shom dmod pa bor chog sgrol yang byas/ /shing de dang po shar du yo ba'i tshe/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba'i dmod pa bor/ /shing de der gshags lho ru 'gyel ba'i tshe/ /bsod nams longs spyod rgyas pa'i dmod pa bor/ /shing de der bzhogs nub tu bzhag pa'i tshe/ khams gsum srid gsum dbang sdud dmod pa bor/ /shing de der bcad byang du bsgrigs pa'i tshe/ /byad ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dmod pa bor/ /mu stegs dam sri'i snying khrag ngar kyang blud/ /las kyi gshin rje 'dus pa'i phyag tu phul/

/gnubs kyi mthu chen bud+dha dzñā na yis/ /byad ma bsgral ba'i zhing gzhi bkod byas nas/ /dam nyams ru tra'i snying la gtor ma bzos/ /mu stegs phung thod nag po'i nang du bzhag /sgrol ba'i mtshon cha bzhi ldan rtsang gis brgyan/ /dmod pa'i drag sngags thog rgod btab pa'i tshe/ /gang la btab kyang zlog med drag po grub/ /mu stegs nag po'i phyogs su lan gsum tshad/ /byad ma thams cad khrag bskyugs brgyal zhing ring*/ /dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la/ /bskul lo sngon gyi tha tshig phrin las mdzod/ hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan/ /yar gyi rtse mo chos nyid dbyings la khyab/ /mar gyi rtse mo rigs drug gnas su brjid/ /sked pa rgya mdud ka dag lhangs se lhang*/ /'od gsal rdo rje chos nyid rtsang phur 'di/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la da thob cig /a 'thas nyon mongs bag chags rtsang gis zlog hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan/ /yar gyi rtse la 'jam dpal rigs gsum rngam/ /mar gyi rtse la gshin rje'i pho brang gsal/ /sked pa rgya mdud dug ris srid gsum sngangs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs drag po'i rtsang phur 'di/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la da thob cig /ban bon mu stegs byad kha rtsang gis zlog hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan/ /yar gyi rtse la 'chi bdag tshe bdag 'jigs/ /mar gyi rtse la srog bdag ljang nag 'tshubs/ /sked pa rgya mdud dregs pa'i sde dpon 'khor/ /pha rol rgol 'joms g.yo 'khrug rtsang phur 'di/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la da thob cig /sde brgyad za kha bar chad rtsang gis zlog hūm̐: skye med rtog med 'od gsal ye shes lnga/ /tshogs drug 'khrul ba'i ngan goms rtsang gis zlog /kun gzhi gang shar khregs chod bde stong rig /'khrul rjes 'brangs pa bdag 'dzin rtsang gis zlog /lnga ldan rang grol chos sku mtha' ru phyin/ /ma rtogs 'dzin pa'i 'khrul gzugs rtsang gis zlog

/zhi rgyas dbang drag chos skyong 'dus pa yis/ /sgrub pa'i bar chad log 'dren rtsang gis zlog khro bo khro mo dam can dmod pa yis/ khro bo khro mo'i rig sngags rtsang gis zlog khro bcu khra thabs sgo skyong pho nya'i rtsang*/ /snang srid yongs kyi byad kha rtsang gis zlog /gshin rje pho mo rngam byed las mkhan rtsang*/ /dri za grul bum gdon tshogs rtsang gis zlog /gshin rje yab yum pho nya sgo srung rtsang*/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i khram kha rtsang gis zlog khams brgyad dmus long gcan spyang pho nya'i rtsang*/ /klu gnyan sa bdag gtad khram rtsang gis zlog /bya nag gcan gzan sha za bdud kyi rtsang*/ /dmag 'khrug mtshon gyi bskal pa rtsang gis zlog /dus drug rnam brgyad nyul byed pho nya'i rtsang*/ /yams nad mu ge'i bskal pa rtsang gis zlog /ki kang btsan dmag sngags srung pho nya'i rtsang*/ /ban bon ngan pa'i byad gtad rtsang gis zlog /srog bdag sde dpon sgo skyong dmod pa'i rtsang*/ /snang srid lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul rtsang gis zlog /gsod byed sman mo bstan ma ma mo'i rtsang*/ /phyugs g.yang nyams pa'i god sri rtsang gis zlog /ging dang keng rus zhing skyong bka' sdod rtsang*/ /lo zla zhag dus skag rkyen rtsang gis zlog /las mgon btsan rgod lha klu gter srung rtsang*/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i bar chad rtsang gis zlog /'jam dpal gshin rje 'dus pa'i rtsang phur 'di/ /stong gsum srid rtser gang gi bye ma tsam/ /rno ngar reg gcod gnam lcags thog rgod dbal/ /nus rtsal drag pos byad ma'i snying la thob/ /dam sri 'dre rgod 'byung po rtsang gis zlog hūm̐: bskul lo rbad do bzlog bskul bsngags pa'i tshe/ /zhe sdang nga rgyal gti mug mun rub 'tshubs/ /mtshon cha nad yams bzlog pa'i las mkhan tshogs/ /rtsang phur dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i dus/ /dam can shan pa'i rtsang phur dmar nag 'di/ /lha dang lha min bka' chad mtshon 'khrugs zlog

/gshin rje'i 'khor lo bdud kyis zhags 'debs zlog /btsan gyi shwa rdel klu yi gtad bcug zlog /ma mo'i nad sna the'u rang phung shig zlog /rgyal po'i smyo 'bog 'gong pos g.yang rku zlog /rgyal 'gong 'brangs pa gnod sbyin rtsis 'debs zlog /gza' yi byad sgrib 'dre mo mi brdzu zlog /sman mos bla rku gri bos shes dkrugs zlog /bse rag phugs tshud dbang thang za nyams zlog /longs spyod g.yang nyams dus min 'chi brgyad zlog /rbad 'dre rbod gtong pha mes dur sri zlog /gzugs med 'dre 'bod rmis ltas mtshan ngan zlog /lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rkyen ngan zlog /pho bdud mo bdud spyi bdud chung bdud zlog /bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa a kro rā dza ya ma rā dza sa ma ya/ e ka ya ma du ru tsa sha na byad ma nṛ tri trig nan e hur thuṃ dza mā ra ya/ e ya ma a ru sha trig thun ya ma kha trin ṇi trang ha la e ka ya ma he kro ta ya gh+ri ma ṇa ma ru ti sarba satwaṃ bha ya pha rol gyis byad du bcug cing khram la btab pa thams cad mā ra ya zlog zlog /e ka du ni e sa bh+yo zlog /

ces zlog sngags mang du bgrangs nas bzlog par bya/ zor dus yin na rtsang dgu blangs la zor du 'phang*/ sa ma ya/ drag sngags rtsang gi las rim pho nya bsgyur chog byad ma 'bum thub kyi bzlog pa yin pas/ rnal 'byor pa gang la la zhig gis rgyun du ma chag par bltas chog tu bkod pa 'di bgyis pas phur thogs stong la 'gras kyang*/ byad kyis mi tshugs par bstan dgra sgrol ba'i mtshon char bkod pa'o/ /mi shes mkhas 'dod can gyi thos chung lcags nag dngul bsgyur byed mkhan/ gter ston gyi zlos gar gsum pas/ kho bo bdag gis gter gzhung nas bsdus pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // gi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las/ bskul bzlog dang bsad pa smad las bcas bzhugs so// 'jigs byed dug ri sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: las bskul bya ba'i rim pa ni: gtor ma bdud rtsi rak+tas bran: gu gul sha chen dud pa phyur: rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog: phyag dar ru mtshon sna tshogs bsgreng : bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor dang : mi dmigs dbyings nas 'di ltar bskul: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar skur bzhengs shig: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs dpung tshogs kyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra sdang tshe: 'jigs byed khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar skur bzhengs shig: rdo rje dur khrod bdag mo skur bzhengs shig: tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po skur bzhengs shig: khro chu dug gi gdong can skur bzhengs shig: dgra nag gdong drug chen po skur bzhengs shig: ki kang me yi spu gri skur bzhengs shig: las mdzad ma mo rig byed skur bzhengs shig: 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum skur bzhengs shig: lcags kyu zhags pa ma yi skur bzhengs shig: lcags sgrog dril bu ma yi skur bzhengs shig:

sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ma rungs mnan gtad byad zor phur kha dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rbad 'dre dang : bsam sbyor ngan pa phung bshig rdzas sbyor rnams: bsad bcom brlag cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ki kang du tri ya ma rā dza rak+ta bha ling+ta la khā hi: zhes pas bskul te phul zhing 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams pha rol dgra bgegs kyi srog la rngam zhing las la chas par bsam: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: yang bzlog rdo rje thog mda'i nang nas: hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum sogs nas e ka du na e sa bh+yo zlog zlog: bar tshar grangs bsags dgos byung na khro chu'i gzhung nas: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur? sogs bh+yo zlog zlog yan bsags/ dang po rdzas dang liṅga 'bri thabs lag len ming gzugs byang bu sogs ni dgra brub nang ltar gsal: bskul pa dang gser skyems bshams nas 'di skad do: hūm̐: kun bzang rdor sems sogs nas sdong grogs mdzod: gzu dpang ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud sogs nas bskul lo mā ra ya: hom bskyed pa ni: hoḥ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'jigs byed chen po drag tu khros pa'i mdun du kaṃ kaṃ dmar nag las brub khung nag po lcags khang las grub pa dmar la zur ba nag la 'thug pa kha dog la: gting zab pa: zin nas thar pa med pa'i nang du: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo sngo la ham pa: skya la rid pa: mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can: bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa: mgon skyabs kyi lha dang bral ba zhig tu gyur: phaṭḥ de nas bden brdar 'gugs gzhug ni: na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sogs/ de nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ.āḥ thugs nyid dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : thabs kyi cho 'phrul gang 'dul phyir: de ring dgra la sprul pa 'gyed: 'joms byed chen po'i sku ru gsal:

dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: yi ge dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho 'phros: rigs bzhi sras mchog sprul pa ste: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma: gshin rje dug ti dkar mos zhon: gser gyi rgya stag mgo dgu la: gshin rje dug ti ser mos zhon: zangs kyi 'phar ba mgo dgu la: gshin rje dug ti dmar mos zhon: dug gi dom nag mgo dgu la: gshin rje dug ti nag mos zhon: bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs: bla chings zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs: bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab tu khur: bla bya nag po sngon nas 'jums: bla khyi nag po rgyab nas 'gyu: 'khor du srin mo sngo nag gnyis: bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re: gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de: las rlung dmar pos thums la shog: drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog: lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog: zhags pa nag pos chings la shog: gshin rje bdud mo mthu ma chung : dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: dug ti ma mo rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yoḥ ya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla rtags a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ de nas skabs su 'gugs sngags ni: dmod pa'i lcags kyu 'di bzhin bzla: oṃ e thun he thun he ya ma ra tsa thun: ka la ha la mu kha kha thun: ki kang ru tra pra ṇa ya thun: ha la ti ka li ru tra sha ti thun: ru tra a pa ka ta rur+ṇa ya thun: ki kang he pra ma thun: ru tra chaig nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya thun thun: skabs su lha dbye sngags ni: thun rgod bye ma gtor zhing : oṃ ya ma rā dza ma ma trag rak+sha mā ra ya phyes: ya ma pra ma dgra bo skyob byed lha thams cad phyes phyes: ki kang kā la hriṃ dgra bo srog la nṛ tri trig nan: e hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya sha truṃ rbad rbad: ya ma rā dza ha la du tri ka la dgra bo byad ma lha dang phyes phyes: srog snying mgo chod tri thuṃ thuṃ:

de nas lha dang dbye ba ni: hūm̐: las kyi gshin rje thams cad dang : bdag gi srung ma thams cad rnams: dgra bo'i lha lnga dbang du sdus: dgra bo'i yul lha snol du chug: dgra bo'i pho lha 'gyel du chug: dgra lha pham zhing 'thor du chug: dgra bo lha dang phrol la shog: bdag gi grogs byed dam can rnams: nyes byed dgra bo dam nyams 'di: mgon byed yul lha dbang du sdus: 'tsho byed pho lha dbang du sdus: skyob byed dgra lha dbang du sdus: grogs byed ma lha dbang du sdus: srung byed srog lha dbang du sdus: 'phog byed zhang lha dbang du sdus: le dgu'i lha srung byad du phob: bh+yoḥ khā kha mu kha dbang mo che: mthing nag chen mo'i bya rog dbu: rtogs med zas su sha la za: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: hu lu mu kha mthu mo che: ser nag chen mo 'ug pa'i dbu: khyed gnyis nyin mtshan med par rgyug: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: dgra dang dgra lha phrol la shog: lus dang srung ma phrol la shog: khyo dang chung ma phrol la shog: gnyen dang nye du phrol la shog: phu bo nu bo phrol la shog: mngon spyod drag pos rdul du rlog: oṃ ya ma rā dza ma ma trag rak+sha mā ra ya phyes: ma tri ya trag rak+sha mā ra ya phyes: ya ma pra ma dgra bo skyob byed kyi lha thams cad phyes phyes: ki kang ka la hriṃ dgra bo srog la nṛ tri trig nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥ ya ma rā dza ha la du tri ka la dgra bo byad ma lha dang phyes phyes: srog snying mgo chod tri thuṃ thuṃ: de nas thun rgod kyis brab cing brdeg: thun sngags ni: oṃ ya ma rā dza ha la ka la phe sha ka bha ru tra mā ra ya pra wa e ka nan: thun bh+yo rbad bh+yoḥ ya ma rā dza a kro ta ka dgra bo byad ma nṛ tri myog: ki kang ha la kha truṃ nṛ tri myog: dgra bo byad ma waka satwaṃ bha ya nan: truṃ truṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: ha la kha gha ya dgra bo dun+t+ri dun+t+ri rbad: pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la dgra bo nṛ tri sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad:

dgra bo'i bla pañtsa ya ya ma u grwa dgra bo'i srog la thun bh+yo rbad bh+yoḥ de nas thun brdeg pa ni: bh+yoḥ snang srid 'byung ba skar ltar 'khrugs: srid pa'i nyi zla cha lang rdeb: gnam sa kun kyang lto ba sbyor: brjid pa'i ri rab mgo mjug ldog: snod kyi rgya mtsho kun kyang skem: rtsi shing nags tshal bun ltar bskyod: las kyi me rlung stobs ldan 'ur: dug gi rlangs pas snang srid brgyal: mtshon gyi char pas skye 'gro gum: phyogs bcu kun kyang gnod sbyin zhing : 'chi bdag gad mo 'brug stong ldir: srog bdag bskal pa'i mun ltar 'khrigs: 'joms byed pho nya glog ltar 'khyug: gnam lcags dug thun thog ltar 'bebs: zi ra tshwa tshwas khor yug khengs: btab bo dgra bgegs snying la ya: e thun ban+de'i byad ma rbad: bh+yo bzlog ban+de'i byad kha zlog: e thun bon po'i byad ma rbad: bh+yo bzlog bon po'i byad kha rbad: e thun mu stegs byad ma rbad: bh+yo bzlog mu stegs byad kha zlog: e thun skye bo'i byad kha rbad: bh+yo bzlog skye bo'i mda' zor zlog: e thun bud med byad ma rbad: bh+yo bzlog bud med byad kha zlog: e thun gshin rje'i dmod pa'i mtshon: e thun dam nyams snying la 'debs: e thun dgra bo'i srog la ya: e thun byad ma myur du sgrol: e ya gshin rje'i dmod pa'i thun: e ya dmigs pa'i dgra la 'debs: e ya ming shul med par mdzod: e thun bzlog go mā ra ya: e thun dgra bo ban+dha rbad: e thun dgra bo tshan+dha rbad: e thun dgra bo ma tha rbad: e thun dgra bo da ha rbad: e thun dgra bo ha ra rbad: e thun dgra bo pa tsa rbad: e thun dgra bo shag ti rbad: e thun dgra bo a ri rbad: e thun dgra bo k+sha na rbad: e thun dgra bo tur+ṇa rbad: e thun dgra bo rba wa rbad: e thun dgra bo i daṃ rbad: e thun dgra bo'i tsit+ta rbad: e thun dgra bo nṛ myog rbad:

de nas thun mtshams su thun gtor phul: skabs su lo zla dgra gshed brjod: de nas phur bu gdab pa ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal thugs las sprul pa'i sras: las mdzad badz+ra kī la ya: mgo bo rgya mdud 'brug stong ldir: 'chang bzung dgra rbad glog ltar 'khyugs: chu srin kha nas thog ser 'bebs: zur gsum shan pa gri thogs 'bum: byad ma bdud la kī la ya: bsgral shing gtub bo kī la ya: oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bo'i tsit+ta bhan+dha bhan+dha ma ra ma ra ha la thun rbad: ces so: gnas spar ba ni: hūm̐: 'o khyod kyi rnam shes āḥdakar po zhig tu gyur nas phur bu'i khong seng nas yar thon te snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs kar thim par gyur: phaṭḥ de nas ral gri thogs la: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ gshin rje ma bzhi'i dus la bab: dug lnga bsgral ba'i phung po 'di: gtub cing phye mar dkrugs par gyis: oṃ ma mo ma dun bh+yo bh+yoḥ khaḍ+ga ya dgra bo sha khrag don snying lnga la rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yo chod chod: gtub gtub myog myog baṃ ri li rbad: ces rkang pa g.yon pa nas brtsam ste rim par gtub la: zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: 'joms byed mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yis: dgra bgegs gzugs phung phye mar rab bshig ste: bhan+dhar bskyil ba'i sha khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'jam dpal gshin rje lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: zhes 'bul: thun gtor 'bul ba ni: nṛ tri dzaḥn mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pas dgra bgegs gnod byed drag po thun gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ lan gsum bya: hūm̐: dza yig dmar nag 'phros pas gtor mar thim: spu gri'i rang bzhin gyur nas dgra bgegs gtub: tshe bsod hub bsdus rnal 'byor bdag la thim:

sha khrag gshin rje mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: bdud rtsis bran zhing : oṃ āḥhūm̐: gtor ma sman raka dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta āḥhūm̐: dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kun: dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: de ring thugs dam dus la bab: gshin rje dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: pha rol gnod byed dam nyams kyi: bla srog don snying phrol la shog: gling bzhi 'di yi sa 'og tu: rim pa dgu yi mtshams shed na: gshin rje'i yi dwags duḥkha can: cho nge 'o dod ldir ba'i gnas: de yi nang du dgra bo brub: pho brang lcags mkhar 'og tu mnan: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad du chug: kha la rgyas 'debs ma he'i gdong : dam nyams dgra bgegs zhal du thob: nyi khri dgu 'bum sa ya stong : las gshin sde tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: mngon spyod chen po'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra dam nyams dgra bgegs kyi bla srog rnam shes la kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes thun gtor 'bul zhing las kyi gnyer gtad do: gsum pa ni: mnan rtags rdzogs nas liṅga brub khung dang bcas pa mdun du bkod de: 'gugs gzhug tshar gcig song nas phur bu thogs te: e ya bh+yo dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya ba: srog bdag ya ma rā dza'i sku: zhal gsum phyag drug gnam lcags dbal: zur gsum dug gi me dpung 'bar: rtse mor las kyi mtshon char 'bebs: dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can gyi: bla srog rnam shes bshig pa'i phyir: dkar nag snying la kī la ya: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa a kro ta rā dza ya ma dgra bgegs thams cad nṛ tri trig nan e hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad:

ces pas bsgral te dbang po thams cad la khyab par phur pas bsnun: zan ling mtshon gyis gtub cing tshogs tha ma ltar zhal bstab bya: shog ling thog mar mgo bo'i phyed nas lteb: ces sogs gzhung ltar lteb la chings lpags dang bcas pa bya zhing rang gi snod du gzhug /thun rdzas kyis bkang la chas bkag: re ba dang byad thag gis bcing rtsang rgya gram du gzir: mnan chas rnams bsags: sa dmigs su dkar gtor phul la: mnan dongs brus par me bshur bya: satwa re thogs te dongs nang du gdeng tsam bya zhing : hūm̐: bdag ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: deng 'dir drag po'i las byed phyir: phyag g.yas gnam lcags satwa re thogs: g.yon pas me yi zhags pa 'dzin: g.yas kyi gnam lcags satwa re de: srid gsum nam mkha'i mthongs su phyar: thog ltar sa la phab pa'i tshe: ri rab gling bzhi phyed du gas: 'og gi rgya mtsho mer gyis gsal: de nang gshin rje ma lus kun: gnas pa 'gro dbang med par yi: mtha' rnams me yi zhags pas bskor: 'chi bdag pho brang mngon sum gsal: de nas gtad pa ni: dzaḥ gshin rje'i pho brang srog bdag gnas mchog nas: srid pa srog gi bdag po mthu bo che: srid pa'i 'khor lo 'jigs byed ma he'i gdong : gshin rje a wa glang mgo da bzhengs shig: za byed 'chi bdag 'bar ba'i kha gdongs la: gnod pa'i dgra bgegs yul mkhar sde rigs dang : sri can gdon bgegs 'byung po ma lus pa: bstab bo a wa glang mgo'i zhal du bstab: brub bo 'chi bdag gshin rje lto bar brubs: bstab bo gtad do nam yang ma shor cig:

ces mnan pa dongs su bsgyur zhing : dmod pa brub chog bya: stag shing gi phur bu btsugs la: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje las kyi dmod pa'i mtshon: srid pa'i ri rab las grub dug phur 'di: ma rungs dam sri 'byung po mnan phyir gtab: nam yang ru tra ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ ya ma rā dza kī li kī la ya he e ha la khaḍ+ga ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ nan pra duṣ+ṭāṃ nan laṃ bha ya nan satwaṃ bha ya nan mo ha ya nan ya ma ye nan ma ru tri bā ru ṇa ya tsakra nan nan: zhes dur rdo stong khams bris pas kha bkab cing : ham̐'u ya bh+yoḥ dmigs bya khang bcud 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khar: srid pa spu gri 'khor los rgyas thob la: snod kyi 'jig rten ma stong bar du rgya: nam mkha'i rlung me chu sa ri rab dang : gnam lcags mchod rten rtsibs stong 'bar bas mnan: rgyas gdab mnan no nam yang ma ldang cig: hūm̐ nan ya nan e nan sum̐ nan kham̐ nan ram̐ nan yam̐ nan mā ra ya nan nan: zhes sāts+tsha nag po dang : 'byung ba go ldog gis rgyas btab la mi mngon par dbyibs: gong gnon gyi zor gtor thogs la: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ mthing nag rab 'jigs me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus: gnam lcags 'phro ba'i thod mkhar pho brang nas: 'jigs byed khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: mngon spyod mthu rtsal thugs dam dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dgra la zor mda' ya: tshe bdag nag po'i thugs dam dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dmag dpon sgrol bar gyis: dgra nag 'bar ba'i thugs dam dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dgra bo dmag mi gtor: khro chu dug sdong thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i go mtshon phye ma gtor: ki kang spu gri'i thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bo'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: sha za rigs lnga'i thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bo'i rten mkhar yul zhing phyags mas thob: pha rol ban+de dgra bo byad ma rnams:

lcags kyi a tsar nag pos sgrol bar gyis: pha rol bon po dgra bo byad ma rnams: zangs kyi a tsar dmar pos sgrol bar gyis: pha rol mi nag dgra bo byad ma rnams: dug gi phag rgod nag pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo bud med byad ma rnams: bswe yi sbal pa dmar pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo chung rgyud byad ma rnams: gdug pa'i dug sbrul nag pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo sgo nor phyugs zhing rnams: lcags kyi sdig rgod 'bar bas za bar gyis: dam nyams dgra bo byad ma lha srung rnams: 'joms byed gshin rje tshogs kyis sgrol bar mdzod: ma rungs bdud kyi sde dpung cham la phob: dmigs pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs shor ra re: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa a kro rā dza ya ma rā dza sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ byad ma nṛ tri trig nan ha bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces mnan pa'i steng ngam dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ bshal chus brtan ma bskyang*/ gtor snod mnan steng du kha sbub la rta bro brdung*/ srung 'khor dang bcas rang gnas su log /bdag gi rnal 'byor gyis sgo nas mchod bstod bzod gsol nyer bsdu bsngo smon sogs las kyi rjes mi mngon bar bsdu bas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /sri mnan cho ga nag 'gros dang dgra brub las rlung mnan pa'i las rim sogs gab 'khrugs rgya cher 'dug kyang dus mtha'i rmongs pa'i gab sel gyi phyir du/ bdud 'joms pas bka' phebs gtsug tu khur zhing pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'i sku phreng lnga pa nges don chos dbyings rang grol gyis chog bsgrigs su bkod pas bdud bzhi ma lus pa'i g.yul las rgyal zhing rgyal bstan dar rgyas yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ngi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi gser skyems shan pa dmag bskul bzhugs so//

hūm̐/ kun bzang rdor sems chos dang las kyi dbang*/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen pad 'byung mtsho rgyal ma/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gter ston 'dus par bcas/ /rig sngags dmod pa'i brgyud gsum bla ma la/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug theg rim dgu'i lha tshogs/ khyad par bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /dug ri me 'bar dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi lha/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul mngon spyod gzi byin skyed/ /las mgon bya rog lha btsan dge bsnyen gza'/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang gtsang ris dpal mgon dang*/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud dam can rgya tsho'i tshogs/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes mthu dpung stobs rtsal skyed/ /sa bdag rje blon 'bangs 'khor sde rigs bcas/ /lo zla zhag dus gnas 'gyu legs nyes ston/ /ko long sdom pa'i rigs kun gser skyems bzhes/ /ru nga kun spongs mthun pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ gzu dpang ni/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /zhi khro rab 'byams mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs/ /rig sngags dmod pa las kyi pho nya rnams/ /ma g.yel dbyings nas dus 'dir dgongs su gsol/ /sngon tshe bskal pa yar ldan dpal che yang*/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bdag cag bsod nams dman/ /jo bo dkon mchog gsum la skyabs zhus kyang*/ /lha srin 'byung pos gnod pa skyob ma thub/ /lus ngag dkar po dge la 'bung bsam kyang*/ /grogs ngan dbang gis sdig pa'i las la bsgyur/ /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam ngan sbyor spangs kyang*/ las ngan dbang gis rang dbang 'dus ma tshugs/ /de yi rgyab rten nag phyogs 'byung pos byed/ /thar pa bsgrubs kyang bar chad dbang btsan na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i dus zhig nam yong ngam/ /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/

/ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /'dul khrims bsrungs kyang bslab sdom gnas ma nus/ /dben gnas 'grims kyang dgra jag chom rkun dar/ /lto gos mthu chen dam chos yal bar dor/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad sna tshogs pa/ /lo nad nor nad skye 'gro'i srog dbugs sdud/ /sdig sgrib bsags pa'i rgyu rkyen 'byung pos byas/ /sgo gsum dge la 'bad pa'i dbang mi 'dug /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen mtshams sbyor ba'i/ /bdud dgra dam sri 'byung pos 'tshe dang rgod/ /lo zla zhag dus skag sri mi mthun rnams/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i lha tshogs kyis/ /mngon spyod drag po'i stobs kyis 'dir khug la/ /bsgral zhing mnan pa'i phrin las dus la bab/ /thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo mā ra ya/ zhes dgra mnan gyi skabs su lag thogs pas/ gter chen de nyid kyi spyan sngar bka' bab rjes su gnang ba sngags 'chang skyid grong smyon pas gang shar la 'ur bris pas bstan dgra tshar gcod shog/ // ci) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi drag po'i sbyin sreg las mtha' gdug pa kun 'joms bzhugs so// dus gsum rgyal kun mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal/ /gtum drag nyams brgyar 'bar ba'i ye shes mes/ /ma rungs bdud sde'i tshogs kun rab bsregs nas/ /mngon spyod las kun 'grub pa'i 'dod don stsol/ de'ang dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sngags pas/ dur khrod dam lho phyogs drag po'i sa gzhi nag cing rtsub pa'i gnas su/ lo zla tshes grangs dus tshod rtsub cing gza' skar 'phrod sbyor ngan pa'i dus su gdug pa'i sa sna gsum gyi stegs bu mda' gang ngam ni khru gang gi khar/ ma traṃ gyi lto bar thab khung gru gsum pa kha khyer sum rim rgya sor nyi shu dpangs su sor bcu gcig las mi dman pa ro sol dang dug khrag gis byugs pa'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa chos 'byung dang bcas pa bri/

thab nang du drag shing tsher ma can dug khrag gis sbags pa'i hom me tshang ting lo sogs tshad dang ldan pa bca'/ g.yas ngos su me srog 'dzin pa'i rdzas yam shing zur gsum sor bcu gnyis pa dang*/ mar nag tshil zhun gyis sbags pa rtsa ba'i rdzas/ dmigs bya'i ru pa ming rus can grangs ldan/ drag po'i rdzas sha sna bag phye dang bsres pa'i ril bu ming rus can/ gnad kyi rdzas sbal sbrul gyi sha dang dug sna/ bsad pa'i rdzas zangs lcags rdo'i phye ma/ myos pa'i rdzas dmar nag dom bsnol gyi khrag /tsha ba'i rdzas til dang nyungs dkar tsha ba gsum/ de ltar rdzas bdun po lcags sam thod pa'i nang du gral rim gyis bkod/ g.yon ngos chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi nang gi nyer spyod/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sman raka dang bcas pa bsham/ mdun du las bum rdor dril dgang blugs me tog sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar 'du byas/ thog mar skyabs sems nas tshogs lhag gi bar phrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs te/ rgyu dus kyi kun slong snying rje bskyed cing dus kyi kun slong*/ zhing bcu sgrol ba'i zhe sdang dang ldan pas chas gos nag po gyon/ mi mgo'i thod phreng dang rus rgyan sogs kyi do shal byas/ zhing lpags kyi gdan la ngag bcad nas kha lho phyogs su 'god/ las bum gyi nang du las gshin bskyed pa ni/ ya ma rā dza sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ las bum dbus su pad nyi'i steng*/ /dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed sku/ /mthing nag rab khros ma he'i zhal/ /phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /gtum rngam mi bzad dpal chas rdzogs/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum gnas pa las/ /'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs/ /rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs gyur/ om̐ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da'i

bar gyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod nas bzlas pa'i tshe/ bdag gi thugs las sngags kyi phreng ba thon nas gzung thag la 'khril te bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar zhugs par gyur/ om̐ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes pa yang snying rtsa sngags brgya rtsa bzlas/ dung chos kyi chu/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ gis phul/ lha thams cad chags pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas byang chub kyi sems su ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas bsang sbyang ni/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du: nṛ dang tri las dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag phung khams skye mched las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams ngo bo zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnam pa so so'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pas nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ bsams la/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da bar du mchod rdzas/ om̐ ya mān+ta ka nṛ tri mā ra ya dza dzaḥ lan gsum gyi sreg rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab/ gdol gshin dme yugs kyi mes ting lo sbar ba dang bcas pas/ om̐ ag+ne ye ha byā ka byā dzaḥ mar nag blugs gzar bdun gyis gso/ chaig mo mā ra ya dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes blugs la rlung g.yab dang bcas me sbar/ me thab bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las drag po'i thab khung nag po gru gsum bang rim sum ldan chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i nang du: ra skyes kham pa 'ja' 'od dang glog gis dkrigs pa zhing gi sga dang pags pas g.yogs te sbrul nag gi gong smed byas pa'i steng du: rang gi thugs ka nas byung ba'i ram̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las: drag po'i me lha mthing nag gtum po 'jigs pa'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang bgrang phreng g.yon gnyis dbyug pa ghaṇ+ḍe bsnams pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur: rang gi thugs ka nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho bzhi spros ye shes kyi me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs:

bar bsams la/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur gshegs me lha drang srong che: rang gi dam tshig tshul bzhin du: 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ e h+ya hi bha ga wan dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ag+ni dzñā na sa ma ye ma hā ka ru ṇi ka tri sha ya hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur: hoḥ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha: 'dod pa thams cad rab sgrub cing : thugs rje sems can don mdzad pa: 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: om̐ ag+ne ye sa ma ye tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes gdan 'bul/ hūm̐/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong che/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag sna tshogs pa'i/ /phrin las kun gyi lad po mdzad/ /ting 'dzin lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ag+ne ye a la la pra tīts+tsha hoḥ sa phyag bya/ hūm̐: rab 'byams zhing gi khyon rnams gang ba yi: zag bral rmad byung 'dod yon nyer spyod lnga: sha khrag dbang po'i tshil rul dam tshig rdzas: gnyis med mnyam rol bde mchod a mṛ ta: ma hā rak+ta brjid ldan gtor ma sogs: me lha drang srong tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi: om̐ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da 'i bar dang*/ pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza kha hi: zhes mchod pa 'bul/ hūm̐: tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon sras me lha'i rgyal: phrin las mnga' bdag mthu chen dpa' bo mchog: dgos 'dod re ba yongs skong 'od po che: las kun sgrub mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod nas byon zas ni/ me lha'i ljags rdo rje'i rtse mo gcig par ram̐ dgang blugs kyi rtser hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba'i res mtshan par gyur: bsams nas: om̐ ag+ne ye swā hā: zhes mdun du bkang ba'i gzar gnyis kha sbyar khro bo'i khu tshur gyis bzung nas pus mo las phyir nang mi 'da' bar g.yon du bskor zhing*/ om̐ ag+ne ye di byā di byā di shud+dhe ma hā shrī ha byā ka byā wa hā na ye bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs spyi dang*/

khyad par bsam pa ngan pa yid la 'chang zhing sbyor ba rtsub mo lag tu len pa'i dgra bgegs chaig mo rbod gtong dang bcas pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad: ces lan gsum gyis phul la/ na moḥ rig pa'i rgyal po drang srong me lha khyod kyi las thams cad byed pas bsreg rdzas lha yi zhal du 'bul ba dang : me nyid ye shes kyi mer mdzad nas bdag gi phrin las ma lus pa bsgrub par mdzad du gsol lo: zhes pa brjod nas yam shing dang*/ om̐ ag+ne ye ya dzñā na ya bdag cag dpon slob sogs nas mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa'i bar gyis 'bul/ mar khu/ ag+ne ye bdag cag sogs spel tshig snga ma ltar 'bul/ rdzas gzhan rnams/ hūm̐/ dmar nag me klong drang srong 'khor bcas la/ /dgra bgegs phung khams skye mched bla tshe srog /'dod rgur 'char ba'i mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes/ /drag po'i longs spyod gnas 'debs gsod pa'i dug /myos byed tsha ba'i rdzas rgod 'di bsregs nas/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs myur du brlag par mdzod/ om̐ ag+n-i kro dha ye dgra bgegs chaig mo mā ra ya dz+wa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ces pas rtsa ba'i rdzas nas rim pa bzhin nyer gcig bdun sogs skabs dang sbyar te 'bul/ bstod pa snga ma ltar byas 'dod don gsol/ om̐ ag+ne ye dz+wa la gāts+tsha muṃ/ ye shes me lha thab kyi shar lhor gshegs nas dpang po mdzad par gyur/ bsam mo/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ dam tshig me lha'i lto ba rgya che'i nang*/ /rab 'jigs pho brang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus/ /pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs ti ra'i steng*/ zhes sogs/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pa'i bar las byang bzhin bya'o/ /de nas/ lha tshogs thams cad sku mdog char sprin ltar nag cing bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can drag po'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i las la rngam par bsams la/ byon zas ni/ ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams ljags rdo rje rtse mo gcig par ram̐ dgang blugs kyi rtser hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba res mtshan par bsam/ g.yon du bskor ba'i bar sngar bzhin las/ khyad par rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka a kro ta ka du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+ṣa kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bhigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ mdun gyi dgang gzar bkang nas/ om̐ ag+ne ye di byā sogs mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa'i bar/ 'jig rten pa'i skabs bzhin lan gsum phul la/ sreg rdzas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ de nas las byang gzhung bzhin bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ e ya: gru gsum sogs tshogs tha ma bzhin byas te/ hūm̐: 'joms byed mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yis/ dgra bgegs gzugs phung phye mar rab bshig nas/ /bhan+dhar bskyil ba'i sha khrag rgya mtsho 'di/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs zhal du 'bul/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i lha tshogs la/ /sdang dgra gnod pa'i bgegs tshogs kyi/ /phyi yi phung khams skye mched 'bul/ /nang gi bla tshe srog dbugs 'bul/ kha rje rlung rta dbang thang 'bul/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/

/las ngan gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i zhal du 'bul/ /dug ri khro 'dus zhal du 'bul/ dur khrod bdag mo'i zhal du 'bul/ /tshe bdag nag po'i zhal du 'bul/ khro chu dug sdong zhal du 'bul/ /dgra nag dregs 'dul zhal du 'bul/ /ki kang nag po'i zhal du 'bul/ /ma mo rigs lnga'i zhal du 'bul/ /gshed chen sde bzhi'i zhal du 'bul/ khram thogs bcu gnyis zhal du 'bul/ /pho nya bcu drug zhal du 'bul/ /srog bdag sde bzhi'i zhal du 'bul/ /dbugs len sde bzhi'i zhal du 'bul/ /shan pa sde bzhi'i zhal du 'bul/ /mon pa sde bzhi'i zhal du 'bul/ /las byed nyi khri'i zhal du 'bul/ /sprul pa yang sprul zhal du 'bul/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i zhal du 'bul/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/ /'khor bcas dgyes shing tshims gyur nas/ /dgra bgegs brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod/ dzaḥ srid pa'i btson khang drag po e/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong*/ /gdug pa'i yam shing dmar nag tshil/ /dmigs pa'i gzugs rten drag po'i rdzas/ /gnad 'bebs myos byos gsod pa'i mtshon/ /tsha ba'i ngad bskyed rdzas rgod rnams/ /bsreg pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa'i tshogs/ /lus ngag rdul du bsregs nas kyang*/ /rjes shul lhag ma med par mdzod/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ om̐ ya mān+ta ka sarba sha trum rus pa tsit+ta ag+ni dz+wa la ram̐ kha kha khā hi/ zhes me'i srog 'dzin gyi rdzas ni/ tsha ba'i rdzas kyi 'bar sngags rdzas kyis bstun pa'i brgya rtsa sogs gtso 'khor thams cad la thun mong du 'bul ba 'di ni 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byed cing*/ rgyas par spro na gtso bo la brgya rtsa 'khor rnams nyer gcig re sogs kyis so sor 'bul ba'i tshul shes par bya'o/ /dmigs gsal bgegs lta bu la rdzas gzhan rnams rdzogs nas/ lcags slang nang du me lce lhen pa'i sar liṅga'i 'gram la drag bskul gser skyems 'gugs 'dren rnams byas nas/

bzhes sgra dang bcas dza gad rdzas ldan gyi me sbar te hom mchod bya ba yin no/ /de nas byon skyems bya ba ni/ gshegs yul la sman raka gtor mchod sreg rdzas rnams sngon bzhin 'bul zhing*/ om̐ badz+ra tam+bu la ye swā hā/ so rtsi dang*/ om̐ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā/ gos zung phul nas bstod pa las byang ltar bya la/ 'dod gsol ni/ ho/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid khrag 'thung khro bo thams cad kyis dpal bdud kyi phyogs thams cad sgrol ba'i dpa' bo/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon yab yum/ tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po/ khro chu dug gi sdong po/ dgra nag dregs pa 'dul byed/ ki kang me'i spu gri/ dug ri ma mo rigs bzhi/ gshed chen 'bar ba sde bzhi/ 'chi bdag khram thogs bcu gnyis/ dus kyi pho nya drug cu/ /srog bdag bdud pho sde bzhi/ dbugs len ru tra sde bzhi/ shan pa pho nya sde bzhi/ a tsar mon pa sde bzhi/ las byed nyi khri dgu 'bum/ sprul pa'i phag sdig sbal sbrul/ bla 'gugs las kyi pho nya/ bla 'gugs mi reng dmar po/ srid pa las kyi 'khor lo/ gsal shing dug gi 'khor lo/ spu gri me'i 'khor lo/ khrag mtsho chu'i 'khor lo/ smyo 'bog rlung gi 'khor lo la sogs pa 'jam dpal dug ri me 'bar gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams la phrin las su gsol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag rgyu sbyor ba po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen ngan pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig /phas kyis rbod gtong byad stems mnan gtad srog 'phang byas pa thams cad byad ma kho rang gi gshed du phob cig /lha 'dres za kha gtad pa gnod pa'i dbal zug pa/ byad kyis khram la btab pa thams cad dgra la sgyur cig /zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang 'gugs pa dang drag po'i las thams cad la dbang 'byor bar mdzod cig

khyad par bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i dgra bgegs chaig mo'i gzugs liṅga bris shing dmar gyi dkyus su bkod pa 'di rnams/ lo dang zla ba zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang bar myur ba nyid du sod la ming tsam brda tsam ma lus par thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig / ces 'dod don gsol/ yig brgyas lhag chad bkang*/ bzod gsol/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod sogs badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la bstims nas slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha dpang por bzhugs pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod bstod bsreg rdzas bdun po sngar bzhin gshegs su gsol/ tam+bu la so rtsi/ wasatra gos zung 'bul/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i dmar gtor/ om̐ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ma hā bha ling+ta pū dza khā hi/ sogs lan gsum gyis phul la mchod bstod bya/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su tshur byon la/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ /dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ rjes su shis pa brjod cing bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab bo/ /me dug khrag gis bzhil nas thal sol rnams mchod rten nam lam rgya gram du mnan par bya'o/ /dge'o// // chi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi/ sri mnan pa'i cho ga gter gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar nag 'gros bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// rgyal ba kun gyi 'jigs byed sku'i rol pa/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po dug gi ri/ /dmod pa'i rig sngags tshwa tshwa g.yo ba'i gzis/ /bdud dpung rnam par gnon la gus phyag 'dud/ sgrub la 'tshe ba'i ma rungs rkyen ngan sri/ /ldang med mnan pa'i cho ga gzhung don ltar/ /cung zad spros la srung mas phrag dog spongs/ /zab chos mkha' ltar rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrubs/

/de la gsum/ sngon 'gro ji ltar bya ba/ dngos gzhi sgrub cing drod tshad mthar dbyung ba/ rjes las kyi mtha' bsdu ba las/ dang po ni/ ji ltar 'os pa'i gnas khang gi dgung du rtsa gsum srung ma'i gtor mchod dang*/ nye 'dabs su phung sa'i ro sol gyis non byas pa'i khar brub khung du gzhug rgyu'i liṅga ni/ dug shog la ru pa sri can gang gi mgo bo dang yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa'i lte bar tri yig dzaḥ gsum bcug pa'i steng du trig nan/ 'og tu breng shag rbad/ phyogs bzhir e hur thum dza/ mtha' skor du yig mgo phyir bstan gyis/ e thun he thun sogs 'gugs sngags kyi mthar gnod byed chaig mo pho sri sogs gdug pa can gyi lus ngag yid gsum mthu stobs nus pa thams cad hūm̐ nan ya nan suṃ nan khaṃ nan raṃ nan yaṃ nan mā ra ya nan nan pho sri sogs zhes phyi nas nang du sbrul 'khyil ltar bkod/ dpral bar chaig mo kha rur trig nan: tshigs chen bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'doms su bhi dha ya trig nan breng shag rbad/ brla la chaig mo'i bla gang du brdzus kyang khug dzaḥ byin pa dang nywa bzhi la mā ra ya rbad satwaṃ bha ya nan/ kha la kha chings shig / phyi rol du/ om̐ lok+t+ri pā la sogs mnan sngags kyi mthar/ gnod byed 'byung po sri can gdug pa can lo skag /zla skag /zhag skag /za ma'i skag /dus tshod kyi skag /cha shas kyi skag /na skag /shi skag /bdud skag /che sri/ chung sri/ dar sri/ gzhon sri/ pho sri/ mo sri/ phung sri/ god sri/ gyod sri/ byur sri sogs sri gang yin smos pa'i/ pha rol gdug cing sdang ba'i byad kha brgya'i mi kha stong gi bram mchu dus tshod kyi chad pa 'byung ba'i g.yo 'khrugs gdug pa can sogs chag sgo rkyen ngan mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad satwaṃ bha nan e ha la khaḍ+ga la sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ nan pra duṣ+ṭa nan laṃ bha ya nan satwaṃ bha ya nan mo ha ya nan ya ma ye nan ma ru tri bā ru ṇa ya tsakra ya nan nan:

phyi bskor du dzaḥkhram nyer gcig gis bskor/ gzhan yang dkar cha gang 'dug la dzaḥkhraṃ dang*/ sarba satwaṃ bha ya nan sogs ling khrus bya/ dug khrag gis byugs la/ rtsa dud kyis bdug /rlung la phyar rjes brub khung du gzhug kha bkab mtha' skor du skyer rtsang drug cus bskor steng du shing gi e khraṃ la bsten pa'i rwa gur phub/ e khraṃ steng du gong gnon gyi bzlog gtor bzhag /mdun du drag po'i nyer spyod/ 'dabs su g.yag ru'i nang du thun rdzas brub pa shog bu'i khrol tshags kyis bkab pa dang*/ gzhan yang thun gtor dkar bgegs g.yab dar rol mo'i bye brag sogs mkho chas mtha' dag 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ las gzhung bsrangs la bzlas pa dang tshogs skong byas rjes/ las gzhung gi thugs dam bskul gser skyems ni/ hūm̐/ kun bzang rdor sems chos dang las kyi dbang*/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen pad 'byung mtsho rgyal ma/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gter ston 'dus par bcas/ /rig sngags dmod pa'i brgyud gsum bla ma la/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug theg dgu'i lha tshogs dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /dug ri me 'bar dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi lha/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul mngon spyod gzi byin bskyed/ /las mgon bya rog lha btsan dge bsnyen gza'/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang gtsang ris dpal mgon dang*/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes mthu dpung stobs rtsal bskyed/ /sa bdag rje blon 'bangs 'khor sde rigs bcas/ /lo zla zhag dus gnas 'gyu legs nyes ston/ /ko long sdom pa'i rigs kun gser skyems bzhes/ /ru nga kun spongs mthun pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ gzu dpang ni/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /zhi khro rab 'byams mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs/ /rig sngags dmod pa'i las kyi pho nya rnams/

/ma g.yel dbyings nas dus 'dir dgongs su gsol/ /sngon tshe bskal pa yar ldan dpal che yang*/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bdag cag bsod nams dman/ /jo bo dkon mchog gsum la skyabs zhus kyang*/ /lha srin 'byung pos gnod pa skyob ma thub/ /lus ngag dkar po dge la 'bung bsam kyang*/ /grogs ngan dbang gis sdig pa'i las la bsgyur/ /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam ngan sbyor spangs kyang*/ /las ngan dbang gis rang dbang 'dug ma tshugs/ /de yi rgyab rten nag phyogs 'byung pos byed/ /thar pa bsgrubs kyang bar chad dbang btsan na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i dus shig nam yong ngam/ /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /'dul khrims bsrungs kyang bslab sdom gnas ma nus/ /dben gnas 'grims kyang dgra jag chom rkun dar/ /lto gos mthu chen dam chos yal bar dor/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad sna tshogs pa/ /lo nad nor nad skye 'gro'i srog dbugs sdud/ /sdig sgrib bsags pa'i rgyu rkyen 'byung pos byas/ /sgo gsum dge la 'bad pa'i dbang mi 'dug /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen mtshams sbyar ba'i/ /bdud dgra dam sri 'byung pos 'tshe dang rgol/ /lo zla zhag dus skag sri mi mthun rnams/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i lha tshogs kyi/ /mngon spyod drag po'i stobs kyis 'dir khug la/ /bsgral zhing mnan pa'i phrin las dus la bab/ /thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo mā ra ya/ brub ling bskyed pa ni/ ho: bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'jigs byed chen po drag tu khros pa'i mdun du: kaṃ kaṃ dmar nag las grub pa'i gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po rngam la 'thug pa bskal pa'i mun nag 'tshub mar gtibs pa phyi thams cad dus mthar 'byung ba sdud pa'i me ltar dmar nag tshwa tshwa skar ltar du 'khrugs shing gtibs pa:

bar thams cad 'byung ba chu rlung rba 'tshubs pa'i skad ltar dug gi rlangs pa sngo dmar drag tu 'phyur ba: de'i nang thams cad spu gri dang ral gri chu gri'i tshogs thams cad gzengs shing skar ltar du 'khrugs pa shin tu mi bzad pa: bdud kyi bsha' ra: btsan gyi bsad khang : gshin rje'i brub khung : ma mo'i 'gyu lam: gza' bdud kyi lte ba: srin po'i za lam: pho nya'i rgyun lam: sde brgyad kyi 'du sa: srog bdag gi tshogs khang : shin tu ya nga ba de'i nang du nṛ tri dmar nag yongs su gyur pa las: dam nyams pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs chaiga'i kho'i phung khams skye mched dbang po thams cad mngon sum du gsal ba: shin tu nyam thag pa'i gzugs can gcer bu byang thang gi lhag pas bsdams pa lta bu: lus sngo zhing ham pa: yan lag thams cad lcags sgrog gis bkyigs shing dmyal srung gshin rje'i pho nyas drag tu bsdams pa 'dar phri le ba: kha 'o dod mig shi mig lus mya ngan bug pa dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa mgon skyabs kyi lha dang bral ba: srog chad la khad pa dbugs bral la khad pa lha srin sde brgyad kyi zas skal gtad pa'i rang bzhin can zhig tu gyur: nṛ tri dgra bgegs a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ mā ra ya thun: de nas dmod cing 'gugs pa ni/

na mo/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma/ gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma/ rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sku 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po/ gsung dbang chen rta mchog rol pa/ thugs yang dag rdo rje gtum po/ yon tan ma mo/ za byed rnam rgyal/ phrin las gsod byed rdo rje gzhon nu/ sprul pa 'jig rten srog bdag dregs pa/ yang sprul dmod pa las kyi spu gri la sogs sgrub pa chen po/ bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga 'bum phrag sum cu so bdun la sogs pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par 'chi bdag las kyi srin po 'jam dpal khro bo dug ri me 'bar srid pa gsum gyi srog bdag /yab zla gsang thig le khro chu dkar po'i lha tshogs/ yum gshor sang nyi ma khros pa khro chu dmar po'i lha tshogs/ sras bzhi khro chu nag po'i rang bzhin/ tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po/ khro chu dug gi sdong po/ dgra nag dregs pa 'dul byed/ k-i kang me'i spu gri/ dug ti ma mo rigs lnga/ gshed chen 'bar ba sde bzhi/ 'chi bdag khram thogs bcu gnyis/ dus kyi pho nya drug cu/ srog bdag bdud po sde bzhi/ dbugs len ru tra sde bzhi/ shan pa pho nya sde bzhi/ a tsar mon pa sde bzhi/ las byed nyi khri dgu 'bum/ sprul pa phag sdig sbal sbrul/ bla 'gugs las kyi pho nya/ bla 'bod mi reng dmar po/ srid pa las kyi 'khor lo/ gsal shing dug gi 'khor lo/ spu gri me'i 'khor lo/ khrag mtsho chu'i 'khor lo/ smyo 'bog rlung gi 'khor lo la sogs pa 'joms byed gshin rje 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bka' srung kun gyi sde dpon dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po/ srog bdag bya rog gdong can/ gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu/ sngags bdag ma mo ral cig
