/skyes bu rdo rje legs pa/ shan pa btsan rgod 'bar ba la sogs pa bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas/ deng 'dir 'gugs pa'i yul du mchis pa ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde la dmod pa/ khyad par rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la sdang zhing gdug pa'i bsam sbyor 'chang ba/ snga dgra lag gis brdar ba/ phyi dgra zhe la bzhag pa/ da dgra thad nas ldang ba/ spyi dgra rlung ltar 'tshubs pa/ sgos dgra rbab ltar rgyug pa/ zur dgra khyi ltar zug pa/ mtho gong nas rgol ba/ dma' khyad du 'bebs pa/ gyod phyogs nas ldang ba/ sri phugs su chud pa/ snyad tsher ltar 'dzugs pa/ mdun sgug dang rgyab 'ded byed pa/ lo sri lo nas dar ba/ zla sri zla bar babs pa/ zhag sri zhag nas ldang ba/ dus sri dus su 'gyu ba/ sri phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas ldang ba/ sri ri rtse lung gsum nas ldang ba/ sri sgo them dang mal 'og nas ldang ba/ sri lam mdo dang mchod rten nas ldang ba/ sri rwa ba dang dur khang nas ldang ba/ sri mtshon kha dang g.yang rbab nas ldang ba/ sri la btsas dang grog phug nas ldang ba/ sri chu mtsho dang lha khang nas ldang ba/ sri kha lag snying gsum nas ldang ba sogs sri can gdug pa can spyi dang*/ khyad par du tshe rabs sngon gyi lan chags/ smon lam logs pa'i bdud rigs/ nad yams dang byur gyi sna 'dren pa/ rkyen ngan dang 'phung 'dres tshang bca' ba/ brlags bcom dang rtsa brlag gis mjug bsdu ba'i log 'dren bdud sri gdug pa can dmigs pa'i yul du bkod pa bsdongs zla rgyab rten dang bcas pa thams cad stong khams gar gnas kyang rang dbang med par las kyi rlung mun pa'i rta la bskyon te myur mgyogs kyi pho nyas nyes can btson du khrid pa bzhin/

gzugs liṅga la bkod/ ming byang bu btab cing rnam shes sa bon la btab pa 'di la khug cig /stims shig /om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ om̐ badz+ra rat+na pā sha hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: om̐ badz+ra karma ghan+ḍe hoḥ zhes drag rol gyi tsha rngam dang 'gugs 'ching sdom myos kyi sngags rgya yang bya/ spro na pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bh+yo eḥ thugs nyid dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thabs kyi cho 'phrul gang 'dul phyir/ /de ring dgra la sprul pa 'gyed/ /'joms byed chen po'i sku ru gsal/ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /yi ge pho nya dzaḥzhig 'phros/ dzaḥlas rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ khro chu dkar po'i pho nya ste/ /lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu la/ /gshin rje dug ti dkar mos zhon/ /bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs/ /bla 'ching zhags pa glogs ltar 'khyugs/ /bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab tu khur/ /bla bya dkar po sngon nas 'jums/ /bla khyi dkar po rgyab nas 'gyu/ /'khor du srin mo dkar mo gnyis/ /bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re/ /gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de/ las rlung dmar pos thums la shog /drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog /lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog /zhags pa nag pos chings la shog /gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung*/ /dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re/ /byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog /dug ti ma mo rtsal ma zhan/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ bh+yo bh+yoḥ ya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla rtags a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /yi ge pho nya hūm̐ zhig 'phros/ hūm̐ las rin chen zhags pa ma/ khro chu ser po'i pho nya ste/ /gser gyi rgya stag mgo dgu la/ /gshin rje dug ti ser mos zhon/ bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs/ /bla 'ching zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs/ /bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab tu khur/ /bla bya ser po sngon nas 'jums/

/bla khyi ser po rgyab nas 'gyu/ /'khor du srin mo ser nag gnyis/ /bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re/ /gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de/ /las rlung dmar pos thums la shog /drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog /lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog /zhags pa nag pos chings la shog /gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung*/ /dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re/ /byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog /dug ti ma mo rtsal ma zhan/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ bh+yo bh+yoḥya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla rtags a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /yi ge pho nya baṃ yig 'phros/ /baṃ las rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ khro chu dmar po'i pho nya ste/ /zangs kyi 'phar ba mgo dgu la/ /gshin rje dug ti dmar mos zhon/ /bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs/ /bla 'ching zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs/ /bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab nas khur: bla bya dmar po sngon nas 'jums/ /bla khyi dmar po rgyab nas 'gyu/ /'khor du srin mo dmar nag gnyis/ /bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re/ /gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de/ /las rlung dmar pos thums la shog /drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog /lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog /zhags pa nag pos chings la shog /gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung*/ /dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re/ /byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog /dug ti ma mo rtsal ma zhan/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ bh+yo bh+yoḥ ya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla rtags a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /yi ge pho nya hoḥzhig 'phros/ /ho las karma dril bu ma/ khro chu'i nag po'i pho nya ste/ /dug gi dom nag mgo dgu la/ /gshin rje dug ti nag mos zhon/ /bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs/ /bla 'ching zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs/ /bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab tu khur/

/bla bya nag po sngon nas 'ju+ums/ /bla khyi nag po rgyab nas 'gyu/ /'khor du srin mo sngo nag gnyis/ /bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re/ /gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de/ /las rlung dmar pos thums la shog /drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog /lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog /zhags pa nag pos chings la shog /gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung*/ /dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re/ /byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog /dug ti ma mo rtsal ma zhan/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ bh+yo bh+yoḥ ya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla rtags a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pho nya bzhi po bskul zhing 'gugs bstim rtags rdzogs su bya ba'i mtshams rnams su 'gugs sngags ni/ om̐ e thun he thun he ya ma rā dza thun/ ka la ha la mi kha thun/ ki kang ru tra pra ṇa ya thun/ ha la ti kā li ru tra shag ti thun/ ru tra a pa ka ra rur+ṇa ya thun/ ki kang he pra ma thun/ sri can chaig mo tri tri a kar+ṣa ya thun thun/ zhes skabs dang bstun te bzlas/ khug rtags rdzogs nas/ sri can gdug pa can gyi khog pa gnam lcags spu gri'i 'khor lo rno ngar dang ldan pa rtsibs bzhi mu khyud med pa gcig gis brgyangs shing sgo gsum nus stobs thams cad g.yo 'gul med par bskal pa'i bar du mnan par bsams la/ om̐ lok+t+ri pā la nan: nā ga du shan nan: a mu ka pur thum nan: bigh+nān trig nan rbad nan: bzlog nan mā ra ya nan: 'phung sri sogs/ kā wa tsi satwaṃ bha ya nan: zhes bzlas mthar thun la sngags shing liṅga la brdeg pa ni: 'au/ nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcu nas gnod cing 'tshe ba'i sri can gdug pa can mā ra ya nan brub/ lo sri lo nas dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ zla sri zla ba la babs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ zhag sri zhag nas ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ dus sri dus su 'gyu ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/

sri phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ sri ri rtse dang lung gsum nas ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ sri sgo them dang mal 'og nas ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ sri lam mdo dang mchod rten nas ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ sri rwa ba dang dur khung nas ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ sri mtshon kha dang g.yang rbab nas ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ sri la btsan dang grog phug nas ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ sri chu mtsho dang lha khang nas ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ sri kha lag snying gsum nas ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ sri yul gling dang 'gag zur nas ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ gyod dang byur gyi sna 'dren pa'i sri thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ yams nad dang rkyen ngan gyi tshang bca' ba sri thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ 'phung 'dre dang rtsa brlag gis mjug bsdu ba'i sri thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ sri can gdug pa can gyi lus ngag yid gsum bskal pa ma stong gi bar du ma ldang cig mā ra ya chings brub satwaṃ bha ya nan hūm̐ nan ya nan e nan sum̐ nan kham̐ nan ram̐ nan yam̐ nan mā ra ya nan nan: zhes pas thun dbab cing g.yab dar dang thal rdeb bya/ thun mtshams su thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ nṛ tri dzaḥ na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i dgra bgegs gnod byed drag po thun gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ lan gsum bya: hūm̐: dza yig dmar nag 'phros pa gtor mar thim: spu gri'i rang bzhin gyur nas dgra bgegs gtub: tshe bsod hub bsdus rnal 'byor bdag la thim: sha khrag gshin rje mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: bdud rtsi bran zhing*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gtor ma sman raka dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta āḥhūm̐: dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kun: dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: de ring thugs dam dus la bab: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: pha rol gnod byed dam nyams kyi: bla srog don snying phrol la shog: gling bzhi 'di yi sa 'og tu: rim pa dgu yi mtshams shed na: gshin rje yi dwags duḥkha can: cho nge 'o dod ldir ba'i gnas: de yi nang du dgra bgegs brub: pho brang lcags mkhar 'og tu mnan: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad du chug: kha la rgyas 'debs ma he'i gdong : dam nyams dgra bgegs zhal du thob: nyi khri dgu 'bum sa ya stong : las gshin sde tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: mngon spyod chen po'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra dam nyams dgra bgegs kyi bla srog rnam shes la kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes thun gtor 'bul zhing las kyis gnyer gtad do: gsum pa ni mnan rtags rdzogs nas liṅga brub khung dang bcas pa mdun du bkod de: 'gugs gzhug tshar gcig song nas phur bu thogs te: e ya bh+yo dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya ba: srog bdag ya ma rā dza'i sku: zhal gsum phyag drug gnam lcags dbal: zur gsum dug gi me dpung 'bar: rtse mor las kyi mtshon char 'bebs: dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can gyi: bla srog rnam shes bshig pa'i phyir: dkar nag snying la kī la ya: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa a kro ta rā dza ya ma rā dza sa ma ya dgra bgegs thams cad nṛ tri trig nan e hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces pas bsgral te dbang po thams cad la khyab par phur pas bsnun: zan ling mtshon gyis gtub cing tshogs tha ma ltar zhal bstab bya: shog ling thog mar mgo bo phyed nas lteb:

ces sogs gzhung ltar bltabs la chings lpags dang bcas pa bya zhing rang gi snod du gzhug /thun rdzas kyis kha bkang la chas bkag: re ba dang byad thag gis bcings rtsang rgya gram du gzir: mnan chas rnams bsags/ sa dmigs su dkar gtor phul mnan dongs brus par me bshur bya: satwa re thogs la dongs nang du gdeng tsam bya zhing : hūm̐: bdag ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: deng 'dir drag po'i las byed phyir: phyag g.yas gnam lcags satwa re thogs: g.yon pas me yi zhags pa 'dzin: g.yas kyi gnam lcags satwa re de: srid gsum nam mkha'i mthongs su phyar: thog ltar sa la phab pa'i tshe: ri rab gling bzhi phyed du gas: 'og gi rgya mtsho mer gyis gsal: de nang gshin rje ma lus kun: gnas pas 'gro dbang med par yi: mtha' rnams me yi zhags pas bskor: 'chi bdag pho brang mngon sum gsal: de nas gtad pa ni: dzaḥ gshin rje'i pho brang srog bdag gnas mchog nas: srid pa srog gi bdag po mthu bo che: srid pa'i 'khor lo 'jigs byed ma he'i gdong : gshin rje a wa glang mgo da bzhengs shig: za byed 'chi bdag 'bar ba'i kha gdongs la: gnod pa'i dgra bgegs yul mkhar sde ris dang : sri can gdon bgegs 'byung po ma lus pa: bstab bo a wa glang mgo'i zhal du bstab: brub bo 'chi bdag gshin rje'i lto bar brubs: bstab bo gtad do nam yang ma shor cig:

ces mnan pa dongs su bskur zhing dmod pa brub chog bya: stag shing gi phur bu btsugs la: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i las kyi dmod pa'i mtshon: srid pa'i ri rab las grub dug phur 'di: ma rungs dam sri 'byung po mnan phyir btab: nam yang ru tra ldang bar ma gyur cig: om̐ ya ma rā dza kī li kī la ya he e ha la khaḍ+ga ya sarba duṣ+ṭan nan laṃ bha ya nan satwaṃ bha ya nan mo ha ya nan ya ma ye nan ma ru tri bā ru ṇa ya tsakra nan nan: zhes dur rdo stong khams bris pas kha bkab cing : hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ dmigs bya khar chud 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khar: srid pa'i spu gri 'khor los rgyas thob la: snod kyi 'jig rten ma stongs bar du rgya: nam mkha'i rlung me chu sa ri rab dang : gnam lcags mchod rten rtsibs stong 'bar bas mnan: rgyas btab mnan no nam yang ma ldang cig: hūm̐: nan ya nan e nan sum̐ nan kham̐ nan ram̐ nan yam̐ nan mā ra ya nan nan: zhes tshwa tshwa nag po dang 'byung ba go ldog gis rgyas btab pa mi mngon par bya/ gong gnon gyi zor gtor thogs la: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ mthing nag rab 'jigs me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus: gnam lcags 'phro ba'i thod mkhar pho brang nas: 'jigs byed khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: mngon spyod mthu rtsal thugs dam dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dgra la zor mda' ya: tshe bdag chen po'i thugs dam dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i dmag dpon sgrol bar gyis: dgra nag 'bar ba'i thugs dam dus la babs: pha rol gdug pa'i dgra bo'i dmag mi gtor: khro chu dug gdong thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i go mtshon phye mar gtor: ki kang spu gri'i thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bo'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: sha za rigs lnga'i thugs dam dus la bab: dgra bo'i rten mkhar yul zhing phyags mas thob: pha rol ban+de dgra bo byad ma rnams:

lcags kyi a tsar nag pos sgrol bar gyis: pha rol bon po dgra bo byad ma rnams: zangs kyi a tsar dmar pos sgrol bar gyis: pha rol mi nag dgra bo byad ma rnams: dug gi phag rgod nag pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo'i bud med byad ma rnams: bswe yi sbal pa dmar pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo'i chung rgyud byad ma rnams: gdug pa'i dug sbrul nag pos za bar gyis: pha rol dgra bo'i sgo nor phyugs zhing rnams: lcags kyi sdig rgod 'bar bas za bar gyis: dam nyams dgra bo'i byad ma lha srung rnams: 'joms byed gshin rje tshogs kyis sgrol bar mdzod: ma rungs bdud kyi sde dpung cham la phob: dmigs pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs shor ra re: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa a kro rā dza ya ma rā dza sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ byad ma nṛ tri trig nan bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces mnan steng ngam dgra phyogs su 'phang bshal chus brtan ma bskyang*/ gtor snod mnan steng du kha sbub la rta bro brdung*/ srung 'khor dang bcas rang gnas su log /bdag gi rnal 'byor gyis sgo nas mchod bstod bzod gsol nyer bsdu bsngo smon sogs las ky-i rjes mi mngon par bsdu bas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /de ltar 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi zin bris mnan pa'i cho ga gter gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar nag 'gros bklag chog tu bkod pa 'di yang*/ rig 'dzin gter chen mchog gi zhabs 'brangs mthu stobs sngags 'chang kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor ma ldog par/ phyogs med du bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa skyid grong smyon pas yid 'ong sa yi thig le khrom gzigs rngam pa tshal du dbu btsugs/ 'bras yul skyid pa'i dga' tshal du grub par sbyar ba 'dis kyang gzhan phan rgya chen 'grub par gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ// // ji) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar khro bo kun 'dus kyi dgra brub las kyi rlung dmar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo mañdzu shrī kro dha rā dza ya/ 'jam dpal gshin rje khro 'dus kyi zhag sgrub dug gi par bu'i dgra brub las kyi rlung dmar bkod pa las thog mar gser skyems bshams te gzu dpang gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor bcas rnams/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /de ring sngags 'chang bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod/ hūm̐/ thog ma'i sangs rgyas chos sku kun bzang dang*/ /longs sku ye shes lnga ldan 'khor tshogs la/ /'jig rten ma rungs dregs pas phrag dog skyes/ /dug lnga log rtog sbyor zhing snyad btsal bas/ /che rtags mnyam bzhag skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mi rtog ye shes snying po don ma chung*/ /ye bzhugs gdod ma'i lha tshogs mkhyen par gsol/ /rnam dag dam tshig gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ hūm̐/ rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas shāka thub kyis/ /bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la/ /ma rungs lha byin nag po phrag dog skyes/ /sna tshogs bar chad brtsams shing snyad btsal bas/ /che rtags ngur smrig chas kyis rab brgyan te/ /grangs med chos 'khor bskor ba don ma chung*/ /sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis mkhyen par gsol/ /ye shes bdud rtsi gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /byang sems 'phags tshogs gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ hūm̐/ 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /klong yangs rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mthu mnga' bas/ /mu stegs bon blon rnams kyis phrag dog skyes/ /mi mthun dmod pa bor te snyad btsal bas/ /che rtags thogs med mkhyen brtse nus pas brgyan/

/'ja' lus skye 'chi spangs pa don ma chung*/ /bde gshegs rig 'dzin rnams kyang mkhyen par gsol/ /rmad byung bla med gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /brda brgyud drang srong grub thob gzu dang dpang*/ hūm̐/ zab gsang snying po a ti bla med la/ /sde snod lung rigs kun gyi bcud 'dus pas/ /nyan thos bshad 'byams dred po chags sdang skyes/ /mi dge'i lung 'dren sdang sems snyad btsal bas/ /che rtags ma bsgoms tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam/ gdams ngag thob tsam 'gro 'dren don ma chung*/ chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mkhyen par gsol/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /dbyings kyi yum chen gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ hūm̐/ rgyal bas lung bstan rig 'dzin sngags 'chang la/ /gsang mdzod bla med brda bzhi klong rdol bas/ /don med chags sdang can gyis phrag dog skyes/ /kun slong ci rigs 'brub cing snyad btsal bas/ /che rtags 'phags pa'i gdung gsob dkyil 'khor 'dzin/ /zab lam mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud don ma chung*/ /lung rigs rgyud sde'i lha tshogs mkhyen par gsol/ /sku lnga dam tshig gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /chos skyong dam can gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ hūm̐/ tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rjes 'jug mdzad rnams la/ /bslu med las 'bras bzang po smin pa'i tshe/ /log 'dren bar chad kun gyis chags sdang skyes/ /'khrug rtsod tshe bsod rtsom zhing snyad btsal bas/ /che rtags rgyu 'bras dkon mchog dpang du btsugs/ /phan sems dge tshogs rgya mtsho don ma chung*/ /dkar phyogs dge ba'i lha tshogs mkhyen par gsol/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /skyabs mchog rtsa ba gsum gyis gzu dpang mdzod/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog 'tsho chos rgyal la/ /longs spyod mnga' 'bangs 'khor gyis rgyas pa la/ /bdud rigs sdig to can gyis chags sdang skyes/ /dmag 'dren g.yul gshom 'phung ba'i dgra btsal bas/

/che rtags dge bcu'i khrims kyis srol gtod nas/ /mnga' 'bangs snying rjes skyong ba don ma chung*/ /'di phyi'i las kyi bdag po mkhyen par gsol/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /chos bdag gnyan gyi srung mas gzu dpang mdzod/ hūm̐/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la/ /deng 'dir drag po'i phrin las dus la bab/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs 'byung po rtsad nas chod/ /phyi rgyud lha dang srung ma thams cad kun/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /dam nyams ru tra'i mgon skyob ma mdzad par/ /dgra bo kho rang lha bdud gshed du phob/ /mā ra ya yi phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ de nas thun gtor 'gugs bstim bsgral mchod khā hi'i bar grub rjes thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo ya/ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /'jam dpal rigs gsum gshegs su gsol/ /rigs bdag dkar po gshegs su gsol/ e ya/ gru gsum snang srid spu gri'i zhing*/ /'byung ba mtshon cha'i rang bzhin 'khrugs/ /me chu'i sgra skad 'brug ltar sgrog /dug gi rlangs pa mun ltar gtibs/ /gshin rje'i pho nya rlung ltar 'tshubs/ /de 'dra 'jigs pa'i gling chen po/ /'chi bdag las kyi pho brang nas/ /dug ri me 'bar gshegs su gsol/ khro chu dug gdong gshegs su gsol/ /tshe bdag nag po gshegs su gsol/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ /dgra nag dregs 'dul gshegs su gsol/ /ki kang dmar nag gshegs su gsol/ /me yi spu gri gshegs su gsol/ /gdong drug mthing nag gshegs su gsol/ dug ti ma mo gshegs su gsol/ /'khor gyi gshin rje gshegs su gsol/ /sprul pa las mkhan gshegs su gsol/ /dgra bgegs bsgral phyir dbyings nas bzhengs/ /rak+ta khrag gi mchod pa bzhes/ /dam tshig chen po'i phrin las mdzod/

e bh+yo/ lho phyogs bdag po dug gi gdong*/ /'chi bdag khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed/ /pho nya drug cu gnas kyi bdag /dug rlangs 'khrigs pa'i pho brang nas/ /srog bdag me 'bar skur bzhengs shig /'chi bdag dug gdong skur bzhengs shig /'joms byed tshe bdag skur bzhengs shig /'khor los bsgyur ba skur bzhengs shig /sgrol byed dgra nag skur bzhengs shig /las byed ki kang skur bzhengs shig /me yi spu gri skur bzhengs shig /gsod byed gdong drug skur bzhengs shig /mi mo sde bzhi skur bzhengs shig hūm̐/ thugs dam ma g.yel gnad nas bzhengs/ /mngon spyod chen po'i dus la bab/ /dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /gshin rje'i pho nya dgra la bh+yo/ /'chi bdag sprul pa skar ltar 'khrugs/ /las byed chen po mi bsrun pa/ /ya ma ra tsa las la chos/ /byad ma dam nyams sdig can 'di/ /bla tshe rnam shes rten dang phrol/ /do nub nam gyi srod thun la/ /dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug la shog /nyin mo dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe/ /dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la zhon/ /dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug la shog /nub mo dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe/ /smag rum mun pa'i rta la zhon/ /dgra bo'i bla srog khug la shog /sdig can dgra bo shor ra re/ /da lta nyid du khug la shog dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya ba/ /nag po lcags kyi a tsa ra/ /g.yas pas spu gri sog le 'dzin/ /g.yon pas 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu gdengs/ /myur mgyogs las kyi pho nya bdun/ /rol du lcags spyang sngon mo khrid/ /klad nas lcags kyi bya khra lding*/ /rlung nag 'tshub ma'i nang du rgyug /dmod pa chen po'i las mkhan pa/ /srid pa 'di yi srog gi bdag khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re/ /dmigs pa'i byad ma khug la shog dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya ba/ /lag dmar zangs kyi a tsa ra/ /g.yas pas zangs kyi ral gri thogs/ /g.yon pas zangs kyi zhags pa 'phen/

/shan pa zangs kyi pho nya bdun/ /rol du zangs 'phar dmar po khrid/ /klad na zangs kyi bya khra lding*/ /shwa rbud dmar po'i nang du rgyug /dmod pa dus kyi las mkhan pa/ /byad ma 'gugs pa'i gshed po che/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re/ /dmigs pa'i byad ma khug la shog dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya ba/ /dug gi phag rgod nag po bdun/ /ngar sgras sa gzhi kun kyang g.yo/ /bswe yi sbal pa dmar po bdun/ /rkan sgras 'jig rten khyab par rdeb/ /'khyug pa'i dug sbrul nag po bdun/ /'gyu bas ri rab 'ur gyis 'gengs/ /lcags kyi sdig pa nag po bdun/ /rbad pas gling bzhi chol bur 'phen/ /sprul pa sde bzhi'i dus la bab/ /dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re/ /dmigs pa'i byad ma khug la shog /gzugs dang ming byang rten la phob/ /byad du chug la gzir zhing gnon/ /dus las ma 'da' sa ma ya/ de nas brub khung dmigs bya bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'jigs byed chen po drag tu khros pa'i mdun du: kaṃ kaṃ dmar nag las grub pa'i gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po rngam la 'thug pa bskal pa'i mun nag 'tshub mar gtibs pa phyi thams cad dus mthar 'byung ba sdud pa'i me ltar dmar nag tshwa tshwa skar ltar du 'khrugs shing gtibs pa: bar thams cad 'byung ba chu rlung rba rlabs 'tshubs pa'i skad ltar dug gi rlangs pa sngo dmar drag tu 'phyur ba: de'i nang thams cad spu gri dang ral gri chu gri'i tshogs thams cad gzengs shing skar ltar du 'khrugs pa shin tu mi bzad pa: bdud kyi bsha' ra: btsan gyi bsad khang : gshin rje'i brub khung : ma mo'i 'gyu lam: gza' bdud kyi lte ba: srin po'i za lam: pho nya'i rgyun lam: sde brgyad kyi 'du sa: srog bdag gi tshogs khang : shin tu ya nga ba de'i nang du nṛ tri dmar nag yongs su gyur pa las: dam nyams pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs chaiga'i kho'i phung khams skye mched dbang po thams cad mngon sum du gsal ba:

shin tu nyam thag pa'i gzugs can gcer bu byang thang gi lhag pas bsdams pa lta bu: lus sngo zhing ham pa: yan lag thams cad lcags sgrog gis bkyigs shing dmyal srung gshin rje'i pho nyas drag tu bsdams pa 'dar phri le ba: kha 'o dod mig shi mig lus mya ngan bug pa dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa mgon skyabs kyi lha dang bral ba: srog chad la khad pa dbugs bral la khad pa lha srin sde brgyad kyi zas skal gtad pa'i rang bzhin can zhig tu gyur: nṛ tri dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dza dza mā ra ya dzaḥ mā ra ya thun/ de nas dmod pa'i bden stobs kyis 'gugs pa ni/ na mo/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi bla ma/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud kyi bla ma/ gang zag snyan brgyud kyi bla ma/ rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sku 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po/ gsung dbang chen rta mchog rol pa/ thugs yang dag rdo rje gtum po/ yon tan ma mo za byed rnam rgyal/ phrin las gsod byed rdo rje gzhon nu/ sprul pa 'jig rten srog bdag dregs pa/ yang sprul dmod pa las kyi spru gri/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par 'chi bdag las kyi srin po 'jam dpal khro bo dug ri me 'bar/ srid pa gsum gyi srog bdag yab zla gsang thig le khro chu dkar po'i lha tshogs/ yum gshor sang nyi ma khros pa khro chu dmar po'i lha tshogs/ sras mchog khro chu nag po'i rang bzhin/ khro chu dug gi gdong pa/ tshe bdag 'bar ba chen po/ khams gsum g.yul las rnam rgyal/ dgra nag dregs pa 'dul byed/ ki kang me'i spu gri/ gdong drug las kyi shan pa/ dug ti ma mo rigs lnga/ gshed chen 'bar ba sde lnga/ 'chi bdag khram thogs bcu gnyis/ dus kyi pho nya drug cu/ srog bdag bdud po sde bzhi/

dbugs len ru tra sde bzhi/ shan pa pho nya sde bzhi/ a tsar mon pa sde bzhi/ las byed nyi khri dgu 'bum/ sprul pa phag sdig sbal sbrul/ bla 'gugs las kyi pho nya/ bla 'bod mi reng dmar po/ srid pa las kyi 'khor lo/ gsal shing dug g-i 'khor lo/ spu gri me'i 'khor lo/ khrag mtsho chu'i 'khor lo/ smyo 'bog rlung gi 'khor lo la sogs pa 'joms byed gshin rje 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bka' srung kun gyi sde dpon dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po/ srog bdag bya rog gdong can/ gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu/ sngags bdag ma mo ral gcig /skyes bu rdo rje legs pa/ shan pa btsan rgod 'bar ba la sogs chos skyong bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde la dmod pa/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la/ sdang zhing gdug pa'i bsam sbyor 'chang ba/ snga dgra lag gis brdar ba/ phyi dgra zhe la 'chang ba/ da dgra thad nas langs pa/ spyi dgra rlung ltar 'tshubs pa/ sgos dgra rbab ltar rgyug pa/ zur dgra khyi ltar zug pa/ mtho gong nas rgol ba/ dma' khyad du 'bebs pa/ gyod phyogs nas langs pa/ sri phugs su tshud pa/ snyad tsher ltar 'dzugs pa/ tshe rabs sngon gyi lan chags/ smon lam log pa'i bdud rigs/ mi nga la lha med zer ba/ lha srung mar mthu med gshe ba/ mthu bu lon bzhin du snyog pa/ kha dmod pa'i ya kha byed pa/ lag gdug pas 'phrog bcom byed pa/ skag rigs sum rgya drug cu/ nad yams dal kha bye ba/ nang dbyen dmag 'khrug byed pa sogs/ mdor na nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/

cir yang bar du gcod pa'i rkyen/ tshe rabs las la grub pa'i bdud rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad rang dbang med par steng nas gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ 'og nas sa'i rten phur phud/ las rlung drag po'i rta la bskyon/ pho nya shan pas mdun nas khrid/ mun nag 'thibs pos rgyab nas ded/ gling bzhi'i khyon gar gnas kyang gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig /lha yi dkar byang 'di la phob cig /btsan gyi dmar byang 'di la phob cig /bdud kyi nag byang 'di la phob cig /skad cig da lta nyid du ming byang bu la btab cing*/ rnam shes sa bon la btab pa 'di la khug cig /stims shig om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra rat+na pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma pho ṭa baṃ/ om̐ badz+ra karma ghaṇ+ḍe ho/ sarba nṛ tri khug cig dza/ satwaṃ bha ya nan/

de nas pho nya bkye ba ni/ tshig mtshams su rak+ta mchod cing*/ hūm̐ ya bh+yo e ya/ thugs nyid dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thabs kyi cho 'phrul gang 'dul phyir/ /de ring dgra la sprul pa 'gyed/ /'joms byed chen po'i sku ru gsal/ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /yi ge pho nya dzaḥzhig 'phros/ dzaḥlas rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ khro chu dkar po'i pho nya ste/ /lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu la/ /gshin rje dug ti dkar mos zhon/ /bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs/ /bla 'ching zhags pa glogs ltar 'khyugs/ /bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab tu khur/ /bla bya dkar po sngon nas 'jums/ /bla khyi dkar po rgyab nas 'gyu/ /'khor du srin mo dkar mo gnyis/ /bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re/ /gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de/ las rlung dmar pos thums la shog /drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog /lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog /zhags pa nag pos chings la shog /gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung*/ /dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re/ /byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog /dug ti ma mo rtsal ma zhan/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ bh+yo bh+yoḥ ya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla rtags a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /yi ge pho nya hūm̐ zhig 'phros/ /hūm̐ las rin chen zhags pa ma/ khro chu ser po'i pho nya ste/ /gser gyi rgya stag mgo dgu la/ /gshin rje dug ti ser mos zhon/ /bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs/ /bla 'ching zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs/ /bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab tu khur/ /bla bya ser po sngon nas 'jums/ /bla khyi ser po rgyab nas 'gyu/ /'khor du srin mo ser nag gnyis/ /bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re/ /gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de/ /las rlung dmar pos thums la shog /drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog /lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog /zhags pa nag pos chings la shog

/gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung*/ /dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re/ /byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog /dug ti ma mo rtsal ma zhan/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ bh+yo bh+yoḥya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla rtags a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /yi ge pho nya baṃ yig 'phros/ /baṃ las rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ khro chu dmar po'i pho nya ste/ /zangs kyi 'phar ba mgo dgu la/ /gshin rje dug ti dmar mos zhon/ /bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs/ /bla 'ching zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs/ /bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab nas khur/ /bla bya dmar po sngon nas 'jums/ /bla khyi dmar po rgyab nas 'gyu/ /'khor du srin mo dmar nag gnyis/ /bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re/ /gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de/ /las rlung dmar pos thums la shog /drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog /lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog /zhags pa nag pos chings la shog /gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung*/ /dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re/ /byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog /dug ti ma mo rtsal ma zhan/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ bh+yo bh+yoḥ ya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla rtags a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /yi ge pho nya hoḥzhig 'phros/ /ho las karma dril bu ma/ khro chu'i nag po'i pho nya ste/ /dug gi dom nag mgo dgu la/ /gshin rje dug ti nag mos zhon/ /bla 'gugs lcags kyu lag na thogs/ /bla 'ching zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs/ /bla 'dzin drwa ba rgyab tu khur/ /bla bya nag po sngon nas 'ju+ums/ /bla khyi nag po rgyab nas 'gyu/ /'khor du srin mo sngo nag gnyis/ /bla 'bod gshin skad tse re re/ /gnyid dang g.yeng ba'i bla 'khyams de/ /las rlung dmar pos thums la shog /drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog /lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog

/zhags pa nag pos chings la shog /gshin rje'i bu mo mthu ma chung*/ /dug khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re/ /byad ma'i bla 'khyams khug la shog /dug ti ma mo rtsal ma zhan/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ bh+yo bh+yoḥ ya ma ma tri kā li ya dun+ti yā dug ti yā dgra bo'i bla rtags a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes las kyi ma mo bzhi bskul pas srog bdag 'gyu ba'i ma mo thams cad sprin ltar du 'khrigs nas dgra bo'i bla srog dbang med du bkug par bsam/ /de nas skabs su bla 'gugs pho nya bskul ba ni/ dmar gtor bshams la/ hūm̐ ya bh+yo ai/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mi bzad khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /dug gi spu gri nag po ma he'i gdong*/ /za byed dgra srog rngam phyir las la bzhengs/ /'chi bdag gshed chen sde bzhi skur bzhengs shig /sprul pa'i las mkhan dmag tshogs skur bzhengs shig /deng 'dir dgra la myur mgyogs pho nya 'gyed/ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /sprul pa'i pho nya lcags kyi a tsa ra/ /dgra bo 'gugs phyir lag na lcags kyu thogs/ /de ring nyi ma snga dro'i dus kyi tshe/ /dgra bo las la g.yengs shing bying rgod dus/ /bla rtags dud 'gro ri khar 'khyams pa'i skabs/ /sprul pa gcan spyang pho nyar brdzus nas kyang*/ /rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /byad ma'i ming byang gzugs ling 'di la phob/ khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /sprul pa'i pho nya dug phag nag po bdun/ /dgra bgegs 'gugs phyir dug gi mche zor rngam/ /de ring nyi ma phyed pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /dgra bo khams nyog shes pa 'thibs pa'i dus/ /bla rtags khang khyim had por sdod pa'i dus/ /sprul pa rlung dmar pho nyar brdzus nas kyang*/ /rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog

/sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /byad ma'i ming byang gzugs ling 'di la khug khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar pa'i thugs ka nas/ /sprul pa'i pho nya bswe sbal dmar po bdun/ /dgra bo 'gugs phyir gnam lcags rkan sgra rdeb/ /de ring nyi ma phyi dro nub pa'i tshe/ /dgra bo snying gzer shes pa 'tshubs pa'i dus/ /bla rtags bya rigs rnams kyang 'du ba'i skabs/ /sprul pa'i za byed srin por brdzus nas kyang*/ /rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /byad ma'i ming byang gzugs ling 'di la khug khug cig badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /sprul pa'i pho nya zangs kyi a tsa ra/ /dgra bgegs 'gugs phyir lag na zangs zhags thogs/ /do nub mun rub nam stod dus kyi tshe/ /dgra bo gnyid 'thibs rig pa 'thor ba'i dus/ /bla rtags gza' skar rnams kyang bkra ba'i skabs/ /sprul pa'i sgra gcan pho nyar brdzus nas kyang*/ /rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /byad ma'i ming byang gzugs ling 'di la khug khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/ /sprul pa'i pho nya dug sbrul nag po bdun/ /dgra bgegs 'gugs phyir myur mgyogs gling bzhir 'khyugs/ /do nub chu srang nam phyed dus kyi tshe/ /dgra bo sngangs shing spu zing byed pa'i dus/ /bla rtags spyi bdud rnams kyang g.yeng ba'i skabs/ /sprul pa bu yug 'tshub mar brdzus nas kyang*/ /rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /byad ma'i ming byang gzugs ling 'di la khug khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas/

/sprul pa'i pho nya lcags sdig nag po bdun/ /dgra bo 'gugs phyir rwa ni bco brgyad gzengs/ /do nub phyed yol tho rangs sdud pa'i tshe/ /dgra bo'i lus grang nyon mongs 'khrigs pa'i tshe/ /bla rtags khams rnams srid par 'jug pa'i skabs/ /sprul pa sman 'brong srin mor brdzus nas kyang*/ /rang dbang med par dgra bo khug la shog /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /byad ma'i bla gzugs liṅga 'di la phob/ khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ /ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ de nas lha dang dbye ba ni/ hūm̐?/ las kyi gshin rje thams cad dang*/ /bdag gi srung ma thams cad rnams/ /dgra bo'i lha lnga dbang du sdus/ /dgra bo'i yul lha snol du chug /dgra bo'i pho lha byol du chug /dgra lha pham zhing 'thor du chug /dgra bo lha dang phrol la shog /bdag gi grogs byed dam can rnams/ /nyes byed dgra bo dam nyams 'di'i/ /mgon byed yul lha dbang du sdus/ /'tsho byed pho lha dbang du sdus/ /skyabs byed dgra lha dbang du sdus/ /grogs byed ma lha dbang du sdus/ /srung byed srog lha dbang du sdus/ /'phags byed zhang lha dbang du sdus/ /le dgu'i lha srung byad du phob/ bh+yoḥ sdig can dgra bo las ngan 'di'i/ /dgra lha spyi bo'i gtsug nas phrol/ /srog lha snying gi dkyil nas phrol/ /zhang lha lte ba'i gnas nas phrol/ /ma lha gsang ba'i gnas nas phrol/ /pho lha phrag pa g.yas nas phrol/ /mo lha phrag pa g.yon nas phrol/ /bang lha mdzod khang nang nas phrol/ /ban bon la sogs 'go ba'i lha/ /rig 'dzin la sogs srung ba'i lha/ /ma lus rgyab nas phrol la shog bh+yoḥ khā kha mu kha dbang mo che/ /mthing nag chen mo bya rog dbu/ /rtogs med zas su sha la za/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /hu lu mu kha mthu mo che/ /ser nag chen mo 'ug pa'i dbu/ khyod gnyis nyin mtshan med par rgyugs/ khyod gnyis thugs dam dus la bab/ /dgra dang dgra lha phrol la shog

/lus dang srung ma phrol la shog khyo dang chung ma phrol la shog /gnyen dang nye du phrol la shog /phu bo nu bo phrol la shog /mngon spyod drag pos rdul du rlog /e ya ma rā dza ma ma trag rak+sha mā ra ya phyes/ /ma tri ya trag rak+sha mā ra ya phyes/ /ya ma pra ma dgra bo skyob byed kyi lha thams cad phyes phyes/ ki kang ka la hring dgra bo'i srog la nṛ tri trig nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya ba truṃ rbad rbad: ya ma rā dza ha la du tri ka la dgra bo byad ma lha dang phyes phyes: srog snying mgo chod tri thuṃ thuṃ dzaḥ de nas bsad sngags bzlas rjes thun gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ e bh+yoḥ snang srid 'byung ba skar ltar 'khrugs/ /srid pa'i nyi zla cha lang rdeb/ /gnam sa kun kyang lto ba sbyor/ /brjid pa'i ri rab mgo mjug ldog /snod kyi rgya mtsho kun kyang skem/ /rtsi shing nags tshal bun ltar bskyod/ /las kyi me rlung stobs ldan 'ur/ /dug gi rlangs pas snang srid brgyal/ /mtshon gyi char pas skye 'gro gum/ /phyogs bcu kun kyang gshin rje'i zhing*/ /'chi bdag gad mo 'brug stong ldir/ /srog bdag bskal pa'i mun ltar 'khrigs/ /'joms byed pho nya glog ltar 'khyugs/ /gnam lcags dug thun thog ltar 'bebs/ /zi ra tshwa tshwas khor yug khengs/ /btab bo dgra bgegs snying la ya/ /e thun ban+de'i byad ma rbad/ /bh+yo bzlog ban+de'i byad kha zlog /e thun bon po'i byad ma rbad/ /bh+yo bzlog bon po'i byad kha rbad/ /e thun mu stegs byad ma rbad/ /bh+yo bzlog mu stegs byad kha zlog /e thun skye bo'i byad kha rbad/ /bh+yo bzlog skye bo'i mda' zor zlog /e thun bud med byad ma rbad/ /bh+yo bzlog bud med byad kha zlog /e thun gshin rje'i dmod pa'i mtshon/ /e thun dam nyams snying la 'debs/ /e thun dgra bo'i srog la ya/ /e thun byad ma myur du sgrol/ /e ya gshin rje'i dmod pa'i thun/

/e ya dmigs pa'i dgra la 'debs/ /e ya ming shul med par mdzod/ /e thun bzlog go mā ra ya/ /e thun dgra bo ban+dha rbad/ /e thun dgra bo tshan+dha rbad/ /e thun dgra bo ma tha rbad/ /e thun dgra bo da ha rbad/ /e thun dgra bo ha ra rbad/ /e thun dgra bo pa tsa rbad/ /e thun dgra bo shag ti rbad/ /e thun dgra bo a ri rbad/ /e thun dgra bo k+sha na rbad/ /e thun dgra bo tur+ṇa rbad/ /e thun dgra bo rba wa rbad/ /e thun dgra bo i daṃ rbad/ /e thun dgra bo'i tsit+ta rbad/ /e thun dgra bo nṛ myog rbad/ de ltar thun mtshams rnams su thun gtor gzhung ltar khā hi'i mjug tu/ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs las la bskul/ /dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la/ /de ring thugs dam dus la bab/ /gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs/ /pha rol byad ma dam nyams kyi/ /bla srog don snying phrol la shog /gling bzhi 'di yi sa 'og tu/ /rim dgu sa yi mtshams shed na/ /gshin rje'i yi dwags duḥkha can/ /cho nge 'o dod ldir ba'i gnas/ /de yi nang du dgra bo brub/ /pho brang lcags mkhar 'og tu gnon/ /dam nyams dgra bo byad du chug kha la rgyas 'debs ma he'i gdong*/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs zhal du bstab/ /nyi khri dgu 'bum sa ya stong*/ /las gshin sde tshogs 'khor bcas rnams/ /mngon spyod chen po'i dus la bab/ /dam nyams sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ om̐ badz+ra mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ki kang du tri ya ma rā dza sa mā ya dza dzaḥ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ keṃ ra e ti ka la ya byad ma nṛ tri trig thum mā ra ya rbad rbad/ dam nyams dgra bgegs bla srog rnam par shes pa la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bha ling+ta pū dza khā hi/ de nas mnan pa'i sa dmigs su gzhi bdag la dkar gtor phul/ /mnan dongs brus te satwa re thogs la/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /deng 'dir drag po'i las byed phyir/

/phyag g.yas gnam lcags satwa re thogs/ /g.yon pas me yi zhags pa 'dzin/ /g.yas kyi gnam lcags satwa re de/ /srid gsum nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar/ /thog ltar sa la phab pa'i tshe/ /ri rab gling bzhi phyed du 'gas/ /'og gi rgya mtsho mer gyis gsal/ /de nang gshin rje ma lus kun/ /gnas pa bros dbang med pa yi/ /mtha' rnams me yi zhags pas bskor/ /'chi bdag pho brang mngon sum gsal/ de nas dongs su gzhug cing*/ dzaḥ gshin rje'i pho brang srog bdag gnas mchog nas/ /srid pa srog gi bdag po mthu bo che/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo 'jigs byed ma he'i gdong*/ /'chi bdag a ba glang mgo da bzhengs shig /za byed 'chi bdag 'bar ba'i kha gdongs la/ /de ring pha rol dgra bgegs byad ma yi/ /dmag dpon dmag mi yul zhing mkhar khang bcas/ /gshin rje a wa glang mgo'i zhal du bstab/ /dgra bo'i pho rgyud thams cad zhal du bstab/ /dgra bo mo rgyud thams cad zhal du bstab/ /dgra bo'i rigs rgyud thams cad zhal du bstab/ /dgra bo'i gnyen 'brel mthun gsum zhal du bstab/ /dgra bgegs phyugs zhing sgo nor zhal du bstab/ /brubs shig 'chi bdag gshin rje'i kha la brub/ /bstab bo gtad do nam yang ma shor cig /

ces gtor ma la tshwa g.yer sgog pa ram bu sre mong bra ge go thal sogs thun du brub cing*/ e a tri thun ma tri thun nṛ tsa dz+wa la kha thun e/ had pa ka la ya ma rā dza dgra bo he brub kham brub dgra bo dzaḥbh+yo thun/ dgra bo ma bh+yo e thun/ lo rgyal po la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ zla ba blon po la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ zhag dmag mi la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ dus tshod mtshon cha la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ snga dgra lag gis brdar ba thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ phyi dgra zhe la 'chang ba thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ da dgra thad du langs pa thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ dgra mgo thog nas babs pa thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ dgra zur babs kyi sleb pa thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ shar shing khams kyi dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ lho me khams kyi dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ nub lcags khams kyi dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ byang chu khams kyi dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ mtshams bzhi sa khams kyi dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ phyogs nas dmag chen g.yo ba'i dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ dgra sgo dang gyod sgo bye ba thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ dgra bo'i pho lha thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ dgra bo'i mo lha thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ dgra bo'i skyes lha thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ dgra bo'i yul zhing mkhar khang dang bcas pa mā ra ya brub nan/ dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ 'byung po mkha' ru 'gyu bas dgra sna khrid pa thams cad mā ra ya brub nan/ om̐ log tri pā la nan/ nā ga du shan nan/ a mu ka pur thuṃ nan/ bigh+nān trig nan rbad nan bzlog nan/ mā ra ya nan dgra bo kā wa tsi satwaṃ bha ya nan/ zhes lhag med btab/ dzaḥ dam nyams dgra bo mi nor yul zhing bcas/ /'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje nag po la/

/zas skom gtad do ya ma he phruṃ nṛ/ /dgra skal gtad do nṛ tri shag thun rbad/ /dgra bo'i srog la trig thuṃ e khroṃ rbad/ /srid pa spu gri'i 'khor bcas rgyas thob la/ /snod kyi 'jig rten ma stong bar du rgya/ /steng nas srid pa'i ri rab las grub pa'i/ /gnam lcags mchod rten rtsibs stong 'bar bas mnan/ /rgyas btab mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig hūm̐ nan ya nan/ e nan/ sum̐ nan kham̐ nan ram̐ nan/ yam̐ nan/ mā ra ya nan nan/ oṃ ya ma rā dza kī li kī la yā he/ e ha la khaḍ+ga ya sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ pra dun tra nan/ satwaṃ bha ya nan/ mo ha ya nan/ ya ma ye nan/ ma ru tri wa ru ṇa ya tsakra ya nan nan/ dur g.yam dgab cing me chu rlung gsum gyis mnan steng du sāts+tsha rnams kyi dkyil du stag shing gi las phur gzugs la las gzhung bzhin bro rdung bya/ gong gnon gyi gtor ma zor du 'phangs zor mtshams bsrung*/ bshal chu btang*/ me chus rgyas btab/ nang du log la tshe 'gugs dngos grub blang sogs mjug cho ga rnams gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /de ltar dug ri nag po khro 'dus kyi dgra brub las kyi rlung dmar zhes pa 'di ni bstan pa spyi'i dus rim la dmigs pa'i kong nag rgya la rba dongs su mnan gtad brgya rtsa sgrub pa'i lag len 'khyer bder gzhung gi mnan pa'i las rim dug mda' nag po las gnyer bar bsdus shing tshig phrad cung zad kha bsgyur dang*/ med du mi rung ba'i kha 'gengs phran bu snga gter gong mar brgyan te bklag chog tu bkod pa'ang*/ sngags smyon ral pa can thugs mchog rdo rjes so// // nyi) sri mnan skabs 'gugs gzhug bsdus pa ni: na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: khyad par za byed las kyi gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: bla ma'i sku dgra sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra: rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe: dmag sna ston dang jag rkun chom po tshogs:

che sri chung sri dar sri dur sri dang : pho sri mo sri dgra sri god sri sogs: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa gang yin pa: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gar gnas kyang : 'chi bdag pho nya rnams kyis khug la shog: dgra gzugs tha ma'i liṅga 'di la khug: dus la bab bo las mkhan mthu ma chung : om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dza ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya khug: ces bkug lan nyer gcig bya// // ti) rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bhaṭ+ṭā ra ma mañdzu shrī pa ra ma ar+tha stu ti nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ byon pa ma lags bzhud mi mnga'/ /bzhengs pa ma lags bzhugs mi mnga'/ /'jig rten pa las shin tu 'das/ /tshig las 'das pa'i spyod yul lags/ /mgon po khyod la ji ltar bstod/ /'on kyang 'jig rten brtags rten gyis/ khyod ni ji 'dra de bzhin du/ /bdag gis gus pas bla mar bstod/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes te/ khyed la skye ba yongs mi mnga'/ /mgon po gshegs dang byon mi mnga'/ /dngos med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khyod ni dngos dang dngos med min/ /chad pa ma lags ther zug min/ khyod rtag ma lags mi rtag min/ /gnyis med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dmar dang ljang dang le brgan dang*/ /ser dang dkar dang nag ma lags/ khyod la kha dog yongs mi mnga'/ /mdog bral khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khyod ni che dang chung ba dang*/ /sbom dang phra ba khyod min te/ /ring dang thung ba'i khams ma lags/ /tshad med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*/ /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas te/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor mi gnas/ /mi gnas khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos rnams kun la mi gnas shing*/ /chos kun rdzogs par thugs su chud/ /mchog tu zab pa nyid rten can/ /zab pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ de ltar bstod na bstod bgrang gi /gzhan du khyod la ci ltar bstod/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa la/

/su la bstod cing su yis bstod/ /gang la thog ma tha ma med/ /mtha' ma mchis shing dbus ma mchis/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa'i/ /rtog bral khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla ma mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /don dam yang dag mtshan brjod pa'i/ /bsod nams 'di yis 'jig rten 'di/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'dra bar shog / 'phags pa rje 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa don dam pa'i bstod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // thi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi zin bris snang gsal khrag 'thung rngam byed ces bya bzhugs so// dang po brgyud 'debs ni/ na mo: snang zhing bdag sogs nas don thob shog: de nas skyabs 'gro ni/ na mo: bla ma bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed: sogs lan gsum/ hoḥ gdod nas 'khor 'das sogs lan gsum/ de nas dkar gtor btang*/ de nas bgegs gtor gyi 'gugs gzhug / hūm̐ dzaḥ bdag nyid 'jam dpal nas a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ yan lan gsum gyis dgug /bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ bdag nyid 'jigs byed nas u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ de nas srung 'khor mchod pa byin rlabs/ byin 'bebs/ brda sgo dbye ba/ dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum/ 'byung rim lha bskyed spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa phyi mchod dang nang mchod kyi mjug khā hi: bar bdud rtsi sman mchod ni/ hūm̐: dam tshig mchog gi bdud rtsi 'di: nas pha la hoḥ gsang mchod ni/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i? spyan gzigs 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ yaḥ 'jam dpal nas kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ e ya bh+yoḥ skye med ngang la sogs nas bstod do: 'dzab bskul ni/ bskul lo bzhengs shig nas 'grub par mdzod: phrin las snying po'i bsnyen dmigs ni/ gtso 'khor sogs nas ches cher rgyas par bsam/ spyi dril gyi bsnyen sngags ni/

om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka nas hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces ci 'grub bzla gtso bo'i sngags ni/ om̐ hriṣ+ṭi sogs tshe bdag khro chu dgra nag me'i spu gri'i yum spyi dril sgo bzhi sogs bcu cha re bzlas rjes su ngan sngags zhag sgrub nang gi thun gtor ni/ na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa dang : nas khug dza dzaḥ zhes pas tshar gsum 'gugs/ de nas/ hūm̐ dza yig dmar nag sogs nas rdzas su gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gtor ma sman raka nas rgya mtsho chen por gyur: rtsa sngags mañdzu shrī ya mān? dgra bgegs sha truṃ mā ra ya khā hi: hūm̐: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i sogs hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: snang srid khro bo rol pa'i nas dngos grub stsol: badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe sogs shab+da āḥhūm̐: sogs ma hā pañtsa khā hi: las byang gi phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐ yaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya nas rab gus dwang bas phyag 'tshal bstod: mjug tu dbyangs gsal dang rten 'brel snying po yig brgya bcas tshar gsum bzla/ phrin las snying po'i nang nas/ hūm̐ āḥ 'khor 'das sogs nas rtag tu la gnas shog: de nas tshogs grol te mchod gtor bzo/ mchod nas sogs brjes te chu gtsang gtor/ de nas mdun bskyed dang zhag sgrub kyi skyabs sems ni/ na moḥ 'di bzung byang chub snying po ma thob par nas mchog 'grub shog: nas lan gsum brjod/ de nas srung 'khor/ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'jam dpal khro bo nag po yi: sogs nas de nas mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa bstod pa sogs nas/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'dus la bdag bstod do: de nas 'dzab bzla/ hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs? nas dkyil 'khor ngang du gsal: sngags bzla ba ni/ om̐ mañdzu shrī sogs chu bo rgyun dbyangs gsal bzlas mjug thun gtor phul ba ni/ na moḥ rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs nas lan gsum bkug ste kho rang gi rtsa sngags kyi mjug

/dgra bgegs sha truṃ sogs nas hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed tshar rjes bskang gso skor gsum/ mgon po bya rog gdong*/ dregs dpung*/ dge bsnyen gsum/ gzhan yang bskang gso gzhung bzhin bya/ de nas tshogs la 'jug /tshogs byin rlabs ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos rnams dmigs med de bzhin nyid: sogs nas spyan 'dren tshogs mchod bskang ba rngam klong 'bring ba/ om̐ āḥkro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ hriṣ+ṭi sogs nas āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ e ya bh+yoḥ phyogs phyogs dag kyang sogs 'gres rkang bshangs te/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha la bzod par gsol: bshags pa ni/ hoḥ bdag blo gti mug sogs yig brgya 'don/ bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐ yaḥ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje nas a kar+ṣa ya khug: lan gsum 'gugs phur pa phung por gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal sogs nas rbad myog gtub cing mchod/ hūm̐: 'joms byed mtshon cha sogs khā hi sa phul: tshogs la rol/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: sogs nas a la la hoḥ ༈ de nas dgra brub dang mnan pa'i las rim la 'jug pa ni/ bskul gtor lha grangs ltar tshang bar bshams la/ phaṭ nṛ tri dzaḥ na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum dang nas ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ sa lan gsum 'gugs/ na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin sogs nas dza dzaḥ lan gsum/ hūm̐: dza yig dmar nag nas āḥhūm̐: bskul pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo yaḥ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas/ khug la shog: ces gtor ma 'bul cho ga nag 'gros nang gi gser skyems ni/ hūm̐: kun bzang rdor sems chos dang las kyi dbang : nas gzu dpang ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs bskul lo mā ra ya: dgra brub nang gi hom bskyed ni/ phaṭ tri khaṃ nṛ tri dzaḥ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ liṅga bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje sogs nas mā ra ya thun dmod pas 'gugs pa ni/

na moḥ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma sogs nas satwaṃ bha ya nan nan: zhes lan gsum bkug nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e thugs nyid dbyings las sogs nas dza dzaḥ zhes dang*/ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba sogs a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ 'gugs sngags ni/ om̐ e thun he thun sogs nas ya thun brgya phrag tsam bzlas nas pho nya'i gtor 'bul bshams la/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar sogs nas ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bla 'gugs kyi sngags ni/ om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka mā ra ya dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ sogs nas tri thum dza dzaḥ thun gtor phul thun dang po'o/ ༈ sri mnan gyi chog ga nag 'gros ni/ dang po bskul gtor bsham/ hūm̐ e yaḥ gru gsum mthing nag sogs khā hi 'i bar gtor ma 'bul/ de nas gser skyems ni/ hūm̐: kun bzang rdor sems sogs nas gzu dpang ling bskyed dmod 'gugs/ na mo: rgyal ba dgongs sogs nas dza karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ lan gsum/ de nas pho nya/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ thugs nyid dbyings sogs ma mo bzhi bskul/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e mthing nag gru gsum sogs nas a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ 'gugs sngags e thun he thun sogs brgya phrag gi mjug tu thun gtor 'bul/ thun gsum 'di 'don/ dgra brub ltar byed na las kyi rlung dmar dgra brub gong ma'i nang nas/ phaṭ nṛ tri dzaḥ na mo mchog gsum sogs nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo yaḥ 'og min chos dbyings sogs dus las ma 'da' sa ma ya: de nas gser skyems/ hūm̐: phyogs bcu yongs pa'i sogs nas 'grub par mdzod/ de nas brub khung bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'jam dpal nas 'gugs pa/ na mo: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud sogs nas satwaṃ bha ya nan: pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e thugs nyid sogs nas ma mo bzhi bskul/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ ai mthing nag sogs nas kar+sha ya dzaḥ 'gugs sngags e thun sogs/ oṃ mañdzu shrī sogs thum dzaḥdzaḥ thun gsum gyi mjug tu thun gtor 'bul/

de nas lha dbye dang sri mnan gyi cho ga la'ang 'di nyid 'don/ hūm̐: las kyi gshin rje thams cad dang : sogs nas tri thum thum de nas bsad sngags/ mdun du gshin rje'i dmag tshogs sogs nas om̐ ya ma rā dza sogs nas shaṃ long rbad rbad: om̐ ya ma rā dza ha la sogs nas thun bh+yo rbad bh+yoḥ de nas thun brdeg pa ni: hūm̐ e bh+yoḥ snang srid 'byung ba skar ltar sogs nas myog rbad: de nas sri mnan gyi cho ga nag 'gros nang sri can gdug pa can sogs/ om̐ log tri sogs nas/ 'o 'o nyi ma phyogs bzhi sogs nas mā ra ya nan nan: de nas gong ltar thun gtor 'bul/ bzhag nyin par gzhung gi phaṭ nṛ tri dzaḥ na mo: mchog gsum sogs thun gtor 'bul/ āḥhūm̐: bskul pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo yaḥ 'og min sogs nas khug la shog: de nas gser skyems/ kun bzang rdor sems sogs nas gzu dpang*/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud

sogs nas mā ra ya: de nas hom bskyed/ phaṭ tri khaṃ nṛ tri dzaḥ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dho sogs nas hūm̐ phaṭḥ liṅga bskyed/ hūm̐ bdag nyid 'jam dpal sogs nas mā ra ya thun: dmod pas 'gugs pa ni/ na mo: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud sogs nas nan nan: lan gsum bkug nas pho nya 'gyed bskul/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e thugs nyid dbyings las sogs nas a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ ma mo bskul/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e mthing nag gru gsum sogs nas a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ e thun he thun a kar thun/ om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka sogs nas tri thum dza dzaḥ de nas lha dbye ni/ hūm̐: las kyi gshin rje sogs nas nṛ tri myog rbad sogs nas e ya ma rā dza ma ma trag sogs nas thum thum de nas bsad sngags/ mdun du gshin rje dmag tshogs sogs nas/ om̐ ya ma rā dza a kro ta rā dza sogs nas rbad rbad: thun sngags/ om̐ ya ma rā dza ha la ka la sogs nas thun bh+yo rbad bh+yoḥ de nas thun/ hūm̐ e bh+yoḥ snang srid 'byung ba skar ltar 'khrugs: sogs nas e thun dgra bo myog rbad rbad: ces thun brdab tshar nas mar song nas thugs dam tshigs bcad 'di ltar bskul: e ya bh+yoḥ dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya sogs nas dmar ling bsgral zhing liṅga cha gsum bgor mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas las byang nang*/ hūm̐: 'joms byed mtshon cha 'bar ba'i sogs nas khā hi: zhes pas phul te de nas hom brtsegs pa'i nang la cha gcig 'bul ba ni/ e raṃ raṃ dz+wa la ram̐: hūm̐: ho stong pa'i ngang las e mthing nag sogs nas mā ra ya ram̐ ram̐ yan 'don de nas/ sri can gdug pa can sogs nas/ log tri pa la sogs 'don/ ༈ de nas dgra chos la 'jug pa ni/ hoḥ rang nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed sogs nas e khaṃ dgra bo nṛ tri dza dzaḥ gang gi bden stobs/ na moḥ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud sogs lan gsum bkug tshar nas/ dgos chad rnams cha tshang bshams te/ gzhung tshig la bstun cing phyag len byed nas/

hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sogs nas/ tshig mtshams rnams su snga dgra thams cad da brubs shig ces sbyar shes par byed/ ru tra nṛ tri bh+yo zlog nan/ mnan pa brgyab rgyu yin na 'di'i bar brgyab chog yang phyi rol du khyer rgyu yin na/ gong ma ltar zan ling bsgral shog ling bsdus rdzas rnams tshad tshad ma gtogs bcag dkrug ma byed/ phyi rol khyer la/ e ya bh+yoḥ snang srid khyon ltar khor yug gshin rje'i sogs/ tshig dang bstun te phyag len byed cing mjug gtor ma gzhung zor cha dgu ma/ dgongs gsol gtor chen 'phang shog ling bsreg rgyu yod na nang bzhin hom bskyed byas te bsregs/ brtan ma skyong gtor bro srung 'khor bkra shis brjod/ ༈ bzlog pa'i las la 'jug pa ni/ dang po bskul pa me rlung thog char/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: sogs nas rak+ta bha ling+ta la khā hi: de nas bzlog pa spu gri 'khor lo'i nang nas/ hūm̐: bskal pa'i me 'bar sogs nas zlog zlog: de nas yang bzlog thog mda' ni/ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum sogs nas oṃ bzlog yan 'don/ de nas khro chu tshar gcig 'don bsnyen pa cung tsam byed mjug tu bzlog pa bya mā ra ya'i rol mo bya/ gtor zor 'phen skabs/ gzhung bskul btang nas/ rol mo rngam stabs byed cing*/ gtor rar ma phyin bar du rol mo brdungs te/ gser skyems gzu dpang btang nas/ liṅga mdun bzhag ling bskyed 'gugs gzhug byed/ hūm̐: dbyings nas skur bzhengs sogs zor rnams rim bzhin 'phang*/ rbad ya 'don bar 'dir dgongs gsol 'don/ de nas/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ mthing nag rab 'jigs sogs nas/ gtor chen 'phang shog ling bsreg rgyu yod na/ e raṃ raṃ dz+wa la ram̐: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang sogs nas mā ra ya raṃ liṅga bsregs brtan ma skyong gtor bro srung 'khor bkra shis brjod/ ༈ gtor zlog bca' thabs/

dmar gtor gru gang la yum gnyis sbyar de'i phyi rim khro bcu la lnga/ shar du tshe bdag la gsum/ khro chu la gsum/ dgra nag la gsum/ me'i spu gri la gsum/ phyogs bzhir sras yab yum bzhi/ khram bdag bcu gnyis/ sgo skyong la bzhi/ ging bzhi/ bdud pho bzhi/ 'chi bdag bzhi/ shan pa bzhi/ ma mo bzhi/ a tsar bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ sgo ma bzhi/ mtheb skyu/ kyu gu kha phyir bstan gang mang bzhag /gnam lcags rdo rje'i sprul phreng gsum pas mdzad pa'o// // di) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi mnan pa bya ba'i cho ga'i dmar khrid yig chung bzhugs so// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de'ang bsham chog dang liṅga'i bca' gzhi gzhung ltar shes nas/ lta sgom dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dang po brgyud 'debs skyabs sems dkar bgegs nas bzung gzhung ltar bstod mtshams bsnyen pa gang lcogs mchod bstod byas te/ bka' gter srung ma'i mchod gsol grub nas tshogs bya/ tshogs phud phul te bskang ba rgyas pa btang nas tshogs tha ma'i liṅga bsgral bstab byas nas rdo rje slob dpon tshogs la rol/ lhag ma btang ba yan grub rjes/ mdun du bsgral thun mkho rdzas sogs gzhung ltar bshams la/ dang po dkyil 'khor las gzhung gi thugs dam bskul/ gser skyems dang gzu dpang byas nas/ mnan chog nang ltar om̐ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las bskal pa'i me rlung dmar nag tu 'tshub cing zhes sogs/ om̐ hriṣ+ṭi wi kri ta na na ya ma rā dza badz+ra dz+wa la kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ cung tsam bzlas la gzi byin bskyed/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: sogs dmigs pa'i byad ma khug la shog: bar 'don/ hom bskyed bya/ 'gugs gzhug lan gsum mam lnga bdun skabs bstun nas gdong mo bzhi'i gtor ma bshams la/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e thugs nyid dbyings nas ma g.yos kyang : sogs nas dgra bo'i bla dwags a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bar 'don 'gugs sngags/

om̐ e thun he thun sogs 'gugs rtags ma byung bar gong 'og brgya'am long skabs dang bstun bzla/ de'ang 'gugs pa'i dus gnad ni/ tho rangs skar chen shar ba stag chen kha gdang ba'i dus/ zhogs pa shar nas grib so byung ba glag gzan la 'jug pa'i dus/ dgong mo nub nas grib so byung ba srin po'i ltor rub pa'i dus/ srod gdong nag la bdud dmag las la chas pa'i dus te/ dus re la dgugs gzhug drag po lan grangs dang pho nya bskul bar bya'o/ /dus drug la ma mo'i gtor ma bshams te/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sogs ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ gtor ma 'bul/ lha dbye'i sngags sogs bgrang*/ bya rog 'ug sgro thogs nas lha dang dbye ba'i dmigs pa bya/ thun gtor bshams la gong ltar/ phaṭ nṛ tri dzaḥ na moḥ rtsa brgyud bla mas 'gugs/ dza yig dmar nag zhes pas byin brlabs nas/ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs las la bskul: zhes pas bha ling+ta pū dza khā hi: mnan gtor nang du phul nas/ bstod pa nyung bsdus tsam bya/ gdon sri sogs la ni lha dbye ma byas kyang 'gab/ dgra mnan la ni mtshams su lha dbye gtso/ bla 'gugs rtags ma byung bar thun brgyab pa mi 'thad/ de'ang zhag grangs long khom dang bstun/ khug rtags rdzogs nas gong ltar 'gres la/ bsad sngags la 'bad nas/ hūm̐ e bh+yoḥ tshig mtshams thun cung zad 'thor/ snang srid 'byung ba skar ltar 'khrugs: zhes dang*/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas sogs/ dzaḥ srid gsum khams 'dir drag po e yi klong : sogs nas nṛ tri bh+yo zlog nan: bar 'don te/ lo rgyal po la dgra dar ba sogs kyis brub chog byas nas gong ltar thun gtor dang bstod pa bya/ de tsam ma lcogs na/ hūm̐ āḥbh+yoḥ snang srid 'byung ba skar ltar 'khrugs: sogs e thun dgra bo nṛ myog rbad: zhes pas thun brgyab lo dgra zla gshed kyi brub chog dang mchod bstod bcas bya'o/

/bsad rtags thon nas snga ma ltar mnan sngags la 'bad thun brgyab sogs gong ltar 'gres la thun gtor dang mchod bstod snga ma ltar ro/ /mnan rtags rdzogs nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du bsgral chas dang thun rdzas sogs mkho ba'i yo byad mngon 'du byas nas/ rang nyid sngags chas kyis brgyan la rngam pa'i bzhugs tshul dang ldan pa'i ngos nas/ hoḥ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i mdun du sogs/ gshin rje'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya nas/ pho nya 'gyed pa sogs 'gugs bsad mnan pa snga ma ltar thun dbab sogs byas/ phur bu lag tu thogs te/ e ya bh+yo dzaḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya ba: sogs mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces pas liṅga khyab par phur pas bsnun/ zan ling bsgral nas tshogs tha ma'i zhal bstab bya/ shog ling lteb tshig man ngag ltar byas nas la chas btum/ mnan pa thams cad du mi kha brub rdzas bcas bcug /re ba nag po'i thum dang byad thag gis bcings 'om bu se ba rtsang rgya gram du gzir/ bdun zur sprad pa'i mi gnyis kyi g.yag ru la zhags pa nag po btags pa phan tshun bzung nas/ mchod g.yog pas tho ba skam pa gtun khung bcas thogs la/ hūm̐ e ya dzaḥ 'chi bdag 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: sogs nas brub bo g.yag ru'i nang du brubs: zhes gzhung tshig dang bstun nas brdung ba dang 'thags pa sogs bya btags pa'i phye ma liṅga bca' nas slar 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya/ dzaḥ gshin rje pho nya gling bzhir 'gyu ba'i tshogs: bcas mā ra ya rbad rbad: bsgral nas gong gi rdzas dang mnyam du g.yag ru nang du brub/ lo dgra zla gshed brub pa sogs spro na bya/ gtor ma 'bul nyin sgo yi dgra chos spros pa la dga' na phrin las gzhung dkyus ltar tshogs lhag yan grub zin dus/ gser skyems sgo dbye chad mdo'-i gtor ma dpags nas 'bul sar dkar gtor dang bzhengs bskul bya zhing*/ hom bskyed dang 'gugs 'dren bya g.yag ru zor sna la bzhag

/las gtor thogs la/ hūm̐ e ya bh+yoḥ snang srid khyon ltar 'khor yug gshin rje'i zhing : sogs/ deng 'dir drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces sngags dang bcas gtor ma 'bul/ khrag grod bsgral ba ni/ dzaḥ 'chi bdag me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: sogs kyis khrag grod bsgral/ bla thag bcad pa ni: dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i dus la bab: sogs rbad bh+yo mā ra ya: zhes pas bcad/ de nas 'byung ba go ldog ni/ dzaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i dus la bab: nas da non cig: bar 'di'i mtshams su spro na dgongs gsol bya/ zor bzlog ni/ dzaḥ dbyings nas skur bzhengs drag po'i mngon spyod mdzod: sogs nas hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ mthing nag rab 'jigs me dpung 'tshubs pa'i dbus: sogs bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces pas bzlog gtor me hom du phul/ bshal chus brtan ma skyong*/ the'u chung sbrel nas gtor bro brdung*/ khyung chen 'bar bas phyi lam bcad par bya'o/ /mnan pa'i yig chung gzhan du shes la gzhung du gsal lo/ /zhes 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi/ tho brtsegs la khrom̐ bris dgra bo mnan pa'i man ngag phrin las kyi dmar khrid 'di yang skye ba du mar 'jam dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dkon mchog chos 'grub kyi gsung gis bskul ba dang*/ rang nyid kyi brjed thor mkho ba bcas/ gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i zham ring thu bor sngags btsun kun dga' blo gros kyis/ rang gnas khrom gzigs dgon du bris pas lta log dpe rkun slob dpon gsang nas nga rgyal mkhas 'dod kyi khog pa kheng ba rnams 'jam dpal gshin rje 'bar bas tshar gcod 'os so// // ni) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las/ bzlog pa'i zin bris bla ma'i zhal shes bstan dgra bsgral ba'i mtshon cha pha rol g.yul zlog bzhugs so// na mo gu ru rat+na ye/ rgyalam̐ ba rab 'byams mthu stobs nam mkha' che/ /rgyalam̐ kun dkyil 'khor gcig 'dus rta bdun dbang*/

/rgyalam̐ mdzad brtse ba'i 'od stong yongs shar ba/ /rgyalam̐ ba rtsa gsum gling pa mtshan khyod dran/ /chom̐s sku'i rang bzhin dbyings kyi lha lam cher/ /chom̐s kun gong bur gtams pa'i 'od dkar can/ /chom̐s sgo rgya mtsho'i gzi 'bar mi 'jigs mtshan/ /chom̐s 'di snyan brgyud zhal rgyun bdag snying 'phros/ zhes kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog sprul rin po che'i zhal rgyun las/ snyan brgyud yi ge ma 'bri zhes gsungs kyang*/ bdag 'dra rmongs dman ma 'ongs pa'i don du mchod bstod las kyi bzlog pa bya ba ni/ bla ma'i zhal rgyun las/ yar gzhi'i steng du sman raka pañtsa dang gzhan yang bka' gter gyi gtor ma bsham/ mar gzhi stag gzig gcan gzan gyi pags par bshams te/ lcags snod nang du bskang bzlog dmar gtor lha grangs bsham/ 'jam dpal gtso 'khor gyi tsakli 'dzugs/ /gdugs tog phub/ rtsang rtse sha dang liṅgas brgyan/ mngon spyod yid 'khul 'du bya ste/ ༈ da ni 'dod tshogs spel ba ni/ dang po sngon 'gro theg chen dgu ldan dang*/ na mo mañdzu shrī badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ye hūm̐/ hoḥ sems can thams cad sogs nas don mchog shog / bar 'don/ de nas las byang kyi/ na moḥ bla ma bcom ldan 'das nas/ skyabs su mchi/ lan gsum/ hoḥ gdod nas 'khor 'das sogs nas lan gsum bya/ de nas bka' brgyad dkar gtor 'bul/ de nas bgegs dgug pa ni/ gral mthar bgegs gtor bshams te gu gul bdug /hūm̐ dzaḥ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje khro bo yi/ nas gnas 'dir khug / lan gsum/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas 'gugs/ oṃ ya ma ra dzā sogs dang hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ bdag ni 'jigs byed 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sogs nas/ u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ kyis bgegs dor/ hūm̐ ya: bdag nyid 'jam dpal nas srung 'khor dang mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ de nas sha chen gyi gsur btang rol mo bsgrags rkang gling tser/ byin 'bebs pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings

sogs nas a āḥ sogs kyis mi mngon dbyings nas byon te bdag dang bsgrub rdzas la thim par mos/ hūm̐: sngon tshe sogs brda sgo brda phyag lha bskyed nas dkyus ltar mchod/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: dug lnga rnam dag sogs nas khā hi 'i bar/ bdud rtsi lag mchod bya ba ni/ ka ni shes rab sogs kyis bdud rtsi mchod/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po sogs dang lha mo dus mtshan ma sogs kyi rtsa sngags gtor ma 'bul ba sogs nas bstod pa yongs rdzogs byas te bsnyen pa ci nus kyi mthar mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje dpa' bo 'khor bcas la: sogs dang*/ bh+rūm̐ : chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : sogs kyi mthar rtsa sngags sham bur kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: de nas bka' srung sde lnga/ lha mo/ zhing skyong*/ gza'/ dge bsnyen rnams 'don par bya/ de nas mdun bskyed bya ba ni/ khro chu'i/

hūm̐: skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkha' yangs pa ru: sogs nas dkyus ltar rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ngang du byas/ bsnyen pa ci nus bzlas/ de nas tshogs la 'jug pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos rnams dmigs med de bzhin tu: sogs nas dkyus ltar/ ga na tsakra la khā hi: de nas/ hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi sogs nas 'grub par mdzod/ bzhed pa rtsal gyi dregs 'joms bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas rang bzhin rang rig 'dus ma byas: byas byang chub bsgrub pa'i gdong grogs gnyan po mdzod: bshags pa ni/ hoḥ bdag blo gti mug sogs nas tshangs par stsol/ yig brgya bzla/ zhal rgyun las/ dkyil 'khor gcig la gdab las gnyis mi bya gsungs pas/ bsgral ba chen por 'jug pa ni/ hom du liṅga bshams pa'i phyi rol du mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis bskor/ dmar gtor gcig bshams te/ dgra chos las/ phaṭ nṛ dzaḥ na moḥ mchog gsum nas bha ling+ta pū dza khā hi: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas dkyus ltar dkrugs lan gsum bya zhing satwaṃ bha ya nan bar 'don/ e thun he thun sogs nas a kar+ṣa ya thun thun bar brjod/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e stong nyid dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : sogs nas/ a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ bar 'don de nas oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka nas tri thum dza dzaḥ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ e mthing nag gru gsum zhes pa'i le'u ma thon kyang mi 'gal/ de nas lha dbye ni/ hūm̐: kha khā mu kha sogs nas shig rbad bh+yo bar 'don/ de nas e ya ma rā dza nas mgo chod tri thum thum bar brjod/ e ya bh+yoḥ gshin rje 'bar ba sogs kyi e hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces bya zhing dmigs bya gab sbas zin bris ltar bya/ thun rdeg pa ni/ hūm̐ e bh+yoḥ snang srid 'byung ba skar ltar 'khrugs: sogs kyis/ dgra bo byad ma thams cad nṛ trig nan e hur thum mā ra ya bzlog bzlog nan: thun rnams rdeg cing zhal bstab bya ba ni/ las byang ltar/ hūm̐: 'joms byed mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yis:

bka' brgyad kyi rtsang bzlog mos na 'di'i skabs sbyar/ de nas bzlog pa bya ba ni/ khrag sna zung gi chang*/ sha chen gyi gsur btang*/ rang nyid khro bo'i lta gdeng dang bcas gzi byin nus pa'i dpung bskyed pa ni/ oṃ a kro ti ka sogs nas/ mdzod cig drag po'i las kyis mngon spyod mdzod: zhes nas/ e ya ma dang hoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: sogs nas e ka du na e sa bh+yo bzlog: sogs nas bar mtshams kun la bzlog pa sbyar te/ bshags pa'i mjug tu bzlog pa dang bzlog sngags sbyar te/ thal mo brdab/ de nas tshogs la rol/ lhag ma btang*/ bskul dang chos skyong rnams kyi bskul bya/ chad mdo bya/ brtan ma skyong*/ rta bro brdung*/ gtang rag mchod bstod bya/ bkra shis mtha' rgyas bya'o/ /de nas 'bul nyin lhag ma yan gong dang 'dra lhag ma 'bul zhing*/ gser skyems cha snyoms bya/ las byang gi bskul gyis mdos zhal bsgyur ste dpag /de nas bka' brgyad srin mo za lam bya/ chad mdo'i tha tshig bsgrag /dge bsnyen/ gza'/ zhing skyong sde lnga rnams 'bul/ dzaḥ dbyings nas skur bzhengs 'don/ hūm̐ ya: mthing nag rab 'jigs nas pha rol gdug pa'i snying la mtshe zor ya: yang dug khrag /rdo/ me/ chu/ thod/ khram/ mda' rnams rim pa bzhin 'phang*/ de nas/ dzaḥ 'chi bdag 'bar ba'i dus la bab: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra la thun char phob: sogs 'byung ba go ldog dang dmod bcol mos na 'gugs gzhug kha bsgyur te bzlog pa dgra la 'phang bzlog sngags kyis thun rdeg /dar nag g.yab/ brtan ma skyong*/ bzlog gzhung dang gtor snod sbub ste zhing bcu'i sgab 'dre 'gugs/ rta bro bya/ gtor snod kha yar gzed de 'bru 'thor/ yar log ste/ bde chen gsang ba snying po'i bskul gyis tshe ril sbyin/ de nas/ shar phyogs dgra bgegs rū tra bsnol ba'i steng : gsung gi bdag nyid 'chi bdag he ru kaḥ sogs nas yab yum gnyis 'khril me dpung klong du gsal:

oṃ a kro ti ka ya mān+ta ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ā yu ṇi bh+rūm̐ rak+ta hūm̐/ sogs kyis tshe mda'i dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab bsdu chog gtang rag bsngo smon bkra shis mtha' rgyas bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ e ma/ bdag sems rnam par dag pa'i sa gzhi la/ /mchog sprul zhal rgyun char gyi zegs ma g.yo/ /re ba yongs 'gengs zin bris ljang bu 'khrungs/ /zhib rgyas lo 'dab bdud bsgral zhe re tshim/ /rang bzos tshad kyis ngal ba'i 'khrul pa bral/ zhes pa'ang slob rgyud grwa 'khor 'ga' dang*/ rlangs chen dpal gyi seṅge'i gdung du 'khrungs shing*/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i chos kyi bdag por lung gis zin pa'i ngag dbang dkon mchog seṅge mchog sprul rin po che'i thos bsam bsgom pa'i rtsa ba la brten cing*/ lung dang rigs pa'i lo 'dab rgyas shing mtshan nyid sde snod thugs su chud pa/ mngon mtho nges legs kyi 'bras bu smin pa gang des 'di ltar 'bri dgos zhes bka' phab pa dang rten 'byung lha reg dkar po bcas spyi bor bstsal bas/ snga chad ring du song bas da chad sgo gsum gus pa'i nongs bshags dang bcas/ bka' gyen ldog ma nus pa'i khul du pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'i rgyud 'dzin yongs kyi gral gsham/ tha shal rmongs rgan rgyal ming gis bla ma'i zhal rgyun ltar bris pa'o// // pi) 'don bsgrigs kyi zin bris bzhugs so// bla ma dang ni 'jam dpal lhar/ /gus pas btud nas 'chad pa ni/ /bka' srung rnams kyis legs gnang phyir/ /gdug pa bsgral phyir zin tho brtsam/ de'ang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la gtso bor/ gsol 'daibs skyabs sems nas bzung dkar gtor sogs gang rigs kyi rjes/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor sgom/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa byin dbab/ brda dbye/ mjal phyag /pho brang lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod/ rdzas bskul rnams gzhung bzhin grub rjes/

bsnyen tshad 'bum mam khri stong las mi nyung bar bzlas rjes 'khor sngags rnams kyang bzhi cha grub nas ā lis sku'i chad lhag bkang ba/ kā lis gsung gi chad lhag bkang ba/ yig brgyas thugs kyi chad lhag bkang ba'i ched tshar gsum bzlas rjes su/ /mchod bstod sogs skyid grong smyon pa rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub skabs kyi phrin las ltar byas la/ bka' srung nag po skor gsum sogs gzhung bzhin tshang bar btang rjes/ khro chu dug sdong gi mngon rtogs dkyus ltar dang las sngags gang dgos sogs yig chung ltar grub nas tshogs la 'jug par bya'o/ /tshogs byin rlabs spyan 'dren mchod pa bskang ba bshags pa sogs gzhung bzhin dang*/ /bskang ba rgyas pa dkyus bzhin grub nas hom bskyed 'gugs gzhug bsgral ba zhal bstab yan tshar rjes/ /de nas drag po mngon spyod kyi las brtsam par bya'o/ /'di ltar dgos zhes rdo rje'i mtshan can gyi bka' yis bskul ngor/ rig sngags 'chang de yis hom lung dag par bgyis te 'chad pa las dgra bgegs log 'dren bsgral ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // phi) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi 'don bsgrigs zin bris bla ma'i zhal shes ltar a nan ta ma tis sbyar ba/ phrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs la/ thog mar sngon 'gro theg chen dgu ldan gshin rje'i las byang gzhung la 'jug /dang po skyabs 'gro gnyis pa sems bskyed/ gzhi bdag la dkar gtor/ bgegs bskrad/ las byang gzhung la 'jug /gter srung dregs dpung sngags la bskyal/ de nas tshogs kyi ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ nas bzung*/ tshogs phud kyi bar bskang ba rnams 'di ru 'don/ tshogs phud phul nas lhag ma bzhag /'di'i skabs smad las la 'jug /de nas lhag ma btang thugs dam bskul/ dregs dpung gi bskul btang*/ chad mdo brtan skyong*/ rta bro dngos grub len chog gtang rag bkra shis brjod/ bsngo smon bya'o/

/smad las 'don bsgrigs kyi dang po/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sogs nas bden stobs gong 'og gnyis gang mos bya/ phaṭ tri kham̐ zhes pa nas satwaṃ bha ya nan/ oṃ e thun he thun zhes na thun thun yan dang*/ hūm̐ ya bh+yo eḥ thugs nyid dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : zhes pa nas a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar 'don/ oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ki kang ya ma tri dza dgra bo sogs tri thum dza dzaḥ bar 'don/ hūm̐ ya bh+yo eḥ mthing nag gru gsum sogs nas nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ ya ma rā dza zhes nas thum thum bar 'don/ hūm̐ e bh+yoḥ snang srid 'byung ba skar ltar 'khrugs: sogs nas nṛ myog rbad: bar 'don/ oṃ ya ma rā dza a kro rā dzaḥ zhes nas/ bzlog nan bar 'don/ e a tri thun/ zhes pa nas/ satwaṃ bha ya nan bar 'don/ dgra bo brub pa phyi nang gnyis las nang du brub pa ni/ hoḥ rang nyid 'jam dpal zhes nas nṛ tri dza dzaḥ bar 'don/ na mo: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud sogs nas/ satwaṃ bha ya nan bar brjod/ phyag len yig chung dang tshig gis bstun/ hūm̐ ya bh+yo eḥ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dzaḥ srid gsum khams 'dir sogs nas/ e ka ya ma tri tsa na sarba ru tra rbad: zhes pa nas/ nṛ tri bh+yo bzlog nan: ces pa'i bar gtong*/ de nas grub pa'i las yin la de rnams nyin re bzhin du bya/ de nas phyi'i dgra bo brub pa ni/ gong gi thun gtor bkug pa bdag bskyed/ hom bskyed bden stobs dmod pa lcags kyu'i sngags/ bla 'gugs pho nya'i bskul/ lha dbye thun dang bcas pa thun bskyal bsad thun dang sngags song ba'i rjes su/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ gshin rje 'bar ba'i pho nya ba: zhes pa nas/ mā ra ya rbad rbad bar 'don/ 'di'i bar du mnan pa'i liṅga dang bsad pa'i liṅga gnyis yod pa las/ bar 'dir mnan ling chas byas snod gang yin gyi nang du btsud/ rgya chings tshon skud kyis bcings la thum dang bcas/

rang sar bzhag gam bsad ling hom du gzhug la/ e raṃ dz+wa la raṃ raṃ zhes pa las/ hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las? sogs/ mā ra ya raṃ/ zhes pa'i bar 'don/ bsregs pa ci bder bkod/ sgo ru dgra chos bya ba ni/ phyag len yig chung ngam gzhung tshig dang bstun phyag len yongs rdzogs tshar nas thun gtor bsham/ hūm̐ e ya bh+yoḥ snang srid khyon ltar 'khor yug ces/ bha ling gi bar 'don/ thun gtor 'bul/ phyag len yig chung la bstun/ hūm̐ e dza yaḥ 'chi bdag 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: zhes pa nas/ mtha' nas nang du brub yan par 'don/ 'di'i bar du mi kha'i rdzas thams cad g.yag ru nang du brub cing*/ dzaḥ gshin rje pho nya zhes pa nas/ rbad kyi bar bskul/ 'di yan du 'thag pa'i rdzas thams cad zan dang bsre la 'di ltar bzo/ liṅga de g.yag ru nang du bcug /'gugs gzhug lan gcig bya/ kha bcad la rang sar bzhag /de nas lag len gzhung tshig dang bstun la khrag grod bsgral ba ni/ dzaḥ 'chi bdag me ltar 'bar zhes nas bh+yo bzlog gi bar brjod/ bla thag gcod pa ni/ dzaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i dus la bab: nas rbad bh+yo mā ra ya: 'byung ba go ldog ni/ dzaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i dus la bab: nas bh+yo bh+yo bar dang*/ de nas gtor zor bcag la/ dzaḥ dbyings nas skur bzhengs zhes pa nas nṛ tri bzlog gi bar/ de nas zor dmag 'gros 'gying thabs dang bcas/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ mthing nag rab 'jigs me rlung zhes nas bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: zhes pa'i bar ro/ /zor 'phang*/ de ni phyi'i dgra chos kyi skor ro/ /da ni mnan pa'i skor la sa mig gi lam so gzhung dang slob dpon gyi zhal shes man ngag gis brgyan pa ltar dang po gnyan mig tu phyin ma thag / oṃ swa bhā w kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ ces pa'i sngags nyer gcig bzla/ bar 'dir gzhi bdag la dkar gtor gser skyems btang*/ bden pa brdar/ gong gi bden brdar brjod thon na/ sa tshad zhal shes ltar brkos la/

hūm̐: bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: zhes nas/ mngon sum gsal: zhes pa'i bar brjod liṅga mdun du bzhag /gzhung gi bden stobs tshar gcig brjod/ de nas liṅga lag tu thogs la/ dongs nang du bting la thabs dang bcas/ dzaḥ gshin rje'i pho brang srog bdag gnas zhes pa nas nan bar brjod/ oṃ a tri thun ma tri thun zhes nas satwaṃ bha ya 'i bar ro/ /de nas sa dgab mnan chas zur du zhal shes gcig yod/ de nas yig chung dang bstun/ hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje las kyi mtshon zhes nas nam nan gyi bar bton tshar rjes lag len tshig dang mthun par bya/ de nas srung 'khor sgom zhing*/ nang du log khro rgyal dug ri'i lha tshogs la zhes dang*/ hūm̐: 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya: zhes nas a ti pu hoḥ bar phyag 'tshal mchod bstod bya/ de nas phyag len yod tshad zin no/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //
